中国共产主义青年团之关系。

中国共产党是第三国际的一个分支。它是一个代表中国无产阶级并领导无产阶级完成社会革命的政党。
中国共产主义青年团是少年共产国际的一个分支。在中国共产党的指导下，共青团领导所有年轻无产阶级发起社会革命，从事年轻一代的文化工作，并提高中国青年的革命知识。
各国无产阶级已紧密团结起来，建立了一个在共产国际指导下运作的政党——共产党。
中国共产主义青年团是少年共产国际的一个分支，并已承认该组织的政策和规章。它也服从少年国际的命令和决议。
由于中国共产党指导机关近期犯下了被认为相当严重的错误，第三国际立即召开紧急会议，重组了政治局。此外，还采取了一些有力措施来纠正此前的错误。中共中央随后召开会议，接受了第三国际的决定。
预计明年共产国际将减少对中国的津贴拨款。
根据中央通告，今年中国共产主义青年团可派遣二十人前往莫斯科，进入中山大学学习。决定由你们从中选拔一人。至于程序等事宜，将由各省委员会负责办理。必须遵守以下条件：-
1. 候选人必须实际参加过“斗争”，并且必须是逐步晋升至较高职位者。应注意，所选人员的离境不得严重影响工作。
2. 只有1927年以前入党的工人、农民和士兵，以及1926年以前入党的知识分子阶层成员，才有资格成为候选人。
3. 候选人必须具备阅读能力。
4. 候选人年龄不得超过30岁。
5. 候选人不得患有肺结核、沙眼或性病。

(2) 中国共产党与
中国共产主义青年团之关系。

(1) 二者之关系。
党是无产阶级的先锋队。它负责领导整个无产阶级发起革命。团是无产阶级青年的先锋队。它负责领导无产阶级青年参与直接影响其生存的革命运动和斗争。由于无产阶级

youth is only a part of the whole proletariat, so
is the work of the League to the work of the Party.
As the Party has undertaken a great mission - the
mission of bringing about a proletariat revolution -
it can hardly have energy to deal with the large
numbers of proletariat youth. Moreover the youths have their
special positions and economic needs, so it is necessary
that a separate organization be formed to look after
them. Hence the Party and the League each working
independently.
The C.Y. and C.P. are separate organizations.
C.P. is the political party of the whole proletariat.
C.Y. is the only organization of the proletariat youth
which functions under the guidance of the political
party, C.P. (C.Y. is not a political party by itself).
In politics and in all forms of struggles, C.Y. cannot
take independent movement or a policy to which the
Party does not agree. Nevertheless all grades in the
League can discuss policies, etc. and make sugges-
tions to the Party. Organically the League is an inde-
pendent body. The organizations of the Party and
League must have a close contact and the League must
from time to time receive directions from the Party.
C.P. must assist C.Y. in the latter's work. C.P.
and C.Y. should both send representatives to meetings. Where
there is no organization of the Party the League should
undertake the work of organization. If the Party wishes
to transfer League members to undertake Party work,
the approval of the League must be first obtained. The
League should criticize the work of the Party and vice
versa. As the C.P. is the Party of the proletariat and
C.Y. is the League of the proletariat youth, there is
no difference in class. The work of C.Y. is a part of
the work of the C.P.
The political knowledge of the C.Y. is inferior to
that of C.P. so C.Y. must function under the guidance
of C.P. C.Y. is an independent body. Apart from recei-
ving directions from the Party in matters affecting
politics, C.Y. should respect C.P.'s views in all other
matters. However C.P. must not interfere with the
independence of C.Y. C.P. should assist C.Y. in training
work/ C.P. should supply men to C.Y. without injuring
the independency of the latter. C.Y. should discuss
all policies of the C.P. The organizations of C.P. and
C.Y. should be conducted in a distinct manner. We do
not recognize C.Y. members as members of C.P. C.Y.
members must undergo the proper procedure in order to
become members of the C.P.
The abbreviation for the Communist Youth League is
C.Y. and the special name is "Middle School". The
mission of the C.Y. is to lead all young people to bring
about Communism.

(2) Their Distinctions.

According to regulations those members below the
age of 21 belong to C.Y. Those between 18 and 21 wishing to
join C.P. must obtain the approval of C.Y. But we
must not apply the regulations to the letter. The distinc-
tion between University and Middle School depends upon
the nature of work.
If a man's age is fit only for C.Y. but his work in
the C.P. is comparatively more important, he may
concurrently become a member of C.P. In the same way

青年只是整个无产阶级的一部分，因此团的工作相对于党的工作而言也是如此。
由于党肩负着伟大的使命——实现无产阶级革命的使命——它几乎无暇顾及数量庞大的无产阶级青年。此外，青年有其特殊的地位和经济需求，因此有必要建立一个独立的组织来照顾他们。因此，党和团各自独立运作。
中国共产主义青年团（C.Y.）和中国共产党（C.P.）是独立的组织。中国共产党是整个无产阶级的政党。中国共产主义青年团是在政党即中国共产党的指导下运作的无产阶级青年的唯一组织（中国共产主义青年团本身不是一个政党）。在政治和各种形式的斗争中，中国共产主义青年团不能采取党不同意的独立行动或政策。尽管如此，团内各级组织可以讨论政策等，并向党提出建议。在组织上，团是一个独立的实体。党和团的组织必须保持密切联系，团必须不时接受党的指示。中国共产党必须协助中国共产主义青年团的工作。中国共产党和中国共产主义青年团都应派代表参加会议。在没有党组织的地方，团应承担组织工作。如果党希望调动团员从事党的工作，必须首先获得团的批准。团应当批评党的工作，反之亦然。由于中国共产党是无产阶级的政党，而中国共产主义青年团是无产阶级青年的团体，因此在阶级上没有区别。中国共产主义青年团的工作是中国共产党工作的一部分。
中国共产主义青年团的政治知识低于中国共产党，因此中国共产主义青年团必须在中国共产党的指导下运作。中国共产主义青年团是一个独立的实体。除了在涉及政治的事务上接受党的指示外，中国共产主义青年团在所有其他事务上都应尊重中国共产党的观点。然而，中国共产党不得干涉中国共产主义青年团的独立性。中国共产党应协助中国共产主义青年团进行培训工作；中国共产党应向中国共产主义青年团提供人员，同时不损害后者的独立性。中国共产主义青年团应讨论中国共产党的所有政策。中国共产党和中国共产主义青年团的组织应以 distinct（明确区分）的方式运作。我们不承认中国共产主义青年团团员为中国共产党员。中国共产主义青年团团员必须经过适当程序才能成为中国共产党员。
中国共产主义青年团的缩写为C.Y.，代号为“中学”。中国共产主义青年团的使命是领导所有青年实现共产主义。

(2) 二者之区别。

根据规定，21岁以下的成员属于中国共产主义青年团。18至21岁之间希望加入中国共产党的人必须获得中国共产主义青年团的批准。但我们不应死板地执行规定。“大学”与“中学”的区别取决于工作的性质。
如果一个人的年龄只适合加入中国共产主义青年团，但其在中国共产党的工作相对更为重要，他可以同时成为中国共产党党员。同样地

one who is above 21 years of age may in the opinion
of the C.Y. still be a member of C.Y. if his
services for the C.Y. are considered indispensable.
We must understand that C.P. and C.Y. are not two
opposing bodies. They should render mutual help.
C.P. should not obtain new members entirely from
C.Y. while the latter should not expect to extend
its organization by claiming new members from C.P.
Both should get their new members from the masses.
We do not wish to see serious differences occurring
between the University and Middle School simply
because the question of distinction between themselves
has not been made clear. The matter should be
carefully discussed at a joint meeting of the Univer-
sity and Middle School. Although the regulations
should be taken as a basic decision practical work
should be considered when differentiation is necessary.
Where there are no separate organizations
for the C.P. and C.Y. such organizations should be
established without delay. They should not work toge-
ther indiscriminately. Separate registrations should
be conducted in sections, Hsiens, etc.
The age question has changed once and again.
At first the age of 28 was the limit between C.P.
and C.Y. Then 23 was adopted. Lately 21 was decided
upon and hereafter any dispute between C.P. and C.Y.
regarding age can be settled by applying to the new
decision.

(3) Their Mutual Help.

Where there is no organization for C.Y., C.P.
should start the work of obtaining members for C.Y.
and establish an organization for them. C.P. should
assign certain members to be responsible for this work.
The names of these responsible members and the circum-
stances under which the C.Y. organization was formed
should be reported to the Provincial Committee of the
C.P. which should forward same to the Provincial
Committee of C.Y. Afterwards the new organization
comes into direct contact with C.Y. Provincial Committee.
Where there are no organizations for the C.P. the C.Y.
should submit a report giving the names of C.Y. members
who are likely to be eligible for membership of C.P. and
descriptions of their working ability to the C.Y. Provincial
Committee which will recommend them to join the C.P.
After their admission had been formally approved by
the C.P. Provincial Committee contact between the
latter and the new members is established.
C.P. members should be responsible for the following
in connection with the work of C.Y.
1. Advice on political matters.
2. Educational work.
3. Financial assistance to C.Y.
4. Help to C.Y. workers.
5. Inspecting and supervising C.Y. work.
6. Help C.Y. in obtaining new members.
7. Report re work of C.Y. and criticism of work of C.Y.
to higher organs.

年满21岁以上的人，如果中国共产主义青年团认为其对中国共产主义青年团的服务不可或缺，仍可被视为中国共产主义青年团团员。
我们必须明白，中国共产党和中国共产主义青年团不是两个对立的机构。它们应当相互帮助。
中国共产党不应完全从中国共产主义青年团吸收新成员，而后者也不应指望通过从中国共产党索取新成员来扩展其组织。双方都应从群众中吸收新成员。
我们不希望看到仅仅因为彼此之间的区别问题尚未厘清，导致“大学”与“中学”之间出现严重分歧。此事应在“大学”与“中学”的联席会议上仔细讨论。虽然规定应作为基本决策予以遵循，但在需要进行区分时，应考虑实际工作情况。
在没有分别设立中国共产党和中国共产主义青年团组织的地方，应立即建立此类组织。它们不应不加区分地一起工作。应在各区、各县等地分别进行登记。
年龄问题已多次变更。起初，28岁是中国共产党和中国共产主义青年团之间的年龄界限。后来采用23岁。最近定为21岁，此后中国共产党和中国共产主义青年团之间关于年龄的任何争议，均可依据这一新决定解决。

(3) 二者之互助。

在没有中国共产主义青年团组织的地方，中国共产党应开始为中国共产主义青年团招募成员的工作，并为其建立组织。中国共产党应指派某些成员负责此项工作。这些负责人的姓名以及中国共产主义青年团组织成立的情况，应报告给中国共产党省委员会，由其转交至中国共产主义青年团省委员会。随后，新组织直接与中国共产主义青年团省委员会联系。
在没有中国共产党组织的地方，中国共产主义青年团应向中国共产主义青年团省委员会提交报告，列出可能符合加入中国共产党资格的团员姓名及其工作能力描述，由省委员会推荐他们加入中国共产党。在他们正式获得中国共产党省委员会批准入党后，省委员会与新成员之间建立联系。
中国共产党党员在涉及中国共产主义青年团工作方面，应负责以下事项：
1. 政治事务方面的建议。
2. 教育工作。
3. 向中国共产主义青年团提供财政援助。
4. 帮助中国共产主义青年团工作人员。
5. 检查和监督中国共产主义青年团的工作。
6. 帮助中国共产主义青年团吸收新成员。
7. 向上级机关报告中国共产主义青年团的工作情况并对中国共产主义青年团的工作提出批评。

C.Y. should undertake the following responsibilities:-
1. Obedient to C.P. on political advice.
2. Respectful to C.P. on latter's views on C.Y. work.
3. Supply workers to C.P. (C.P. should obtain C.Y.'s approval if C.Y. members are required for C.P.)
4. Assist C.P. in developing C.P. organizations.
5. Organize young labourers sections and boys groups to be affiliated to labour unions.
6. Organize young peasants sections, young men's vanguards, boys groups, etc. to be affiliated to Peasants Committees.
7. Send representatives of branches, Hsiens or Special Committees to participate at joint meetings of C.P. and C.Y.
8. Establish young labourers committee and young labourers sections in labour unions and youth department, boys groups and young men's vanguards in Peasant Unions.
9. C.Y. members in labour and peasant unions should maintain separate C.Y. organizations.
10. C.Y. members who are concurrently C.P. members only pay C.Y. fees.

C.Y. members participating in meetings of C.P. are entitled to vote.
The relations between University and Middle School have been briefly stated. The University should render financial assistance to the Middle School if and when the latter runs short of funds as middle school work is a part of University work.

(3) System of Organization of C.P. and C.Y.

The organization of the Chinese Communist Youth League is similar to that of other branches of the Communist Youth International. It is based on the centralized democratic system. The principles of this system is as follows :-
1. Both high and low officers are elected by general conference of members, conference of representatives and national conference of representatives.
2. Officers thus elected are responsible to the voters and should submit regular reports.
3. Low grade officers should obey and carry out all decisions of their superior officers and those of Executive Committee of the C.Y. International.

Branches of the League are organized according to districts, Hsiens, etc. (Hsien Committees, Provincial Committees, etc.). A Hsien Committee is higher than a branch of the District Committee in the same district.
The highest organ of the League is the general meeting of members, meeting of representatives or the national conference of representatives. The lowest organ is branch committee or district committee which is established in a Hsien or Municipality. Hsien Committee and Municipal Committee are established in a Province. The Provincial Committee receives orders from the Central. There are also Village committees and Factory Committees. Sections and Sub-sections are also established in branches. In the higher offices (those above district committee) there are, besides the Secretary, an organization department, propaganda dept Economic struggle and labour movement department, young peasants department, military department, students department, children's department and women's department.

共青团应承担以下职责：
1. 在政治建议方面服从共产党。
2. 就共产党对共青团工作的看法，尊重共产党的意见。
3. 向共产党提供工作人员。（如果共产党需要共青团成员，应获得共青团的批准。）
4. 协助共产党发展共产党的组织。
5. 组织青年劳工部和童子团，使其隶属于工会。
6. 组织青年农民部、青年先锋队、童子团等，使其隶属于农民委员会。
7. 派遣支部、县或特别委员会的代表参加共产党和共青团的联席会议。
8. 在工会中建立青年劳工委员会和青年劳工部，在农会中建立青年部、童子团和青年先锋队。
9. 工会和农会中的共青团员应保持独立的共青团组织。
10. 兼具共产党员身份的共青团员只需缴纳共青团费。

参加共产党会议的共青团员享有表决权。
大学与中学的关系已简要说明。如果中学经费短缺，大学应提供财政援助，因为中学工作是大学工作的一部分。

(3) 共产党和共青团的组织体系

中国共产主义青年团的组织结构与其他共产主义青年国际分支类似。它基于民主集中制。该制度的原则如下：
1. 各级干部均由会员大会、代表会议和全国代表大会选举产生。
2. 经此选举产生的干部对选民负责，并应定期提交报告。
3. 下级干部应服从并执行上级干部的所有决定以及共产主义青年国际执行委员会的决定。

团的支部按区、县等组建（县委员会、省委员会等）。在同一区域内，县委员会高于区委支部。
团的最高机关是会员大会、代表会议或全国代表大会。最低机关是在县或市设立的支部委员会或区委员会。在省设立县委员会和市委员会。省委员会接受中央的命令。此外还有村委员会和工厂委员会。支部内也设立部和分部。在高级机关（区委员会以上）中，除书记外，还设有组织部、宣传部、经济斗争与劳工运动部、青年农民部、军事部、学生部、儿童部和妇女部。

(1) Branch Committee.

Branch Committee is the unit of organization
in C.Y.L. Branch Committees are found in the
various trades such as Factory Branch, Railway Branch,
Mine Branch, Seamen's Branch, Shop Branch, etc. All
C.Y. members must be members of Branches. Three
or more persons may form a branch but their formation
must be approved by the superior organ. Persons
not belonging to the various trades such as manual
workers, individual employees, house servants, or
educated people, may organize street branches.
For the purpose of carrying out their routine
work, branches with more than 3 members may elect a
secretary among themselves. Branches with more than
five members may elect a committee. One of the
committeemen will be elected as secretary. The secre-
tary and committee will execute the decisions of the
branch, carry out the instructions of superior organs,
distribute the work among the members (distribution of
propaganda matter, printing of propaganda stuff,
investigation of conditions of the masses and
reactionary parties, etc.), obtain new members and get
into contact with branches of C.P.
To maintain efficiency the following rules should
be observed by each Branch Committee :-
1. New members should be admitted under strict conditions.
All members must be registered.
2. Branches with more than seven members must organize
sections.
3. Branches with two or more sections must elect a committee.
4. Branches must discuss the work of the place where the
branch is situate.
5. Branches must discuss how to win over the masses and
lead them to participate in struggles.
6. Branches must establish a contact with District
Committee.

As the branch is the unit of the League, a branch
should be organized before sections can be formed.
If there are more than three members, they form a
branch. When the branch has six or more members, then
sections may be formed.
Each member of C.Y. must be a member of a branch.
The man responsible for the branch must keep a definite
register of membership.

The responsibilities of a branch towards the
public are as follows :-
1. To propagate the principles of the League among the
young masses and obtain new members in order to
strengthen the branch.
2. To act as representatives of the young masses and
engage in economic and other movements beneficial
to the young people.
3. To engage in political movements under the
guidance of superior organs, thereby assuming the
role of leaders in the political movements of the
young masses.

(1) 支部委员会。

支部委员会是共青团的组织单位。支部委员会存在于各种行业中，如工厂支部、铁路支部、矿山支部、海员支部、商店支部等。所有共青团员必须是支部的成员。三人或以上可组成一个支部，但其成立必须经上级机关批准。不属于各行业的体力工人、个别雇员、家仆或知识分子等，可以组织街道支部。
为了开展日常工作，拥有三名以上成员的支部可以在内部选举一名书记。拥有五名以上成员的支部可以选举一个委员会。委员中将选出一人担任书记。书记和委员会将执行支部的决定，贯彻上级机关的指示，在成员间分配工作（分发宣传材料、印刷宣传品、调查群众状况及反动党派情况等），吸收新成员并与共产党支部取得联系。
为保持效率，各支部委员会应遵守以下规则：
1. 新成员的加入应在严格条件下进行。所有成员必须登记注册。
2. 拥有七名以上成员的支部必须组织分部。
3. 拥有两个或以上分部的支部必须选举一个委员会。
4. 支部必须讨论支部所在地的工作。
5. 支部必须讨论如何争取群众并领导他们参与斗争。
6. 支部必须与区委员会建立联系。

由于支部是团的单位，在成立分部之前应先组织支部。如果有三名以上成员，即组成一个支部。当支部拥有六名或以上成员时，则可以成立分部。
每名共青团员必须是支部的成员。支部负责人必须保存明确的成员名册。

支部对公众的职责如下：
1. 在青年群众中宣传团的宗旨，吸收新成员以加强支部。
2. 作为青年群众的代表，从事有利于青年的经济和其他运动。
3. 在上级机关的指导下从事政治运动，从而在青年群众的政治运动中承担领导角色。

pages.en:
-6-

The responsibilities of a branch towards its
members are as follows :-
1. To train and supervise members in League work.
2. To execute the decisions and carry out instructions
of superior organs.
3. To discuss general policies.
4. To hold regular meetings and discuss various
practical measures of the locality and national
and international problems.

The secretary of a branch undertakes all
affairs of the branch. He communicates with outside
organizations and superior organs, to which he
submits monthly reports or makes verbal reports
from time to time. He draws up plans for the training
of members and development of the branch. He assigns
work to members and checks the result of such work.
He calls branch meetings at regular intervals and
prepares the agenda for these meetings. He collects
membership fees and settles disputes between members.

(2) District Committee.

The District Committee is composed of branches
for the various trades, street branches, village
branches, etc. The highest organ in the District Committee
is the general meeting of members of the District
concerned or the meeting of representatives of the
various branches in the district. The District Committee
is elected by these meetings and approved by a superior
organ. Half of the committeemen of a district should
be members of important branches. The duties of a
District Committee comprises supervision of work of
branches, registration of members, calling of meetings,
organization of new branches, keeping of books, etc.
The District Committee should hold two meetings each
month. A Standing Committee should be elected to
look after the routine work. The District Committee
will be responsible to call meetings of the secretaries
of the various branches.
All disputes in a branch should be settled by the
branch itself. When a branch is unable to settle a dispute,
it will be referred to the District Committee.
The District Committee arranges the meetings of the
different branches under its control. The dates of the
meetings are then given to the branch secretaries and the
District Secretary informs the Standing Committee when
they are to attend the branch meetings. Branches forward
weekly reports to the District Committee.
When anything serious happens in the locality of a
branch the District Committee should at once send an
officer to the branch and hold a meeting to discuss
the matter.
If anything happens among the masses in the locality
of a branch the branch secretary should immediately
report it to the District Committee.

支部对其成员的职责如下：
1. 训练和监督成员进行团的工作。
2. 执行上级机关的决定并贯彻其指示。
3. 讨论总体政策。
4. 举行定期会议，讨论地方的各种实际措施以及国家和国际问题。

支部书记负责支部的一切事务。他与外部组织和上级机关沟通，并向其提交月度报告或不定时作口头报告。他制定成员培训和支部发展的计划。他向成员分配工作并检查这些工作的结果。他定期召开支部会议并为这些会议准备议程。他收取会费并调解成员间的纠纷。

(2) 区委员会。

区委员会由各行业支部、街道支部、村支部等组成。区委员会的最高机关是有关区的会员大会或区内各支部的代表会议。区委员会由这些会议选举产生，并经上级机关批准。区委员会的一半委员应是重要支部的成员。区委员会的职责包括监督支部工作、成员登记、召集会议、组织新支部、保管账簿等。区委员会每月应举行两次会议。应选举一个常务委员会来处理日常工作。区委员会负责召集各支部书记会议。
支部内的所有纠纷应由支部自行解决。当支部无法解决纠纷时，将提交给区委员会。
区委员会安排其管辖下各支部的会议。会议日期随后告知各支部书记，区书记通知常务委员会何时出席支部会议。支部向区委员会提交周报。
当支部所在地发生任何严重事件时，区委员会应立即派遣一名干部到该支部并召开会议讨论此事。
如果支部所在地的群众中发生任何事件，支部书记应立即向区委员会报告。

pages.en:

(3) Hsien Committee.

In a Hsien the highest authority is the meeting
of representatives of Districts. This meeting takes
place every three months. An emergency meeting of repre-
sentatives may be called on the proposal of one third
of the organizations of the League in the Hsien or
on the orders of the Provincial Committee and Central
Bureau. The Hsien Committee is responsible to the
meeting of District Representatives. The meeting of
District Representatives of a Hsien elects the Hsien
Committee and representatives to the Provincial
Meeting of representatives or to the meeting of
special districts. The number of representatives to
attend the Hsien meeting is decided by the Hsien
Committee, but such decisions must be first approved
by the Special District Committee or Provincial
Committee.

The Hsien meeting of representatives is held
once in four months. Between the holding of these
meetings the Hsien Committee will be considered the
highest organ of a Hsien. The Hsien Committee must
comprise among others representatives of important
districts of the Hsien. The Hsien Committee holds
monthly meetings and elects a standing committee to deal
with the routine work. The Committee also elects a secre-
tary whose appointment must be approved by the superior
organ.

For the purpose of facilitating the execution
of decisions of the Hsien Conference, Provincial Committee
or Central, a Hsien Committee may form different depart-
ments or sub-committees to undertake the different tasks.
The Hsien Committee submits reports to superior organs.

Where there is a Hsien Committee, a Municipal
Committee is not necessary. All work will be supervised
by the Hsien Committee. A city may be divided into
districts each of which will be controlled by a District
Committee.

A Municipal Committee is organized on lines
similar to a Hsien Committee. It also has district
committees. Where there is already a special district
committee and provincial committee, a municipal committee
is not necessary and the work will be taken over by
the provincial or special committee.

A special district committee is organized in the
same way as a Hsien Committee. A special district committee
assumes the role of a provincial committee and comes into
contact with the central if a provincial committee does
not exist at that place. In that case the special district
committee will be organized as if it is a provincial
committee and will undertake the duties of a provincial
committee.

If there are over 50 members and three branches
a meeting of representatives may be called to elect a
Hsien Committee.

When there are three branches and 30 members, the
provincial committee may sanction the formation of a
Hsien Committee. Three to five important members of the
Hsien will form the executive body. One of them will be

(3) 县委员会。

在县里，最高权力机构是各区代表会议。该会议每三个月举行一次。经该县三分之一团组织提议，或根据省委员会和中央局的命令，可召开紧急代表会议。县委员会对区代表会议负责。县的区代表会议选举县委员会以及出席省代表会议或特别区代表会议的代表。出席县会议的代表人数由县委员会决定，但此类决定必须首先经特别区委员会或省委员会批准。

县代表会议每四个月举行一次。在这些会议休会期间，县委员会被视为县的最高机关。县委员会必须包括该县重要区的代表等。县委员会每月举行会议，并选举一个常务委员会来处理日常工作。委员会还选举一名书记，其任命必须经上级机关批准。

为了便于执行县会议、省委员会或中央的决定，县委员会可以设立不同的部或小组委员会来承担不同的任务。县委员会向上级机关提交报告。

设有县委员会的地方，无需设立市委员会。所有工作将由县委员会监督。城市可以划分为若干区，每个区由一个区委员会控制。

市委员会的组织方式与县委员会类似。它也设有区委员会。如果已有特别区委员会和省委员会，则无需设立市委员会，工作将由省委员会或特别委员会接管。

特别区委员会的组织方式与县委员会相同。如果当地没有省委员会，特别区委员会将承担省委员会的角色并与中央联系。在这种情况下，特别区委员会将按省委员会的方式组织，并承担省委员会的职责。

如果有超过50名成员和三个支部，可以召开代表会议选举县委员会。

如果有三个支部和30名成员，省委员会可以批准成立县委员会。县里的三至五名重要成员将组成执行机构。其中一人将

the secretary, one the organizer, one the propagandist
and two others will take charge of all other work.
The duties of the Hsien Committee are to draw up
plans of work for the whole Hsien, arrange meetings
of the various district committees, send representatives
to attend regular meetings of the district committees,
settle disputes in the districts, execute the decisions
of the provincial committee, assist the districts and
branches to establish communication offices and
secretariats.

(4) Provincial Committee.

In a province the highest authority is the
provincial meeting of representatives. This meeting is held
every six months. An emergency meeting of representatives
may be held with the approval of the Central on the
proposal of one third of the organizations of that province
or on the orders of the Central.
The provincial committee is the highest organ of
a province after the provincial conference of represen-
tatives adjourns. The provincial committee should parti-
cipate in the affairs of important trade branches. and
other League bodies. The number of committeemen of the
provincial committee is decided by the provincial
meeting. The provincial committee holds meetings every
two months and elects a standing committee to deal
with daily routine work. The standing committee elects a
secretary among themselves. The standing committee should
be near the provincial committee of the C.P.
The provincial committee executes all decisions
of the Provincial Meeting of representatives and the
Central Committee, supervises the work of the whole
province, assigns members to participate in the work of
all subordinate offices, etc. The provincial committee
is responsible to the provincial meeting of representa-
tives and to the Central. It should submit a report to
the Central each month. The provincial committee will
if possible publish its own organ or publish some-
thing jointly with the C.P
The provincial meeting of representatives will
also elect a supervisory committee which will super-
vise the provincial committee, Hsien committee, district
committee in financial matters. The supervisory
committee is responsible to the provincial meeting of
representatives.
The standing committee of a province shall be
composed of five persons. Two of them should be
a labourer and a peasant. Three should attend to the
routine work and two should perform inspection duties
outside.

(5) Central Committee.

The Central Committee is the highest organ after
the adjournment of the National Conference of represen-
tatives. It is elected by the National Conference of
representatives. The duties of the Central Committee
are to supervise the political and organization work of
the League for the whole country, organize and maintain

秘书一人，组织员一人，宣传员一人，另有两人负责处理其他所有工作。
县委员会的职责是为全县制定工作计划，安排各区委员会的会议，派遣代表参加区委员会的定期会议，解决各区内的纠纷，执行省委员会的决定，协助各区和支部建立通讯处和秘书处。

(4) 省委员会。

在一个省内，最高权力机构是省代表大会。该会议每六个月召开一次。经中央批准，在该省三分之一组织提议下，或根据中央命令，可召开紧急代表会议。
在省代表大会休会期间，省委员会是全省的最高机关。省委员会应参与重要行业分支及其他青年团机构的事务。省委员会委员的人数由省代表大会决定。省委员会每两个月举行一次会议，并选举常务委员会处理日常事务。常务委员会在委员中选举一名秘书。常务委员会应与共产党省委保持密切联系。
省委员会执行省代表大会和中央委员会的所有决定，监督全省的工作，指派成员参与所有下属机构的工作等。省委员会对省代表大会和中央负责。它应每月向中央提交报告。如果可能，省委员会将出版自己的机关刊物，或与共产党联合出版某些刊物。
省代表大会还将选举一个监察委员会，负责在财务方面监督省委员会、县委员会和区委员会。监察委员会对省代表大会负责。
一个省的常务委员会应由五人组成。其中两人应为工人和农民。三人负责日常工作，两人在外履行视察职责。

(5) 中央委员会。

全国代表大会休会后，中央委员会是最高机关。它由全国代表大会选举产生。中央委员会的职责是监督青年团在全国范围内的政治和组织工作，组织和维持

a publishing bureau, control the central treasury
and distribute the necessary working staff. The
number of members and that of reserves for the Central
Committee are decided by the National Conference.
During the absence of a regular member, a reserve takes
his place. The general meeting of the Central Committee
is held every three months. Reserve members may attend
but they are not allowed to vote. The Central Committee
elects a standing committee amongst themselves. The
standing committee forms the Central Bureau. The
Central Bureau will be located at the place where the
C.P. Central is situated. The general meeting of the
Central Committee has the right to change the members
of the Central Bureau. The Central Bureau is responsible
to the Central Committee and should be in constant touch
with the political bureau of the C.P.
For the purpose of facilitating the supervision
of the work of the various subordinate offices the Central
will establish a secretariat, an organization department,
a propaganda department, an economic struggle committee,
a village work committee, a military committee, a women's
committee, a children's work committee, etc. The various
departments or committees will carry out the decisions of
the Central. The chiefs of the departments and committees
are appointed by the Central Bureau and if possible
their positions will be given to members of the Central
committee. The Central Committee and Central Bureau
jointly elect a chief secretary.
The Central Committee should publish a periodical
for the young labourers and peasants and besides should
issue a regular 'correspondence' to serve as reference
for the supervising organs of the League.
For the purpose of facilitating the supervision
work in the various provinces the Central Committee may
establish Central Executive Bureaux (such as North China
Bureau, Yangtsze Bureau, etc.) or appoint special
Central Commissioners. These officers are responsible
to the Central.
For political reasons the Central Headquarters will not
for the time being not shifted to Shanghai.
Recently the Central Committee at Hankow decided to
establish a Northern Bureau, a Southern Bureau and a
Communication Bureau in Shanghai. The correspondence
between the Central and the Northern Bureau. Southern
Bureau and Kiangsi, Chekiang, Fokien and Anhwei should
be transmitted through the Shanghai Communication Bureau
which should receive in each case a duplicate copy of
the correspondence thus transmitted. The Shanghai Communi-
cation Bureau was formally established on August 26.
The Central Bureau has been shifted to Shanghai.
Today (October 25) the standing committee will hold its
first meeting at Shanghai.

(6) National Conference.

According to regulations the National Conference
will be held once a year. The number of representatives
will be decided by the Central. If the National Conference
is held a short time previous to the National Conference
of representatives or the conference of the Communist
Youth International it will elect the representatives

一个出版局，控制中央金库并分配必要的工作人员。中央委员会的正式委员和候补委员的人数由全国代表大会决定。在正式委员缺席期间，由候补委员接替其职位。中央委员会全体会议每三个月召开一次。候补委员可以列席，但无表决权。中央委员会在其成员中选举产生常务委员会。常务委员会组成中央局。中央局设在中共中央所在地。中央委员会全体会议有权变更中央局的成员。中央局对中央委员会负责，并应与共产党的政治局保持经常联系。
为了便于监督各下属机构的工作，中央将设立秘书处、组织部、宣传部、经济斗争委员会、乡村工作委员会、军事委员会、妇女委员会、儿童工作委员会等。各部门或委员会将执行中央的决定。各部门和委员会的负责人由中央局任命，如果可能，这些职位将由中央委员会成员担任。中央委员会和中央局共同选举一名总秘书。
中央委员会应为青年工人和农民出版一种期刊，此外还应发行定期的“通讯”，作为青年团监督机构的参考。
为了便于监督各省的工作，中央委员会可设立中央执行局（如华北局、长江局等）或任命专门的中央特派员。这些官员对中央负责。
出于政治原因，中央总部暂时不迁往上海。
最近，汉口的中央委员会决定在上海设立北方局、南方局和交通局。中央与北方局、南方局以及江西、浙江、福建和安徽之间的通信，应通过上海交通局传递，该局在每种情况下都应收到所传递信件的副本。上海交通局于8月26日正式成立。
中央局已迁至上海。
今天（10月25日），常务委员会将在上海举行第一次会议。

(6) 全国大会。

根据规定，全国大会每年召开一次。代表人数由中央决定。如果全国大会在全国代表大会或共产主义青年国际会议召开前不久举行，它将选举出席

to attend these conferences. All resolutions of
the National Conference must be approved by the
Central Committee.

(7) National Conference of
Representatives.

The National Conference of representatives is
the highest authority of the League. It is held once
a year with the approval of the Communist Youth
International. An emergency National Conference of
representatives may be held on orders of the executive
committee of the Communist Youth International or on
the proposal of over half of the League organizations
of the whole country. The emergency meeting must be sanc-
tioned by the Communist Youth International.
The National Conference of representatives had the
right to pass resolutions only when a majority of the
representatives from the various provinces are present.
The number of representatives is decided by the Central.
The National Conference of Representatives is
held to :
1. pass the reports of the Central Committee and Central
Supervisory Committee.
2. decide the general policy and questions regarding regulations
3, decide the political policy and problems of organization,
etc of the Party and League and pass resolutions on
the working policy for the whole League.
4. elect the Central Committee and Central Supervisory
Committee.
5. elect representatives to attend the Communist Youth
International Conference and conference of represen-
tatives of the C.P.
The representatives attending the National
Conference are elected by the Provincial Meeting of
representatives. Under present conditions, however,
these representatives may be appointed by the Provincial
Committees with the approval of the Communist Youth
International. An emergency National Conference may
take place of a National Conference of representatives
with the approval of the Communist Youth International.
If a member of the Central Committee is elected
by a local organization to act as representative to the
National Conference of representatives he will not
be entitled to vote.
The sessions of the 6th National Conference of
Representatives lasted 22 days and were attended by 84
representatives. Amongst the 84 representatives, there
were 10 peasants, a large number of labourers and a small
number of the intellectual class.
Provinces represented included Kiangsu, Chekiang,
Fokien, Kwangtung, Kiangse, Anhwei, Hunan, Hupeh,
Yunnan, Kweichow, Shensi, Chili, Szechuen, Shantung,
Honan, Shanse, Inner Mongolia and Manchuria.

(8) Communist International Conference.

When a local organization disagrees with the
decisions of its superior organ either in the party or
League, it can appeal as far as the Communist Youth
International Conference.
The 7th Conference of the C.I. held last year and the
5th conference of the C.C.P. held this year have both

这些会议的代表。全国大会的所有决议必须经中央委员会批准。

(7) 全国代表大会。

全国代表大会是青年团的最高权力机构。经共产主义青年国际批准，每年召开一次。根据共产主义青年国际执行委员会的命令，或根据全国半数以上青年团组织的提议，可召开紧急全国代表大会。紧急会议必须得到共产主义青年国际的批准。
只有当来自各省的大多数代表出席时，全国代表大会才有权通过决议。代表人数由中央决定。
召开全国代表大会的目的如下：
1. 审议中央委员会和中央监察委员会的报告。
2. 决定总体政策和有关规章制度的问题。
3. 决定党和青年团的政治政策和组织问题等，并通过关于全青年团工作政策的决议。
4. 选举中央委员会和中央监察委员会。
5. 选举代表出席共产主义青年国际会议和共产党代表大会。
出席全国代表大会的代表由省代表大会选举产生。然而，在目前条件下，这些代表可由省委员会提名，并经共产主义青年国际批准。经共产主义青年国际批准，紧急全国代表大会可取代全国代表大会。
如果中央委员会成员被地方组织选为全国代表大会的代表，他将没有表决权。
第六届全国代表大会的会期持续了22天，共有84名代表出席。在这84名代表中，有10名农民，大量工人，以及少数知识分子阶层。
代表的省份包括江苏、浙江、福建、广东、江西、安徽、湖南、湖北、云南、贵州、陕西、直隶、四川、山东、河南、山西、内蒙古和满洲。

(8) 共产国际会议。

当地方组织在党或青年团内对其上级机关的决定有异议时，它可以一直上诉至共产主义青年国际会议。
去年召开的共产国际第七次会议和今年召开的中共第五次会议都

pointed out the necessity of performing the
following important tasks during the transition
period of the revolutionary movement : a land revo-
lution by peasants, struggles by the labouring
class in order to remove all kinds of oppression
and slavery, destruction of the feudal systems and
the imperialistic economic foundations, obtaining
the leadership of the proletariat of China.

(9) Special Committees.

1. As the territory in Southern and Western
Chekiang is very large and communication is
difficult between there and the Provincial Committee,
it has been decided to establish a Special Committee
at Linhai (Southern Chekiang) and Lanchi (Western
Chekiang).
2. A Special Committee shall be composed of five
persons (one of them must be a city labourer). If a
Special Committee is situated at a certain Hsien, it func-
tions concurrently as a Hsien Committee for that Hsien.
3. The duties of a Special Committee are as follows:-
a. undertakes all affairs at the place of its location.
b. plans and supervises the work of all Hsiens under
its control.
c. restores League organizations in the neighbouring
areas.
d. draws up working plans weekly or monthly to be
carried out by the Hsiens.
e. decides the policies of struggles of the different
Hsiens.
4. The relations between a Special Committee and the
Provincial Committee are as follows :-
a. The Special Committee receives direct orders
from the Provincial Committee and executes these orders
and plans formulated by the Provincial Committee.
It also instructs the Hsiens to do the samething.
b. The Special Committee after receiving the
orders and plans for work from the provincial commi-
ttee will discuss them with a view to devising
practical ways to execute them.
c. The Special Committee should be in close touch
with the Provincial Committee, to which it should
report from time to time the progress of its work
etc. (Reports should be submitted every week and at
the end of each month).
d. The Special Committee should send a man every
month to make a report to the Provincial Committee.
Such a messenger may also be sent to the Provincial
Committee on special occasions. Each month or every
two months the Provincial Committee will
detail an officer to the various districts of the
Special Committee to make a tour of inspection.
5. Relations between the Special Committee and
Provincial Committee and the various districts:-
a. All Hsiens under a Special Committee should apart from
reporting to the Special Committee, submit monthly
reports to the Provincial Committee and execute
all orders received directly from the Provincial
Committee.
b. All Hsiens should after receiving orders, etc. from
the Special and Provincial Committees discuss and
decide as to the best and most practical method
to carry them out.

指出了在革命运动过渡时期执行以下重要任务的必要性：农民的土地革命，劳动阶级为消除各种压迫和奴役而进行的斗争，摧毁封建制度和帝国主义的经济基础，取得中国无产阶级的领导权。

(9) 特别委员会。

1. 由于浙江南部和西部的地域非常辽阔，且与省委员会之间的交通困难，决定在临海（浙南）和兰溪（浙西）设立特别委员会。
2. 特别委员会应由五人组成（其中一人必须是城市工人）。如果特别委员会设在某个县，它同时兼任该县的县委员会职能。
3. 特别委员会的职责如下：
a. 处理其所在地的所有事务。
b. 规划和监督其管辖下所有县的工作。
c. 恢复邻近地区的青年团组织。
d. 制定每周或每月的工作计划，供各县执行。
e. 决定不同县的斗争政策。
4. 特别委员会与省委员会的关系如下：
a. 特别委员会直接接受省委员会的命令，并执行省委员会制定的这些命令和计划。它还指示各县做同样的事情。
b. 特别委员会在收到省委员会的命令和工作计划后，将进行讨论，以 devise 切实可行的执行方法。
c. 特别委员会应与省委员会保持密切联系，并不时向其报告工作进展等。（报告应每周提交，并在每月月底提交）。
d. 特别委员会每月应派一人向省委员会汇报。在特殊情况下，也可向省委员会派遣此类信使。省委员会每月或每两个月将派遣一名官员到特别委员会的各个辖区进行巡视检查。
5. 特别委员会、省委员会与各区之间的关系：
a. 特别委员会辖下的所有县，除了向特别委员会报告外，还应向省委员会提交月度报告，并执行直接从省委员会收到的所有命令。
b. 所有县在收到特别委员会和省委员会的命令等后，应讨论并决定执行这些命令的最佳和最实际的方法。

c. If a Hsien receives orders from both the
Special and Provincial Committee on the same
subject but with different views, a report
giving its opinion should be forwarded to
both committees. The Provincial Committee will give
the final decision.
d. The Special Committee should forward ████ to the
Provincial Committee duplicate copies of all
written advices, etc. sent to the different
Hsien Committees.

It is the opinion of the Central that Special
Committees should be abolished. But this change for
the time being will seriously affect the work of the
League. Furthermore it is necessary for a Special
Committee to take charge concurrently of the work
of a Hsien Committee. For this reason the Special
Committees in Southern and Western Chekiang are also
discharging the duties of the Hsien Committees.
Special Committees are only a temporary arrangement.
They are not permanent organizations. Special Committees
are formed at Chekiang owing to the difficulty of
communication. Places like Taichow and Wenchow are a
long way off from the Provincial Committee and any
communication must pass through Shanghai. For this
and other reasons special committees cannot be abolished
for the present. The instructions from the Central
regarding the abolition of special committees will
therefore be carefully discussed by the Provincial
Committee and probably a decision will not be reached
until after the Autumn harvest.

(10) Inspectors.

Inspectors are appointed to ensure that the
orders, plans and policies of higher organs may
be efficiently carried out by the lower organs
including branches.
The Central, Provincial, Hsien and Special
Committees must each have a number of inspectors.
Central must have 5 inspectors, Kwangtung, Hunan, Hupeh
and Kiangsu must each have 6, Kiangse, Honan, Chili,
Shantung, Chekiang and Szechuen must each have 4,
other provinces 3 each, Special and Hsien Committees
must each have from 2 to 4 inspectors.
Inspectors are appointed by the organs by whom
they are sent out.
Inspectors should not act as members of Committees
of outside districts without the approval of the
organs by whom they are appointed.

c. 如果一个县同时收到特别委员会和省委员会关于同一事项但观点不同的命令，应将其意见报告呈送这两个委员会。由省委员会作出最终决定。
d. 特别委员会应向省委员会转交 ████ 发给各县委员会的所有书面指示等的副本。

中央认为特别委员会应予撤销。但这一变动目前将严重影响团的工作。此外，特别委员会有必要兼管县委员会的工作。因此，浙南和浙西的特别委员会也在履行县委员会的职责。特别委员会只是临时安排。它们不是永久性的组织。在浙江设立特别委员会是由于通讯困难。台州和温州等地距离省委员会很远，任何通讯都必须经过上海。由于这个原因和其他原因，特别委员会目前不能撤销。因此，省委员会将仔细讨论中央关于撤销特别委员会的指示，可能在秋收之后才会作出决定。

(10) 视察员。

任命视察员是为了确保上级机关（包括支部）的命令、计划和政策能被下级机关有效执行。
中央、省、县和特别委员会都必须有一定数量的视察员。中央必须有5名视察员，广东、湖南、湖北和江苏各必须有6名，江西、河南、直隶、山东、浙江和四川各必须有4名，其他各省各3名，特别委员会和县委员会各必须有2至4名视察员。
视察员由派遣他们的机关任命。
未经任命机关批准，视察员不得担任外区委员会的成员。

13.
SECRET METHODS OF THE COMMUNIST PARTY AND THE
COMMUNIST YOUTH LEAGUE.

One of the proposals of the Second Extended
Conference held in China reads as follows:-
"To carry out organization work in a secret manner
does not mean to curtail the sphere of activities or to
suspend the work of the League or to reduce the chances
for open activities. On the contrary it will keep
our organizations safer and farther away from the
military and police so that we will be abled to extend
our activities, increase our directive power, and get
into closer touch with the masses."

The organization of the Communist Party needs to
be firm and to observe secrecy in order to avoid the
cruel and oppressive measures of the ruling classes, the
Fasciste and other cliques. By observing secrecy it
does not follow that we are to close our doors and do
nothing except keep membership forms in our boxes, we
should observe the following rules:-
1) The regular organic connections between Party Branches
and between members are to be kept secret so as to
avoid detection by enemies and to alleviate sacrifice
should discovery be made.
2) While observing secrecy the Party is required to
establish, through the medium of the Branches of the
Party and the League, close connections with non-Party
mass organizations and public or semi-public bodies
to enable them to receive orders from the Party.
Every member of the Party is required to do a part of
the work and the Party should be made the centre of
the masses.

Inattention to secret methods in former days often
resulted in trouble; therefore, we should now pay special
attention to secrecy which will insure us against losses.

It appears that the branches at various places
fail to observe the rules of secrecy thus affecting the
work of the League.

The secrets of the organization of the League
should never be disclosed to the masses. In areas
already occupied the League is to carry out its activities
as openly as possible, but at the same time it has to
take the following precautions:-
1) To establish secret organs.
2) In order that their identities may remain secret
responsible comrades should not take any part in public
activities.
If the above rules are fully observed the
organization of the League will not be completely upset
should anything unexpected happen.

Secrecy relating to Offices and Residences

In the Russian Communist Party the method of
intercommunication between the various branches has been
so perfected that its enemies are bewildered. For
instance, "A" is an important organ while "B", "C", "D",
"E", "F", and "G" are subsidiary organs, but not all
these know the location of "A". "C" only knows "B" but
does not know "A"; "D" only knows "C" but does not know
"B"; "E" only knows "D" but does not know "C"; "F" only
knows "E" but does not know "D"; "G" only make arrangements

共产党和共产主义青年团的秘密工作方法。

在中国举行的第二次扩大会议的一项提议如下：-
“以秘密方式进行组织工作并不意味着缩小活动范围或停止团的工作或减少公开活动的机会。相反，这将使我们的组织更安全，远离军警，从而使我们能够扩展活动，增加指导力量，并与群众建立更紧密的联系。”

共产党的组织需要严密并遵守保密规定，以避免统治阶级、法西斯分子和其他派系的残酷压迫措施。遵守保密规定并不意味着我们要闭门不出，除了把会员表锁在箱子里外什么都不做，我们应该遵守以下规则：-
1) 党支部之间以及党员之间的常规组织联系要保持秘密，以避免被敌人察觉，并在被发现时减轻牺牲。
2) 在遵守保密规定的同时，党需要通过党支部和团支部的媒介，与非党的群众组织和公共或半公共团体建立密切联系，使它们能够接受党的命令。每个党员都要承担一部分工作，党应成为群众的中心。

过去对秘密方法的忽视常常导致麻烦；因此，我们现在应特别注意保密，以确保我们免受损失。

看来各地的支部未能遵守保密规则，从而影响了团的工作。

团的组织机密绝不应向群众泄露。在已占领的地区，团要尽可能公开地开展活动，但同时必须采取以下预防措施：-
1) 建立秘密机关。
2) 为了保持身份秘密，负责同志不应参与任何公开活动。
如果充分遵守上述规则，即使发生意外情况，团的组织也不会完全崩溃。

关于办公室和住所的保密

在俄国共产党中，各支部之间的联络方法已经完善到令其敌人困惑的地步。例如，“A”是一个重要机关，而“B”、“C”、“D”、“E”、“F”和“G”是附属机关，但并非所有这些机关都知道“A”的位置。“C”只知道“B”而不知道“A”；“D”只知道“C”而不知道“B”；“E”只知道“D”而不知道“C”；“F”只知道“E”而不知道“D”；“G”只就

pages.en:
14.
relating to various matters but does not know the
whereabouts of "A", "B", "C", or others.
The publication organs in Russia adopted such a
system of organization and were therefore able to
remain intact during troublesome times.

Our League should at once learn this system of
organization. All organs such as offices, communication
offices, and secret archives as well as residential
addresses of responsible comrades should be isolated.

All houses should be perfectly equipped and contain
a number of articles which might be useful as camouflage.
Offices should be made absolutely secret and all documents
after perusal should be very carefully put up. If we
pay attention to these trivial matters we might escape
punishment in case of arrest by accident or search.

All organs such as communication offices, arts
sections, secretariats and residences of responsible
comrades should be separated from one another. No
documents must be kept in communication offices.

On no occasion should more than one responsible
comrade live at any singe address.

Fictitious names should be used to designate various
organs to avoid discovery by detectives. Addresses of
secret organs are not to be given to anybody unless it is
absolutely necessary and only a minimum quantity of
documents is to be kept in such organs. Lists of names
or addresses of League members should not be kept. If
it is necessary to keep them they should be made out in
secret characters or codes.

All organs should have a "second defence line", that
is--there should be secret communication offices, working
offices, and archives ready for use in case of emergency.

Responsible persons and organs of the League should
be known only to the necessary persons and this number
must be kept as small as possible.

In carrying out struggles the rules of secrecy should
be more strictly observed. Particulars of responsible
persons or organs should in no way be disclosed to non-
comrades.

Every comrade should lead the masses to act on the
views of the public bodies by observing the resolutions
of senior organs.

We have to shift our secret offices from time to
time.

Writings of consequences should not be thrown away
freely in order to avoid disclosure. A member should
not write his own name and address or the addresses of
organs in his notebook. It would be much better to
memorize or to write them in shorthand or in secret
signs or with incorrect house numbers etc.

Hereunder is a list of fictitious names for organs
to replace the old ones which have now been cancelled:-

俄国的出版机关采用了这种组织体系，因此在动荡时期得以保全。

我们的团应立即学习这种组织体系。所有机关，如办公室、通讯处和秘密档案室，以及负责同志的居住地址，都应相互隔离。

所有房屋都应配备齐全，并包含一些可用作伪装的物品。办公室应绝对保密，所有文件在阅读后应非常小心地收好。如果我们注意这些琐碎的事情，在意外被捕或搜查时可能会逃脱惩罚。

所有机关，如通讯处、艺术科、秘书处和负责同志的住所，都应彼此分开。通讯处不得保存任何文件。

任何情况下，一个地址不得居住超过一名负责同志。

应使用假名来指代各种机关，以避免被侦探发现。除非绝对必要，否则不得向任何人提供秘密机关的地址，且此类机关内只应保存最少量的文件。不得保存团员姓名或地址名单。如果必须保存，应使用密写或密码编写。

所有机关都应有“第二道防线”，即——应备有秘密通讯处、工作办公室和档案室，以备紧急情况下使用。

团的负责人和机关只应为必要的人员所知，且人数必须保持在尽可能少的水平。

在进行斗争时，应更严格地遵守保密规则。负责人或机关的详细情况绝不得向非同志泄露。

每个同志都应通过遵守上级机关的决议，引导群众按照公共团体的观点行事。

我们必须不时更换秘密办公室。

重要文件不得随意丢弃，以免泄露。成员不得在笔记本上写下自己的姓名和地址或机关的地址。最好将其记在脑子里，或用速记、秘密符号、错误的门牌号等方式记录。

Secrecy of Documents

Executive organs of various grades should keep all documents in secluded places to be known to as few persons as possible. However, arrangements should be made that if one or two comrades are arrested there are still others who know the places.

Circulars or letters of various bodies which are not useful for future reference should be destroyed after perusal or after keeping them for a number of days. Documents of a dangerous nature should never be thrown into wastepaper baskets without first being torn to pieces for it is feared that somebody might pick them up to read. Literature bearing on theories without practical information may sometimes be kept but care must be taken that the discovery of such literature will not lead to the discovery of organs or individuals.

The mailing of circulars, letters, and printing matters through the post may cause not only miscarriage or delay but also great dangers. Therefore we should observe the following measures:-
1) To try our best to find school-mates or other reliable persons to act as medium. During a serious period the best way is to organize secret communications and to use various means of delivering messages in secrecy.
2) All letters should be addressed c/o shops or schools. It is inadvisable to address letters direct to places or persons.
3) If a number of circulars etc. are to be mailed at the same time, wrappers or covers of different colours should be used. They should be mailed at pillar boxes in different districts.
4) The name and address of the sender should not be given in full.
5) The name and address etc. on the outside cover should be written in such a common manner that will not attract the attention of others.
6) Envelopes etc. bearing false headings of business concerns or schools might be used, but one false address should not be used for too long a time. The use of suitable false headings is to be decided by the nature or contents of the matter to be mailed.
7) Investigations must be made to ascertain whether letters or other mail matter duly reach the addressee.

文件保密

各级执行机关应将所有文件保存在隐蔽的地方，知情人越少越好。然而，应作出安排，即使有一两名同志被捕，仍有其他人知道这些地方。

各类团体供日后参考无用的通告或信件，应在阅读后或保存数天后销毁。危险性质的文件在撕碎前绝不得扔进废纸篓，因为担心有人可能会捡起来阅读。涉及理论而无实际信息的文献有时可以保留，但必须注意，此类文献的发现不会导致机关或个人被发现。

通过邮政邮寄通告、信件和印刷品不仅可能导致误投或延误，还会带来巨大危险。因此，我们应采取以下措施：-
1) 尽力寻找同学或其他可靠人员作为中介。在严峻时期，最好的办法是组织秘密通讯，并使用各种手段秘密传递信息。
2) 所有信件均应寄至商店或学校转交。直接寄给地点或个人是不明智的。
3) 如果要同时邮寄多份通告等，应使用不同颜色的包装纸或信封。它们应在不同地区的邮筒投递。
4) 寄件人的姓名和地址不应完整填写。
5) 外封上的姓名和地址等应以一种普通的、不会引起他人注意的方式书写。
6) 可以使用带有虚假商号或学校抬头的信封等，但一个虚假地址不得使用太久。使用合适的虚假抬头应根据待邮寄物品的性质或内容来决定。
7) 必须进行调查，以确定信件或其他邮件是否确实送达收件人。

If not, other means of delivery are to be adopted.
8) Lengthy reports or letters to be mailed might be
written in books such as The Bible, stories of prominent
persons, novels, and science books. The book to be
used for this purpose must be of Chinese style binding
so that it can be unbound. The message is to be
written in pencil on the reverse side of folded sheets,
after which the book is to be re-bound in the original
form and then sent by mail. In a word, the branches
at various places should change their means of
communication from time to time.

No documents should be stored in the residences of
comrades. If necessary, only a very small number of
important documents should be kept so that our organs
will not be easily discovered by the ruling classes.

In writing circulars we should endeavour to avoid
as much as possible words and sentences the meaning of
which is too clear. We should write them in the style
of lectures or advertisements or we should at least use
as many false names (for organs) as possible. In the
case of important circulars, they have to be delivered
through convenient persons or other secret means.

In writing letters all dangerous terms are to be
avoided and replaced by artificial ones. The best way
is to write lengthy letters of a friendly, business or
family nature, but the contents should be as thoroughly
clear as possible. If a pronoun ("pronouns" are false
terms designating organs) cannot be found in the A or B
List of Pronouns issued by the "Central School", a
character of similar pronunciation or a term that might
be comprehensive to the recipient is to be used. When
it is difficult to do as stated, writing might be done
with fluid medicine (invisible ink) or milk in accordance
with instructions issued by the "Central School".

The contents of false letters should be adaptable
to the social standing of the recipient.

Envelopes and the writing on them should be of the
common style so as not to attract the attention of censors.
It would be better to use envelopes bearing the headings
of shops and public organizations.

If many letters are to be sent, they should be
mailed at different pillar boxes. The writing on
envelopes or covers should vary in style or be done by
different persons.

All documents which need not be preserved should be
burned whilst those to be preserved have to be copied
in a secret manner or to be kept at a secluded place.

Communication addresses or list of comrades
should not be written on papers in an openly manner.
They have to be written in secrecy or memorized.

Letters reporting change of addresses and letters
bearing on other important matters should be mailed
separately. The following rules are to be observed:-

8) 拟邮寄的长篇报告或信件，可书写于《圣经》、名人故事、小说及科学书籍等书中。用于此目的之书籍必须为中式线装，以便拆开。信息需用铅笔书写于折叠书页的背面，随后将书籍按原样重新装订，再通过邮件寄出。总之，各地支部应不时变更其通讯方式。

同志住所内不得存放任何文件。如有必要，仅可保留极少量重要文件，以免我方机关被统治阶级轻易发现。

撰写通告时，应尽量避免使用含义过于直白的词句。行文风格宜仿照讲演稿或广告，或至少尽可能多地使用（机关的）假名。对于重要通告，须通过可靠人员或其他秘密手段递送。

写信时应避免所有危险术语，并以人造代号替代。最佳方式是撰写内容看似友好、商务或家事的长信，但其中隐含的意思应尽可能清晰明了。若在“中央学校”发布的A表或B表代名词中找不到适用的代词（“代词”系指代机关的假名），则可使用发音相近的字，或使用收信人能理解的术语。若难以按上述方式操作，则可依照“中央学校”发出的指示，使用药水（隐形墨水）或牛奶进行书写。

假信的内容应适应收信人的社会地位。

信封及其上的字迹应采用普通样式，以免引起检查人员的注意。最好使用印有商号或公共机构抬头的信封。

如需寄送大量信件，应投寄于不同的邮筒。信封或封皮上的字迹风格应有所变化，或由不同人书写。

所有无需保存的文件均应烧毁；需保存的文件须以秘密方式抄录，或存放于隐蔽处。

通讯地址或同志名单不得公然书写于纸上。须秘密书写或记在心中。

报告地址变更的信件及涉及其他重要事项的信件应分开邮寄。须遵守以下规则：-

the first letter talks about studies, the subject
of the second letter should not be changed to business.
2) All letters are to be numbered.
3) Letters reporting change of addresses must not tell
about "school " affairs.

With the exception of comrades who might be
interviewed in person, others who desire to make
arrangements should not be informed of the meeting
addresses and their recommendation letters are to be
sent through the mail. Rules governing time and

All documents such as letters bearing on transfer
from one school to another and recommendation letters
to be sent from organs of various grades, must be written
in secrecy.

Rules governing communication by letter have been
revised and read as follows:-

Chinese style envelopes which have a Red stripe in
the middle. When sealing letters they should be
stamped with a chop containing the name of a certain
shop.
2) To look for persons at communication addresses is not
allowed.
3) No envelope should be addressed "care of". A smaller
envelope is to be enclosed telling the man to deliver
the letter in person to a certain place.

Letters to provincial committees should be written
clearly and if fluid medicine is used a test should be

Letters signed in the name "Fee Hoong (飛虹)" are

所有涉及从一个学校转至另一个学校的信件，以及由各级机关发出的介绍信等文件，均须秘密书写。

致省委的信件应书写清晰，若使用药水，须进行测试以确保效果满意。

若收到省委来信且页码已编号，你需涂抹碘酒。请使用米汤向省委写信，并将页码编号。

若收到写在白色印刷纸上的文件，即为我方通告，你应涂抹蓝矾溶液（? 硫酸亚铁）。

Rules of Secrecy for Communication Agents

When meeting agents from various places the first
thing is to examine their introduction letters carefully
to ensure that they are not detectives in disguise.
During conversation attention should be paid to their
features in order to discover whether they are suspicious
characters. In a word, communication agents should
always be on their guard because they are really the eyes
and ears of our organizations.

In making arrangements at any place the real names
of persons or addresses of our organizations should not
be disclosed readily. Care must be taken that "pronouns"
are to be used.

Between District Committees or Executive Committees
and Sections and Sub-Sections there should be as little
documentary communications as possible. It is better
that messages be conveyed verbally, but if a documentary
communication is necessary "pronouns" and "false writing"
should be used. Arrangements have to be made regarding
the use of secret signs etc.

Visits to the residences of responsible comrades,
organs, or your own offices have to be cut down as much
as possible. Don't always go by the same road.

Written instructions from Provincial Committees to
various branches should be made as little as possible.

交通员保密规则

与各地交通员会面时，首要任务是仔细查验其介绍信，以确保其并非伪装的侦探。交谈期间应注意观察其面部特征，以辨别是否为可疑人物。总之，交通员应时刻保持警惕，因为他们实为我方组织的耳目。

在任何地方进行安排时，不得轻易透露人员真名或我方机关地址。务必注意使用“代词”。

区委或执委与各支部、小组之间的书面通讯应尽可能减少。最好口头传达信息，但若必须进行书面通讯，则应使用“代词”和“假写”。须就使用秘密信号等事宜做出安排。

应尽可能减少拜访负责同志的住所、机关或你自己的办公室。不要总是走同一条路。

省委对各支部的书面指示应尽可能减少。

pages.en:
19.

The best way is for the Provincial Committees to send
Inspectors to districts or to transfer comrades from
districts for the discussion of party affairs. A net
of communications should be erected throughout the a
whole province.

Branches at various places should submit a detailed
report on their means of communications with neighbouring
cities so that the Provincial Committee might be able
to establish a communication organ for the whole province.

"Central" has to send men to participate in the
Communication Conference of the C.P. and establish a
communication branch in Shanghai to control documents
from the Northern and South-Eastern provinces. There
should be responsible persons to look after the
communication services between Shanghai and Hankow.

The provincial committee, sections and sub-sections
should have communication agents or letter-delivering
parties for the conveyance of messages and orders.

The provincial committee, sections, and sub-sections
should have special affairs workers or special affairs
parties to collect important political and social news
of special interest.

Large quantities of propaganda literature for
transportation should be put in boxes and well camouflaged.
If they are packed up in parcels they should look like
parcels from shops so as not to attract the attention
of our enemies. Care must be taken that the strings
of the parcels are strong.

Secrecy of Meetings

The following rules are to be observed in connection
with meetings of comrades:-
1) Notices for meeting should not be issued too early or
too late. If too early, information might be
disclosed and if too late persons might be unable to
attend.
2) The name of the meeting or the matters to be discussed
should not be written clearly.
3) The full address of a meeting place should be given
only on the first occasion and on any future
occasions not in full. Comrades should remember
the full address given on the first occasion.
4) Comrades should attend punctually.
5) After the conclusion of the meeting comrades should
not remain too long at the meeting place or leave
together and walk on the same road.
6) Everybody should speak in a low tone.
7) To make sure that nobody is listening or peeping.
8) To bring no document unless it is necessary to do so.
The documents carried on person have to be duly
concealed and if possible the original document be
not carried.
9) To prepare answers to enemies who might come.
10) When enemies arrive efforts should at once be made to
burn the documents (matches are to be carried always).
11) Arrangements should be made beforehand to avoid
arrest in case of a raid. Articles of amusements
and ordinary books should be ready on hand to be used
as excuse and sometimes you might pretend to be giving
a lesson on French or English.
pages.zh:
19.

最佳方式是省委派遣巡视员前往各区，或调动各区同志来讨论党务。应在全省范围内建立通讯网络。

各地支部应提交一份关于其与邻近城市通讯方式的详细报告，以便省委能够建立全省性的通讯机关。

“中央”须派人参加中共的通讯会议，并在上海设立通讯分支，以管控来自北方及东南各省的文件。须有专人负责上海与汉口之间的通讯服务。

省委、各支部及小组应配备交通员或送信组，以传递消息和命令。

省委、各支部及小组应配备特务工作人员或特务小组，以收集具有特殊利益的重要政治和社会新闻。

大量待运输的宣传文献应装入箱中并妥善伪装。若打包成包裹，外观应像商店发出的包裹，以免引起敌人注意。务必确保包裹捆扎绳结实牢固。

会议保密规则

同志开会须遵守以下规则：-
1) 会议通知发出时间不宜过早或过晚。若过早，消息可能泄露；若过晚，人员可能无法出席。
2) 会议名称或讨论事项不得写得清楚明白。
3) 仅在第一次通知时提供会议地点的完整地址，此后各次通知均不提供完整地址。同志应记住第一次提供的完整地址。
4) 同志应准时出席。
5) 会议结束后，同志不得在会场停留过久，也不得一同离开或沿同一条道路行走。
6) 所有人说话应低声。
7) 确保无人窃听或窥视。
8) 除非必要，不得携带文件。随身携带的文件须妥善藏匿，若可能，不得携带原件。
9) 预备好应对可能前来的敌人的说辞。
10) 当敌人到达时，应立即设法烧毁文件（须始终携带火柴）。
11) 应事先做出安排，以防在突袭时被逮捕。手边应备有娱乐用品和普通书籍，用作借口，有时你可假装正在教授法语或英语课。

pages.en:
20.

13) The form of meeting should be changed in accordance
with circumstances. The meeting might be held
in open country, restaurants, bazaars, or other
places. The time should not be too long and
reports and discussions should be as concise as
possible.

When a Branch has 10 comrades it will be
divided into sections and when a section has 10 comrades
it will be divided into sub-sections. Meetings of
Branch committee and joint meetings of section clerks
and sub-section chiefs will be held, but not a general
meeting of whole Branch.

The comrades of each sub-section know only the
comrades of their own sub-section and not necessarily
the comrades of other sub-sections. Sub-section
chiefs know only the sub-section chiefs of the same
Section, but not those of other Sections. Comrades
have direct connections with sub-section chiefs and
the latter have connections with Sections, and Sections
have connections with Branch committee.

A representative of the Provincial Committee,
or of Hsien or District Committee, while attending a
conference of a lower grade organization needs not let
the comrades attending know his name but simply let them
know that he is representing a certain organ. Hsien
and District Committees need not inform all the
comrades of the League of the names of the responsible
comrades. The addresses of responsible comrades
need not be known to one another and no unnecessary
connections should exist between various organizations.
In each Section there should be 2 or 3 reliable
comrades to undertake detective work to see that no
reactionary elements or detectives join the League.

A meeting of a standing committee of any grade
must not exceed 7 persons. If a meeting of many
persons is necessary no person should be allowed to
carry important documents to the meeting and reliable
comrades or guards be posted in the vicinity to keep
watch.

The time and place of meetings should be
notified verbally or by using secret "slogans" (secret
terms.

The time of meetings should be increased by
five hours. For instance, if a meeting is to be held
at 1 p.m. it should be stated that the meeting will
be held at 6 p.m. and if a meeting is to be held at
8 a.m. it should be stated that the meeting will be
held at 1 p.m. That is, the correct time of the
meeting is always five hours earlier.

Secrecy of Speech and Movements

Don't tell others that so and so is a C.P. or
C.Y. or you are liable to be punished. Moreover,
others will know that you are a member.

If you meet a man looking like a comrade you
must not regard him as a real comrade simply because
he declares he is one. You must bear in mind that
pages.zh:
20.

13) 会议形式应视情况而改变。会议可在野外、餐馆、集市或其他地方举行。时间不宜过长，报告和讨论应尽可能简明扼要。

当一个支部有10名同志时，应划分为若干组；当一组有10名同志时，应划分为若干小组。应召开支部委员会会议以及组长与小组长的联席会议，但不召开整个支部的全体会议。

各小组的同志只认识本小组的同志，不一定认识其他小组的同志。小组长只认识同一组的其它小组长，而不认识其他组的小组长。同志与小组长直接联系，小组长与组联系，组与支部委员会联系。

省委、县委或区委的代表在参加下级组织的会议时，无需让与会同志知道其姓名，只需让他们知道其代表某个机关即可。县委和区委无需向团内所有同志通报负责同志的姓名。负责同志的住址彼此无需知晓，各组织之间不应存在不必要的联系。每组应有2至3名可靠同志从事侦察工作，以确保无反动分子或侦探混入团内。

任何级别的常务委员会会议人数不得超过7人。如果必须召开多人会议，任何人不得携带重要文件参会，并应在附近安排可靠同志或警卫进行监视。

会议的时间和地点应通过口头或使用秘密“口号”（秘密术语）通知。

会议时间应提前五小时表述。例如，如果会议定于下午1点举行，应称会议将于下午6点举行；如果会议定于上午8点举行，应称会议将于下午1点举行。也就是说，正确的会议时间总是比所述时间早五个小时。

言语与行动的保密

不要告诉他人某人是共产党员或共青团员，否则你将受到惩罚。此外，他人也会由此得知你是成员。

如果你遇到一个看似同志的人，绝不能仅因他自称是同志就认为他是真正的同志。你必须牢记，

pages.en:
21.

he might be a detective. You must learn detective work
and not allow yourself to be detected. Without the
introduction of a superior organ or a responsible person
of the district even a real comrade should be treated
like a non-comrade.

If you meet a comrade on the road you need not
call him unless it is necessary. The reason is that
our enemies always make an arrested comrade walk on
the road in order to find out his associates.

Comrades in a same organ (factories, schools or
shops) should not be on too intimate terms with one
another for this will show to others that you are all
comrades. You should exercise the greatest care in
meeting "heavily coloured" (well known) comrades and
should pretend to keep away from them. You had
rather get into close touch with non-comrade masses.

With the exception of persons of superior organs
and responsible persons of the League you must not talk
about League problems with anybody, even your parents,
brothers, or your beloved ones.

You must not talk with a comrade about League
problems even in technical terms when you are in the
presence of a non-comrade. You should exercise the
greatest care when talking to a non-comrade.

The words C. P. and C. Y. should not be spoken of
openly at certain places and you should use "pronouns".

When you are questioned whether a certain person
is a C.Y. or C.P., you should say that you have no idea.
You may talk with a man concerning the views or
movements of another which can be known to the public or
you may, when circumstances permit, talk with him about
the principles of Marxism and the political views of the
Chinese Communist Party to win his sympathy with the
League but you should in no way disclose to him the
secrets of the League.

When travelling in boat or vehicle you must
always be on guard against detectives. When you become
aware of being shadowed you must not allow yourself to
get excited but try to avoid the follower. You must
not return to your residence direct or visit a "school"
or an organ but should quickly mix with a crowd or
go to a busy shop or amusement resort to avoid him.

When an organ is discovered by enemies, the
comrades at large should at once and without hesitation
inform the relevant organs and responsible comrades, but
care must be taken that you are not shadowed.

Under no circumstance should you betray the party
or the nation. Despite cruel torture you must not
disclose any of our secrets. If you make any disclosure
that lead to the discovery of our organizations you
commit the most serious offense. You have to stick to
the instructions contained in a small booklet entitled
"How to act in trials".
pages.zh:
21.

他可能是侦探。你必须学会反侦察技巧，不让自己被察觉。如果没有上级机关或地区负责人的介绍，即使是真正的同志也应被视为非同志对待。

如果在路上遇到同志，除非必要，不必称呼他。原因是我们的敌人总是让被捕的同志在路上行走，以找出其同伙。

同一机关（工厂、学校或商店）内的同志彼此关系不应过于亲密，因为这会向他人显示你们都是同志。在与“色彩浓厚”（知名）的同志接触时应格外小心，并应假装疏远他们。你宁愿与非同志群众建立密切联系。

除上级机关人员和团的负责人外，你不得与任何人谈论团的问题，即使是你的父母、兄弟或爱人也不行。

在有非同志在场的情况下，你甚至不得使用技术术语与同志谈论团的问题。与非同志交谈时应格外小心。

在某些场合不得公开提及“C. P.”（共产党）和“C. Y.”（共青团）字样，而应使用“代称”。

当被问及某人是否是共青团员或共产党员时，你应表示不知情。你可以与他人谈论另一人的观点或行动，只要这些是公众所知的；或者在情况允许时，与他谈论马克思主义原则和中国共产党的政治观点，以赢得他对团的同情，但绝不可向他泄露团的秘密。

乘船或乘车旅行时，必须时刻警惕侦探。当你意识到被跟踪时，不得惊慌，而应设法摆脱跟踪者。你不得直接返回住所，也不得访问“学校”或机关，而应迅速混入人群，或前往繁忙的商店或娱乐场所以避开跟踪者。

当机关被敌人发现时，广大同志应立即毫不犹豫地通知相关机关和负责同志，但必须注意不被跟踪。

在任何情况下都不得背叛党或国家。尽管遭受残酷酷刑，你不得泄露我们的任何秘密。如果你的泄密导致我们的组织被发现，你就犯了最严重的罪行。你必须遵守名为《受审时如何行动》的小册子中的指示。

The principle of this booklet is that you deny
everything. If you disclose other comrades intending
to get yourself out of trouble you will not benefit
but have to face a more serious charge. You must not
allow yourself to be fooled. When you are in gaol
you have to guard against detectives also. You must
not trust anybody other than very reliable persons in
the gaol. In a word, you should have the courage to
deny all questions.

At all times and under all circumstances you have
to prepare a statement in anticipation that you might
be arrested. In doing so you will not be confused
or get excited at the moment of your arrest. If
more than three persons are at one place you have to
decide among yourselves the statements to be made so
that they will coincide if arrested you are arrested.
When distributing literature, or posting slogans, there
should be at least two persons one of whom should act
as guard.

You should observe secrecy in dealing with outsiders,
reactionaries and comrades. If you are arrested, you
must not disclose the secrets of our organizations. If
you do so, you will harm not only the organizations but
also yourself. Always prepare a suitable statement.

Other Matters of Secrecy

For the sake of secrecy comrades should endeavour
to find a proper profession.

To have a photograph with friends is a common practice
but comrades are not advised to acquire this habit.
You should have as few photographs as possible taken and
you must not write anything on the photographs that will
disclose your identity.

Comrades engaged in work of a secret nature are
advised not to live at one place for too long and should
be transferred at least once in two years.

Under certain circumstances female comrades having
bobbed hair should not attend mass meetings.

Send reliable, intelligent, and unexposed comrades
to reactionary cliques to detect their secrets. They
are not to be disclosed to other comrades. The best
way is to send two comrades who are not known to each
other to one place so as to check their reports.

该小册子的原则是否认一切。如果你为了脱身而供出其他同志，不仅无益，反而将面临更严重的指控。你不得受骗。在狱中你也必须提防侦探。除了狱中非常可靠的人之外，你不得信任任何人。总之，你应有勇气否认所有问题。

在任何时候和任何情况下，你都必须准备好一份陈述，以防被捕。这样做可使你在被捕时不致慌乱或惊慌。如果三人以上在同一地点，你们必须事先商定好陈述内容，以便在被捕时口径一致。分发传单或张贴标语时，至少应有两人，其中一人担任警戒。

在与外人、反动分子和同志打交道时，你应保守秘密。如果你被捕，不得泄露我们组织的秘密。如果你这样做，不仅会损害组织，也会损害你自己。始终准备好一份合适的陈述。

其他保密事项

为了保密，同志应努力寻找一份正当职业。

与朋友合影是常见做法，但不建议同志养成此习惯。你应尽可能少拍照，且不得在照片上书写任何会暴露你身份的内容。

从事秘密工作的同志建议不要在一地居住过久，至少每两年调动一次。

在某些情况下，剪短发的女同志不得参加群众集会。

派遣可靠、聪明且未暴露的同志进入反动派系以侦取其秘密。这些秘密不得向其他同志披露。最好的办法是派遣两名互不相识的同志去同一地点，以便核对他们的报告。

SOME IMPORTANT ORGANIZATIONS CONTROLLED OR FORMED BY
THE COMMUNIST PARTY OR THE COMMUNIST YOUTH LEAGUE.

(1) Public Bodies: Labour Union and Peasants Union.
    The Communist Party and/or the Communist Youth League
is guided and controlled only by the organization that forms
the Party and/or the League which is an independent organ
not connected with the Communist Party or the Communist
Youths League of with superior or inferior rank. (For
instance: The Communist Party of Railway Workers General
Labour Union cannot directly control the Communist Party
of various Branch Railway Unions and the Central Communist
Party and League cannot direct the Provincial Communist
Party and Communist Youths League.) However this
disconnection between the high and low ranks of the
Communist Party and the Communist Youths League does not
affect the system of Labour and Peasants Union, because
a labour or a peasant union may , under the guidance of the
Communist Party or the Youth League, direct the branch or
subordinate union, but the Party or the League cannot direct-
ly control or instruct the Party or the League of the subordi-
nate unions. The policy adopted by the Party or the League
of the subordinate unions should follow that of the Party
or the League of the leading unions.
    All efforts are to be concentrated on organizing the
proletariat, on teaching them the slogans of the Party,
on preparing them for a great revolutionary work with the
object of forming and leading the labour and peasants unions
in the economic and political struggle.
    The farmers are full of feudal ideas and will willingly
participate in any fighting . In time of war, they can
work at communications, espionage, errands, propaganda.
Farmer and Labour Employees Associations. should be formed
and their work outlined. Such an association may be formed
in a place where there are 7 or 8 farm labourers. This
Association may also join the Peasants Union, and participate

由共产党或共产主义青年团控制或成立的一些重要组织。

(1) 公开团体：工会和农民协会。
    共产党和/或共产主义青年团仅由组成党和/或团的组织指导和控制，该组织是一个独立机关，不与共产党或共产主义青年团的上級或下级机构相连。（例如：铁路总工会共产党不能直接控制各分支铁路工会的共产党，中央党和团不能指挥省级共产党和共产主义青年团。）然而，共产党和共产主义青年团上下级之间的这种断连并不影响工会和农民协会的系统，因为工会或农民协会可以在共产党或青年团的指导下，指挥分支或下属工会，但党或团不能直接控制或指示下属工会的党或团。下属工会的党或团所采取的政策应遵循领导工会的党或团的政策。
    所有努力都应集中于组织无产阶级，向他们灌输党的口号，为他们从事伟大的革命工作做准备，目的是在经济和政治斗争中形成并领导工会和农民协会。

The Revolutionary Labour Unions must work among the
unemployed and prevent them from joining the "yellow" Labour
Union or the labour union under government control. Many
unemployed may be instructed to direct the farmers to create
disturbances. The unemployed are also a useful ally in
creating riots in cities and in helping to seize political
power by violence.

LABOUR UNIONS.

1) The funds set aside for the labour movement should not be
used by the Party. Therefore, a special person is to be
appointed to direct the labour movement and to receive
instructions from the Central Communist Party.
2) The Labour Union and the Party should be distinct and
seperate.
3) Each district should send at least one report a month on
the work done or a special report on the plans and conditions
of a struggle and or on any urgent matter. The report
should be sent to the Central in the name of the Communist
Party and another report sent to the General Union in the
name of labour unions.
4) In industrial places or places where there are provincial
committees, one worker at least should be designated to
direct the labour movement and to communicate with the
General Union, but he is not allowed to do other important
work.

1) A Labour Union is formed of labourers.
2) The object is to unite labourers in one spirit and to
struggle for the rights of the labouring class.

4) The Union will have an Executive Committee of 7 members,
a Standing Committee of 3 members, one chairman of the
Executive Committee and one Chief for each of the five
departments.
5) Discipline:-
a) All resolutions of the Union must be observed and
enforced.
b) No. one is allowed to break up the union.
c) No personal dispute is permitted.
d) No connection with the gentry, the capitalist class
and other reactionary elements is permitted.
e) No leakage of secrets of the Union is permitted.
f) No one may join the Kuomintang.
6) Fees:-

b) Every member must pay 5 coppers per mensem to the Union.
7) Disputes among members are to be settled by the Executive

a landlord will be supported by all the members summoned

PEASANTS UNIONS

The organization of a Peasants Union should be made
on broad lines. The slogan to be used is "Revolution for
the Redistribution of Land" for the purpose of stirring up
the farmers to struggle. As the reactionary elements are in
control, Peasants Unions will be banned as illegal, because
they will direct the farmers to resist payment of rentals
and taxes and to kill landlords and the gentry until all
labourers are prepared for armed violence and uprising.
Since the Peasants Union is the leading executive organ
in riots and uprisings, it will naturally become the farmers
representative body if the struggle is successful, and the
Union will be dissolved when the Soviet Government is formed
and all activity is concentrated.
In the past, little attention was paid to the organization
of farmers and to the work to be carried out among them. The

a) 为劳工阶级的权利而斗争。
b) 所有劳工必须团结起来支持工会。
c) 反对压迫劳工的士绅、地主、资本家及其他反动分子。

11) 这些规章可由大会修订。

农会

农会的组织应采取广泛路线。使用的口号是“土地重新分配革命”，目的是煽动农民进行斗争。由于反动分子掌握控制权，农会将作为非法组织被禁止，因为它们将指导农民抗租抗税，并杀害地主和士绅，直到所有劳工准备好进行武装暴力和起义。
由于农会是暴动和起义中的领导执行机构，如果斗争成功，它自然将成为农民的代表机构，而当苏维埃政府成立且所有活动集中时，该工会将解散。
过去，人们对农民的组织以及在农民中开展的工作关注甚少。该

pages.en:
- 5 -

movement was spasmodic. The farmers dispersed and the
organization was automatically dissolved whether the struggle
succeeded or failed. Consequently, it was difficult to
promote education among the farmers, unity and coherence
being lacking.
    In view of the blunders of the past the object of the
struggle and activities in areas not yet occupied by the
Soviet should be to form and perpetuate a Farmers' Federation
or a Farmers' Committee, and strenuous efforts should be
exerted to instill into the farmers the principles of the
Party and the ideas of the Revolution for the Redistribution
of Land and the acquisition of political power. The F
Federation should not be satisfied with the fulfilment of
certain economic demands but must make the farmers thoroughly
understand and firmly believe in our principles so that even
though the struggle may prove a failure, the final triumph
will be ours in the long run, because the farmers will
continue the struggle. Therefore, the Party should stress
the following:-
1) To establish and promote a Farmers' Federation which
    should be secretly organised. Our strength in the village
    depends upon the number of farmers supporting us. The
    Soviet Government will be founded only during a time of
    uprisings. Before the Coup d'etat the proletariat must
    be prepared for a Soviet Government.
2) When the Soviet Government has been established the Union
    of Farmers Employees will be formed to replace the Farmers'
    Federation. In areas not yet occupied by the Soviet, an
    independent handicraft Labour Union is to be established
    in the villages to work for the benefit of handicraft
    workers. (This Union may continue to exist after the
    occupation of the territory.) When the Farmers' Federation
    has been well-founded, it may establish a Farm Employees
    Department for the benefit of farm employees and the
    Department may convoke in the name of the Federation meetings
pages.zh:
