运动是零星断续的。农民四散，无论斗争成功与否，组织都会自动解散。因此，难以在农民中推广教育，缺乏团结和凝聚力。
    鉴于过去的错误，在尚未被苏维埃占领的地区，斗争和活动的目标应是建立并维持一个农民联合会或农民委员会，并应大力向农民灌输党的原则、土地重新分配革命以及夺取政权的思想。农民联合会不应满足于实现某些经济诉求，而必须使农民彻底理解并坚定相信我们的原则，这样即使斗争证明失败，从长远来看最终胜利仍将属于我们，因为农民将继续斗争。因此，党应强调以下几点：-
1) 建立并促进一个秘密组织的农民联合会。我们在村庄的力量取决于支持我们的农民数量。苏维埃政府只会在起义期间建立。在政变之前，无产阶级必须为苏维埃政府做好准备。
2) 当苏维埃政府建立后，将成立农民雇员联合会以取代农民联合会。在尚未被苏维埃占领的地区，应在村庄建立独立的手工业工会，为手工业工人的利益工作。（该工会在领土被占领后可能继续存在。）当农民联合会根基稳固后，可以设立一个农业雇员部，为农业雇员的利益服务，该部可以联合会的名义召集此类雇员的会议

pages.en:
- 6 -
of such employees but before the formation of the Farmers'
Federation an independent Farm Employees Labour Union
should not be established.
The Farmers' Federation:-
1) To promote class distinction in villages.
2) Poor farmers are to form the nucleus of the Farmer
Movement. The direction of the movement and the control
of the Federation should be undertaken by poor farm
employees and small handicraft workers, and not by the
rich farmers for fear the latter might seize political
authority in the village. Riots and uprisings will be
conducted not by the Federation but by a special Village
Revolutionary Committee. The members of the Federation
who are employees must form another independent
organization.
The Hsien Farmers' Federation Regulations:-
1) The Hsien Farmers' Federation is organised by all the
farmers in a Hsien under the Chekiang Provincial Farmers'
Federation.
2) The Federation unites all farmers to struggle for their
rights.
3) The system of organization of the Federation is as followings:
Hsien Farmers Assembly - Hsien { Standing Com. / Executive " } - District { Standing Com. / Executive Com. } - Village { S. / E. }
4) The internal organization of the Assembly:-
General Assembly -- { Secretary / Standing Committee / Military Affairs Committee } ---- { Executive Committee } - { Organization / Youth / Women / Amusement }
5) a) A Hsien Farmers' Federation will have a Standing
Committee of 7 members, an Executive Committee of 13
members, one chairman of the Standing Committee, one
pages.zh:
- 6 -
但在农民联合会成立之前，不应建立独立的农业雇员工会。
农民联合会：-
1) 在村庄中促进阶级区分。
2) 贫农应构成农民运动的核心。运动的指导和联合会的控制应由贫苦农业雇员和小手工业者承担，而不是由富农承担，以免后者夺取村里的政治权力。暴动和起义不由联合会进行，而是由专门的村革命委员会进行。联合会中身为雇员的成员必须组成另一个独立的组织。
县农民联合会规章：-
1) 县农民联合会由该县所有农民在浙江省农民联合会之下组织而成。
2) 联合会团结所有农民为其权利而斗争。
3) 联合会的组织体系如下：
县农民大会 - 县 { 常委会 / 执委会 } - 区 { 常委会 / 执委会 } - 村 { 常 / 执 }
4) 大会的内部组织：-
大会 -- { 书记 / 常务委员会 / 军事事务委员会 } ---- { 执行委员会 } - { 组织 / 青年 / 妇女 / 娱乐 }
5) a) 县农民联合会将设有一个由7名成员组成的常务委员会，一个由13名成员组成的执行委员会，一名常务委员会主席，一名

pages.en:
- 7 -

Secretary, one chief for each of the four departments.
b) A District Farmers' Federation will have a Standing
Committee of 5 members, an Executive Committee of 9
members, a chairman of the Standing Committee, one
Secretary, one chief for each department.
c) A Village Farmers' Federation will have an Executive
Committee 7 members, A Standing Committee of 3 members,
one chairman for a Standing Committee, one Secretary,
one chief for each department.
6) The Military Affairs Department is an independent organ
in the Federation but is co-related with the Military
Affairs Department of the Federation of various grades.
7) Discipline:-
a) All resolutions passed by the Federation should
be complied with.
b) No one is allowed to break up the unity of the members.
c) No personal dispute is permitted.
d) No connection with the gentry, the landlords, and the
capitalists is permitted.
e) No leakage of secrets of the Federation is allowed.
f) No one may join the anti-Revolutionary Kuomintang.
Any one who contravenes any of the above rules of discipline
will be severely punished.
8) Membership Fees:-
a) Entrance fees; a member will pay 10 cents at the time
of entry into the Federation.
b) Monthly fee; every member will pay 3 coppers per mensen.
9) Any dispute among members is to be settled by the
Executive Committee.
10) Any member who is oppressed by the gentry, the landlord,
or any other reactionary element will be whole-heartedly
supported by the Federation.
11) Slogans to be used by the Federation:-
a) Struggle hard for the rights of the farmers.
b) Oppose all landlords, gentry and other reactionary
pages.zh:
- 7 -

书记，以及四个部门各一名主任。
b) 区农民联合会将设有一个由5名成员组成的常务委员会，一个由9名成员组成的执行委员会，一名常务委员会主席，一名书记，以及各部门各一名主任。
c) 村农民联合会将设有一个由7名成员组成的执行委员会，一个由3名成员组成的常务委员会，一名常务委员会主席，一名书记，以及各部门各一名主任。
6) 军事事务部是联合会内的一个独立机构，但与各级联合会的军事事务部相关联。
7) 纪律：-
a) 应遵守联合会通过的所有决议。
b) 任何人不得破坏成员的团结。
c) 不允许个人争执。
d) 不允许与士绅、地主和资本家有任何联系。
e) 不允许泄露联合会秘密。
f) 任何人不得加入反革命的国民党。
任何违反上述任何纪律规则的人都将受到严厉惩罚。
8) 会费：-
a) 入会费；成员在加入联合会时须缴纳10分。
b) 月费；每名成员每月须缴纳3枚铜板。
9) 成员间的任何纠纷由执行委员会解决。
10) 任何受到士绅、地主或其他反动分子压迫的成员，都将得到联合会的全心支持。
11) 联合会使用的口号：-
a) 为农民的权利而努力斗争。
b) 反对所有压迫我们的地主、士绅及其他反动

pages.en:
- 8 -
elements that oppress us.
c) Oppose the Kuomintang that deceives us.
d) Start a Revolution for the Redistribution of Land.
e) Arm the Farmers.
f) Support the Labour Union, for the labourers are our
brethren.
g) Support the Communist Party and the Communist Youths
League.
12)These regulations may be amended by the General Assembly
of the Federation.
pages.zh:
- 8 -
分子。
c) 反对欺骗我们的国民党。
d) 发动土地重新分配革命。
e) 武装农民。
f) 支持工会，因为劳工是我们的兄弟。
g) 支持共产党和共产主义青年团。
12) 这些规章可由联合会大会修订。

pages.en:
- 9 -

RELATIONS OF YOUNG LABOURERS AND FARMERS TO THE LABOUR
AND FARMER FEDERATIONS (CONTROLLED BY THE COMMUNIST PARTY).

A Labour Union should be under the direction or
influence of the Party. When a Labour Union or any other
labour organization has been established it should direct
and persuade the young labourers to join the Union and organize
a Youth Committee or a Youth Department in the Union.

The law governing the organization of Red Labour
Unions and Farmers' Federation does not but should stipulate
that the chairman of the Youth Department or of the Youth
Committee should be ex officio a member of the Executive
Committee of the Union or Federation (Chairman, preferably
a member of Communist Youth League). The Youths Department
attached to the Farmers' Federation will help to discuss and
solve questions relating to child labour. The Youths may
form an independent group, together with the Adults Group.

The Executive Committee members of the Labour Union
or Farmers' Federation should be chosen among the young
farmers and labourers who are members of the Party. Courageous
and capable young farmers and workers who are not members of
the Party may undertake active work in the Union or Federation
and may be asked to express their views on questions that
are economic advantage to the young labourers and farmers. In
this way close relations between the young labourers and
farmers , the Youth Committee members, and the Labour Union
and the Farmers' Federation may be cultivated.

The Youth Department of the Farmers Federation is
formed by all the youths of a village:-

1) The chairman of the Youths Department should be a member
of the Executive Committee of the Farmers Federation and
the Youth Department is attached to the Federation.

2) The work of the Youth Department is to discuss the needs
and demands of young farmers and to arouse them to struggle
for their rights, but questions concerning the Federation
pages.zh:
- 9 -

青年劳工和农民与（由共产党控制的）劳工及农民联合会的关系。

工会应在党的指导或影响之下。当工会或任何其他劳工组织成立后，应指导和劝说青年劳工加入工会，并在工会内组织青年委员会或青年部。

管理红色工会和农民联合会组织的法规虽未规定，但应规定青年部或青年委员会的主席为工会或联合会执行委员会的当然委员（主席最好为共产主义青年团团员）。附属于农民联合会的青年部将协助讨论和解决有关童工的问题。青年人可以组成一个独立的团体，与成人团体并列。

工会或农民联合会的执行委员会委员应从身为党员的青年农民和劳工中选出。非党员但勇敢且有能力的青年农民和工人可以在工会或联合会中承担积极工作，并可被征询对有利于青年劳工和农民的经济问题的意见。通过这种方式，可以培养青年劳工和农民、青年委员会成员以及工会和农民联合会之间的密切关系。

农民联合会的青年部由一个村的所有青年组成：-

1) 青年部主席应为农民联合会执行委员会的成员，青年部隶属于该联合会。

2) 青年部的工作是讨论青年农民的需求和诉求，并激发他们为争取权利而斗争，但涉及联合会

pages.en:
- 10 -
should be brought by the young farmers to the attention
of the Federation. The Youth Department will also
establish an Education and Amusement Group, a Committee
of Boys Cow Herds, a Children's Society and the Youths'
Vanguards. The Youths should participate in all work
of the adults.
3) The Youth Department should not form an independent
Young Farmers' Federation but the Department may form
small groups to receive instructions from the Federation
in regard to the work.
4) When the Farmers' Federation is not under the control
of the Party, attempts should be made to instigate the
low ranks of that Federation, particularly the youths,
to demand the formation of a Youth Department. Under the
Youth Department will be an entertainment organ which
will be used to attract not only the youths but also
adults to participate in any amusement meetings.
The Committee of Boys Cow Herds which is under
the Youth Department will do a part of the Youth Department's
work.
1) The Committee of Boys Cow Herds is attached to the
Farmers Federation or the Youth Department.
2) The work of the Committee is to struggle for the rights
of the boys who cow herds, to provide entertainments
and to promote their educational training.
3) The Committee should be under the direction of the Youth
Department which will lead in the struggle for the
improvement of the welfare of the boys.
4) The unit of this organization of boys is a village.
The Youths Group directed by the Federation and
the Communist Youth League should train youths in such a way
that they may serve as armed pickets or plainclothes
soldiers in time of fighting.
In provinces where fierce wars are waged, like in
Hunan, Hupeh, Kiangsi, and Kwantung, the Armed Youth Groups
pages.zh:
- 10 -
的事项应由青年农民提请联合会注意。青年部还将设立教育娱乐组、牧童委员会、儿童社和青年先锋队。青年应参与成人的所有工作。
3) 青年部不应组建独立的青年农民联合会，但该部可以组建小组，以接受联合会关于工作的指示。
4) 当农民联合会不受党控制时，应试图煽动该联合会的下层人员，特别是青年，要求成立青年部。在青年部之下将设有一个娱乐机构，用于不仅吸引青年，也吸引成年人参加任何娱乐集会。
隶属于青年部的牧童委员会将承担青年部的部分工作。
1) 牧童委员会隶属于农民联合会或青年部。
2) 委员会的工作是为牧童争取权利，提供娱乐活动，并促进他们的教育培训。
3) 委员会应在青年部的指导下工作，由青年部领导改善牧童福利的斗争。
4) 该男孩组织的单位为一个村庄。
由联合会和共产主义青年团领导的青年团应以这样一种方式训练青年，使他们在战斗时期能够担任武装纠察队或便衣士兵。
在湖南、湖北、江西和广东等激战省份，武装青年团

pages.en:
- 11 -
(which should be controlled by the Farmers' Federation) will
be known as the "Youth Volunteer Corps", "The Youth Athletic
Association", or the "Group for the Extermination of Traitors".
Members of the Groups must be from 15 to 20 years old, and
poor youths are preferred. Apprentices of handicraft trades,
young students and teachers, and young men from all walks of
life may join the Group which should be organised on the model
of the Farmers Self-Defense Army. Such an armed group will
receive military education and taught political science under
the Farmers Federation and will be mobilized by the Federations
in time of war.
In provinces like Kiangsu, Chekiang and the northern
provinces, the cultural groups for the youths will prove
more effective and they may be named the "Young Farmers' Club",
the "Youths Federation", "Lecture and"Culture Society", "
"Avocational Schools", Free Schools", etc.. Opportunity should
be taken to propagate revolutionary ideas through lectures
and slogans may be distributed to revolutionize the ideas of
the people before any concrete action is taken.
All the Youth Groups should at once do their best
to recruit senior young labourers to join the Red Labour Union.
In the Union the Youth Committee members and other young
workers are eligible for executive positions, and they may form
Youth Labour Committee to help the Red Labour Union.
In the committee of the labour union of a factory,
the senior members of the Youth Group or any young labourer
under the influence of the Party may be elected to serve.
These youths must be very brave, aggressive and radical and are
really in a position to work for the welfare of the labourers,
They may work in the yellow labour unions. The factory
committee is the central organ in a factory, and it may be
formed at any time if there are workers, regardless of party
differences. Such a committee may function openly. In a
factory the labour Union resembles an official organ or Tangpu,
while the factory committee may be likened unto a legislative
pages.zh:
- 11 -
（应受农民联合会控制）将被称为“青年志愿队”、“青年体育协会”或“除奸团”。团成员年龄必须在15至20岁之间，且优先招收贫苦青年。手工业学徒、青年学生和教师，以及各界青年男子均可加入该团，该团应按农民自卫军的模式组织。此类武装团体将在农民联合会领导下接受军事教育和政治学教导，并在战时由联合会动员。
在江苏、浙江及北方各省，青年的文化团体将被证明更为有效，它们可命名为“青年农民俱乐部”、“青年联合会”、“讲演与文化社”、“业余学校”、“免费学校”等。应利用机会通过讲座传播革命思想，并在采取任何具体行动之前分发标语，以革新民众的思想。
所有青年团体应立即尽力招募资深青年劳工加入红色工会。在工会中，青年委员会成员和其他青年工人有资格担任行政职务，他们可以组建青年劳工委员会以协助红色工会。
在工厂的工会委员会中，青年团的资深成员或任何受党影响的青年劳工均可当选任职。这些青年必须非常勇敢、进取和激进，并真正能够为劳工的福利工作。他们可以在黄色工会中工作。工厂委员会是工厂的中心机构，只要有工人，无论党派差异如何，随时都可以组建。此类委员会可以公开运作。在工厂中，工会类似于官方机构或堂铺，而工厂委员会可比作立法

pages.en:
- 12 -
assembly.
The characteristics of a factory committee are
(1) the responsible officials of the committee are absolutely
voluntary, (2) members will not pay any fee. If the Soviet
proletariat seize political power in the district, this
Committee will become the administrative body of the factory.
Not only Red labour unions will be organized in
secret but also small groups like the Anti-Japanese Society,
the Brethren Group, the Sisters Group, etc. will be formed
among the young labourers. These small groups are very i
important and necessary in factories where a labour union or
factory committee is not easily organised. They may be
gradually developed by propaganda into factory committees
and recruit senior workers into the Red Labour Union.
The Red Labour Union should organise groups to
give physical training and Chinese boxing to young labourers
with the object of educating them to be of more use to the
Red Labour Union. In this way, the young farmers will unite
under the union and will understand the significance of
political power.
We must work and win over the young labourers in
the Labour Unions controlled by the Kuomintang, and instigate
them to form a Youth Department and to establish various
recreation and avocational organs (as evening schools, clubs,
etc.) the membership of which will include youths and adults.
The Apprentices' Committee is formed by the apprentices of
factories or shops.
1) The apprentices will take a period of from two to three
years to learn a trade before they can become journeymen.
During the period of apprenticeship they receive not more
than a few dollars a year and sometimes are provided with
food and lodging only, but they work like other labourers
and will do extra work, and are harshly treated and freely
discharged by the foreman.
2) Because of their unique economic position, apprentices
pages.zh:
- 12 -
议会。
工厂委员会的特点是：(1) 委员会的负责官员完全出于自愿，(2) 成员不缴纳任何费用。如果苏维埃无产阶级在该地区夺取政权，该委员会将成为工厂的行政机构。
不仅秘密组织红色工会，而且在青年劳工中还将组建诸如反日会、兄弟团、姐妹团等小团体。这些小团体在不易组织工会或工厂委员会的工厂中非常重要且必要。它们可以通过宣传逐步发展为工厂委员会，并招募资深工人加入红色工会。
红色工会应组织团体，向青年劳工提供体能训练和中国拳术，目的是教育他们更好地为红色工会服务。通过这种方式，青年农民将在工会下团结起来，并理解政权的意义。
我们必须努力争取国民党控制的工会中的青年劳工，煽动他们成立青年部，并建立各种娱乐和业余机构（如夜校、俱乐部等），其成员包括青年和成年人。
学徒委员会由工厂或商店的学徒组成。
1) 学徒需要两到三年的时间学习手艺才能成为熟练工。在学徒期间，他们每年获得的报酬不超过几美元，有时仅提供食宿，但他们像其他劳工一样工作，还要做额外的工作，受到工头的严厉对待并被随意解雇。
2) 由于其独特的经济地位，学徒

pages.en:
- 13 -

will form an independent committee.

3) Apprentices may form a small committee or group of their
own and then unite with other groups to form an Apprentices'
Federation.

4) The apprentices of a factory may form one Apprentice Committee and all the committees in one district may be
formed into one Federation.

5) The relation between the Apprentice Committee and the
Labour Union is similar to that between the Communist Party
and the Communist Youth.

6) If an Apprentices Federation is under a Labour Union which
is not controlled by us, such Federation will be regarded
as an Auxilliary Organ to the Labour Union.

7) The functions of an Apprentice Committee or Federation
are to promote education, to provide amusements and to give
physical training courses.

Child labourers (between the age of 8 and 16) should
form an independent Child Labour Association;-

1) The Association will provide amusements and entertainments
which must be suitable to the psychology of the children
so as to arouse their interest. Children will be taught
military knowledge and undergo physical training.

2) The children will perform scouting, running errands and
ambulance work during the war.

3) The Child Labour Association will be attached to the
Young Labourers Committee.

4) In southern Chekiang, there are Apprentice Committees. In
places where there are no Red Labour Unions, the apprentices
form independent associations.

All districts should organise young labourers into
secret labour unions and factory groups and hasten the work
of the Young Labour Committee of Secret Labour Union and
establish Labourers' Evening Schools, Physical Training
Association, Brethren Alliance, etc..
pages.zh:
- 13 -

将组成一个独立的委员会。

3) 学徒可以组建自己的小型委员会或小组，然后与其他团体联合组成学徒联合会。

4) 一个工厂的学徒可以组成一个学徒委员会，一个地区内的所有委员会可以组成一个联合会。

5) 学徒委员会与工会之间的关系类似于共产党与共产主义青年团之间的关系。

6) 如果学徒联合会隶属于一个不由我们控制的工会，则该联合会被视为工会的辅助机构。

7) 学徒委员会或联合会的职能是促进教育、提供娱乐和开设体能训练课程。

童工（8至16岁之间）应组建独立的童工协会：-

1) 协会将提供适合儿童心理的娱乐和消遣活动，以激发他们的兴趣。将教授儿童军事知识并进行体能训练。

2) 儿童将在战争期间执行侦察、跑腿和救护工作。

3) 童工协会将隶属于青年劳工委员会。

4) 在浙南地区，设有学徒委员会。在没有红色工会的地方，学徒组建独立的协会。

各区应将青年劳工组织进秘密工会和工厂小组，加快秘密工会青年劳工委员会的工作，并建立劳工夜校、体育协会、兄弟联盟等。

pages.en:
- 14 -

If there are no secretly armed labourers, attention
should be paid to the organization of Youths Volunteer Corps,
Chinese Boxers Association, Athletic Association, etc. so
that these organizations may defend the workers in time of
peace and participate in armed violence, and serve as pickets
in case of strike. So in ordinary times military training should
be stressed under the guidance of the Party.
pages.zh:
- 14 -

如果没有秘密武装的劳工，应注意组织青年志愿队、中国拳术协会、体育协会等，以便这些组织在和平时期保卫工人，参与武装暴力行动，并在罢工期间担任纠察队。因此，在平时应在党的指导下强调军事训练。

pages.en:
- 15 -

2) SECRET BODIES: THE RED DEFENSE CORPS & THE RED ARMY.
a) Original rules of military movement.

The Chinese Revolution has reached the stage of a Land
Revolution, for degree of occupied districts and cities.
During this period, the enemy's armed forces in the cities
must be annihilated for the purpose of securing the rights
of the proletariat in these districts. The Party should
not only correct its past errors in military affairs but
it should devise ways and means to destroy enemy's force, to
enlarge the armed labour and peasant force and to inaugurate
a Red Army. The military affairs question is now the most
important.

The new southern militarists are slaughtering labourers
and peasants and maltreating soldiers. Consequently, the
soldiers furnish a strong hatred against their senior officers
and have been much moved by the Land Revolution, the labour
and peasant uprisings in different districts and the slogan
"to distribute land among the soldiers". At this period,
we have a hopeful chance for the expansion of our military
movement and for the destruction and annihilation of the
enemy's armies. The People's Corps and the Volunteer Corps,
the majority of whose members are employed labourers and
peasants, can easily be led away from the capitalists.

In order to overthrow the armed force of the anti-
revolutionalists, their senior officers and their soldiers
must be seduced. The Labour and Peasant Red Defense Corps
must do its utmost to expand in the distributed districts.
Furthermore, gallant leaders and soldiers of the Red Defense
Corps must be selected as Chief of sections of the Red Army.

Although the Central has done its best to rectify its
past errors since the October 7 conference, yet the military
movement has failed to support the Land Revolution.

Hereafter the military movement should be carried out
in accordance with the following measures:-

1) The military uprisings by the labourers and peasants masses
pages.zh:
- 15 -

2) 秘密机构：红色防卫团与红军。
a) 军事运动的原始规则。

中国革命已进入土地革命阶段，旨在占领地区和城市。在此期间，必须消灭城市中的敌军武装力量，以确保无产阶级在这些地区的权利。党不仅应纠正过去在军事事务上的错误，还应制定方法和手段来摧毁敌军力量，扩大武装劳工和农民力量，并组建红军。军事事务问题现在是最为重要的。

新南方军阀正在屠杀劳工和农民，并虐待士兵。因此，士兵对其高级军官怀有强烈的仇恨，并深受各地土地革命、劳工和农民起义以及“分田给士兵”口号的影响。在这一时期，我们有希望的机会来扩大我们的军事运动，并破坏和歼灭敌军。人民团和志愿团的成员大多是受雇的劳工和农民，很容易从资本家那里被争取过来。

为了推翻反革命派的武装力量，必须诱降其高级军官和士兵。劳工和农民红色防卫团必须尽最大努力在分配的地区扩张。此外，必须选拔红色防卫团的英勇领导人和士兵担任红军的各部部长。

尽管中央自10月7日会议以来已尽力纠正过去的错误，但军事运动未能支持土地革命。

此后，军事运动应按照以下措施进行：-

1) 劳工和农民群众的军事起义

pages.en:
- 16 -

should be launched in such a way as to cause all labourers
and peasants to be determined for militarism. They must
join the enemy's armies with the object of breaking them up.
They should endeavour to instigate the soldiers by means
of propaganda and carry out other activities detrimental
to the enemy's discipline.

2) The unification of the military movement must lead to the
seizure of political authority. Our political rights in the
areas we have occupied must be expanded.

3) Attention must be drawn to the strategy of the enemy when
fighting. Comrades must be carefully instructed in military
practice.

b) The problem of breaking up reactionary forces.

The reactionary armies, the People's Corps, the Volunteer
Corps and the district bandits can be easily disrupted. In
truth, their management is rotten and the leaders are unable
to issue pay to their armies. The soldiers and policemen
throughout the country have not received their pay for 6 or
7 months and men who demand payment are being detained .
Many soldiers have deserted after receiving their pay.

To disrupt the reactionary forces we should become closely
connected with the soldiers and the masses. The method is
to send men to join the armies or to effect an arrangement
with them. The men to be sent to join the armies should be
those who can write letters for others or who can play
musical instruments.

When the soldiers are creating disturbance, labourers
and peasants must do their best to induce them to join the
Party. At this time, it is absolutely necessary for the Party
to organise a unit to accomodate reactionary soldiers. The
senior officer of the unit must be detailed from Soviet Russia.

Slogans for the soldiers' movement:-

1) The monthly pay for a soldier should be twenty dollars.
2) Pay in arrears must be issued.
pages.zh:
- 16 -

发动的方式应使所有劳工和农民决心反对军阀主义。他们必须加入敌军，目的是瓦解敌军。他们应努力通过宣传煽动士兵，并开展其他损害敌军纪律的活动。

2) 军事运动的统一必须导致夺取政治权力。我们在已占领地区的政治权利必须得到扩大。

3) 作战时必须注意敌方的战略。必须仔细指导同志们的军事实践。

b) 瓦解反动势力的问题。

反动军队、人民团、志愿团以及各区土匪很容易被打散。事实上，他们的管理腐败，领导人无法向军队发放军饷。全国各地的士兵和警察已有六七个月未领到薪饷，要求发饷的人正被拘留。许多士兵在领到薪饷后便开小差逃跑了。

为了瓦解反动势力，我们应该与士兵和群众建立密切联系。方法是派人加入军队，或与他们达成安排。派去加入军队的人应该是那些能替人写信或会演奏乐器的人。

当士兵制造骚乱时，劳工和农民必须尽力诱导他们加入本党。此时，本党绝对有必要组织一个单位来收容反动士兵。该单位的高级军官必须由苏维埃俄国派遣。

士兵运动的口号：-

1) 士兵的月薪应为二十元。
2) 必须补发欠饷。

pages.en:
- 17 -

3) Pay must be issued in full.
4) Oppose a deduction of pay.
5) Oppose the assaulting and reprimanding of soldiers
by senior officers.
6) No drill when a soldier is sick.
7) Sick and wounded soldiers must be given sundry expenses.
8) Oppose the deprivation of a soldier's freedom.
9) Kill senior officers who oppress soldiers.
10) Soldiers are not to fight labourers and peasants.
11) Kill senior officers who massacre labourers and peasants.
12) Soldiers are to participate in the labour and peasant
uprisings.
13) Houses for soldiers.
14) Do not fight for the militarists.
15) Overthrow new militarists for not issuing pay.
16) Kill new militarists who slaughter labourers and peasants.
17) Overthrow Imperialism and the "running dogs", the
Kuomintang armies.
18) Soldiers must join the Revolutionary Soldiers Federation.
19) The Central Communist Party is the Party of labourers,
peasants and soldiers.

c) The problem for the enlargement of armed labour and peasant
masses

The object of the organisation of the Red Defense Corps
is to enlarge the military activities of the labour and
peasant masses. In rustic regions, members of the Red
Defense Corps of the Soviet should direct the work of the
district Defense Corps. It is better for the Red Defense
Corps to include all the members of the secret labour unions.
A batch of our Comrades should be trained to direct the
Defense Corps. Members of the Defense Corps in cities must
learn street fighting while those in country regions must
practise night attack, field attack, etc.. After an uprising,
the brave elements of the Corps should join the Red Army.
pages.zh:

3) 必须全额发放薪饷。
4) 反对克扣薪饷。
5) 反对高级军官殴打和斥责士兵。
6) 士兵生病时不得操练。
7) 必须给予伤病士兵杂费津贴。
8) 反对剥夺士兵的自由。
9) 杀死压迫士兵的高级军官。
10) 士兵不得与劳工和农民作战。
11) 杀死屠杀劳工和农民的高级军官。
12) 士兵要参加劳工和农民的起义。
13) 为士兵提供住房。
14) 不要为军阀打仗。
15) 推翻不发薪饷的新军阀。
16) 杀死屠杀劳工和农民的新军阀。
17) 推翻帝国主义及其走狗国民党军队。
18) 士兵必须加入革命士兵联合会。
19) 中共中央是劳工、农民和士兵的政党。

c) 扩大武装劳工和农民群众的问题

组织红色防卫队的目的是扩大劳工和农民群众的军事活动。在农村地区，苏维埃红色防卫队的成员应指导区防卫队的工作。红色防卫队最好吸纳所有秘密工会的成员。应训练一批我们的同志来指导防卫队。城市中的防卫队成员必须学习巷战，而农村地区的成员必须练习夜袭、野战等。起义后，防卫队中的勇敢分子应加入红军。

pages.en:
- 18 -

d) The question of establishing a Red Army.
The Red armies are established to protect uprisings,
and are temporarily formed on the 3-5 system, namely,
12 men to a Class, 3 Classes to a Squad, 5 Squads to a
Company, 5 Companies to a Regiment, 5 Regiments to a
Division. A Division contains 4,500 men. Besides the above
there are a Detecting Corps, a Communication Corps, a
Military Medical Corps, a Special Corps and other organizations
attached to the Red Armies. Equal treatment must be
accorded to officers and men.

e) Military organization of the Party and the systematic
direction of the Soviet.
The military affairs of the Party must be completely
organised. The post of Secretary of a Military Committee
should be concurrently held by a Secretary of a Provincial
Committee or of a Special Committee or by a Standing
Committee member. The work of a Military Committee is not
simply confined to devising schemes of construction. It
has to control troop movements. When the Red Army is
in the field, the engagement shall be jointly directed by
the army itself and a member of the Red Defense Corps of
the Soviet in an occupied district, who is a member of a
Military Committee of the Party or is a special deputy of
the military affairs of the Party. When a war is in progress,
the Commander-in-Chief of the Red Army possesses the power
to direct the Red Defense Corps. The transfer of the Red
Army is subject to the order of the Soviet of the district
The Soviet of various Hsiens possesses the power to move
the Red Defense Corps in the Hsiens but it is not allowed
to transfer the Red Army directly.

f) Party organisation and political work in the armies.
The Red Armies should be organised by regiments into
a unit and form branches and sub-branches. Particular heed
should be given to the political work of the Red Army.
In war years, the soldiers of the Red armies are both
pages.zh:

d) 建立红军的问题。
建立红军是为了保护起义，暂时按“三五制”组建，即每班12人，每排3个班，每连5个排，每团5个连，每师5个团。一个师包含4,500人。除上述编制外，红军还附有侦察队、通信队、军医队、特种队及其他组织。官兵必须待遇平等。

e) 党的军事组织及苏维埃的系统领导。
党的军事事务必须完全组织起来。军事委员会书记一职应由省委或特委的书记，或由常务委员会委员兼任。军事委员会的工作不仅仅局限于制定建设方案。它还必须控制部队调动。当红军在野外作战时，战斗应由军队本身与被占领区苏维埃红色防卫队的一名成员共同指挥，该成员必须是党的军事委员会委员或党的军事事务特别副手。战争进行时，红军总司令拥有指挥红色防卫队的权力。红军的调动须服从该区苏维埃的命令。各县苏维埃拥有调动县内红色防卫队的权力，但不允许直接调动红军。

f) 军队中的党组织和政治工作。
红军应以团为单位进行组织，并建立支部和分部。应特别注意红军的政治工作。在战争年代，红军的士兵既是

pages.en:
- 19 -

fighters and members of Propaganda Sections. The Red
Armies should be supervised by political members of the
Soviet, who will undertake political work. The Political
Committee is a Party representative and is responsible
for improving the livelihood of the Red armies.

g) Miscellaneous:-

A detailed investigation into the firearms held by
labourers and peasants in a province should be made an
and measures should be devised to manufacture ammunition
and to repair guns and to supplement ammunition. Our
soldiers may purchase ammunition from other soldiers. The
purchase is easily made when the soldiers are about to
start. In a Red Division , say 6,000 men, it is estimated
that the monthly expenses for every soldier, for food,
dress, medicine and sundry fees total $15. That is to say,
$90,000 is required for a Division every month. These
funds will be procured by confiscation and other means.

Detecting and investigation work should also be carried
out systematically. Comrades should be detailed to work
in military and political organs of the reactionaries with
the object of obtaining information of secret documents.
The organization in this military outline cannot be made
public except to responsible comrades.

In addition to a Peasant Corporation, a peasant village
should endeavour to form an Employed Peasants Labour Union.

Hereafter the peasants should pay immediate attention
to the undermentioned points:-

1) The arms to be in use in a peasant village are not
limited to rifles and such weapons. Sticks, swords
and even plows may be used by the peasants.

2) We can seize arms from a weak force but we should avoid
battle with a strong enemy army. In this case, we
should endeavour to overcome the enemy by separate
surprise attacks.

The Military Committee
pages.zh:
- 19 -

战斗员，也是宣传队的成员。红军应受苏维埃政治成员的监督，由他们负责政治工作。政治委员会是党的代表，负责改善红军的生活状况。

g) 杂项：-

应对一个省内劳工和农民持有的枪支进行详细调查，并制定制造弹药、修理枪支和补充弹药的 меры。我们的士兵可以向其他士兵购买弹药。当士兵即将出发时，购买很容易完成。在一个红军师（例如6,000人）中，估计每名士兵每月的伙食、服装、医药和杂费总计为15元。也就是说，一个师每月需要90,000元。这些资金将通过没收和其他手段筹集。

侦察和调查工作也应系统地开展。应派遣同志在反动派的军事和政治机关中工作，目的是获取秘密文件的情报。本军事大纲中的组织结构除对负责的同志外，不得公开。

除了农民协会外，农民村还应努力成立雇农工会。

此后，农民应立即注意以下几点：-

1) 农民村中使用的武器不限于步枪等武器。棍棒、刀剑甚至犁耙都可被农民使用。

2) 我们可以从弱敌手中夺取武器，但应避免与强大的敌军作战。在这种情况下，我们应努力通过单独的突袭来战胜敌人。

军事委员会

The Military Committee.
1) A Provincial Committee, a Special Committee and a Hsien
or City Committee in which uprisings are being conducted
should each organize a Military Committee. Special
Military deputies should participate in the work of an
important city and in the Hsien Committees.
2) All classes of Military Committees should have direct
connection with one another.
3) The post of Secretary of a Military Committee may be
concurrently held by a Standing Committee member of the
Party of the same class.
The work of a Military Committee:
1) To investigate into actual conditions and to collect
material.
2) To devise schemes for military work. Such schemes must
be examined and sanctioned by the Party and then be issued
direct to junior military committees for execution.
3) To discuss measures to come into contact with soldiers
and to form labour and soldier masses.
4) To draw up methods of organisation, training, military
art, etc. and outlines of General Propaganda.
5) To supervise the work of junior military committees.
Activities to be carried out at present:-
1) To establish military committees of various classes.
Offices for military special deputies should be established
in Hangchow, Ningpo, Ninghai, Wenchow , etc..
2) To start investigation work.
3) Party organs to begin discussions of military affairs.
4) Party organs to begin propaganda work, in oral or written
form, among soldiers and the masses.
5) To absorb soldier comrades to inaugurate soldier branches.
6) To commence secret organization of the Red Defense Corps
in various districts where there are villages or peasant
committees.
pages.zh:
20 -

军事委员会。
1) 正在进行起义的省委、特委以及县或市委都应各自组织一个军事委员会。特别军事副手应参与重要城市和县委的工作。
2) 各级军事委员会之间应有直接联系。
3) 军事委员会书记一职可由同级党的常务委员会委员兼任。
军事委员会的工作：
1) 调查实际情况并收集材料。
2) 制定军事工作方案。此类方案必须经党审查批准，然后直接下发给下级军事委员会执行。
3) 讨论与士兵接触以及形成劳工和士兵群众的措施。
4) 制定组织、训练、军事艺术等方法及总体宣传大纲。
5) 监督下级军事委员会的工作。
目前要开展的活动：-
1) 建立各级军事委员会。应在杭州、宁波、宁海、温州等地设立特别军事副手办事处。
2) 开始调查工作。
3) 党的机关开始讨论军事事务。
4) 党的机关开始在士兵和群众中开展口头或书面的宣传工作。
5) 吸收士兵党员，建立士兵支部。
6) 在有村庄或农民委员会的各个地区，开始秘密组织红色防卫队。

pages.en:
- 21 -
7) To organize peasant armies (Red Armies) in those
areas where struggles are being conducted or will be
started.
pages.zh:
- 21 -
7) 在正在进行斗争或即将开始斗争的地区组织农民军（红军）。

pages.en:
THE YOUTHS VANGUARDS AND THE BOY CORPS.

For the time being the organization of the
Youths Vanguards does not require a big organization on an
all-Province or a nation-wide scale. Such organizations
are to be established in various places. The Youths Vanguards
under our leadership should be between 15 to 23 years of age.
They have to receive the same training as that received by
our Corps, on the simple armaments and politics. They must
be brave in order to participate in the riots and struggles
in the various districts; they must establish a close relation-
ship with the Peasants Army and should be led to participate
in the organization of the Peasants Army. The existence of
the organization should be open or semi-open but if circumstances
are unfavourable, it should be carried out secretly. Every
effort should be made to make the organization popular among
the youths. We should therefore, with as many members as
possible, lead other organizations like the Gray Color Youths
Body, the Workers and Peasants Bodies, the Recreation Clubs,
the Common Schools, the Athletic Corps etc. The child
labour corps should be developed popularly, their ages should
be from 8 to 16 years. The organization of a boy corps in
the various factories has an important significance and should
be carefully attended to. There is a very important principle
in the organization of the Youths Vanguards, the Labourous
Boy Corps and the other poor youths organizations, viz. these
organizations should be used in the struggle for rank. The
various Ranks Working Departments should exert all their
efforts to place the brave and poor labourers in the leading
position, so that they can accept our aims.

Among the workers and the peasants, the organiza-
tions of the youths vanguards should spend more on arms drill
and the child labour corps should devote more time to the
cultural and intellectual training.
pages.zh:
青年先锋队和童子团。

目前，青年先锋队的组织不需要在全省或全国范围内建立大型组织。此类组织将在各地建立。在我们领导下的青年先锋队队员年龄应在15至23岁之间。他们必须接受与我们队伍相同的简单武器和政治训练。他们必须勇敢，以便参加各区的暴动和斗争；他们必须与农民军建立密切关系，并应被引导参与农民军的组织。该组织的存在可以是公开或半公开的，但如果情况不利，则应秘密进行。应尽一切努力使该组织在青年中普及。因此，我们应该以尽可能多的成员，领导其他组织，如灰色青年团、工农团体、娱乐俱乐部、平民学校、体育队等。童工团应普遍发展，其年龄应为8至16岁。在各工厂中组织童子团具有重要意义，应予以认真关注。在组织青年先锋队、劳动童子团和其他贫困青年组织时，有一个非常重要的原则，即这些组织应用于争取等级的斗争。各级工作部门应竭尽全力将勇敢且贫困的劳动者置于领导地位，以便他们能接受我们的目标。

在工人和农民中，青年先锋队组织应更多地投入武器操练，而童工团应 devote 更多时间于文化和智力训练。

pages.en:
Your attention is specially drawn to the use of
the various gray colored names such as the Brothers Associations,
the Chivalry Learning Association, etc. when establishing
the youths vanguard in the villages. In the cities and in
the villages, the cow boy corps, the small ball troops should
be named after our boy corps organization. We must undertake
their training in athletics and the boys should be guided
to participate in the peasants struggles or other struggles
under the leadership of the C.P. The fine elements should
be selected and introduced into the Party Group. The boy
corps should establish a close relationship with the red
color labour union, the peasants unions, and the youths
vanguards.

Intensify the organization and the work of the village
boy corps in order to establish and develop it into a village
boy corps mass organization. The work should be extended
to make the boy corps become the organization of the village
boy mass organizations. Slogans should be prepared. The
corps should proceed with the movement under the direction
of the Peasants Union and establish intimate working relations
with the Youths Vanguards. The education and the training
of the boy corps should be mingled with recreations and
amusements and should be undertaken orally and literally.
The fathers, mothers, brothers, sisters etc. should be
introduced by the boy corps to join the peasants unions, the
youths vanguards and the boy corps. All superstitions,
ancestor worships, and rites and ceremonies should be opposed.

Under the direction of the Peasants Union, the
Youths Vanguards and the Boy Corps should proceed positively
with their arms drill and political training in order to
participate in the political and economical struggles of
the mass organizations. As to the education and amusement
of the Boy Corps, every effort should be made to bring the
Corps under the guide of the Peasants Union or Labour Union.
pages.zh:
请特别注意在乡村建立青年先锋队时，使用各种灰色名称，如兄弟会、侠义学会等。在城市和乡村，童子军、小球队应以我们的童子军组织命名。我们必须承担他们的体育训练，并引导少年们在共产党的领导下参加农民斗争或其他斗争。应挑选优秀分子引入党团。童子军应与红色工会、农民协会和青年先锋队建立密切关系。

加强乡村童子军的组织和工作，以便将其建立和发展为乡村童子军群众组织。工作应扩展，使童子军成为乡村少年群众组织的机构。应准备口号。童子军应在农民协会的指导下开展运动，并与青年先锋队建立亲密的工作关系。童子军的教育和训练应与娱乐活动相结合，并以口头和书面方式进行。童子军应介绍父亲、母亲、兄弟、姐妹等加入农民协会、青年先锋队和童子军。应反对一切迷信、祖先崇拜及礼仪仪式。

在农民协会的指导下，青年先锋队和童子军应积极进行武装操练和政治训练，以便参加群众组织的政治和经济斗争。至于童子军的教育和娱乐，应尽一切努力使童子军处于农民协会或工会的指导之下。

(Youths Vanguards need not be organized in the cities.)

THE YOUTHS VANGUARD.

The Youths Vanguard is an organization for the armed struggle of the young peasants for their rights.
The vanguards should receive arms drill besides training in political and cultural matters in order to be prepared for future struggles. But under reactionary political oppression, the name of the Youths Vanguards is not to be used openly, and the organization of the Youths Athletic Corps and the Brothers Corps should be used in its stead in order to collect more young people to attend the training. Taking advantage of public meetings, anniversaries, and recreations, the Youths Vanguards should conduct activities secretly, so that more young men can receive the training.

The Youths Vanguard is an organization of armed youths in the villages of from 16 years to 23 years of age. The organization belongs to the Peasants Union's Youths Department. In the districts under the control of the red army or the red guards, the Youths Vanguards should make good connections with the red force and provide them with able members.

The organization of the Vanguards has now commenced in Chekiang, but the members have to be trained to participate in public struggles, in order that they can serve, or act as expert detectives of communications and as protectors of disseminators of handbills, posters etc. and if necessary they may be sent to the war front.

The work of the Youths Vanguard in the villages and in the Peasants Unions should be placed under the direction of the Unions and the Vanguards should be on intimate relations with the Peasants Unions and the Peasants Youths organizations. All movements belonging to military affairs should comply with the directions of the Workers and Peasants Armaments Headquarters. The Youths Vanguards, besides undertaking all the struggle and military work, should pay
pages.zh:
（城市无需组织青年先锋队。）

青年先锋队。

青年先锋队是年轻农民为争取权利而进行武装斗争的组织。
除了政治和文化事务的训练外，先锋队还应接受武装操练，为未来的斗争做好准备。但在反动政治压迫下，不得公开使用“青年先锋队”之名，而应代之以“青年体育团”和“兄弟团”的组织名称，以便吸引更多年轻人参加培训。利用公共集会、纪念日和娱乐活动，青年先锋队应秘密开展活动，从而使更多青年接受训练。

青年先锋队是乡村中16岁至23岁的武装青年组织。该组织隶属于农民协会青年部。在红军或赤卫队控制的地区，青年先锋队应与红色力量保持良好联系，并向其提供得力成员。

目前，浙江已开始组建先锋队，但必须对成员进行培训，使其能够参与公共斗争，以便担任通讯方面的专业侦探、传单和海报等宣传品的分发者的保护者，并在必要时被派往战争前线。

乡村和农民协会中的青年先锋队工作应置于协会的指导之下，先锋队应与农民协会和农民青年组织保持亲密关系。所有属于军事事务的行动均应遵守工农武装总指挥部的指示。青年先锋队除了承担所有斗争和军事工作外，还应注意

pages.en:
attention to the members' political and educational propaganda
The amusement and cultural works of the Youths Vanguards and
the Peasant Youths and the organization of the Peasants Union
should be expanded.
It is rather improper to have the Youths Vanguards
and the Peasants Unions to be separate organizations. It
is better for the Youths Vanguards to oppose this in the
name of the Peasants Union. At the same time, the Youths
Vanguard should be the central element in the Peasants
Union to undertake propaganda work and to spread it among
the members of the Unions. As the Youths Vanguard is not
an independent element in the Peasants Unions, it is
unnecessary for it to oppose any mistake made by the Peasants
Union.
As the Youths Vanguard possesses political,
military and cultural characteristics, their duties are
(1) to take part in the riots in a village or in guerilla
warfare under the direction of the Peasants Union or
the Peasants Committee; it is their work to create a
state of panic among the people.
(2) During a riot, the public youth mass should be called
forth to attend and to uphold the Soviet Government.
(3) In the districts where there are no Peasants Unions or
Peasants Committee, they have to instigate a mass
struggle and to establish a Peasants Union or Peasants
Committee under the direction of the Party Group.
(4) Within the peasant mass, the propaganda on the expansion
of the revolutionary aims and the Soviet Government should
be spread so that a general riot can be stimulated.
(5) In the places where there exist the so-called Red Spears
Associations, the Daggers Associations etc., the Youths
Vanguard should, in the name of the Peasants Unions,
lead the members of the Association to bring about mass
pages.zh:
成员的政治和教育宣传工作。
应扩大青年先锋队、农民青年以及农民协会组织的娱乐和文化工作。
让青年先锋队和农民协会成为分离的组织是不太恰当的。青年先锋队最好以农民协会的名义反对这种分离。同时，青年先锋队应作为农民协会的核心力量，承担宣传工作并在协会成员中加以传播。由于青年先锋队不是农民协会中的独立要素，因此没有必要去反对农民协会所犯的任何错误。
鉴于青年先锋队具有政治、军事和文化特征，其职责是：
(1) 在农民协会或农民委员会的指导下，参加乡村暴动或游击战；他们的工作是在民众中制造恐慌状态。
(2) 在暴动期间，应号召广大青年群众参加并拥护苏维埃政府。
(3) 在没有农民协会或农民委员会的地区，他们必须在党团的指导下煽动群众斗争，并建立农民协会或农民委员会。
(4) 在农民群众中，应传播关于扩大革命目标和苏维埃政府的宣传，以刺激全面暴动。
(5) 在存在所谓红枪会、大刀会等组织的地方，青年先锋队应以农民协会的名义，带领协会会员发动群众

pages.en:
- 26 -

struggle; the vassal organizations of the Associations should
be abolished.
(6) The ordinary activities of the Youths Vanguard should be :-
(a) Calling of usual meetings of the various ranks.
(b) To give every member the usual military training.
(c) To popularize the organizations.
(d) To intensify revolutionary training and to develop
Communistic education in order to accelerate an
understanding of the members towards the questions on
rank and land revolutions and the political organizations.
(e) To attend to the work of the Peasants Unions and the
Peasants Committees.
(f) To disseminate various kinds of propaganda papers and
publications and to establish farmers newspapers and
pictorials.
(g) To undertake the detective work and to protect the
Peasants organizations.
(h) To promote various kinds of athletic games like
football, boxing etc.
(i) To promote various kinds of amusements like music
(village songs may be compiled) and other amusements.
(j) To observe the joint drill ceremoney every week and
every month.
(k) To attend to mass conferences, the various revolutionary
anniversaries in the various districts etc. and to
hold processions, to call meetings, to spread propaganda
and to shout slogans.

Organization Law:
(1) The Youths Vanguard is organized in units, each village
being equal to one unit, in which a detachment of the
Vanguard will be established. A detachment has one leader
and one deputy leader. A detachment is divided into
sections; one section contains ten men, and a sectional
chief is to be elected. A detachment can hold a conference
pages.zh:
- 26 -

斗争；应废除这些协会的附属组织。
(6) 青年先锋队的日常活动应为：
(a) 召开各级常规会议。
(b) 对每位成员进行常规军事训练。
(c) 普及组织工作。
(d) 加强革命训练，发展共产主义教育，以加速成员对阶级、土地革命及政治组织问题的理解。
(e) 协助农民协会和农民委员会的工作。
(f) 散发各种宣传刊物和出版物，并创办农民报纸和画报。
(g) 承担侦探工作并保护农民组织。
(h) 推广各类体育比赛，如足球、拳击等。
(i) 推广各类娱乐活动，如音乐（可编纂乡村歌曲）及其他娱乐。
(j) 每周和每月举行联合操练仪式。
(k) 参加群众大会、各地区的各种革命纪念日等，举行游行、召开会议、散布宣传并高呼口号。

组织法：
(1) 青年先锋队以单位为建制，每个村相当于一个单位，其中将设立一个先锋队分队。一个分队设一名队长和一名副队长。分队下设若干小队；每小队由十人组成，并选举一名小队长。分队可召开

pages.en:
- 27 -
of all sectional chiefs and this conference is the highest
organ in the whole village. Three to seven Executive
Committeemen are to be elected at the conference.
(2) Two or three meetings may be held by each section within
one month. The conference of Sectional Chiefs is to be
held once a week, and the meeting of the detachment chiefs
is to be held once a month.
(3) Detachment and sectional chiefs are to be elected from
the lower ranks, but in time of necessity, they can be
appointed by superior organs.
The Relations Of The Vanguard With the Peasants Committee
And The Peasants Army.
(1) All the work of the Youths Vanguard should be under the
direction of the Communist Group. The various detachments,
detachment chiefs and the sectional chiefs are to held
by comrades, and the Communist Group will select comrades
for the vanguard.
(2) The Youths Vanguard should be under the direction of the
Youths Department of the Peasants Union, and each member
of the Vanguard should join the Peasants Unions and the
Peasants Committee.
(3) In war time, the Youths Vanguard should be directed by
the Peasants Army. A portion of the Vanguard should be
enlisted into the Peasants Army and a part of the Peasants
Army should select a number of its members to train the
Youths Vanguard.
The Youths Vanguard is an organization formed
by the Youths mass in villages, which work is one of the
greatest importance in villages. Their characteristics are:-
(1) military, (2) political and (3) cultural.
Their work in ordinary times are:-
(a) to instill military knowledge and actions (like the work
of spies, sentinels, bodyguards, policing squads to
maintain order etc.) to the young people.
pages.zh:
- 27 -
全体小队长会议，该会议是全村的最高机构。会议上应选举三至七名执行委员。
(2) 每个小队在一个月内可举行两到三次会议。小队长会议每周举行一次，分队长会议每月举行一次。
(3) 分队长和小队长应从下级人员中选举产生，但在必要时刻，可由上级机关任命。
先锋队与农民委员会及农民军的关系。
(1) 青年先锋队的所有工作均应在共产党组的指导下进行。各分队、分队长和小队长均由同志担任，共产党组将为先锋队选派同志。
(2) 青年先锋队应受农民协会青年部的指导，每名先锋队成员均应加入农民协会和农民委员会。
(3) 战时，青年先锋队应由农民军指挥。部分先锋队成员应征入农民军，农民军也应挑选部分成员来训练青年先锋队。
青年先锋队是由乡村青年群众组成的组织，其工作在乡村中具有极其重要的意义。其特征为：(1) 军事性，(2) 政治性和 (3) 文化性。
其平时的工作为：
(a) 向青年灌输军事知识和行动（如间谍、哨兵、保镖、维持秩序的警察小队等工作）。

pages.en:
- 28 -

(b) to hold various kinds of processions(like drills, music
parties, groups etc.) and to instill educational knowledge
among the youths in order to promote the civilization of
the youths.

(c) to hold various kinds of meetings(like revolutionary
anniversary days and other memorial days), directing all
the youths to participate in the various propaganda work
in order to promote an understanding of politics and
the make them accustomed to organizational work or
movements. The principal object is to promote the
political knowledge and the understanging of ranks by the
youths mass, and to lead them to struggle for the rights
of the youths themselves.

Their duties in war time are:-

(a) to undertake the major part of propaganda work by organizing
propaganda groups to disseminate handbills, posters,
slogans and to stage processions and deliver speeches.

(b) to undertake work as spies, or sentinels, relay men etc.

(c) to stage struggles, processions, demonstrations, and to
strike at the reactionary elements, to arrest reactionaries,
to resist armed attacks by reactionary elements, and to
make secret attacks on the armed men of the reactionaries
(like the Police, Peace Maintenance Corps etc.)

Organization:-

(1) The Youths Vanguard is to be organized of youths of from
16 to 23 years of age, who are farmers. The vanguard will
be under the control of the Peasants Unions.

(2) Each village is equal to one unit, and each unit should
have a detachment of more than five men. If the
detachment containing more than ten men, it should be
divided into sections or groups, each group should to
contain five to twelve men. A village or district which
has two detachments or groups, should form a big detachment.
Each Hsien should establish a headquarters, which should
contain three to five directors.
pages.zh:
- 28 -

(b) 举行各种形式的游行（如操练、音乐聚会、团体活动等），并向青年灌输教育知识，以促进青年的文明化。

(c) 举行各种会议（如革命纪念日和其他纪念日），指导所有青年参与各种宣传工作，以提高政治觉悟，使他们习惯于组织工作或运动。主要目的是提高青年群众的政治知识和阶级意识，并领导他们为争取青年自身的权利而斗争。

其战时的职责为：

(a) 通过组织宣传小组散发传单、海报、标语，举行游行和发表演讲，承担大部分宣传工作。

(b) 承担间谍、哨兵、通讯员等工作。

(c) 发动斗争、游行、示威，打击反动分子，逮捕反革命分子，抵抗反动分子的武装攻击，并对反动派的武装人员（如警察、保安队等）进行秘密袭击。

组织：

(1) 青年先锋队由16至23岁的农民青年组成。先锋队受农民协会控制。

(2) 每个村相当于一个单位，每个单位应有一个五人以上的分队。如果分队超过十人，应分为小队或小组，每组应包含五至十二人。拥有两个分队或小组的村或区，应组成一个大分队。每个县应设立一个总部，由三至五名董事组成。

pages.en:
- 29 -

(3) The Headquarters should be in communication with the Hsien's
Peasants Unions, the big detachments with the village or
district peasants unions, and the groups or sections with
the village peasants unions.
(4) In those Hsiens or districts which contain villages, a
central detachment should be organized. Each central
or middle detachment should comprise at least two detachments.
and each big detachment may contain two middle detachments.
One chief and one vice-chief should be elected in one
middle detachment.

The Relations Between the Youths Vanguard With the Peasants
Unions And the Red Army.
(1) The economic relations with the Peasants Unions have been
already mentioned in Article 3.
(2) Relations of working with the Peasants Unions:-
(a) They have to receive directions from the Youths Departments
of the Peasants Unions, and the latter should systemically
train them. The conference of the various ranks of the
Youths Vanguard, or the meeting of the entire body of the
Vanguard should be convoked frequently, at which, direction
on political,military and cultural works should be given.
(b) The Peasants Union should pay all the expenses of the
Youths Vanguard.
(c) The various ranks of the Peasants Unions in a Hsien must
at any time direct the organizations of the equal ranks
of the Youths Vanguard(like the big detachments or the
peasants unions' detachments etc.) to go on with their
work within their respective working areas, But in time
of war, or of transfer, the Youths Vanguard should obey
the directions of the General Directors of the Youths
Vanguard, the various ranks of the Peasants Unions cannot
give orders at this time in order to avoid confusion.
pages.zh:
- 29 -

(3) 总部应与县农民协会保持联络，大支队应与村或区农民协会保持联络，小组或分队应与村农民协会保持联络。
(4) 在包含村庄的那些县或区，应组织一个中心支队。每个中心或中等支队应至少包括两个支队，每个大支队可包含两个中等支队。在一个中等支队中，应选举一名正职和一名副职负责人。

少年先锋队与农民协会及红军的关系。
(1) 与农民协会的经济关系已在第3条中提及。
(2) 与农民协会的工作关系：-
(a) 他们必须接受农民协会青年部的指导，后者应系统地训练他们。应经常召开各级少年先锋队的会议，或全体先锋队大会，在会上给予政治、军事和文化工作方面的指导。
(b) 农民协会应承担少年先锋队的所有费用。
(c) 县内各级农民协会必须随时指导同等级的少年先锋队组织（如大支队或农民协会支队等）在其各自的工作区域内开展工作，但在战时或转移期间，少年先锋队应服从少年先锋队总指挥部的指导，此时各级农民协会不得下达命令，以避免混乱。

pages.en:
- 30 -

(3) The Youths Vanguard should be on intimate terms with the
red army, and in time of necessity, they should be directed
by the red army, but this should be approved by the
General Directors Headquarters of the Youths Vanguard.
The Relations Between the Youths Vanguard With the Communist
Groups.
(1) The Groups should establish Group sections in the various
small Youths Vanguard for holding discussions.
(2) The Group sections should spread our political views among
the youths vanguard with the various kinds of formulae
(like making speeches during a meeting), and the brave
and clever elements in the mass of the youths vanguard
should be gradually collected.

semi-openly used in its stead. But in dealing with internal
affairs, the name of the Youths Vanguard should be maintained,
and the nature and training work of the Vanguard should be
strictly followed in order to prepare for future struggles.
In case of victory, the "gray color " organizations should be
immediately turned into red color struggling organizations.
(2) The so-called armed training does not strictly mean military
training. The learning of boxing, the training for various
kinds of athletics, and games etc. are all the primary steps
of armed training. The armed training of the Youths Vanguard
begins with the lessons mentioned above; they are a prelude
to the military and fighting training.
(3) In the past, very few places organized Youths Vanguard and those
places which had such organizations were not enthusiastically
developed. Therefore when the organizations receive a notice,
they should act on the resolutions passed or any decisions
reached by the Provincial Committee to proceed with their work,
and they should submit a report of the work to the Provincial
Committee.

THE BOY CORPS.

The boy mass in a workers area should receive
special attention. The various ranks of Groups and Departments
should try everything possible to restore and to develop the
original organizations of the labour boy corps. At the same
time, the new boy corps should be established and trained.
The training work of the boy corps should include amusements
and the boys should be guided to participate in the various
struggles under the leadership of Labour Unions in or-der to
make them become fighters. Slogans of boy corps should be
drawn up. The boy corps should enter the movement under the
direction of the red labour union.

- 31 -

“灰色”名称，如青年娱乐协会、青年体育协会等，公开或半公开地取而代之。但在处理内部事务时，应保持“少年先锋队”的名称，并严格遵循先锋队的性质和训练工作，为未来的斗争做准备。一旦取得胜利，“灰色”组织应立即转变为红色斗争组织。
(2) 所谓的武装训练并不严格意味着军事训练。学习拳击、各种体育运动和游戏的训练等都是武装训练的初级步骤。少年先锋队的武装训练从上述课程开始；它们是军事和战斗训练的前奏。
(3) 过去，很少有地方组织少年先锋队，而那些有此组织的地方也没有热情地发展。因此，当各组织收到通知时，应根据省委通过的决议或作出的决定开展工作，并向省委提交工作报告。

童子团。

工人区的儿童群众应受到特别关注。各级小组和部门应尽一切可能恢复和发展原有的劳工童子团组织。同时，应建立和训练新的童子团。童子团的训练工作应包括娱乐活动，并引导儿童在工会的领导下参与各种斗争，使他们成为战士。应制定童子团的口号。童子团应在红色工会的指导下进入运动。

pages.en:
- 32 -

The Boy Corps have two descriptions: one as belonging to villages and the other as belonging to labour(factories). Their ages must be from 8 to 16. The work of the organizations is principally to promote amusements and education but during a time of struggle, they should work as spies and propagandists. Their slogan is "Rush forward". Their work is to be controlled by themselves.

No matter whether they boy labourers, boy cowheards, or apprentices, they are active units, future fighters, although at present, they are the slaves of the adults, and are being cruelly oppressed. We must not look down upon them, we should organize them into bodies and train them in revolutionary ideas besides providing them with amusements to promote their fighting instincts. In the Boy Corps are included the Village Labour Boy Corps, the Factory Boy Corps, the Street Boy Corps and the School Boy Corps.

Attention should be drawn to the movements of the boys because they are the future elements and the future builders of society. They have not been tinged with the rites of the old society and they have not been overcome by capitalistic thought. Their instinct is active, they are imitative and constructive. They will act according to our propaganda and carry out what they are taught. Furthermore, they are not afraid of oppressions and they do not fear death. They have no family worries so that they can bravely struggle for their own principles.

The father country of the proletariat rank - The Soviet, has in a short period organized several millions of boys wearing red collars to frighten away imperialism. They said "What we fear is not the Bolshevik political rights, but the millions of little beings, because the Soviet political rights can be upset by any political power, but it is unable to strike down the millions of boys. For the time being we should redeem all the boys in order to prepare to launch a desperate fighting with the reactionaries."
pages.zh:
- 32 -

童子团有两种类型：一种属于农村，另一种属于劳工（工厂）。其年龄必须在8至16岁之间。组织的工作主要是促进娱乐和教育，但在斗争时期，他们应充当间谍和宣传员。他们的口号是“冲锋向前”。他们的工作由他们自己控制。

无论是童工、牧童还是学徒，他们都是活跃的单位，是未来的战士，尽管目前他们是成年人的奴隶，正遭受残酷的压迫。我们不应轻视他们，应将他们组织起来，除了提供娱乐以促进他们的战斗本能的之外，还要用革命思想训练他们。童子团包括农村劳工童子团、工厂童子团、街头童子团和学校童子团。

应关注儿童的运动，因为他们是未来的要素和社会的未来建设者。他们尚未沾染旧社会的礼教，也未被资本主义思想所征服。他们的本能是活跃的，具有模仿性和建设性。他们会根据我们的宣传行事，并执行所教的内容。此外，他们不害怕压迫，也不畏惧死亡。他们没有家庭顾虑，因此可以勇敢地为自己的原则而斗争。

无产阶级阶层的祖国——苏维埃，在短时间内组织了数百万佩戴红领结的儿童，以吓退帝国主义。他们说：“我们害怕的不是布尔什维克的政治权利，而是数百万的小生命，因为苏维埃的政治权利可能被任何政治力量推翻，但无法击垮数百万儿童。目前，我们应该拯救所有儿童，以便准备与反动派进行殊死搏斗。”

- 33

The boys in the villages should be organized
independently into boy corps.
(1) The work of the boy corps should be amusements, education and
the training of drills and primarily military knowledge.
(2) They have to attend the struggles.
The work of the Boy Corps are:-
(1) It is a mistake to disregard the organization of the boys
corps in the various Hsiens. The system of the work of
the boy corps will be mentioned later.
(2) Although the work of the boy corps is amusement, but the
amusement must be of the fighting kind.
(3) The boys should be trained into become acquainted with the
work of spies, flag signaling, rescue work, maintaining
order, and to act as relay men to carry news.
(4) No matter whether it is before or after a war, the boy
corps should undertake the work of securing news, investigat-
ing the wounded etc.
(5) The boy corps should struggle for the interests of the boys
themselves under the leadership of the labour unions or the
peasants unions.
(6) The boy corps should promote their own developments, they
must not be regarded as infant organizations. Those
boys of the age of thirteen and who understand the real
meaning of the corps, can act as special members.
(7) Sections should be organized within the boy corps and all
resolutions passed by the boy corps must be of a sectional
utility. Avoid instructing the boys in a harsh manner.
(8) All labour boy corps should belong to the labour unions,
the village boys should belong to the Peasants Unions and
the various ranks of the boy corps should belong to the
Youths Committee of the various ranks of the labour unions
or the peasants unions. The Peasants Unions should
discuss the work of the boy corps. The expenses of the

农村的儿童应独立组织成童子团。
(1) 童子团的工作应是娱乐、教育以及操练和初步军事知识的训练。
(2) 他们必须参加斗争。
童子团的工作是：-
(1) 忽视各县童子团的组织是一个错误。童子团的工作系统将在后文提及。
(2) 虽然童子团的工作是娱乐，但娱乐必须是战斗性质的。
(3) 应训练儿童熟悉间谍工作、旗语信号、救援工作、维持秩序以及担任传递消息的交通员。
(4) 无论是在战前还是战后，童子团都应承担获取新闻、调查伤员等工作。
(5) 童子团应在工会或农民协会的领导下，为儿童自身的利益而斗争。
(6) 童子团应促进自身的发展，不应被视为幼稚的组织。那些年满十三岁且理解团体真正含义的儿童，可以作为特别成员。
(7) 应在童子团内组织分队，童子团通过的所有决议必须具有分队的实用性。避免以严厉的方式指令儿童。
(8) 所有劳工童子团应隶属于工会，农村儿童应隶属于农民协会，各级童子团应隶属于各级工会或农民协会的青年委员会。农民协会应讨论童子团的工作。童子团的经费

boy corps should be formally defrayed by the labour unions
or the peasants unions. The students or the street boys
organizations can be under the control of the boy corps
of the area.

(9) The organization of the boy corps can include a Hsien
Headquarters, a district or a village corps department.
Each village or district has to be divided into big
detachments. Five men can form a detachment, and if
there are over ten men, then the detachment can be divided
into sections. Each detachment can have two or three
sections. Two detachments can form a big detachment.
In villages or districts which have two big detachments,
a so-called District or Village Boy Corps Headquarters
can be formed. A big detachment in a district or village
will have no fixed numbers. When there are three Corps
Headquarters in one Hsien, then a Hsien or City General
Headquarters may be formed.

(10) In a big detachment, one factory equals to one unit, while
a village is regarded as one unit in the village boy corps.
The demarcation of the district or village units can be
undertaken by the Peasants Committees.

(11) The various ranks of the Boy Corp organizations should
consist of three to seven boys. Each section shall
contain one chief and one vice-chief. Each big detachment
shall have one chief and two vice-chiefs. The two vice
sectional chiefs should undertake their respective work
on propaganda and education. Above the Corps Departments,
the Chief of the corps should undertake propaganda and
educational work.

(12) The work of the boy corps is to be borne mainly by the
C.Y. and the various ranks of the C.Y. should urge the
responsible C.Y. members to pass resolutions in order to
accelerate the work. The work of the village boy corps
(i.e. the big detachments or detachments) is one of great

应由工会或农民协会正式支付。学生或街头儿童组织可受该地区童子团的管辖。

(9) 童子团的组织可以包括县总部、区或村童子团部。每个村或区必须划分为大支队。五人可组成一个支队，如果超过十人，则该支队可分为若干分队。每个支队可有两个或三个分队。两个支队可组成一个大支队。在拥有两个大支队的村或区，可以成立所谓的区或村童子团总部。区或村中的大支队没有固定人数。当一个县内有三个团部时，则可以成立县或市总指挥部。

(10) 在一个大支队中，一个工厂等于一个单位，而在农村童子团中，一个村庄被视为一个单位。区或村单位的划分可由农民委员会进行。

(11) 各级童子团组织应由三至七名儿童组成。每个分队应设一名正职和一名副职负责人。每个大支队应设一名正职和两名副职负责人。两名副分队长应分别负责宣传和教育工作。在团部之上，团长应承担宣传和教育工作的职责。

(12) 童子团的工作主要由共青团承担，各级共青团应督促负责的共青团成员通过决议，以加速工作。农村童子团（即大支队或支队）的工作对各支部部门来说至关重要。

importance for the branch departments.

the labour unions and the peasants union and the C.Y.'s

THE VICTIMS RELIEF ASSOCIATION.
After the expansion of the conference held in
March this year, big and minor struggles have taken place at
various places during the past several months. Therefore,
many leaders of the revolutionary masses - the Communists -
have been arrested and killed. In the jails of the Special
Courts in Hangchow, Ningpo and Landohi, there are crowds of
these revolutionary political offenders, but the struggle is
still breaking out here and there. Victims Relief Associations
should be established in various places to assist the development
of the Party organisations and one the other hand, to render
relief to the victimized revolutionists and to their families.
(1) The Organization.
(a) The various Hsien or district committees should appoint
one man each to undertake the work of establishing the
Associations. In villages or in public bodies(like
schools, peasants unions and the labour unions) which
have branch organizations of the C.P., branch victims
associations should be established. Members of the

受害者救济协会。
在今年三月召开的会议扩大后，过去几个月里各地发生了大大小小的斗争。因此，许多革命群众领袖——共产党员——被捕并被杀害。在杭州、宁波和兰多希（音译）特别法院的监狱里，关押着大批这类革命政治犯，但斗争仍在各地爆发。应在各地建立受害者救济协会，以协助党组织的发展，另一方面，向受害的革命者及其家属提供救济。
(1) 组织。
(a) 各县或区委员会应各指派一人负责建立协会的工作。在拥有中共分支组织的村庄或公共机构（如学校、农民协会和工会）中，应建立分支受害者协会。成员

pages.en:
- 36 -

associations should be widely collected. In Ningpo
and Langchi, where the relief work is more urgent, one
member should be appointed to undertake relief work
without concurrently doing other work. $10 will be
granted every month to the branch associations in the
two places by the Provincial Victims Relief Association.
Other branches will not be so assisted.
(b) The Name of the Association:- In Chekiang, the majority
of people knowsvery well that the Victims Relief
Associationsare CpP. organs, So the name is not fit
for use in Chekiang province. When there is such a
branch association established in any public body, a
suitable name should be used. Other names like the
Mutual Relief Association, the So and So Relief
Association, the Fraternity Associations, the Joint
Friendship Associations, the Mutual Assistance Associations,
and the Mutual Progress Associations etc. may be suitably
adopted. But in dealing with internal Party affairs,
the name of the Victims Relief Association should be
retained.
(c) The Personnel of the Association:- The principal elements
to develop the Relief Association are certainly the
workers, farmers , the students and the merchants.
But the middle class ranks and the intellectual elements
are gradually quitting battle lines of the anti-big-
capitalists because they have been oppressed by the
Kuomintang and the reactionary National Government; they
are inclining to the Left. Therefore, special attention
should be paid to the collection of these elements.
In order to facilitate the relief work and the organization
work, an Association of victimized families should also
be established.

应广泛征集各协会。在宁波和兰溪（音译），救济工作更为紧迫，应指派一名成员专门负责救济工作，不得兼任其他工作。省受害者救济协会每月将向这两地的分会拨款10美元。其他分会不享受此类资助。
(b) 协会名称：在浙江，大多数人非常清楚受害者救济协会是中共机构，因此该名称不适合在浙江省使用。当在任何公共团体中建立此类分会时，应使用合适的名称。其他名称如互助协会、某某救济协会、兄弟会、联谊协会、互济会和共进会等，均可酌情采用。但在处理党内事务时，应保留“受害者救济协会”的名称。
(c) 协会人员：发展救济协会的主要力量当然是工人、农民、学生和商人。但中产阶级阶层和知识分子元素因受到国民党和反动国民政府的压迫，正逐渐退出反大资本家的战线；他们倾向于左派。因此，应特别注意吸纳这些元素。为了便于开展救济工作和组织工作，还应成立一个受害家庭协会。

pages.en:
- 37 -

(d) Methods to Develop the Organization.- There are many
methods to develop the organizations, but not a single
method can be accepted unanimously. Of suitable methods
are the following are the principals:-
(1) Comrades in the various sections, branch departments
and party groups should collect new members.
(2) The responsible members of the relief associations
should conduct activities to enlist new members by
inciting the popular mass.
(3) The members of the association as well as those who
are in sympathy with the association should be requested
to undertake the work of enlisting new members.
(4) The victimized families should be utilized to conduct
propaganda activities.
(e) The Expenditure of The Association.- The amount of
Association fees to be paid by individual members depends
on the professions of the members; no regular amount can
be fixed. Workers or farmers may subscribe 1 to 2 coppers;
students five to ten coppers monthly. The members of public
bodies may freely fix the contribution themselves; the funds
collected shall be kept by a responsible man elected by
the public bodies, but must not remit them to the
Association. In case any member is wounded or arrested
in some struggle, the funds may be immediately used to
render relief. This means of collecting funds gives a
clear account to the subscribers on the proper use of the
money, and many complicated procedure of handling the
money may be avoided during the secret period. But
a full account of the money collected should be reported
to the General Victims Relief Association once a month.
(2) The Propaganda.
Regular propaganda work should be undertaken
besides the organization work of the Association. When the
work encounters the White Terror, manifestoes and handbills
pages.zh:
- 37 -

(d) 发展组织的方法。发展组织的方法有很多，但没有一种方法能获得一致认可。以下是主要适用的方法：
(1) 各科、支部部门和党团中的同志应征集新成员。
(2) 救济协会的负责人应通过发动群众来开展活动，以招募新成员。
(3) 应要求协会成员以及同情协会的人士承担招募新成员的工作。
(4) 应利用受害家庭开展宣传活动。
(e) 协会的开支。个人成员缴纳的会费金额取决于成员的职业；无法规定固定金额。工人或农民可每月缴纳1至2个铜板；学生每月缴纳5至10个铜板。公共团体的成员可自行决定捐款金额；所筹资金应由公共团体选举出的负责人保管，但不得汇给协会。如果任何成员在斗争中受伤或被捕，可立即使用这些资金进行救济。这种筹资方式让捐款人清楚了解资金的正当用途，并且在秘密时期可以避免处理资金的许多复杂程序。但每月应向省总受害者救济协会报告所筹资金的完整账目。
(2) 宣传。
除了协会的组织工作外，还应开展常规宣传工作。当工作遭遇白色恐怖时，应发布和分发宣言及传单

pages.en:
- 38 -
should be published and distributed. The small capitalist
ranks and intellectual elements should be regularly provided
with propaganda materials, (gray colored third party's
sayings) so that their sympathy may be won. Promote
public confidence in the Victims Relief Association and
expand the organization of the Association. A record of
the victims' photographs, wills etc. should be collected
and sent to the Provincial General Association.
(3) Relief.
(a) Scope of the Relief. - Relief will be given to those
who are wounded or killed in struggles or who are
refugees from the struggles, or the families of members
who have been killed or arrested. Sick or unemployed
members are not to be given relief by the Association.
(b) The Extent of the Relief:- the relief funds given may
be fixed in accordance with the condition of the
victims or of the victims' families.
(c) The Uses of Money Given Out As Relief Funds:-
(1) For funeral expenses, at most, $20.
(2) Should the victim's family cannot really support
itself, each member of the family will be given
$2 a month for one year.
(3) Wounded victims will be given 40 cents a day
for medical and living expenses. The period of
the relief will be three months after which
period, no further relief will be given. Wounded
victims who do not receive treatment in hospitals
will be given relief fund once of not more than $3.
(4) Victims who are arrested will be given $3 a month
as food expenses, $6 for clothing expenses during
Spring and Winter, and $4 as other expenses during
Summer and Autumn.
(5) Those who are seriously ill in a jail will be given
$5 a month as medical expenses; those who are
pages.zh:
- 38 -

应定期向小资产阶级阶层和知识分子提供宣传材料（灰色的第三方言论），以赢得他们的同情。促进公众对受害者救济协会的信心，并扩大协会的组织。应收集受害者的照片、遗嘱等记录，并送往省总会。
(3) 救济。
(a) 救济范围。——救济对象包括在斗争中受伤或死亡的人、斗争中的难民，以及被杀害或逮捕成员的家属。生病或失业的成员不由协会提供救济。
(b) 救济程度：——可根据受害者或其家庭的状况确定发放的救济金金额。
(c) 作为救济金发放的资金用途：
(1) 用于丧葬费用，最多20美元。
(2) 如果受害者家庭确实无法维持生计，每个家庭成员每月将获得2美元，为期一年。
(3) 受伤受害者每天将获得40美分，用于医疗和生活费用。救济期为三个月，此后不再提供救济。不在医院接受治疗的受伤受害者将一次性获得不超过3美元的救济金。
(4) 被捕受害者每月将获得3美元作为伙食费，春季和冬季获得6美元作为服装费，夏季和秋季获得4美元作为其他费用。
(5) 狱中重病者每月将获得5美元作为医疗费；那些

pages.en:
- 39 -

slightly sick will not be given any relief fund.
(6) The families of those victims who are arrested will be
given living expenses of $2 each month; and after sentence
has been passed, the relief funds will be given once for
all, the amount of which depending on the heaviness of
the sentence.
(7) Rescue funds (including lawyer feew, canvassing fecs,
etc.) will be $20 each, beyong which sum, the fund will
call upon a special fund. The drawing upon the special
fund should be approved by the Party and the General
Association.
(8) Those victims who can not earn their living temporarily
after they are released will be given a relief fund of $5.

ports will be given living expenses.
(b) Those who are wounded will be sent to hospitals
for treatment.
(D) The Treating of The Dead.

The work and the plans of the Relief Society of the
Southern Chekiang Special Committee are as follows:-
1) In view of the work and the organization of the Relief
Society in the future, the Central Government of the
Communist Party has submitted the following suggestions:-
a) The Relief Society is not a charity organ nor is it
an independent relief organ. The principal object of
the Relief Society is to assist in the development of
the revolutionary struggle. Its missions are as follows:-
1) To render spiritual and material assistance to
revolutionary victims, to console to their sufferings
and to encourage them to a stronger determination
and courage in revolutionary struggle.
2) To call on the vast mass of people and on sympathizers
to render mutual assistance in times of revolution.
3) To promote an understanding of the revolution among
the multitude of labourers and farmers.
4) To expand the anti white terror propaganda for the
purpose of arousing the hatred against oppressions
by reactionaries.
Although the methods of work of the Relief Society
are quite different from those of the Party, yet its political
mission and work should be sanctioned by the Party. It should
act as assistant to the Party.
b) At present the chief mission of the Party is to devise
means to secure control of the hundreds of thousand
millions of people under its direction. The present
policies are as follows:-
1) To propagate among the multitude of labourers and
farmers where relief work is to be introduced and to
make the people themselves organise relief and to
expand the spirit of mutual aid and activities among
the people of various trades.
2) To look after the comrades of the Relief Society
among the small capitalists and to strengthen the
foundations of the Society and its position in the

浙南特别委员会救济社的工作和计划如下：
1) 鉴于救济社未来的工作和组织，共产党中央提出了以下建议：
a) 救济社不是慈善机构，也不是独立的救济机构。救济社的主要目标是协助发展革命斗争。其使命如下：
1) 为革命受害者提供精神和物质援助，抚慰他们的痛苦，并鼓励他们在革命斗争中拥有更坚定的决心和勇气。
2) 号召广大民众和同情者在革命时期互相援助。
3) 促进广大劳工和农民对革命的理解。
4) 扩大反白色恐怖宣传，目的是激起对反动派压迫的仇恨。
虽然救济社的工作方法与党截然不同，但其政治使命和工作应得到党的认可。它应充当党的助手。
b) 目前党的主要任务是设法确保对其领导下的成千上万民众的控制。目前的政策如下：
1) 在将要开展救济工作的广大劳工和农民中进行宣传，使人们自己组织救济，并扩大各行业人民之间的互助精神和活动。
2) 照顾小资产阶级中的救济社同志，加强社团的基础及其在社会中的地位

pages.en:
community.
3) To stir up anti white terror propaganda among the
revolutionary sympathizers.
4) To urge the people under the direction of the Party
to be united strength and determined in the struggle.
c) The organisation of the Relief Society should be
reformed as follows:-
1) The work and organisation of the Relief Society
should be independent and united.
2) Each public body or individual must be able to develop
the organisation of the Relief Society. It can
also be named "The Mutual Aid Association", "The
Mutual Assistance Association" and "The Friendship
Society" which should be organised publicly and which
the people themselves should maintain. The Relief
Society will direct and render assistance in their
work.
3) The Relief Society will still be an organisation of the
whole country, but, in order to facilitate its work,
the municipal hsiens will change the name into
"The Humanity Mutual Assistance Association" or "The
Charity Association".
4) The various public or semi-public organisation are still
to be directed by the local "Tangpu".
d) The Relief principles should be altered as follows:-
1) Relief should be rendered to the families of those
arrested, injured, killed or dead in prisons as well
as to those who have taken to flight.
2) Relief funds are to be issued fully to the families
of persons who have died in prison so that the family
might use the funds to start in a small trade or other
occupations. The Relief Society should find work
for them should circumstances permit.
3) The funds for development and special relief at the time
of a severe struggle should be raised through the

4) 敦促在党领导下的人们团结力量，坚定斗争。
c) 救济社的组织应改革如下：
1) 救济社的工作和组织应独立且统一。
2) 每个公共团体或个人都必须能够发展救济社的组织。也可以命名为“互助协会”、“互济会”和“联谊会”，这些组织应公开组建，并由人民自己维持。救济社将指导并协助他们的工作。

2) 应向在狱中死亡者的家属全额发放救济金，以便家庭利用这笔资金开始小生意或其他职业。如果情况允许，救济社应为他们找工作。
3) 在激烈斗争时期的发展和特别救济资金应通过

Recently over 60 comrades were imprisoned and 120

The various hsiens and provincial relief societies

1 - CONFISCATION OF LANDS.

The most important mission of the Chinese
revolutionary proletariat is to start a revolution to enforce
the peoples rights. The confiscation of land will annihilate
the feudal and political foundations and wipe out feudalism.
In order to complete this mission, the absolute political rights
of labourers and farmers under the proletariat should be
established.

The Central Government of the Communist Party
has instructed the various "Tangpu" to carry out the schemes
for creating disturbances. The most important points are:-
1) That all lands and family temples be confiscated and con-
verted into public property and managed by the Soviet and
those persons who know how to plough plan be given a
portion of the lands.
2) That all lands be divided among the farmers to be ploughed
after a Land Certificate has been issued by the Soviet
hsien government. If such a body has not yet been
established, the Certificate should be issued by the highest
local Soviet. The lands are not to be bought or sold.
3) That the distribution of lands be based on the number of
of members in a family or on the fertility or sterility of
the land.
4) That officials and soldiers of the Red Army who are now in
service and have families be allowed to engage men to plough
the field.
5) That the lands be shared among the farm labourers in case
the latter wish to plough the land for themselves.
6) That the regulations governing the protection of farm
labourers be promulgated and that stress be laid on the
following points: that wages be increased; that their
treatment be improved; that the working hours be reduced.
All these benefits will be secured after the lands have
been confiscated.
7) That the wages of manual workers and coolies be increased

1 - 没收土地。

中国革命无产阶级最重要的使命是发动革命以实行民权。没收土地将摧毁封建和政治基础，并铲除封建主义。为了完成这一使命，应确立无产阶级领导下劳动者和农民的绝对政治权利。

共产党中央政府已指示各“塘部”（音译）执行制造动乱的计划。最重要的要点是：-
1) 所有土地和宗祠均予没收，转为公有财产，由苏维埃管理，并将部分土地分给懂得耕种的人。
2) 所有土地在苏维埃县政府颁发土地证后分给农民耕种。如果尚未建立此类机构，则应由最高地方苏维埃颁发证书。土地不得买卖。
3) 土地分配应基于家庭成员人数或土地的肥沃与贫瘠程度。
4) 允许现役且有家庭的红军官兵雇人耕种田地。
5) 如果农业工人希望自己耕种土地，则应将土地分给他们。
6) 颁布保护农业工人的条例，并强调以下几点：增加工资；改善待遇；减少工作时间。所有这些福利将在没收土地后得到保障。
7) 增加体力工人和苦力的工资

pages.en:
and their treatment be improved.
8) That all lands be divided by the Soviet under the direction
and assistance of the Soviet District.
9) That the maintenance of the livelihood of independent
old, weak and maimed persons, orphans and widows, who are
unable to do any work, be upheld.
10) That land holders pay the Soviet hsien a tax of 25% of the
agricultural products, that 20% of the total taxes collected
by the Soviet be given to the Soviet Government, 30% to the
Soviet Province, 20% to the Soviet Village and 30% to the
Soviet Hsien. The expenses of the Soviet District are
to be paid by the Soviet Hsien.

2 - SOVIET POLITICAL RIGHTS.

The Soviet is an organ to create disturbances and
to start struggles, to massacre local bullies and gentries
and to deal with the people's economic problem. It is also
an organ of legislative and judicial administration. In
other words, it is the government of labourers, farmers,
soldiers and poor citizens in China and is a real people's
government for the advantages of a majority of the people
throughout the country.
1) Prior to the occurrence of disturbances , the Soviet is
an organ to direct the creation of such disturbances. As
soon as the Soviet has been established, the Farmers
Federation, the Revolution Committee and other organs will
be dissolved and all authority will be centred in the Soviet.
2) The Soviet is the direct political authority of the people.
The Soviet should be established by election. at a public
meeting or at a meeting of representatives. Boys and girls
of 16 who are not oppressors of labourers, religious or
anti-revolutionary elements have the right to vote or
to be voted for.
3) The executive committee of the Soviet Village should be
organised by from 5 to 7 persons. Three expectant members
pages.zh:

8) 所有土地应在苏维埃区的指导和协助下由苏维埃进行分配。
9) 维持无法工作的独立生活的老弱病残者、孤儿和寡妇的生计。
10) 土地持有者向苏维埃县缴纳农产品25%的税，苏维埃征收的总税款中，20%上缴苏维埃政府，30%上缴苏维埃省，20%上缴苏维埃村，30%留归苏维埃县。苏维埃区的费用由苏维埃县支付。

2 - 苏维埃政治权利。

苏维埃是一个制造动乱、发起斗争、屠杀当地恶霸和绅士以及处理人民经济问题的机构。它也是立法和司法行政机关。换言之，它是中国工人、农民、士兵和贫苦市民的政府，是一个通过全国大多数人的利益来实现的真正人民政府。
1) 在发生动乱之前，苏维埃是指导制造此类动乱的机构。苏维埃一旦成立，农民协会、革命委员会及其他机构将被解散，所有权力将集中于苏维埃。
2) 苏维埃是人民的直接政治权力机构。苏维埃应通过公众会议或代表会议选举产生。年满16岁、非压迫劳动者者、非宗教人士或非反革命分子的男女青年拥有选举权和被选举权。
3) 苏维埃村的执行委员会应由5至7人组成。另应选举
