行政委员会主席，该委员会应组织财政委员会、经济委员会、文化委员会、审判与镇压反革命委员会、土地委员会和赤卫队委员会。每个委员会应由3至5人组成，并由县行政委员会的一名成员担任这些委员会的主席。
重要村庄的商业中心可以在苏维埃县的控制下独立建立为苏维埃中心。
6) 如果上海、汉口、天津等城市发生全面动乱，应举行工人、农民和士兵会议，出席代表的人数应根据当地斗争的情况和环境确定。工人代表的数量应至少占出席人数的70%，农民和士兵代表应至少占15%。
苏维埃市执行委员会的15至21名成员应从会议出席者中选举产生，另有7名候补成员。组织方法与苏维埃县执行委员会采用的方法相同。
7) 当需要在整个省份（如广东或湖南）制造全面动乱时，应举行工人、农民和士兵代表会议，组织苏维埃省执行委员会以指导全国的动乱。参加会议的代表最少应为40人。工人代表的数量应至少占出席人数的40%，士兵代表占10%，农民代表占50%。
苏维埃省执行委员会的21至27名成员应从会议成员中选举产生，并应组织一个

pages.en:
of from 7 to 9 persons. A chairman of the executive
committee of the Soviet Province and a Standing Committee
will be elected at a conference of the executive committees.
The executive committee of the Soviet Province will hold
a meeting once a month and the Standing Committee once
a week.
8) The various representatives of the labourers, farmers and
soldiers should draw up plans and measures of the struggle.
When a Soviet has been established all confiscations,
promulgations, executions and enforcements are to be
formally carried out by the Soviet. The subordinate organs
should strictly obey the orders of the higher Soviet.
9) The Red Guard Corps throughout the hsien is to be controlled
and mobilized under the command of the Soviet Hsien while
the Red Army (labour and agricultural revolutionary army)
is to be controlled and mobilized by the Soviet Province.
10) In connection with the confiscation of lands and the
establishment of a Soviet, the "Central Government" has
instructed the various "Tangpu" to carry out the following
work:-
a) All lands are to be confiscated to the Soviet and
converted into public property. The land is not to
be bought or sold.
b) Persons who wish to plough the land should ask for
a Land Certificate from the Soviet.
c) Land must be distributed according to the number of
members in a family and on the fertility or sterility
of the soil.
d) Officials and soldiers of the Red Army who are now in
service and have families are to be allowed to engage
men to plough the land.
e) Land must be distributed among the farm labourers who
wish to to plough it themselves.
f) The wages of farm workers must be increased; the
working hours reduced and their treatment improved.
pages.zh:
由7至9人组成的常务委员会。苏维埃省执行委员会主席和常务委员会将在执行委员会会议上选举产生。苏维埃省执行委员会每月举行一次会议，常务委员会每周举行一次会议。
8) 工人、农民和士兵的各代表应制定斗争计划和措施。苏维埃一旦成立，所有没收、颁布、处决和执行行动均由苏维埃正式进行。下级机关应严格遵守上级苏维埃的命令。
9) 全县的赤卫队应在苏维埃县的指挥下控制和动员，而红军（工农革命军）应由苏维埃省控制和动员。
10) 关于没收土地和建立苏维埃，“中央政府”已指示各“塘部”（音译）开展以下工作：-
a) 所有土地均没收归苏维埃所有，转为公有财产。土地不得买卖。
b) 希望耕种土地的人应向苏维埃申请土地证。
c) 土地必须根据家庭成员人数和土壤的肥沃与贫瘠程度进行分配。
d) 允许现役且有家庭的红军官兵雇人耕种土地。
e) 土地必须分给希望自己耕种的农业工人。
f) 必须增加农业工人的工资；减少工作时间并改善他们的待遇。

pages.en:
g) The wages of manual workers and coolies are to be
increased and their treatment be improved.
h) The Village Soviet will distribute the lands under
the direction of the Soviet District.
i) The Village Soviet will maintain the livelihood of
old, weak and maimed persons, orphans, widows and
such other persons.
j) All land holders must pay a tax of from 10% to 15%
of the agricultural products to meet the administration
expenses of the Soviet Hsien.
k) The Farmers Federation and the Revolutionary Suppression
Committee will be dissolved and their authority be
vested in the Soviet as soon as it has been established.
l) Persons who are not members of the Party are to be
induced to attend a public meeting or a conference
of representatives and boys and girls of 16 years
of age will have the right to vote or to be voted for.
Persons who oppress labourers or who are anti-
revolutionaries or religious persons are excluded.
m) All the plans and measures for a struggle drawn up and p
passed at a conference of representatives of labourers,
farmers and soldiers must be passed, promulgated and
enforced by the Soviet. All subordinate organs should
obey the superior authority.
n) The Red Guard Corps shall be commanded by the Soviet
Hsien while the Labour and Industrial Revolutionary
Army shall be placed under the control of the Soviet
Province.
pages.zh:
g) 增加体力工人和苦力的工资并改善他们的待遇。
h) 村苏维埃将在苏维埃区的指导下分配土地。
i) 村苏维埃将维持老弱病残者、孤儿、寡妇及其他此类人员的生计。
j) 所有土地持有者必须缴纳农产品10%至15%的税，以支付苏维埃县的行政费用。
k) 农民协会和革命镇压委员会将在苏维埃成立后立即解散，其权力移交给苏维埃。
l) 应诱导非党员参加公众会议或代表会议，年满16岁的男女青年拥有选举权和被选举权。压迫劳动者者、反革命分子或宗教人士除外。
m) 在工人、农民和士兵代表会议上制定并通过的所有斗争计划和措施，必须由苏维埃通过、颁布和执行。所有下级机关应服从上级权威。
n) 赤卫队由苏维埃县指挥，而工农革命军由苏维埃省控制。

The following is a list of abbreviations used by
Communists and Communist Youth Group:-
"Fan Kuo" (反國) means anti-Kuomintang.
"Fan Ti" (反帝) means anti-Imperialism.
"King Tou" (經鬥) means economic struggle.
"Hsueh Yung" (學運) means students movement.
"Fu Yung" (婦運) means women's movement.
"Ching Kung" (青工) means young labourers.
"Ching Nun" (青農) means young farmers.
"Siao Sien" (少先), means Youths Vanguard.
"Hsueh Lien" (學聯) means students union.
"Nun Ya" (農協) means farmers union.
"Tuan Tsoo" (團組) means youth groups organizations.
"Ver Tse Wei" (活子會) means meeting of active elements.
"Fi Kee" (非基) means anti-Christianity.
"Nun Tan" (農代) means meeting of Farmer representatives.

The following is a list of code words used:-
大學 大校
"Dah Hsueh" or "Dah Yao" for Communist Party.
中學 中校
"Chung Hsueh" or "Chun Yao" for Communist Youth Group.
民校
"Min Yao" for anti-Kuomintang.
大學
"Dah Hsueh" for Communist Party Group
全學
"Tung Hsueh" for Own partisans.

Brotheris organizations, Sisters organization,or
organizations formed by No.1 or No.2 are all classfied.as
"Sworn brothers" organizations and are under the masses
organizations.

Educational groups and research organizations are
all under the organization formed by students or professors.
"Ia Han Wei", (羅漢會) and pilgrims group are
under the control of organizations formed with the outward
object of holding superstitious practices but in reality to
give training in boxing, fencing, shooting, athletics etc.

pages.en:
- 51 -

The following phrases have been given special
meanings:-
(1) Aimless doctrine for impudent violence.
(2) Vanguard doctrine for Heroic movements without support
of masses.
(3) Peaceful development for Organizations which do not favour
struggles.
(4) Opportunity doctrine for Those who rely on others or are
in the habit of imposing upon others.
(5) Abolition doctrine, for Those who are in favour of
amalgamation of Party and Group and who do not desire
to develop their organizations.
(6) Reform doctrine, for Kuomintang reducing the rate of
rents or revising treaties.
(7) White Terror for suppression of Communism.
(8) Red Terror for massacre and incendiarism committed by
Communists.
(9) Yellow Labour Union for Labour Unions under the directions
of the Kuomintang.
(10) Clan's doctrine or Clan's society for Relations between
families or Chinese old customs.
(11) Flying meeting for meetings held in a hurry either when
the labourers are going to work or leaving their works.
(12) Communication Net for Arrangements made with Communications
organizations.
pages.zh:
- 51 -

以下短语具有特殊含义：-
(1) 盲目主义，指鲁莽的暴力行为。
(2) 先锋主义，指没有群众支持的英雄式运动。
(3) 和平发展，指不主张斗争的组织。
(4) 机会主义，指那些依赖他人或习惯于欺压他人的人。
(5) 取消主义，指那些主张党和团体合并且不希望发展其组织的人。
(6) 改良主义，指国民党降低租金率或修订条约。
(7) 白色恐怖，指镇压共产主义。
(8) 红色恐怖，指共产主义者实施的屠杀和纵火。
(9) 黄色工会，指在国民党指导下的工会。
(10) 宗族主义或宗族社会，指家族关系或中国旧习俗。
(11) 飞行会议，指在工人上班或下班时匆忙举行的会议。
(12) 通讯网，指与通讯组织做出的安排。

Joining
Any youth, aged between 14 and 23, who acknowledges

Under particular circumstances, any person whose

Members of Party and Group

加入
任何年龄在14至23岁之间，承认青年共产国际和本团总纲及章程的青年，均有资格成为本组织成员。（赵洛）
在特殊情况下，任何年龄小于14岁或大于23岁的人也有资格成为本组织成员，并获准发言，但除非他是分支机构的负责成员，否则无权投票或表示赞成或反对。（赵洛）

党和团成员
每位成员应遵守青年共产国际和本团的所有决议，并积极参与除组织工作以外的所有工作，以及缴纳会费（赵洛）

党或团成员应尽最大努力完成各项工作，以履行其革命性的“历史”责任（宗洛）。

党或团成员应尽可能多地介绍同志，以加强和扩展党和团的组织（宗洛）。

党或团成员应尽最大努力促进党和团的书刊流通，以进一步推进宣传工作。（宗洛）。

A member of the Group when arriving at another
"international" should join the organization of the
Group in that country and participate in the work of
certain organizations (Chao Loh).

The Committee above the District Committee can
enlist members of the Group direct. (Choo loh).

Introduction

Conditions for joining Group.

A. Youth labourers or apprentices of industrial concerns
and workshops as well as peasant youth proletarians
on certain introduction and approval by the Industrial
Branch.

B. Peasants, postal workers, manual workers, soldiers,
shop assistants, junior coolies may join the group
on the recommendation of one member of the Group or
Party.

C. Students or intelligent or educated persons may join
the Group on recommendation of two members of the
Group or Party.

D. Any ex-member of another political party (such as
the Kuomintang, etc.) as well as any military
officer of the reactionary troops may be allowed
to join the Group or Party provided he can provide
recommendations from more than three members of
the Group or Party who have been in the Party more
than one year and his application has been approved
by the Provincial Committee. (Choo loh).

The date of joining the Group of any public body or
political organization will be determined by a special
meeting of the Central of this Group or a mass meeting.
(Choo Loh).

Particular attention should be paid to the extension
of the organization among the masses with a view to
selecting brave and radical youth vanguards and boy groups
from among the Peasants Cooperative Associations or labour
unions to be members of the Group. During the time of
struggle, efforts should be made to enlist a large number
of radical elements in the membership but more strict
attention should be paid in the introduction of
intelligent or educated people. (Great 16).

The registration forms are only to be used and when
a new comrade is recommended so as to show the importance
of his introduction. These forms are not to be kept
forever and especially during a reign of "white" terror
should be destroyed without delay. Consequently, these
forms can be destroyed as soon as the applicant has been
formally admitted to membership. (Great 34).

When introducing a new comrade, various methods
should be employed to test him. When he is found to
be really eligible for membership, his name should be
introduced to the Section Meeting in the Branch and
a report should be submitted to the District Committee
for permission to admit him to membership. Before the
approval of the senior organ has been obtained, he
should not be informed of whatever affairs of the Group
whatever

区委员会以上的委员会可以直接招募团成员。（周洛）。

介绍

入团条件。

A. 工业企业和车间的青年工人或学徒，以及经工业支部特定介绍和批准的无产阶级青年农民。

B. 农民、邮政工人、体力劳动者、士兵、店员、初级苦力，经一名团或党员推荐，可加入本团。

C. 学生或知识分子或有教养的人士，经两名团或党员推荐，可加入本团。

D. 任何其他政党（如国民党等）的前党员，以及反动军队的任何军官，若能提供三名以上入党一年以上的团或党员的推荐，并经省委员会批准其申请，则可允许加入本团或党。（周洛）。

任何公共团体或政治组织的入团日期，将由本团中央特别会议或群众大会确定。（周洛）。

应特别注意在群众中扩展组织，以便从农民合作社或工会中挑选勇敢和激进的青年先锋队和少年组成员成为团成员。在斗争期间，应努力招募大量激进分子入团，但在介绍知识分子或有教养的人士时应更加严格注意。（大16）。

登记表仅在新同志被推荐时使用，以显示其介绍的重要性。这些表格不得永久保存，特别是在“白色”恐怖统治期间，应立即销毁。因此，申请人正式被接纳为成员后，这些表格即可销毁。（大34）。

在介绍新同志时，应采用各种方法对其进行考验。当发现其确实具备入团资格时，应将其姓名提交支部科会议，并向区委员会提交报告以请求批准其入团。在获得上级机关批准之前，不应向其透露任何团务事宜

----------
Registration

A meeting of a Branch should be held to discuss
the nature of our work. The work will then be divided
among comrades who will be spoken to individually. At
the next meeting, an investigation will be made to
ascertain whether they are energetic or not in their work.
This enquiry will form the basis to determine the
registration. (Uni 25)

Those whose work is found to be good by the
meeting of the Branch will be registered.
The investigation is to be started with an
inspection of the work.
When a member of the Group changes his work or
removes his residence, he must get a letter of introduction
from the senior organ in order to enable him to
register at another place. (Chao Loh).

----------
Approval

The admission of a new member of the Group must
be approved by the Branch (Industrial Branch, Street
Branch, Peasant Branch) and where there is no Branch,
by the local organization but subject to the sanction
of the senior organ of the Group. (Chao Loh).

Any applicant may be assigned, before his application
has been approved, by the responsible organ to do certain
work so as to test his faithfulness to the revolution
and his capability to perform duty.

The dismissal of a member must be passed by the
Branch and approved by the senior organ. Before the
approval, the member to be dismissed should be suspended
from work. If a disagreement is reached over the
dismissal, he may appeal to the highest organ. The
committees of various grades are authorized to dismiss
a member from membership directly when he is guilty of
reactionary behaviour, but should inform the junior
organ to which he belongs. (Chao Loh).

批准

接纳新小组成员必须经支部（工业支部、街道支部、农民支部）批准；若无支部，则由地方组织批准，但须受小组上级机关的认可。（赵洛）。

在申请获批之前，负责机关可指派任何申请人从事某些工作，以测试其对革命的忠诚度及履行职责的能力。

开除成员须经支部通过并由上级机关批准。在批准之前，拟被开除的成员应暂停工作。若对开除决定存在异议，可向最高机关上诉。各级委员会有权直接开除有反动行为的成员，但应通知其所属的下级机关。（赵洛）。

Assembly
Assembly of the members of the party and group.

At meetings of the Branch, efforts should be made to give every member a chance to speak. The practical questions of various branches will be the main points for discussion during these meetings. The lecture-like report of the past should be abandoned. (Great 157)

During a meeting, every problem should be explained first by him (? the person proposing it). Suggestions should also be made to obtain the 2nd Defence line (?). The Hsien committee, District committee and Branch committee should all appoint successors. This step is taken not only as a precaution against the White terror but also as a way to give special training to the members of the working sections. Consequently these comrades should be made to participate in all practical work so as to give them training. (Great 41)

All discussions should be based upon the practical situation of the Branch at the local place. The sudden discussion of an imaginary subject will only puzzle comrades as to how to speak. The post of chairman of the meeting may be filled by comrades in turn and every way should be adopted to encourage members to speak. (Great 42)

To express one's opinion is better than blind obedience (Yu 9).

Each chairman should make a report by turn.

When labour or peasant comrades participate in a directing organ they are not there just to make up the deficient number. They should be given more chance to speak, and more practical work in order to study various methods of working. The old and responsible members should on the one hand offer their experience as teaching and on the other hand accept and make use of their (the new members') radical moral support so as to promote mutual training. (Great 41)

Assembly of the Public

In various grades of the Peasant Cooperative Association, a Peasant Youth Working Section should be established at once. It would be best if comrades of the group undertake the youth work among the peasants under the direction of the Group through the cooperation of the Peasant Cooperative Association. - Youth Peasants' General meetings or representatives' meetings should be convened in order to extend the propaganda for the personal benefits of the youth peasants. (Great 153)

To convene a mass meeting of youth labourers and youth peasants - in view of the special circumstances and demands of the youth peasants (the financial state, the social state, the amount of work as well as the working time of these youths are different from those of the grown up), general meetings of youth labourers or youth peasants should be convened now and then in order

集会
党员和小组成员的集会。

在支部会议上，应努力让每位成员都有发言机会。各支部的实际问题将是这些会议讨论的重点。应摒弃过去那种类似讲座式的报告。（Great 157）

在会议期间，每个问题应先由提出者（？指提议人）进行解释。还应提出建议以获得第二道防线（？）。县委员会、区委员会和支部委员会都应任命继任者。采取这一步骤不仅是为了防备白色恐怖，也是为了给予工作部门的成员特殊训练。因此，应让这些同志参与所有实际工作，以便使他们得到锻炼。（Great 41）

所有讨论都应基于当地支部的实际情况。突然讨论一个虚构的主题只会让同志们困惑不知如何发言。会议主席一职可由同志们轮流担任，并应采取各种方式鼓励成员发言。（Great 42）

表达个人意见胜于盲从（Yu 9）。

每位主席应轮流作报告。

当工人或农民同志参与领导机构时，他们不仅仅是为了凑数。应给予他们更多的发言机会和更多的实际工作，以便学习各种工作方法。资深且负责任的成员一方面应提供经验作为教导，另一方面应接受并利用（新成员的）激进的道德支持，以促进相互训练。（Great 41）

公众集会

在各级农民合作社中，应立即建立青年工作部。最好是在小组的指导下，通过农民合作社的合作，由小组成员承担农民中的青年工作。应召开青年农民大会或代表会议，以扩大针对青年农民个人利益的宣传。（Great 153）

召开青年工人和青年农民群众大会——鉴于青年农民的特殊情况和需求（这些青年的财务状况、社会状况、工作量以及工作时间与成年人不同），应不时召开青年工人或青年农民大会，以便

to enable them to receive similar training - to discuss
their personal sufferings and demands and to struggle for
their own welfare (Great 86).

Organization

With a view to distinguishing the limits of work
of various parties, the organization work of the party,
the 'art' work as well as the Training work are known
as the internal work of the party, while the movement
to propagate among various organizations in the
community and instigate all non-members of the masses to
do work is termed the external work of the party, also
known as the "Community Work" (for instance, work
in the Tenants Association and Labour Union). We
do not mean, however, that those engaged in internal
work will not perform external work or vice versa, and
consequently we do not want to consider them as
independent of each other. On the other hand, however,
we can not mix them together although they are
intimately related. That is why it is necessary to
separate the limit of work from the question of party.
It is beyond doubt that any organization of artists
or proletarians is formed by the most advanced and
civilized members of their respective class. The
political party of the proletarians - the Communist
party - is therefore the vanguard of the most advanced
and civilized of the proletarians. Consequently, it
is impossible to enlist all elements of this class to
membership of this organization. (1) It is not necessary
that the organization problem of the "External Work"
should receive as serious consideration as that accorded
to the Internal work although these two works are of the
same importance. (2) The propaganda question of the
external work should not be so plain or direct as that
of the "Internal Work". Indirect methods should be
employed in the External Work. (3) In the case of
external work, a fuller knowledge should be acquired
of the actual condition of the work in question and
the immediate requirements. More instigation should
be performed. (4) The organization engaged in external
work does not require to be formally and mechanically
under our guidance. It should be active and ready to
receive and accept our hints. Besides, the public
should not be compelled to follow us.

With the exception of those (such as Peasants
Guerilla Groups) which will directly come into collision
with the ruling class, all organizations should be
made public as far as possible, thus establishing a
close contact with the public and inducing more persons
to join. If an organization of every light grey colour
(such as e.g. Cooperative Society) is required to be kept
secret, the result will be that not only the public will
be alienated but this organization will be just another
"C.Y." You should pay particular attention to this
point.

Without a large organization, the masses cannot be
led towards us. We are not of the dignified class who do
nothing but carry out research on principles nor of the
lower class who are only useful as a fuse to start struggles.
To extend the movement peacefully is wrong, but to maintain
it without extending is also not right. (Great 81)

使他们接受类似的训练——讨论他们个人的苦难和需求，并为自身的福利而斗争（Great 86）。

组织

为了区分各党派的工作界限，党的组织工作、“艺术”工作以及培训工作被称为党的内部工作，而在社区各组织中进行宣传并鼓动所有非党员群众开展工作的运动，则称为党的外部工作，也称为“社区工作”（例如，在租户协会和工会中的工作）。然而，这并不意味着从事内部工作的人不执行外部工作，反之亦然，因此我们并不认为它们是相互独立的。但另一方面，尽管它们关系密切，我们不能将它们混为一谈。这就是为什么有必要将工作界限与党的问题区分开来。毫无疑问，任何艺术家或无产阶级的组织都是由各自阶级中最先进、最文明的成员组成的。无产阶级的政党——共产党——因此是无产阶级中最先进、最文明分子的先锋队。因此，不可能将该阶级的所有元素都吸纳进该组织的成员中。(1) 虽然这两项工作同等重要，但“外部工作”的组织问题不必像内部工作那样受到严肃考虑。(2) 外部工作的宣传问题不应像“内部工作”那样直白或直接。在外部工作中应采用间接方法。(3) 在外部工作的情况下，应对相关工作的实际状况和即时需求有更充分的了解。应进行更多的鼓动。(4) 从事外部工作的组织不需要在形式上和机械地接受我们的指导。它应当活跃，并乐于接受和采纳我们的暗示。此外，不应强迫公众跟随我们。

除了那些（如农民游击队）将直接与统治阶级发生冲突的组织外，所有组织应尽可能公开化，从而与公众建立密切联系，并吸引更多人加入。如果要求每种浅灰色调的组织（例如合作社）都保持秘密，结果不仅会使公众疏远，而且该组织将成为另一个“C.Y.”（共产主义青年团）。你应特别注意这一点。

没有庞大的组织，就无法引导群众走向我们。我们不属于那种只进行原则研究而不做事的高贵阶层，也不属于那种仅作为引发斗争的导火索才有用的下层阶级。和平地扩展运动是错误的，但不扩展而维持现状也是不对的。（Great 81）

During the work of extending the movement at places
where we have no comrades, special experts should be
assigned to the job. The work should be equally
distributed and not be concentrated at one village or
a city or even neighbouring hsien. If there has
been no organization in the neighbouring hsien,
special branch or district committee should be sent
there to undertake the work.

Organization of the Main Body of the Party and Group.

Organization work (including the relation of the
working party or group in the reactionary organization).

1) To materialize the proletarianization of the
organization of the Group -- (a) In the city or town
the labourers should be the main element and in
peasant villages, poor peasants will form the main
element. (b) The proletarian knowledge of members
should be improved. The idea of assisting the
proletarians from the non-proletarian - students,
shop assistants - point of view is to be opposed.
(c) At present, strict discipline should be maintained
in the organization and the work of investigation and
compiling of statistics should be improved.

2) To materialize the ubiquity and to maintain the
non adult status of the organization of the Group ---
(a) gradual arrangements should be made to weed out
those members above the age of 22 who will then join the
Party. (b) Efforts should be made to increase the
number of members particularly in factories, workshops,
and among peasantry. Measures should be adopted to
overcome timidity as a result of the "white" terror.
(c) Before October, in Chekiang, there should be at
least ....... Municipality or Hsien committees of
C.Y., Special Branch Committees, ..... Branch Committees
and ........ comrades. (d) To materialize the
politicalization of the organization of the Group ----
(a) Arouse the political understanding and interests of
every member in the political movement so as to make
him a qualified and self-convincing political warrior;
(b) Establish close relations between all people's
political organizations and the Group.

The Directory organ should assign members to
undertake various directing works so as to give them
a chance to study. At the same time, two defects should
be watched: Firstly the work becoming individualized,
lacking the spirit of a body; to remedy this, all work
should be assigned at a meeting which will discuss it
before a decision is reached. Secondly, capable
comrades, once leaving the people, become lazy and
adopt an official manner. In order to remove this
defect, a careful watch should be kept on the movements
of all members and no one should be at once promoted
to the directory organ just because he has been a leader
of the public. In short he should not at once sever
his relations with the public and join the Hsien Committee,
etc.

The preliminary education work of comrades should
not be neglected. This work should be undertaken by
the branch, and a new member must be particularly given
a general outline of the work as quickly as possible,
pages.zh:
- 7 -

在我们没有同志的地方开展扩展运动的工作时，应指派专门专家负责此项工作。工作应均衡分布，不要集中在一个村庄、一个城市甚至邻近的县。如果邻近的县尚无组织，应派遣特别支部或区委员会前往那里开展工作。

党和小组主体机构的组织。

组织工作（包括在反动组织中的工作组或小组的关系）。

1) 实现小组组织的无产阶级化——(a) 在城市或城镇，工人应是主要元素；在农村村庄，贫农应构成主要元素。(b) 应提高成员的无产阶级知识。要反对从无产者以外的视角——学生、店员——来援助无产者的观念。(c) 目前，应在组织中维持严格的纪律，并改进调查和统计编制工作。

2) 实现小组组织的普遍性并维持其非成年状态——(a) 应逐步安排剔除22岁以上的成员，这些人随后将加入党组织。(b) 应努力增加成员数量，特别是在工厂、车间和农民中。应采取措施克服因“白色”恐怖而产生的胆怯心理。(c) 在十月之前，在浙江，至少应有.......个共青团市委或县委、特别支部委员会、.....个支部委员会和........名同志。(d) 实现小组组织的政治化----(a) 唤起每位成员对政治运动的政治理解和兴趣，使其成为一名合格且自我信念坚定的政治战士；(b) 在所有人民政治组织与小组之间建立密切关系。

指导机关应指派成员承担各项指导工作，以便给他们学习的机会。同时应警惕两个缺陷：第一，工作个人化，缺乏集体精神；为此，所有工作应在会议上分配，并在做出决定前进行讨论。第二，有能力的同志一旦脱离群众，就会变得懒惰并采取官僚作风。为了消除这一缺陷，应密切关注所有成员的动向，不得仅因其曾是公众领袖就立即将其提拔至指导机关。简言之，他不应立即切断与公众的联系并加入县委员会等机构。

不应忽视同志们的预备教育工作。这项工作应由支部承担，并且必须尽快向新成员提供工作的一般大纲，

pages.en:
- 8 -

so that after a month has elapsed he will be able to under-
stand the duty of the Group; (1) the difference between
the Group and the Peasants' Cooperative or Labour Union;
(2) The difference between the Group and the Party; (3)
What revolution can do; (4) The simple definition of
communism; (5) What is a branch; (6) What are District
Committees and Hsien Committees; (7) The duty of each
comrade; How to become a good comrade? On no account
should this work be neglected no matter how busily engaged
otherwise. (Great 58).

The objects of Training are: (1) To enable comrades to
understand the economical and political situation of China
as well as the relations between various grades. (2)
To enable comrades to understand the significance of
agrarian revolution. (3) To enable them to understand the
economic situation in Chekiang Province as well as its
relation with the community. (4) To improve their
theoretical and practical knowledge of the peasant's
movement so as to enable them to make use of this in their
own districts. (5) To enable them to acquire a general
military knowledge and the art of riot. Consequently
during training, attention should be paid to the problem
of the Chinese revolution and the peasants' practical work.

An organization is formed by individual members.
Therefore every member should abide by the regulations of the
Group and maintain discipline so as to strengthen the
influence of the Group. Externally (1) Propagate among
non-member youths so as to introduce them to the Group.
(2) Report any movement connected with the Group to the
Secretary of the branch or other superior organ and at the
same time energetically participate in the movement. (3)
Execute energetically the work assigned by the Group.
(4) Maintain strict secrecy with regard to all secrets
of the Group. Internally (1) Attend punctually all
meetings fixed by the Group. (2) Pay the membership fees
every month. (3) Observe the discipline fixed by the
Group. (4) Offer sincere advice to other comrades. (5)
Adhere to the policy of the Group and offer opinion from
time to time. (6) Finish the reading of the publications
of the Party and Group within the time specified.

Although problems can be discussed by any member
before they have decided upon by the Party or Group,
every member should execute the decision unconditionally
as soon as it has been decided upon by the organ concerned.
No-one is allowed to raise any opposition. (Chao Loh)

The District Committee should not only pay particular
attention to the active elements of the branches but also
notify the Hsien Committee of their names so as to give
them special training.

When a Provincial Committee Notification is to be
circulated, the Hsien Committee should not merely copy
and forward it. It should be corrected to meet the local
situation and written in the form of a Hsien Circular
before it is sent to the branches.

You should go to the lower rank and try to talk to
comrades because new comrades are not all bad. The
close relation between comrades and the organization can
be achieved only by your so doing. (Great 48).
pages.zh:
- 8 -

以便经过一个月后，他能够理解小组的职责；(1) 小组与农民合作社或工会之间的区别；(2) 小组与党之间的区别；(3) 革命能做什么；(4) 共产主义的简单定义；(5) 什么是支部；(6) 什么是区委和县委；(7) 每位同志的职责；如何成为一名好同志？无论其他工作多么繁忙，决不可忽视这项工作。（Great 58）。

培训的目标是：(1) 使同志们了解中国的经济和政治形势以及各阶层之间的关系。(2) 使同志们了解土地革命的意义。(3) 使他们了解浙江省的经济状况及其与社会的关系。(4) 提高他们对农民运动的理论和实践知识，以便能够在各自地区加以运用。(5) 使他们获得一般的军事知识和暴动艺术。因此，在培训期间，应注意中国革命问题和农民的实际工作。

组织由个人成员组成。因此，每个成员都应遵守小组的规定并维持纪律，以加强小组的影响力。对外方面：(1) 在非成员青年中进行宣传，以便将他们引入小组。(2) 向支部书记或其他上级机关报告任何与小组有关的运动，同时积极参与该运动。(3) 积极执行小组分配的工作。(4) 对小组的所有秘密保持严格的保密。对内方面：(1) 准时参加小组规定的所有会议。(2) 每月缴纳会费。(3) 遵守小组规定的纪律。(4) 向其他同志提供真诚的建议。(5) 坚持小组的政策并不时提出意见。(6) 在规定的时间内完成对党及小组出版物的阅读。

虽然任何问题在党或小组决定之前都可以由任何成员讨论，但一旦有关机关作出决定，每个成员都必须无条件地执行决定。不允许任何人提出反对意见。（Chao Loh）

区委不仅应特别注意支部中的积极分子，还应将他们的姓名通知县委，以便给予他们专门的培训。

当省委通知需要传达时，县委不应仅仅抄送转发。应根据当地情况进行修正，并以县通告的形式撰写，然后再发送给各支部。

你应该深入基层，尝试与同志们交谈，因为新同志并非都不好。只有通过这样做，才能实现同志与组织之间的紧密关系。（Great 48）。

pages.en:
- 9 -

The same spirit shall be applied to the work
in villages or small places. Every member should try
to find new members; three members will become a
branch or section. With regard to those pessimistic
or unscrupulous fellows, no leniency is to be shown;
they should be wiped off at once, otherwise the
organization cannot be perfect. (Great 48).

All new organization (Branch, District, Hsien
and others) must obtain the approval of the senior
organs.

All work of the Party should be kept secret. The
lazy comrades and those hesitating fellows should be
dismissed at once. A strict registration of members
is to be taken and all members must pay their member-
ship fees and participate in the work of the branches.
(Hai 7).

The organization at various places is terribly
deficient. We should make our steps uniform and
regulate our policy in order to resist and overcome
our enemies. (Great 51)

The work in future is to create new organizations
and strengthen the foundations. Those hesitating,
unfaithful, pessimistic, lazy and unscrupulous elements
should be mercilessly wiped off. The old organizations
need not to be taken care of in the matter of developing
the new organization. The question of discipline should
also be carefully considered and adhered to. (Great 48)

Those who hesitate in struggle and show timidity in
movement should be done away with and those brave and
radical ones should be promoted to participate in the
directing organ. In this way it is possible to purge
the group of the opportunists. (Great 46)

All hesitating fellows should be expelled and brave
and radical elements should be reorganized so as to
establish perfect directing organs. (Great 68)

The joining, or dismissal, or resigning of comrades
is to be decided by meetings and nobody is allowed to
influence or dictate the decision by his feelings in the
matter. (Great 51).

During the re-organization, the wrong ideas of the
old comrades should of course be corrected, but you should
not be detained by them. You should go forward and
pick out the new comrades in order to perfect the
reorganization. Those opportunists who lack the courage
to do the work and hesitate should be expelled. (Gr. 49)

No matter how capable they are, those labour and
peasant comrades who have been picked out to work in
Hsien Committees or District Committees must be assigned
to do the work in the usual way. You should not allow
a few men to monopolize the work. You should obtain
a few more faithful comrades among the labourers and
peasants to work in the Hsien or District Committee.
Don't rely solely on educated people who are easily
shaken by outsiders.
pages.zh:
- 9 -

同样的精神也应应用于乡村或小地方的工作。每个成员都应努力寻找新成员；三名成员即可成为一个支部或分部。对于那些悲观或不择手段的人，不得表现出宽容；应立即将其清除，否则组织无法完善。（Great 48）。

所有新组织（支部、区、县及其他）必须获得上级机关的批准。

党的所有工作都应保密。懒惰的同志和那些犹豫不决的人应立即被开除。要对成员进行严格登记，所有成员必须缴纳会费并参与支部的工作。（Hai 7）。

各地的组织严重不足。我们应该统一步伐，规范政策，以抵抗和克服我们的敌人。（Great 51）

未来的工作是创建新组织并巩固基础。那些犹豫不决、不忠诚、悲观、懒惰和不择手段的元素应无情地清除。在发展新组织时，无需顾及旧组织。纪律问题也应仔细考虑并严格遵守。（Great 48）

那些在斗争中犹豫不决、在行动中表现出怯懦的人应被清除，而那些勇敢和激进的人应被提拔参与领导机关。通过这种方式，有可能清除小组中的机会主义者。（Great 46）

所有犹豫不决的人都应被驱逐，勇敢和激进的元素应重新组织，以建立完善的领导机关。（Great 68）

同志的加入、开除或辞职应由会议决定，任何人不得凭个人感情影响或主导此事的决定。（Great 51）。

在重组过程中，当然应该纠正老同志的错误思想，但你不应受其牵制。你应该向前迈进，挑选新同志，以完善重组工作。那些缺乏勇气开展工作且犹豫不决的机会主义者应被开除。（Gr. 49）

无论能力如何，那些被挑选到县委或区委工作的工农同志，都必须按常规方式分配工作。你不允许让少数人垄断工作。你应该在工人和农民中争取更多忠诚的同志在县委或区委工作。不要仅仅依赖那些容易受外人动摇的知识分子。

pages.en:
-10-

There are very few labour and peasant elements
among the responsible officers in various organs.
Moreover, some responsible officers even despise the
labour and peasant elements. Consequently from this
date from Central to the Branch, all directing organs
should absorb as many labour and peasant elements as
possible. The lower organs should select the labour
and peasant elements, who will be allowed to attend
the 5th General Meeting as a preliminary step to
joining the Central.

Labour and peasant elements should be admitted to
all organs and the post of secretary in the branch
should be filled by labourers. There must be at least
one labourer and one peasant in the Reserve Committee
and 1/3 of the Executive Committee should be made up
of the labour and peasant element. In the lower grade
labour and peasant elements should be more intensively
employed. (Tung Sai)

Labour and peasant elements should be selected
to receive special training, but it is not necessary
to transfer them at once to the Hsien Committee. They
should participate as much as possible in the work of
the District Committee or branch Committee. (Great 31).

The labour and peasant elements in the directing
organ should be given full opportunity to carry out
activities. You should strictly avoid making them
figureheads. Where there is no labour or peasant
elements in the directing organ, efforts should be made
to pick out these elements to undertake directing work.
(Great 45).

Radical and courageous labour and peasant elements
should be assigned to all practical work so as to expel
the unscrupulous, thus perfecting the organization.

The present organization consists of more farmers
than peasants with the result that the Group may be
injected with the principles of the small capitalists,
and it is therefore a farmer's Group, which cannot
work for the welfare of the proletariat. (Great 52)

Although more than half of the number of the
responsible comrades in various grades are labour
and peasant elements, they however have not participated
in any actual work. It is necessary, therefore, to
give them training, because it should be remembered that
the duty does not finish with the mere increasing of
the numerical strength of labour and peasant elements.

The unstable condition of the directing organ is
due to lack of the proletarian spirit as a result of
the monopolization of authority by educated small
capitalists. (Great 52)

You must train up some peasant leaders who should
be picked from the more intelligent and educated peasants.
They will be Secretaries to branches and leaders of the
Peasant Cooperative Associations and shall be your
successors. Therefore do not assume yourself the entire
responsibility for the work.
pages.zh:
-10-

各级机关负责官员中的工农元素非常少。此外，一些负责官员甚至轻视工农元素。因此，从即日起，从中央到支部，所有领导机关都应尽可能吸收更多的工农元素。下级机关应选拔工农元素，作为加入中央的初步步骤，允许他们出席第五次代表大会。

所有机关都应接纳工农元素，支部书记一职应由工人担任。后备委员会中必须至少有一名工人和一名农民，执行委员会中应有三分之一由工农元素组成。在下级层面，应更密集地使用工农元素。（Tung Sai）

应选拔工农元素接受专门培训，但不必立即将他们调往县委。他们应尽可能多地参与区委或支部委员会的工作。（Great 31）。

应给予领导机关中的工农元素充分的机会开展活动。你应严格避免让他们成为傀儡。如果领导机关中没有工农元素，应努力挑选这些元素来承担领导工作。（Great 45）。

应将激进和勇敢的工农元素分配到所有实际工作中，以清除不择手段之徒，从而完善组织。

目前的组织中农民（farmers）多于贫农/佃农（peasants），导致小组可能注入小资本家的原则，因此这是一个“农民（farmers）”的小组，无法为无产阶级的福利工作。（Great 52）

虽然各级负责同志中有一半以上是工农元素，但他们并未参与任何实际工作。因此，有必要对他们进行培训，因为必须记住，职责不仅仅在于增加工农元素的数量。

领导机关的不稳定状态是由于受过教育的小资本家垄断权力，导致缺乏无产阶级精神所致。（Great 52）

你必须培养一些农民领袖，应从较聪明和受过教育的农民中挑选。他们将担任支部书记和农民合作社协会的领导人，并作为你的接班人。因此，不要独自承担全部工作责任。

pages.en:
- 11 -

Reform all directing organs. More labour elements
should be appointed to be leaders of small sections,
committees of branches, secretaries of District
committees and Hsien committees. There should be at
least 2 labour members in the Standing Committee of
the District Committee. (In villages the district
Committee memberships should be filled by peasants or
farmers). (Hsi 19).

The economic struggle and labour union work
are the main duty of this Group. The various grades of the
Group in Chekiang, however have paid very little attention
to this fact. Those at Hangchow, Ningpo, Huchow, Kaishing
and Wenchow have not even commenced their work yet with
the result that the group in the city can not secure a
strong basis for working and that the directing organ
is monopolized by the peasants, thus side tracking the
main course of struggle and thereby causing a serious
crisis. (Great 153)

With a view to preventing the aggression of our
group by peasants we should abandon the former subscription-
like method of enlisting peasants in the Group. We should
pick out the most courageous, faithful, active and best
educated from the political point of view, youth farmers
and peasants to be members. We must not admit those who
only support, sympathize and are willing to receive our
direction. (Great 153).

Organization outside the main body of the Party and Group
Dealing with Party and Organization

With regard to the people's school, xxxxxxxxxx
(1) The older members of the Group should join K.M.T.
and be the centre members of the K.M.T. with a view to
establishing K.M.T. at various places.
(2) The various Grades of the Party should watch closely
the people's school, Party, Group at various places, espe-
cially at a place where the Party is not very influential.
(3) The work in the People's school should be one of the
main duties of each branch.
(4) A close relation should be established between the
Provincial Committee and other Committees of the Group
with the People's school. (Kiang 11)

The Party should pay attention to the work of
people's school, and establish a close relation with it.
(Kiang 10).

Dealing with School organization

In a school, a small section should be organized and
in case of necessity, a branch can be established with the
approval of the senior organ of the Group. (Hao 10h)

Apart from receiving training and participating
in activities, the small section in the school should
undertake work in the school. It is responsible for
monopolizing the students' unions as before, but of course
we can not permit the reactionary elements to control
them. Consequently as many of our members as possible
should have themselves elected to the Committee of this
organization.

Besides joining the Student's Union, our members
should organise a 'left' body which will be the
headquarters from which activities among the students,
will be conducted.
pages.zh:
- 11 -

改革所有领导机关。应任命更多的工人元素担任小分部负责人、支部委员、区委书记和县委书记。区委常务委员会中应至少有两名工人成员。（在乡村，区委成员应由贫农/佃农或农民填充）。（Hsi 19）。

经济斗争和工会工作是本小组的主要职责。然而，浙江各级小组对此事实关注甚少。杭州、宁波、湖州、嘉兴和温州等地甚至尚未开始工作，导致城市中的小组无法获得坚实的工作基础，且领导机关被农民垄断，从而偏离了斗争的主线，造成了严重的危机。（Great 153）

为了防止我们的小组受到农民的侵蚀，我们应该放弃以前像招募会员那样吸纳农民加入小组的方法。我们应该从政治上最勇敢、忠诚、积极且受过良好教育的青年农民和贫农/佃农中挑选成员。我们不得接纳那些仅表示支持、同情并愿意接受我们指导的人。（Great 153）。

党和小组主体之外的组织
关于党和组织的问题

关于民众学校，xxxxxxxxxx
(1) 小组的老成员应加入国民党，并成为国民党的核心成员，以便在各地建立国民党。
(2) 党的各级组织应密切关注各地的民众学校、党和小组，特别是在党影响力不大的地方。
(3) 民众学校的工作应是每个支部的主要职责之一。
(4) 省委及小组其他委员会应与民众学校建立密切关系。（Kiang 11）

党应注意民众学校的工作，并与其建立密切关系。（Kiang 10）。

关于学校组织

在学校中，应组织一个小分部，如有必要，经小组上级机关批准，可以建立一个支部。（Hao 10h）

除了接受培训和参与活动外，学校中的小分部应在学校内开展工作。它负责像以前一样垄断学生会，但当然我们不能允许反动元素控制它们。因此，我们应尽可能让更多的成员当选为该组织的委员会成员。

除了加入学生会外，我们的成员还应组织一个“左翼”团体，这将作为在学生中开展活动的总部。

pages.en:
- 12 -

literature sections, etc. should be organized with a
view to attracting students to our banner.

The main organization is to be extended and
strengthened (such as the Students Union) (Great 60)

It is an undesirable fact that since the rapid
development of the revolution and up to the uprising
of the labour peasants to seize political power, the
students have shown a tendency to veer towards the
small capitalists and their revolutionary spirit has
been lowered. At present the students can never
entertain any longer the carrying on of people's
organization under our leadership, although certain
poor and radical student elements can still be made
use of. (Great 196)

The reading class at Taichow, Chekiang has the
Central organ in Shanghai. (Great 101).

Dealing with labour organization

The Party should appoint from the nearest branch
responsible officers to develop the labour organization
in the labour district.

We should endeavour to gain admission to any
superstitions or feudalistic organisations of the
labourers and then form new bodies or reorganize the
former groups with a view to changing their nature.
(Great 37).

Hereafter you should make more efforts to develop
the city labour work or village manual work in order
to strengthen not only the organization of the group but
also the red labour union. (great 45).

The movement among the city shop assistants is also
very important. At the beginning, they may be organized
these into one body, but later should be formed into
separate bodies according to their trade. (Great 37).

In a reactionary labour union, a secret red
labour union can be organized. (Great 57).

We should try to seize the labour unions organized
by the Kuomintang (The seizure should commence with the
lower grade). Our Red Labour Organization is not open
to the capitalists. (Hai 22).

The old labour unions are to be overthrown and
replaced by new ones. (hai 22).

The labour Union of the Kuomintang which is used
for show purposes only should also be overthrown.

In organizing the labour union, we must win the
support of others and on the other hand pay special
attention to the organization of the lower grade.
(Hai 22).

A labour union is not required to use the title of a
union. (Hai 22).
pages.zh:
- 12 -

文学部等应加以组织，以吸引学生归附我方旗帜。

主要组织应予扩展和加强（如学生会）（Great 60）

自革命迅速发展乃至工农起义夺取政权以来，学生表现出倾向小资产阶级的趋势，其革命精神有所低落，这是一个不利的事实。目前，学生已不再能接受在我方领导下开展民众组织工作，尽管某些贫困且激进的学生分子仍可加以利用。（Great 196）

浙江台州读书班的中央机关设在上海。（Great 101）。

关于劳工组织工作

党应从最近的支部指派负责官员，在劳工区发展劳工组织。

我们应努力打入劳工的任何迷信或封建组织，进而组建新团体或改组原有团体，以改变其性质。（Great 37）。

此后，你们应更加努力发展城市劳工工作或乡村手工业工作，不仅为了加强小组的组织，也为了加强红色工会。（great 45）。

城市店员中的运动也非常重要。起初，可将他们组织为一个整体，但随后应按其行业分别组成独立的团体。（Great 37）。

在反动工会内部，可以组织秘密的红色工会。（Great 57）。

我们应试图夺取由国民党组织的工会（夺取工作应从下层开始）。我们的红色劳工组织不对资本家开放。（Hai 22）。

旧工会应予推翻，并由新工会取代。（hai 22）。

那些仅用于装点门面的国民党工会也应予推翻。

在组织工会时，我们必须赢得他人的支持，另一方面要特别注意下层的组织工作。（Hai 22）。

工会并不需要使用“工会”这一名称。（Hai 22）。

pages.en:
- 13 -

Among labourers small sections should be
organized. (This measure is to be used when it is
impossible to organize labour unions). (Hai 22).

When the committee of a labour union is appointed
by the Kuomintang our members should break their
organization and try to xx effect reorganization.
(Hai 23).

Dealing with Peasant Organization

You must not tell peasants that our organization
is of the Kuomintang party in order to avoid scaring
them. If you have already done so, you should cease
activities at once and send other comrades to organize
a Peasants' Committee and inform them that this
organization is not that of the Authorities but works
for their benefit. Farmers can be admitted but not
allowed to occupy positions of importance. (Great 14).

As many employed peasants and poor peasants should
be admitted as possible and it is better to enlist
no rich farmers than too many. (Great 45).

The peasant organization should be developed
in order to overcome feudalistic relations. The leading
power should be vested in the poor peasants. Small
sections should be organized one after the other in
peasant villages and a large membership should not be
expected at the very beginning. (Hai 7).

When the peasants have no confidence in the
organization, various measures should be adopted to break
their feudalistic ideas and relations. (Hai 7)

The materialization of the demands of the peasants
is the duty of the Peasants Cooperative Association
(Peasants Committee), and when there is no Peasants'
Association, rests with the peasants themselves.
By seizing the opportunity efforts should be also used
to organize such bodies to deal with this matter,
(Great 67)

The Hsien Committee of various Hsiens should at
once establish a Peasants Movement Committee with 3
members in order to execute the impending plan.
(Hai 19).
pages.zh:
- 13 -

在劳工中应组织小型分部。（当无法组织工会时，采用此措施）。（Hai 22）。

当工会委员会由国民党任命时，我方成员应破坏其组织，并设法 xx 实现改组。（Hai 23）。

关于农民组织工作

切勿告诉农民我们的组织属于国民党，以免吓跑他们。如果已经这样做，应立即停止活动，并派遣其他同志去组织农民委员会，告知他们该组织并非当局机构，而是为他们谋利益的。可以吸收农民加入，但不允许其担任重要职务。（Great 14）。

应尽可能多地吸收雇农和贫农，与其吸收过多富农，不如不吸收为佳。（Great 45）。

应发展农民组织以克服封建关系。领导权应掌握在贫农手中。应在农村逐个组织小型分部，起初不应期望有大量成员。（Hai 7）。

当农民对组织缺乏信心时，应采取各种措施打破他们的封建思想和关系。（Hai 7）

实现农民的需求是农民合作协会（农民委员会）的职责；在没有农民协会的情况下，则由农民自行负责。应抓住时机，努力组织此类团体来处理此事，（Great 67）

各县县委员会应立即成立一个由三人组成的农民运动委员会，以执行即将实施的计划。（Hai 19）。

pages.en:
- 14 -

Organization dealing with Youths

The Group gradually resolved itself from an organization of students to that of the labour and peasant youth elements. (Great 124).

In our mass organization there are only empty "upper" organs. Though we lead the masses to rise in certain struggles, yet these masses are like birds, easy to assemble and disperse. Practically speaking there is no work of the Party among the youths (Great 88).

Work among youths is the particular duty of the group. You must pay special attention to the work among the juvenile labourers and peasants and organize them. Apart from the organization of various mutual and amusements and athletics, it is necessary to start the formation of youth vanguards and "Full Power Groups" (充量團) and to accelerate their training (Great 69).

In places under worse circumstances, "Brothers' Groups" may be established, but it is essential to energetically drive out the existence of the element of feudalism. Under the "No.1", there should be a "No.2" and a "No.3" in order to avoid the "No.1" becoming a dictator and to make the organization in the nature of committees (Great 16).

Each section of the Brothers' Groups and Sisters' Groups may consist of from 5 to 10 persons. It is best to have one of our comrades to act as the head of each group. It is not necessary that the members of a "brothers' group" or a "sisters' group" belong to one factory and that the various sections of such groups be united. It is, however, always considered best to make a clear distinction as regards to factories and unity should be there where possible. This kind of organization may be considered as a primary step to the organization of masses and labour unions as well as the development of the Group (Great 14).

Develop the organization of the young masses (such as the "Brothers' Groups, Young Men's Societies, Children's Groups, Secret Labour Unions, Peasants Committees, Youths' Vanguards, etc.) and consolidate the same (Great 68).

When the organization of labourers either led or influenced by the Party is not complete, an organization of juvenile workers may be formed. The mature labourers may be permitted to join the organization, which is to be amalgamated with the proper labour organization when completing formation (Great 87).

The number of apprentices and child workers being very great, it is important not to ignore the organization of same, which is as much important as the organization of juvenile labourers, so far as the complete labour organization is concerned (Great 87).
pages.zh:
- 14 -

青年工作组织

该团体逐渐从一个学生组织转变为由劳工和农民青年分子组成的组织。（Great 124）。

在我们的群众组织中，只有空壳的“上层”机构。虽然我们领导群众进行某些斗争，但这些群众如同鸟群，易聚易散。实际上，党在青年中并没有开展工作（Great 88）。

青年工作是该团体的特定职责。你们必须特别注意在少年劳工和农民中的工作，并将他们组织起来。除了组织各种互助、娱乐和体育活动外，有必要开始组建青年先锋队和“充量團”，并加速对他们的训练（Great 69）。

在环境较差的地方，可以建立“兄弟团”，但必须大力清除封建主义因素的存在。在“一号”之下，应设有“二号”和“三号”，以避免“一号”成为独裁者，并使组织具有委员会的性质（Great 16）。

兄弟团和姐妹团的每个小组可由5至10人组成。最好由我们的一名同志担任每个小组的负责人。“兄弟团”或“姐妹团”的成员不必属于同一家工厂，此类团体的各个分部也不必联合。然而，始终认为最好就工厂而言做出明确区分，并在可能的地方实现联合。这种组织可被视为组织群众和工会以及发展该团体的初步步骤（Great 14）。

发展青年群众的组织（如“兄弟团”、青年社、儿童团、秘密工会、农民委员会、青年先锋队等），并加以巩固（Great 68）。

当由党领导或影响的劳工组织尚不完善时，可以组建少年工人组织。允许成年劳工加入该组织，待其组建完成后，再与适当的劳工组织合并（Great 87）。

鉴于学徒和童工人数众多，不可忽视对他们的组织工作，就完整的劳工组织而言，这与组织少年劳工同样重要（Great 87）。

pages.en:
- 15 -

Organization dealing with soldiers

The armed organization of the labouring and
farming masses should be started. It should be
systematic and in addition, political and military
education should be given them.

Being necessary to struggles in farming villages,
our armed organization is absolutely important (Hai 7).

The method of organization is not limited to
"Small" Groups, "Middle" Groups and "Big" Groups and
it is not necessary to adopt the name of "Labourers'
and Peasants' Revolutionary Army". Our party should
carry out the organization according to the circumstances
and the struggles (Hai 7).

In a number of "fundamental" masses (such as
Village Peasants' Union or a trade branch union),
select brave elements and organize them into various
corps, the name of which can be fixed according to
the custom and condition in various places (Hai 7).

The groups in a village peasants' union are taken
as the units of peasants' organization, and then the
village peasants' unions, district peasants' unions
and Hsien peasants' unions to form a system. The
trade branch labour unions are taken as the units of
labour unions, and then the trade labour unions and
Hsien Labour Unions to form a system. The armed
organization in the Hsien labour unions and Hsien
peasants' unions is under the control of the Military
Affairs Department of the Hsien Committee (Hai 7).

Training in certain military arts should be carried
out only under certain secret conditions and training
in lots should be undertaken among "organized" armed
groups in various places. The Hsien Military Affairs
Department is required to assign members to train
various "fundamental" armed groups one by one (Hai 7).

Party members should be included in various "funda-
mental" armed groups to receive the same organization
and training (Hai 7).

Military Committees should be organized to execute
military works. (1) The Provincial Committee, Special
Committee and the "uprising" Hsien and District Committees
should all organize military committees, while "military
affairs specially assigned officers" should be sent to
other important Hsiens and districts. The Military
Committee may consist of from 3 to 5 persons; and the
Group should assign representatives to take part in it.
(2) In military centres where there is no military sub-
committee, under the Military Committee and the
Military Affairs Specially Assigned Officers,
xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx
with the Group, should form Soldiers' Committees with
a view to inducing C.Y. to participate in the work of
the soldiers. (3) Military committees of various grades
should have direct relation as well as the Special
Committees, Hsien Committees and District Committees
of the same grade.

- 16 -

The Senior army commanders should be referred to
and their findings be obeyed in the case of any
difference in opinions regarding the direction of
military committees and special committees, Hsien
committees and district committees (Great 178).

The Group should carry out whenever possible
secret armed education and training among the juvenile
labouring masses (at least among the comrades), and
meanwhile should present its strongest force to assist
the Party in establishing the secret armed organization
-- such as the Red Guards, Labourers' and Peasants'
Revolutionary Armies, etc. Brave and reliable
comrades should also be detailed to join the armed
organization (Great 153).

Branches of the Group can be dispensed with in
the armies. The group members may take part in the
work of branches of the Party (Chao 6).

(?The Group) in conjunction with the Party should
organize a "Soldiers' Movement Committee" (Hai 20).

Work of Organization in armies --- The capitalistic
society, from various points of view, seems to be
without government yet it must support the armies
of the "reactionary" political power. The organization
of the armies is extraordinarily strict. Should we
become a little slack in the armies, it is certain that
our past work would be undone and it would be late to
regret. Therefore, we must pay special attention to
secret work in the armies. In our organization, a
company should be taken as the branch unit and a
section as the section unit. The maximum number of
members of a section should not exceed 5, and there should
be no connection whatever among the sections as well as
branches. The chiefs of sections and branches may
have conferences, but other meetings can be dispensed
with. Above the Branches (Companies), special members
should be assigned to battalions and regiments. The
clerk of a branch or special member should be under
the direction of the chairman of the Soldiers' Committee
in the locality concerned or the clerks of the District
and Hsien Committees (Great 189).

There should be persons responsible for the
military departments of the Provincial, District and
Hsien Committees. In the "reactionary" armies, the
C.Y. should in conjunction with the Party organize
"destruction" work. In the revolutionary armies, the
C.Y. may form "Juvenile military service men's small
sections" under the control of the C.Y. Direction Organ
of the place and the branch of the party (Sang 6).

The Branches of the Soldiers' Committee should
consist of sections each of three persons, which are
only to have connection with the Party but not with
the Party members in order to entail strict secrecy
in each section (Hai 26).

The organization of Soldiers' Committees and
other military organs in armies should be independent.
pages.zh:
- 16 -

若对军事委员会、特别委员会、县委员会及区委员会的指导方向存在意见分歧，应请示高级军事指挥官，并服从其裁决（Great 178）。

本团应在可能的情况下，在青年劳工群众中（至少是在同志中）开展秘密的武装教育和训练，同时应拿出最强有力的力量协助党建立秘密武装组织——如赤卫队、工农革命军等。还应选派勇敢可靠的同志加入这些武装组织（Great 153）。

军队中的本团支部可以取消。本团成员可参加党的支部工作（Chao 6）。

（？本团）应与党联合组织一个“士兵运动委员会”（Hai 20）。

军队中的组织工作——从各方面来看，资本主义社会似乎处于无政府状态，但它必须支持“反动”政治权力的军队。军队的组织极其严密。如果我们在军队工作中稍有松懈，肯定会使我们过去的工作付诸东流，届时后悔莫及。因此，我们必须特别注意在军队中的秘密工作。在我们的组织中，应以连为支部单位，以班为小组单位。每个小组的成员人数不得超过5人，各小组之间以及各支部之间不得有任何联系。小组长和支部书记可以开会，但其他会议可以免开。在支部（连）之上，应向营和团指派特派员。支部书记或特派员应受当地士兵委员会主席或区、县委员会书记的领导（Great 189）。

省、区和县委员会的军事部门应有专人负责。在“反动”军队中，共青团应与党联合组织“破坏”工作。在革命军队中，共青团可在当地共青团指导机构和党支部的控制下，组建“青年军人小组”（Sang 6）。

士兵委员会的支部应由三人组成的小组构成，这些小组只与党发生联系，而不与党员个人发生联系，以确保每个小组的严格保密性（Hai 26）。

军队中士兵委员会及其他军事机构的组织应保持独立。

pages.en:
- 17 -

Only the responsible comrades and the organs or
individuals concerned or related should have relation.
Relation with the Party organs is absolutely prohibited
in order that these organs may avoid danger of being
discovered in the event of a raid (by the authorities)
(Great 132).

In places politically and economically strong
(such as Hangchow, Kashing, Huchow, Ningpo, Shaoshing,
etc.), it is necessary to organize in conjunction with
the Party, Soldiers' Committees to be specially
responsible for the control and direction of military
work and the discussion of problems regarding
soldiers (Great 189).

The general trend of mind of the soldiers is for
faith and friendship. We may use these virtues to
get into touch with the soldiers and assign comrades
to employ various means to make sworn friends of them.
Secondly we should do our best to induce disbanded and
the families or friends of soldiers, to join the Group,
because they have connection with the soldiers and can
lead us into the heart of the armies. (Great 189).

We committed a blunder in the past just because
we only paid attention to the movement among military
officers and not the work among the masses. Of course,
we do not object to the using of the position of a
military officer comrade to develop our organization
among the soldiers' masses (Great 189).

Organization dealing with Bandits

In "Red Rifle Societies" in Honan in which have been
discovered independent organizations of youths, we
should assign efficient comrades to participate in them
with a view to leading them systematically and
developing our organization. As many youths join
societies (such as Koo Lao Society (哥老会)) and
gymnastic bodies (such as the "Boxing Group") of peasants
in various places, we must abandon our past "pessimistic"
attitude and deal with these bodies as an important
task and endeavour to obtain control of the masses.
It is also necessary to gradually attempt to remove their
(the youths) feudalistic ideas. When the chiefs of
these bodies act "reactionally", the masses should rise
and attack them (Sang 6).

It is absolutely necessary to remove the custom
of negotiating with the leaders of the bandits. We
must concentrate our power to develop the organization
of the Party and Group among the bandit followers and
to eliminate feudalism among the bandits. The
bandits are to us only a kind of secondary power in
peasant villages and not at all the principal force
(Great 153).
pages.zh:
- 17 -

只有负责同志及相关机构或个人才能与其发生联系。严禁与党的机构发生联系，以便在这些机构遭到（当局）突袭时避免被发现的风险（Great 132）。

在政治和经济实力较强的地区（如杭州、嘉兴、湖州、宁波、绍兴等），有必要与党联合组织士兵委员会，专门负责军事工作的控制和指导，并讨论有关士兵的问题（Great 189）。

士兵的普遍心理倾向是讲究信义和友情。我们可以利用这些美德与士兵接触，并指派同志运用各种手段与他们结拜为兄弟。其次，我们应尽力诱导退伍士兵以及士兵的家属或朋友加入本团，因为他们与士兵有联系，能引导我们深入军队核心。（Great 189）。

我们过去的错误在于只注重军官中的运动，而忽视了群众工作。当然，我们并不反对利用军官同志的身份在士兵群众中发展我们的组织（Great 189）。

处理匪帮的组织工作

在河南的“红枪会”中，已发现独立的青年组织，我们应派遣得力同志参与其中，以便系统地领导他们并发展我们的组织。由于许多青年加入各地的会社（如哥老会）和农民的武术团体（如“拳术团”），我们必须放弃过去“悲观”的态度，将这些团体作为重要任务来处理，并努力争取对群众的控制。还有必要逐步尝试消除他们（青年）的封建思想。当这些团体的首领表现“反动”时，群众应起来攻击他们（Sang 6）。

绝对有必要废除与匪首谈判的习惯。我们必须集中力量在匪众中发展党和本团的组织，并消除匪帮中的封建主义。对我们来说，匪帮只是农村中的一种次要力量，绝非主要力量（Great 153）。

pages.en:
- 18 -

It is necessary to break the organization of the bandits, to overthrow the reactionary chiefs and to obtain control of the masses. The buying over and negotiating with the bandit leaders is absolutely not allowed. We should also abandon the policy of depending on the bandits.
The "red rifle societies", the "big knife societies", etc. in many places are very powerful among the peasant masses. In most cases, the leadership is in the hands of the gentry, landlords and rich peasants, but as these bodies are of the masses, the Party should continue to accelerate work among the masses in order to snatch the leadership. The party furthermore should propagate the principal slogans of the Party among the poor peasants of these bodies and the peasant masses in general, for the purpose of making the Party as the central power of these bodies and thus gradually changing their organization (Hai 43).

PROPAGANDA

Propaganda and its relation

(1) The Provincial Committee fixes an outline of the anti-Imperialist movement and propaganda. The various Party offices on receiving it should base their work on the rules of propaganda set forth therein.
(2) handbills in plain language based on the outline of propaganda should be prepared and distributed among the residents (3) posters bearing slogans based on the outline should be exhibited in towns and villages. In well policed districts, other means may be employed such as using chalk or charcoal to write slogans on walls or poles (4) simple, clear and ironic cartoons are most suitable to the toiling masses and soldiers (5) to convene various kinds of small or large meetings of masses and to deliver public lectures. It is also advisable to hold "flying" meetings and to carry out short verbal propaganda (6) to lecture in fancy dress in peasant villages (7) other propaganda methods -- such as compilation of songs, etc. (8) the Provincial Committee should in the name and standing the Party publish manifestoes to express its own attitude. After the issue of these manifestoes, it is also necessary to publish similar manifestoes according to their respective scope of power in various places. In times of necessity, it is also required to issue handbills addressed to labourers, peasants, students, petty merchants, soldiers, Kuomintang members, etc. (Great 157).

The Provincial Committee should publish a "gray" periodical, which is to stand in the third person; on one hand to criticise and reproach the "reactionary" Kuomintang and on the other hand to suggest ways by which the masses may obtain light. The contents of this periodical may include (a) political comment (b) logical articles (c) literature and (d) correspondence. It should be taken as a weekly for the time being. This periodical is suitable for the intellectuals (Great 157).

Besides this periodical, it is also necessary to publish a mosquito newspaper (either periodical or non-periodical), the contents of which should dwell chiefly on the livelihood of labourers and peasants and the conditions of their struggles as well as the conditions of the masses. It is also good to compile booklets, the contents of which should be simple and plain and
pages.zh:
- 18 -

有必要瓦解匪帮组织，推翻反动头目，并取得对群众的控制。绝对不允许收买或与匪首谈判。我们也应放弃依赖匪帮的政策。
许多地方的“红枪会”、“大刀会”等在农民群众中势力很大。在大多数情况下，领导权掌握在绅士、地主和富农手中，但由于这些团体具有群众性，党应继续加速在群众中的工作，以夺取领导权。此外，党还应在这些团体的贫农和广大农民群众中宣传党的主要口号，目的是使党成为这些团体的核心力量，从而逐渐改变其组织结构（Hai 43）。

宣传工作

宣传及其关系

(1) 省委制定反帝运动和宣传的大纲。各级党组织收到后，应以此中规定的宣传规则为基础开展工作。
(2) 应根据宣传大纲准备通俗易懂的传单，并在居民中分发 (3) 应在城镇和乡村张贴基于大纲的标语海报。在警察戒备森严的地区，可采用其他手段，如用粉笔或木炭在墙壁或电线杆上书写标语 (4) 简单、清晰且带有讽刺意味的漫画最适合劳苦大众和士兵 (5) 召开各种小型或大型的群众集会并进行公开演讲。也建议举行“飞行”集会（即快速聚集又快速解散的集会）并进行简短的口头宣传 (6) 在农村村庄进行化装演讲 (7) 其他宣传方法——如编写歌曲等 (8) 省委应以党的名义和地位发表宣言，表明自身态度。在这些宣言发布后，各地也有必要根据各自的权限范围发布类似的宣言。在必要时，还需向工人、农民、学生、小商人、士兵、国民党成员等发行传单（Great 157）。

省委应出版一份“灰色”刊物，以第三人称立场行文；一方面批评和谴责“反动”的国民党，另一方面建议群众获得光明的途径。该刊物的内容可包括 (a) 政治评论 (b) 逻辑文章 (c) 文学作品 和 (d) 通讯。目前暂定为周刊。该刊物适合知识分子阅读（Great 157）。

除了这份刊物外，还有必要出版一种“蚊子报”（定期或不定期均可），其内容应主要关注工人和农民的生计、他们的斗争状况以及群众状况。编纂小册子也是好的，其内容应简单明了，并

pages.en:
- 19 -

include songs suitable for the masses (Great 157).

In places, especially Ningpo, Linghai, Lanchi, Yung Kah and other important districts, it will be best to try and accomplish Nos. 5 and 6 as referred to above. Should it be found impossible to publish periodicals, it would be advisable to instruct comrades to subscribe articles to comparatively "leftist" publications. The articles should be a little "gray" and care should be taken not to expose the real authorship. Meanwhile it is essential to devise means for the wide sale of the periodical of the Provincial Committee, "Hu Pu" (Lake Wave), and the "Cloth Paper" of the Central (Great 157).

The Provincial Committee should constantly supply various places with propaganda and training material such as "Political correspondence", "Outline of political propaganda", strategical problems, answers to logical problems, material for practical struggle, etc. In turn various places should put this material for discussion in branches (Should discussion result in failure to understand, the material can be returned to senior Party organs for explanation), in order that each comrade may understand it (Great 157).

Slogans should be divided into propaganda slogans and movement slogans. In the former, special attention should be paid to the Party's fundamental propaganda (Land revolution, Soviet political power, etc.) (Hai 17).

The propaganda slogan is comparatively of the higher and broader sense. The movement slogan is what the masses require at the time of their struggle (Hai 38).

Under the white terror, the method of our propaganda towards the external is as follows :-
1. To be of the opinion that a little is better than nothing. To disseminate handbills and fabricate rumours and to write slogans on walls .........
2. To avail ourselves of the opportunity of religious assemblies or meetings of the masses to disseminate propaganda matter on a large scale.
3. To endeavour to resuscitate the periodical of the Students' Federation and to thereafter push its sale energetically and secretly among the student masses (Kiang 11).

Though public lectures yield great results, it is necessary to pay attention to the following points:-
1. It is not advisable for comrades who are specially assigned for secret work, to lecture frequently.
2. The dress in ordinary circumstances and at lectures should not be same.
3. After the lecture, comrades should not directly proceed to their residences or those of responsible comrades or organs (Duh Yee 1).
pages.zh:
- 19 -

包含适合群众的歌曲（Great 157）。

在一些地方，特别是宁波、临海、兰溪、永嘉和其他重要地区，最好尝试完成上述第5和第6项工作。如果发现无法出版刊物，建议指示同志向相对“左倾”的出版物投稿。文章应略带“灰色”，并注意不要暴露真实作者身份。同时，必须设法广泛销售省委的刊物《湖波》和中央的《布报》（Great 157）。

省委应不断向各地提供宣传和培训材料，如《政治通讯》、《政治宣传大纲》、战略问题、逻辑问题解答、实际斗争材料等。反过来，各地应将此材料在支部中进行讨论（如果讨论后仍不理解，可将材料退回上级党组织请求解释），以便每位同志都能理解（Great 157）。

口号应分为宣传口号和运动口号。在前者中，应特别注意党的基本宣传内容（土地革命、苏维埃政权等）（Hai 17）。

宣传口号具有比较高层和广泛的含义。运动口号是群众在斗争时刻所需要的（Hai 38）。

在白色恐怖下，我们对外的宣传方法如下：
1. 秉持“聊胜于无”的观点。散发传单、制造谣言以及在墙上书写标语……
2. 利用宗教集会或群众集会的机会，大规模地传播宣传材料。
3. 努力恢复学生联合会的刊物，随后在学生群众中积极而秘密地推动其销售（Kiang 11）。

虽然公开演讲效果显著，但必须注意以下几点：
1. 专门从事秘密工作的同志不宜频繁进行演讲。
2. 日常着装与演讲时的着装不应相同。
3. 演讲结束后，同志不应直接返回自己的住所，或负责同志及机构的住所（Duh Yee 1）。

pages.en:
- 20 -

To inform the masses of the opinions of the Party
by means of epistles, wall paper, childrens songs and
posters dealing with politics and economics which should
answer the demand of the people. This propaganda matter
should be frequently exhibited. In large hsiens,, it is
necessary to have a weekly or 3-day periodical (mimeo-
graphed) to carry out regular propaganda in black and
white. The Branches are required to organize propaganda
groups to work in labour unions and peasants' unions so
that the labouring and peasant masses may have a clear
idea about the opinions of the Party (Duh Ye 3).

In propaganda "empty" political slogans should
be avoided in the early stages (for instance after
uttering only a few words, the following slogans are
at once shouted : "Down with the Kuomintang, Support the
C.P., Join the C.Y."). We often forget the slogans
in support of the daily economical struggles which
are of such importance to the masses. It should be
understood that the purely political and empty slogans
often scare away the masses (Great 153).

Do not at the early stage propagate our principles
in slogans, that is, do not directly say "land revolution".
At present when the masses are on the point of understanding,
we must carry out propaganda which is necessary to the
masses and make them grasp our opinions (Hai 21).

The introduction of comrades is only a part of the
propaganda work and not the whole. In the past propaganda
was conducted verbally and very seldom among the masses.
There was no propaganda in black and white and no
propaganda at all favouring the education of the comrades
(Hai 21).

Compile simple and short handbills, "hoarding"
paper and "wall" paper to further propaganda; it is not
necessary to wait for anniversary occasions (Hai 21).

Convene on all possible occasions assemblages of
juvenile labouring and peasant masses to further the
propaganda (Hai 21).

In crowded places, conduct propaganda verbally and
in writing, such as when the masses are basking in the sun
or when labourers are changing shifts (Hai 21).

Write slogans with chalk or charcoal in places where
they will be conspicuous to the masses (Hai 21).

Deliver lectures in fancy dress (Hai 21).

When the masses move, our influence will surely
penetrate them. Meanwhile you must pay great attention
to method and skill in propaganda. At the commencement,
the propaganda should not be too "red" as such a step would
scare away the masses. The speech should not be "empty"
as this will only make the masses disgusted (Great 38).

Propaganda Work : The principal propaganda and
slogans are land revolution, the grappling of the political
power, the organization of the Soviet and the killing of
the wicked gentry (Hai 6).
pages.zh:
- 20 -

通过信件、墙报、儿歌以及涉及政治和经济的海报，向群众宣传党的主张，这些内容应顺应民众的需求。此类宣传品应经常展示。在大县，有必要出版周刊或三日刊（油印），以进行定期的黑白文字宣传。各支部须组织宣传小组，在工会和农会中开展工作，以便使劳工和农民群众清楚了解党的主张（Duh Ye 3）。

在宣传初期，应避免使用“空洞”的政治口号（例如，仅说了几句话后，便立即高呼：“打倒国民党，支持共产党，加入共青团”）。我们往往忘记了那些对群众至关重要的、支持日常经济斗争的口号。应当明白，纯粹政治性和空洞的口号往往会吓跑群众（Great 153）。

在初期不要用口号来宣传我们的原则，也就是说，不要直接说“土地革命”。目前，当群众正处于理解阶段时，我们必须开展对群众必要的宣传，使他们掌握我们的观点（Hai 21）。

介绍同志只是宣传工作的一部分，而非全部。过去的宣传主要是口头的，且很少在群众中进行。既没有黑白文字宣传，也没有任何有利于同志教育的宣传（Hai 21）。

编制简短的小册子、“传单”和“墙报”以推进宣传；不必等待纪念日场合（Hai 21）。

利用一切可能的机会召集青年劳工和农民群众集会，以推进宣传（Hai 21）。

在人群拥挤的地方，进行口头和书面宣传，例如当群众晒太阳或工人换班时（Hai 21）。

在群众显眼的地方，用粉笔或木炭书写标语（Hai 21）。

进行化装演讲（Hai 21）。

当群众运动起来时，我们的影响力必将渗透其中。同时，你必须高度重视宣传的方法和技巧。在开始时，宣传不应太“红”，因为此举会吓跑群众。讲话不应“空洞”，因为这只会令群众厌恶（Great 38）。

宣传工作：主要的宣传和口号是土地革命、夺取政权、组织苏维埃以及诛杀恶绅（Hai 6）。

pages.en:
- 21 -

Appoint a communication organ which is to distribute
documents and propaganda matter of the Provincial Committee
and the Special Committee (Hai 5).

Compile very small and very plain handbills for
distribution among the masses (Hai 7).

Each mass organization or Hsien Committee should
do its best to assist in the publication of "wall" paper
which is to be issued regularly every few days for
propaganda purposes (Hai 7).

The Hsien or District Committee should appoint
certain members to draw various cartoons (which should
bear on propaganda) for distribution among the masses
(Hai 7).

The Party should avail itself of the opportunity
of various assemblies of the masses and assign members
therein to conduct propaganda. The party should appoint
comrades to be responsbile for constant propaganda work when
opportunity offers. For instance, when the peasants
bask in the sun: As a rule in a village the peasants go
to one particular spot to bask in the sun; then the
branches should at once detail members to propagate in
their respective areas. Again, the "twilight assemblage";
peasants usually gather together in one place at dusk for
a chat. For example, the "Peasant Village Small Shop" :-
here a number of people assemble during the day as well
as at dusk. Attention should also be given to the places
of assemblage of labourers in the evening. The propaganda
should be systematic. Do not hope that the propaganda
will at the early stage induce people to join the C.P.
The Party organs should at all times propagate according
to the necessity of the masses and make them understand
(the party) (Hai 7).

Propaganda work should be extensified and penetrating -
we must employ the kindest, the sincerest, the most
skillful and the most clever method (our life should
conform as much as possible to that of labourers and
peasants) to get into touch with the masses, to notice and
understand the daily life of the masses. Find out the
most practical propaganda method which will come into
close contact with their daily life. You must introduce
the propaganda of land revolution, soviet political power
and opposition to the Imperialists and the Kuomintang by
showing the relations of these to their daily life. It
is important not to use high sounding words but plain language.
The propaganda should be carried out at all times and places
and be widespread and should sink into the mind of the masses.
Such methods of propaganda will reap a good harvest among
the masses (Great 86).

Constantly and continually carry out agitation among
the "lower layer" of the masses - employ the abovementioned
methods of propaganda and extend them to the "lower layer"
of the masses. Constantly propagate and conduct agitation
among them in order to arouse their sense of class
distinction and politics and thus increase their feeling
towards struggles and make them intolerable of the
retardation of struggles (Great 86).
pages.zh:
- 21 -

指定一个通讯机构，负责分发省委和特委的文件及宣传材料（Hai 5）。

编制非常小巧且 plain（通俗/简单）的小册子，在群众中分发（Hai 7）。

每个群众组织或县委员会应尽力协助出版“墙报”，该墙报应每隔几天定期发行，用于宣传目的（Hai 7）。

县或区委员会应指定某些成员绘制各种漫画（内容应与宣传相关），并在群众中分发（Hai 7）。

党应利用群众各种集会的时机，指派其中的成员进行宣传。党应指派同志负责在有机会时进行持续的宣传工 作。例如，当农民晒太阳时：通常在一个村庄里，农民会去一个特定的地点晒太阳；此时各支部应立即派遣成员到各自区域进行宣传。再者，“黄昏集会”；农民通常在黄昏时聚集在一处聊天。例如，“乡村小商店”：这里白天和黄昏都有许多人聚集。还应注意工人在晚上的聚集地点。宣传应有系统性。不要指望在初期宣传就能诱导人们加入共产党。党的机关应始终根据群众的需要进行宣传，使他们理解（党）（Hai 7）。

宣传工作应扩展并深入——我们必须采用最亲切、最真诚、最熟练和最巧妙的方法（我们的生活应尽可能与劳工和农民的生活相一致）来接触群众，注意并了解群众的日常生活。找出与他们日常生活密切结合的最实用的宣传方法。你必须通过展示土地革命、苏维埃政权以及反对帝国主义和国民党与它们日常生活的关系，来引入这些方面的宣传。重要的是不使用高调的言辞，而是使用平实的语言。宣传应随时随地进行，广泛传播，并深入人心。这样的宣传方法将在群众中获得良好的收获（Great 86）。

在群众的“下层”中不断持续地进行鼓动——采用上述宣传方法并将其扩展到群众的“下层”。在他们中间不断宣传和鼓动，以唤起他们的阶级意识和政治意识，从而增强他们的斗争感情，使他们无法容忍斗争的停滞（Great 86）。

pages.en:
- 22 -

The demands in our slogans should not be weaker than those put forth (? to the capitalists). It is not necessary that the result of the struggle should coincide with the demands of the slogans, but care should be taken against the inclination of the masses towards the Kuomintang. (Great 22).

Attention should be paid to secret propaganda among "improving" elements of the opponents with a view to making them oppose any resolution or movement of the opponents which may cause great harm to us and the revolution (Duh Ye 1).

Distribution of handbills is our most important work. When disseminating ordinary handbills, you need have no fear, because it is not very important in the event of your arrest. But in the case of distributing important handbills, attention should be paid against the police and meanwhile the distribution should be carried out quickly and from the back or the side of others. Care should also be taken as to the following points :-
1. Do not carry with you any document, diaries, etc. that have any connection with the Party.
2. Prepare a statement to be used if and when you are arrested.
3. Remove in advance all documents and books which are connected with the Party, from your residence. In time of arrest, you must not mention your own address but an address of other comrades where no document is stored. In such cases, you must warn the comrade concerned beforehand.
4. After finishing the distribution of the handbills, do not return directly home nor proceed to residences of responsible comrades or to premises where organs are located.
5. In a meeting place should two comrades wish to know whether a third person is a comrade, the "hand" communication method should be employed for questions and answers. (Duh Ye 1).

Anti-Kuomintang propaganda can of course be further accelerated in the anti-Imperialist movement and meanwhile this procedure may be reversed with success (Great 87).

Appoint comrades to disguise themselves as food hawkers or loafers and thus propagate among them (? soldiers). Propaganda in writing is also important but the words used should be simple and easy to read. The adoption of cartoons and songs are even better. The distribution of the propaganda matter should be carried out with care. It is best to try and put it in the hats or shoes of soldiers or under their pillows or throw it in places which soldiers frequently visit such as tea shops, wine shops, front of lavatories, entrance of billets, etc. (Great 189).

You should at once start to fix an outline of the practical demands of workers in various factories according to their respective conditions in these industrial concerns. This outline can be taken as a basis for propaganda. These demands should contain a demand for a strike. This outline should be forwarded to the Provincial Committee for information (Great 14).
pages.zh:
- 22 -

我们口号中的要求不应弱于那些提出的要求（?针对资本家）。斗争的结果不必与口号的要求完全一致，但应注意防止群众倾向国民党。（Great 22）。

应注意在对手的“改良”分子中进行秘密宣传，旨在使他们反对任何可能对我们和革命造成巨大危害的对手决议或运动（Duh Ye 1）。

分发传单是我们最重要的工作。分发普通传单时，你无需恐惧，因为即使被捕，后果也不是很严重。但在分发重要传单时，应注意避开警察，同时分发行动要迅速，并从他人的背后或侧面进行。还应注意以下几点：
1. 不要携带任何与党有关的文件、日记等。
2. 准备一份供被捕时使用的供词。
3. 提前从住所移除所有与党有关的文件和书籍。在被捕时，不得提及自己的地址，而应提供一个未存放文件的其它同志的地址。在此类情况下，必须事先警告相关同志。
4. 分发完传单后，不要直接回家，也不要前往负责同志的住所或机关所在地。
5. 在会议场所，如果两名同志想知道第三人是否为同志，应采用“手势”沟通方法进行问答。（Duh Ye 1）。

反国民党宣传当然可以在反帝运动中进一步加速，同时这一程序也可以成功地反向操作（Great 87）。

指派同志伪装成食物小贩或闲散人员，从而在他们（?士兵）中间进行宣传。书面宣传也很重要，但用词应简单易懂。采用漫画和歌曲甚至更好。宣传品的分发应谨慎进行。最好尝试将其放入士兵的帽子或鞋子里，或放在他们的枕头下，或扔在士兵经常光顾的地方，如茶馆、酒店、厕所前、营房入口等。（Great 189）。

你应立即开始根据各工业企业的具体情况，制定各工厂工人的实际需求大纲。此大纲可作为宣传的基础。这些需求应包含罢工的要求。此大纲应报送省委备案（Great 14）。

pages.en:
- 23 -

At present when the close of the year is approaching
you must forthwith prepare all tasks. You must draft
a detailed plan and send it to the branches of the
district committee. You should at once proceed with
the plan, including investigation, propaganda and
agitation and thus you can hope to reap a good harvest.
In cities and in the countryside, it is essential to
intensify the movement to refuse payment of taxes and to
oppose the dismissal of workers on the occasion of the
lunar new year as well as propaganda favouring demands
for an increase in pay and reduction in working hours
(Great 42).

In places of assemblage of the masses - tea shops,
front of temples, under trees and corners of roads,
deliver lectures or take part in chatting, etc. to reveal
the intrigue of the authorities in order to arouse the
feeling of opposition in the masses and put forth
slogans favouring reduction in rentals (Great 67).

Ring bells, beat trumpets and proceed in fancy
dress to various peasant villages for propaganda
purposes in order to make every family feel the intrigue
and oppose it (? the Government) (Great 67).

Spread rumours, such as - rentals due are being
forcibly demanded - for the purpose of stirring up and
bad feeling among the peasants towards the governing
authorities. The rumours should be sufficiently credible.
This, however, is not the principal task (Great 67).

Among slogans favouring reduction in rentals, it
is necessary to insert slogans of a political nature
(especially the anti-Imperialist slogans) (Great 67).

Propaganda and its relation with Organization

You have done too little propaganda work. You must
constantly convene mass meetings, when you must propagate
as much as possible. At each meeting, you must arrange
some theatrical performance so as to arouse the interest
of the masses. It is of course better to have lecturing
groups, to carry out lectures in fancy dress and such
like works. The work of publishing cartoons and "wall"
papers should be one of the constant tasks of each branch
(Great 20).

Constantly do your best to convene meetings of
juvenile labourers and peasants and to open training classes.
In places of assemblage of the masses, conduct propaganda
by word of mouth and in writing. Use chalk, charcoal,
etc. to write propaganda in conspicuous places on roads,
public places or residences (Hai 22).

The Group should exert its utmost to proceed with
the propaganda and education work in peasant villages.
Extend the propaganda in favour of land revolution and
the Soviet political power by means of pictorials, paper
slips, leaflets, cards, rural songs, Peiping songs,
mass meetings, theatrical performances, lectures in fancy
dress, etc. (Great 153).
pages.zh:
- 23 -

目前年终将至，你必须立即准备各项任务。你必须起草详细计划，并发送给区委各支部。你应立即执行该计划，包括调查、宣传和鼓动，从而有望获得良好的成果。在城市和农村，必须加强拒付税款运动，并在农历新年之际反对解雇工人，同时宣传增加工资和减少工时的要求（Great 42）。

在群众聚集地——茶馆、庙宇前、树下和路口角落——进行演讲或参与聊天等，以揭露当局的阴谋，从而激起群众的反对情绪，并提出减租口号（Great 67）。

敲钟、吹号并化装前往各个农民村庄进行宣传，目的是让每家每户都感受到阴谋并加以反对（?政府）（Great 67）。

散布谣言，例如——强行催缴到期租金——目的是煽动农民对统治当局的不满和敌意。谣言应具有足够的可信度。然而，这不是主要任务（Great 67）。

在支持减租的口号中，有必要插入政治性质的口号（特别是反帝口号）（Great 67）。

宣传及其与组织的关系

你们做的宣传工作太少了。你们必须不断召开群众大会，在会上必须尽可能多地进行宣传。在每次会议上，你们必须安排一些戏剧表演，以引起群众的兴趣。当然，最好有演讲组，进行化装演讲等工作。出版漫画和“墙报”的工作应成为各支部的常规任务之一（Great 20）。

不断尽力召开青年劳工和农民会议，并开设培训班。在群众聚集地，进行口头和书面宣传。使用粉笔、木炭等在道路、公共场所或住宅的显眼位置书写宣传内容（Hai 22）。

小组应竭尽全力在农民村庄开展宣传和教育工 作。通过画报、纸条、传单、卡片、乡村歌曲、北平歌曲、群众大会、戏剧表演、化装演讲等方式，扩展支持土地革命和苏维埃政权的宣传（Great 153）。

pages.en:
- 24 -

You should do your best towards the work of
propaganda and agitation among the masses. You
should often hold "flying meetings" for propaganda and
agitation (Great 14).

The period of time of "flying" meetings is very
short. They may be held in front of factories before the
workers commence their duties or after they finish their
labour (Great 14).

In order to systematically direct the work of
education and propaganda, there should be one Propaganda
Committee under the Provincial Committee. The chairman
of the Propaganda Committee should be a Standing Committee
member. In a special committee, Hsien committee and a
district committee, there should also be a member of the
Standing Committee to be responsible for the propaganda
work. The organization or not of a propaganda committee
depends upon the scope of work in the locality concerned.
The membership should range from 3 to 5 persons and the
C.Y. should assign one member to take part in it (Great 157)

Both the propaganda and the organization work should
commence at the "bottom" and work to the "top". This is
the real method of mass work; it can also be termed the
working form of establishing the mass foundation
(Great 58).

In your daily life, you should secretly carry out the
propaganda of the Party and the Group and enlist the
bravest of the faithful poor peasants and "improving"
intellectuals. If you enter a school, you are bound to
organize at least one branch, irrespective as to whether it
is of university or middle school students (Tung 15).

In the school, you should try to form small organizations
for the purpose of seizing control of the "gray"
publications of the masses. You should also constantly
publish "wall" papers and conduct other propaganda work
(Great 70).

Intensify the propaganda among the masses and develop
the organization of the masses (such as Peasants' Committee,
Youth Vanguards, Brothers' Groups, Childrens Groups, etc.)
(Great 65).

The intellectuals (of the Party?) are now mostly
distributed in various countryside places; the Hsien
committee should assign more work to them. Besides
being active among the peasants and doing the propaganda
and organization works, they should go into primary
schools and schools for common people and organize the
