children in peasant villages (peasant or labouring classes).
Under the children's groups, you should conduct ██████████
movements of more cultural nature but care should be taken
not to arouse the bad feeling of the peasant masses
towards us. (Great 16)
pages.zh:
- 24 -

你们应尽力开展群众中的宣传与鼓动工作。你们应经常举行“飞行集会”进行宣传与鼓动（Great 14）。

“飞行”集会的持续时间很短。可以在工人开始工作之前或结束劳动之后，在工厂门前举行（Great 14）。

为了系统地指导教育与宣传工作，省委之下应设立一个宣传委员会。宣传委员会主席应由常务委员会委员担任。在特委、县委和区委中，也应由一名常务委员会委员负责宣传工作。是否设立宣传委员会，取决于当地的工作范围。成员人数应为3至5人，共青团应指派一名成员参加（Great 157）。

宣传和组织工作都应从“底层”开始，向“上层”推进。这是真正的群众工作方法；也可以称为建立群众基础的工作形式（Great 58）。

在日常生活中，你们应秘密进行党和团组的宣传，并招募最勇敢、忠诚的贫苦农民和“进步”知识分子。如果进入学校，无论大学生还是中学生，都必须至少建立一个支部（Tung 15）。

在学校里，你们应尝试建立小型组织，以夺取对群众“灰色”刊物的控制权。你们还应经常出版“墙报”并开展其他宣传工作（Great 70）。

加强群众中的宣传工作，发展群众组织（如农民委员会、青年先锋队、兄弟会、儿童团等）（Great 65）。

（党的？）知识分子现在大多分布在各个乡村地区；县委应给他们分配更多工作。除了在农村中积极活动，从事宣传和组织工作外，他们还应进入小学和民众学校，组织农民村庄（农民或劳工阶级）的儿童。在儿童团之下，你们应开展██████████更具文化性质的运动，但应注意不要引起农民群众对我们的反感。（Great 16）

pages.en:
- 25 -

Intrigue in Preparation
Movement

The action of the Party and Group in the movement

The secret work of the Party and the movement
of the masses should be clearly separated. The actual
organization of the Party in a town or village should always
be kept secret, but its actions should be directed towards
the masses, thus constituting a link between the secret
work of the party and the public movement of the masses
outside the Party. The principles and opinions of the
Party are conveyed to the masses through the Party and
the Group (Duh Ye 4).

Extend the Party organization among the
proletariat and "semi-proletariat" (handcraftsmen, farm
labourers, poor peasants) in peasant villages. Should
the revolutionary masses among the peasants join the
Party organization, it would be necessary to use the
Party to replace the peasant mass organization (Peasants'
Cooperative Association). It is imperative to unite the
revolutionary peasant masses under the Peasants' Cooperative
Association or the Soviet. The Party should not directly
command or direct the masses. The Party can only push its
action through the Peasants' Cooperative Association or the
Soviet (Great 162).

The Party and the Group are the link between the
Party and the masses. The party policy should be conveyed
to the masses in order to make the latter see the true
standing of the Party and not the individual working for
the party (Great 162).

Relation between the Party and the Group in the
soldiers movement - in the anti-revolutionary troops, the
branches of the Party and Group are not separated and are
under the direction of the soldiers' committees. (Great 189).

In brothers' groups and cooperative associations,
you must extend our political influence. Select faithful
and brave leaders of the masses and induce them to join the
Group and commence the work of the Party and Group among
them (Great 37).

In places where there are branches and comrades,
let the branches and comrades be active among the masses.
In places where there is no branch nor comrades or where
the branch is very weak, comrades should be detailed
directly to the masses and gradually organize them. If
it be found impossible to form Peasants' Cooperative
Associations or peasants' committees, organizations under
other names should be formed (such as at present we may
adopt the name "Locust Elimination Society", etc.) Efforts
should also be made to enlist the "progressive" elements
among the juvenile peasants to join the group in order to
establish the group organization (Great 153).

Various group offices should at once redress or promote
the organization of various youth bodies in their respective
areas, as well as establish our group sections through
which we enforce our directions (Sang 6).

In employees' unions, peasants' unions, student unions
or other social or cultural bodies, should there be more
pages.zh:
- 25 -

准备中的阴谋
运动

党与团组在运动中的行动

党的秘密工作与群众运动应明确分开。城镇或乡村中党的实际组织应始终保持秘密，但其行动应面向群众，从而构成党的秘密工作与党外群众公开运动之间的联系。党的原则和意见通过党和团组传达给群众（Duh Ye 4）。

在农民村庄中，扩大党在无产阶级和“半无产阶级”（手工业者、农业雇工、贫农）中的组织。如果农民中的革命群众加入党组织，就有必要用党来取代农民群众组织（农民合作社协会）。必须在农民合作社协会或苏维埃之下团结革命的农民群众。党不应直接命令或指挥群众。党只能通过农民合作社协会或苏维埃来推动其行动（Great 162）。

党和团组是党与群众之间的纽带。党的政策应传达给群众，使后者看到党的真实立场，而不是为党工作的个人（Great 162）。

士兵运动中党与团组的关系——在反革命军队中，党和团组的支部不分开，并在士兵委员会的指导下运作。（Great 189）。

在兄弟会和合作社协会中，你们必须扩大我们的政治影响。挑选忠诚勇敢的群众领袖，诱导他们加入团组，并在他们中间开始党和团组的工作（Great 37）。

在有支部和同志的地方，让支部和同志在群众中积极活动。在没有支部也没有同志，或者支部非常薄弱的地方，应直接派遣同志深入群众，逐步组织他们。如果发现无法成立农民合作社协会或农民委员会，则应以其他名义成立组织（例如目前我们可以采用“灭蝗社”等名称）。还应努力招募青年农民中的“进步”分子加入团组，以建立团组组织（Great 153）。

各团组办事处应立即整顿或促进各自区域内各类青年团体的组织，并通过我们实施指令的团组分部来建立我们的组织（Sang 6）。

在职工会、农民协会、学生会或其他社会或文化团体中，如果有超过

pages.en:
- 26 -

than three group members, they can establish a group
section (Chao 6).

A group section is an organization by which the
Group can carry out the group policy, strengthen the
group and supervise the group members in any organization.
The group sections obey the instructions of various grades
of committees according to the scope of influence of the
section, i.e. obey the Central should the scope extend to
the whole nation, obey the provincial committee should
the scope be limited to one province, etc. (Chao 6).

The appointment of the staff of a group section
should be approved by an appropriate senior organ. All
problems should be referred to the section members or
section staff for discussion, whereupon they will be
submitted to senior organs for approval. Finally they will
be passed to the public organization for discussion and
execution. In a general meeting of Group section members,
each member should offer opinions according to order
(Chao 6).

As soon as the number of persons reaches 3, a
small factory section can be formed. Should the number
of sections reach a suitable standard, a factory labour
union can be organized. Should it be possible to
organize it in a public manner, a factory committee may
be organized but the work of the labour union sections
cannot be abandoned and should secretly continue (Great 14).

Movement of Party politics

The opponent in the Semi-colonial revolution is the
Imperialist and the anti-Imperialist movement is our
long-period struggle. At present the Chinese revolution
is a democratic revolution of an anti-Imperialist and anti-
capitalistic nature. The anti-Imperialist movement may
be taken as the initiative centre of all work. At present,
the labour movement should be developed through the
anti-Imperialist movement. The labouring class should
seize the leadership in the anti-Imperialist movement.
Both in labour unions and peasants' unions, anti-Imperialist
propaganda and activities should be publicly carried out.
You must point out before the labouring and peasant masses
the offence of the Kuomintang in surrendering to the
Imperialists, with a view to making the masses understand
that in order to overthrow the Imperialists; it is equally
important to overthrow the tool of the Imperialists - the
Kuomintang. Japan is not the only one to be dealt with in
the anti-Imperialist movement but all imperialists must be
opposed. The anti-Imperialist movement is a kind of public
work. It is necessary to link the secret work of the
Party and the public movement outside the Party with a view
to infusing the opinions of the Party into the masses
and to forming extensive mass-like labour and peasant
organizations publicly or semi-publicly under the direction
of the Party (Duh Ye 3).
pages.zh:
- 26 -

三名团组成员，他们可以建立一个团组分部（Chao 6）。

团组分部是团组用以执行团组政策、加强团组并监督任何组织内团组成员的组织。团组分部根据分部的影响范围，服从各级委员会的指示，即如果范围扩展到全国，则服从中央；如果范围限于一省，则服从省委，以此类推（Chao 6）。

团组分部工作人员的任命应经适当上级机关批准。所有问题应提交分部成员或分部工作人员讨论，随后提交上级机关批准。最后将移交公共组织进行讨论和执行。在团组分部成员全体会议上，每位成员应按顺序发表意见（Chao 6）。

一旦人数达到3人，即可成立一个小工厂分部。如果分部数量达到适当标准，可以组织工厂工会。如果可能以公开方式组织，可以组织工厂委员会，但工会分部的工作不能放弃，应秘密继续（Great 14）。

党的政治运动

半殖民地革命的对象是帝国主义，反帝运动是我们长期的斗争。目前中国革命是一场反帝反资本主义性质的民主革命。反帝运动可作为一切工作的发起中心。目前，劳工运动应通过反帝运动来发展。劳工阶级应在反帝运动中夺取领导权。在工会和农民协会中，应公开开展反帝宣传和活动。你们必须在劳工和农民群众面前指出国民党向帝国主义投降的罪行，以使群众明白，为了推翻帝国主义，同样重要的是推翻帝国主义的工具——国民党。在反帝运动中，要对付的不仅仅是日本，而是必须反对所有帝国主义者。反帝运动是一种公开工作。有必要将党的秘密工作与党外的公开运动联系起来，以便将党的意见灌输到群众中，并在党的指导下公开或半公开地形成广泛的类群众性的劳工和农民组织（Duh Ye 3）。

pages.en:
- 27 -

Intensify and extend anti-Kuomintang propaganda
and that favouring land revolution. It is necessary to
make the propaganda universal and penetrating (Great 68).

The principal aims of this movement are anti-Imperialist
and anti-Kuomintang tables. If there is only anti-Imperialist
propaganda and movement and the anti-Kuomintang movement
is ignored, we whuld be working for the Kuomintang and
that is senseless (Duh Ye 7).

As regards the movement for customs autonomy, our
work is to make public the intrigue of "Nanking" and to
oppose the increased burden on the people so that the sym-
pathy of the masses may be obtained to oppose the Nanking
Government (Kiang 1).

The support committees in labour circles are at
present the most important tasks of the Shanghai Party
and Group in order to use the united battle front of
the labourers to seize control of the masses and to
intensify the anti-Imperialist struggle (Duh Ye 7).

Anti-Imperialist work is one of the principal and
constant tasks in the present Chinese revolution, the
class and democratic revolution. Should the anti-
Imperialist work be carried out thoroughly in a town
it is certain that very quick development will be obtained
(Great 67).

'n towns in Chekiang such as Hangchow, Ningpo and
Wenchow, the work is very backward. The work to be
carried out in other hsiens has also been abandoned. Only
because the white terror is comparatively less in the
countryside and the power of the governing class is
weaker, is our power and development concentrated in the
rural districts. According to the statistics of member-
ship of comrades in Chekiang, over 70% are peasants. It
is a crisis of the group and the party and anti-Imperialist
work cannot be carried out. This is entirely due to
lack of town work (Great 87).

Special attention should be paid to town work.
Meanwhile it is necessary to intensify the anti-Imperialist
movement (Great 68).

You should not neglect the town work and the anti-
Imperialist movement. Only by accelerating and developing
the town work can our final victory be strengthened.
(Great 67).

Movement of the Masses

The "principle of command" does not mean the education
of the masses, or the influencing of the people by speech,
it means the direction and oppression of the masses by
commands. Formerly under the "principle of opportunity", the
Party ordered the masses on behalf of the Kuomintang to
cease their activities, and at present under the "principle
of "Blind Movement"], ordered the masses, in order to
oppose the Kuomintang, that they must be active (Great 154).
pages.zh:
- 27 -

加强和扩大反国民党宣传和支持土地革命的宣传。必须使宣传普遍且深入（Great 68）。

这次运动的主要目标是反帝和反国民党。如果只有反帝宣传和运动，而忽视反国民党运动，我们就是在为国民党工作，那是毫无意义的（Duh Ye 7）。

关于关税自主运动，我们的工作是将“南京”的阴谋公之于众，并反对增加人民负担，以获得群众的同情来反对南京政府（Kiang 1）。

劳工界的支持委员会目前是上海党和团组最重要的任务，以便利用劳动者的统一战线来控制群众并加强反帝斗争（Duh Ye 7）。

反帝工作是当前中国革命、阶级和民主革命的主要且持续的任务之一。如果在城镇中彻底开展反帝工作，肯定会获得非常快速的发展（Great 67）。

在浙江的杭州、宁波和温州等城镇，工作非常落后。其他县的工作也被放弃了。仅仅因为农村的白色恐怖相对较轻，统治阶级的力量较弱，我们的力量和发展才集中在农村地区。根据浙江同志成员的统计数据，超过70%是农民。这是团组和党的危机，反帝工作无法开展。这完全是由于缺乏城市工作造成的（Great 87）。

应特别注意城市工作。同时有必要加强反帝运动（Great 68）。

你们不应忽视城市工作和反帝运动。只有加速和发展城市工作，才能加强我们的最终胜利。（Great 67）。

群众运动

“命令原则”并不意味着教育群众，或通过言语影响人民，它意味着通过命令来指导和压迫群众。以前在“机会主义原则”下，党代表国民党命令群众停止活动，而现在在“盲动主义原则”下，为了反对国民党，命令群众必须积极行动（Great 154）。

pages.en:
- 28 -

The masses are not taken as the central power of
the struggle and the accomplishment of the Chinese
revolution is being attempted by the comrades' single
movement. This movement does not lead the masses to take
part nor to mobilize them. The result will be that the
masses will not realize their own power and will depend
on the Red Armies. Though the movement is successful,
it will not give the masses a good impression but will
increase their bad habit of dependance. Meanwhile as the
success has not been achieved by the masses, it is not
protected by a strong mass foundation (Great 153).

In places where there is no organization, the masses
can be dealt with semi-publicly while secrecy be kept
with regard to the society, because secrecy towards the
masses may sometimes frighten them and is at times
impossible.

The group should pay special attention to the work
in reactionary bodies. The group organs should direct
comrades or non-comrades to avail themselves of various
opportunities to seek news from the reactionaries which
can be used as reference for strategical purposes and
as material to make public the offence of the reactionaries
as well as to destroy their organization and power. It
is also important to strengthen the direction and training
of comrades responsible for the work with a view to
checking their instability of mind (Kiang 11).

The activities of the Western Hill Clique have
resulted in alienating our masses. Why? How can we
check this evil? It is a very serious question; you
should not neglect it (Great 21).

In August last year the whole body of the Central
Committee met and restored the "Under the Party Direction"
working system - go to the juvenile labouring and peasant
masses (Great 124).

Common People's Schools are a class of organ through
which contact may be obtained with the masses in peasant
villages, and through which they can be trained. You
should supervise and urge the responsible comrades to
carry on with this kind of school. You can lead the
young students of these institutions to various athletic
and other amusements and at the same time instill
political ideas in their minds (these ideas should be
suitable to the minds of children) and prepare to organize
children's groups (Great 37).

You should at once be determined to go to the masses
and get into touch with the labourers and peasants. On
the one hand, investigate and on the other use sympathetic
words as regards their painful existence (such as long
working hours, low pay, exhorbitant rent, oppression and
maltreatment due to non-payment of taxes, etc.) with a
view to enlisting their belief in us. Again employ
sympathetic and fiery speech to foment them and meantime
do your best to give them a general political knowledge
and an inkling of organization and ideas of "class" for the
purpose of stirring up their sentiment and making them
act for themselves so as to gain a victory (Great 11).
pages.zh:
- 28 -

群众并未被视为斗争的核心力量，中国革命的完成正试图通过同志们的单独行动来实现。这一运动既不引导群众参与，也不动员群众。其结果将是群众无法认识到自身的力量，而会依赖红军。即使运动取得成功，也不会给群众留下良好印象，反而会增加他们依赖的恶习。同时，由于成功并非由群众取得，因此缺乏强大的群众基础作为保护（Great 153）。

在没有组织的地方，可以对群众采取半公开的方式，而对社团则保持秘密，因为对群众保密有时会吓到他们，且有时也是不可能的。

小组应特别注意在反动团体中的工作。小组机构应指导同志或非同志利用各种机会从反动派那里获取情报，这些情报可作为战略参考，也可作为揭露反动派罪行以及摧毁其组织和权力的材料。同样重要的是，加强对负责此项工作的同志的指导和训练，以遏制他们思想上的不稳定（Kiang 11）。

西山会议派的活动导致我们的群众疏远了我们。为什么？我们如何遏制这种弊病？这是一个非常严重的问题；你们不应忽视它（Great 21）。

去年八月，中央委员会全体会议召开，恢复了“在党的领导下”的工作制度——深入青年劳工和农民群众中（Great 124）。

平民学校是一类机构，通过它可以与农村地区的群众建立联系，并对其进行培训。你们应监督并督促负责的同志继续开办此类学校。你们可以引导这些机构的年轻学生参加各种体育和其他娱乐活动，同时向他们灌输政治思想（这些思想应适合儿童的心智），并准备组织儿童团体（Great 37）。

你们应立即下定决心深入群众，与劳工和农民建立联系。一方面进行调查，另一方面就他们痛苦的生存状况（如长时间工作、低工资、高昂租金、因未缴纳税款而遭受的压迫和虐待等）使用同情的言辞，以争取他们对我们的信任。再次运用同情且激昂的言论来煽动他们，同时尽力给予他们一般的政治知识，以及对组织和“阶级”概念的初步了解，目的是激发他们的情感，促使他们采取行动，从而取得胜利（Great 11）。

pages.en:
- 29 -

Movement of the Students

At present the strategy of the student movement in various places is not the seizing control of the entire student unions or federation of student unions. The existence of the secret national student general organ is not necessary. It is essential to develop the youth organizations of various descriptions. The principal action is to propagate the labourers and peasants' revolution and to attack the Kuomintang and other reactionary ideas by logical means - to win over the actual revolutionary intellectuals by means of struggles in ideas (Great 196).

In the past, the foundation of the Group work was almost entirely built on the student movement. The present Chinese revolution has now changed from the national revolution of the capitalists and the petty capitalists united on the same battle line to the stage when the labourers, peasants, soldiers and the poor people will directly rise and riot for participation in political power and the establishment of the Soviet. At this stage, the student movement has lost its value (xxxxxx Great 190).

The purpose of our participation in the student unions is to further the anti-Imperialist movement, to struggle for the interests of the students and to ameliorate school conditions. Should it be possible to foment trouble, this should be extended as much as possible. If our activities are restricted or hindered by the XX party members (? Kuomintang members) of the student unions, means should be employed to make public their offence (Duh Ye 7).

Form various kinds of small organizations among the students (such as a literature research society, political discussion society, etc.) and issue political or literary publications, by which we may push our political ideas into the student masses and make it possible for us to lead them in ideas and in movement (Great 60).

It is still necessary if possible to secure the control of student unions which are supported by the masses (Great 124)

Do your best to take party in various leftist publications in order to develop our ideas and influence (Great 124).

Use the name of "Iron & Blood Group" to scare away the reactionary leaders in various schools (Kia 20).

The reorganization of student federations by the Provincial Party organizations (? Kuomintang) should be opposed (Tung 9).
pages.zh:
- 29 -

学生运动

目前，各地学生运动的策略并非夺取整个学生会或学生联合会的控制权。设立秘密的全国学生总机构是没有必要的。关键在于发展各种类型的青年组织。主要行动是通过逻辑手段宣传劳工和农民革命，攻击国民党及其他反动思想——通过思想斗争赢得真正的革命知识分子（Great 196）。

过去，小组工作的基础几乎完全建立在学生运动之上。目前的中国革命已从资本家和小资产阶级在同一战线上联合的国民革命阶段，转变为劳工、农民、士兵和穷人直接起义和暴动以参与政治权力并建立苏维埃的阶段。在这一阶段，学生运动已失去其价值（xxxxxx Great 190）。

我们参与学生会的目的是推进反帝运动，为学生利益而斗争，并改善学校条件。如果可能煽动事端，应尽可能扩大事态。如果我们的活动受到学生会中 XX 党成员（？国民党成员）的限制或阻碍，应采取手段公开他们的罪行（Duh Ye 7）。

在学生中组建各种小型组织（如文学研究会、政治讨论社等），并发行政治或文学刊物，借此将我们的政治思想推入学生群众中，使我们在思想和行动上能够领导他们（Great 60）。

如有可能，仍有必要确保控制得到群众支持的学生会（Great 124）

尽力参与各种左翼刊物的工作，以发展我们的思想和影响力（Great 124）。

利用“铁血团”的名义吓退各学校的反动领导人（Kia 20）。

应反对由省党部组织（？国民党）对学生联合会进行的改组（Tung 9）。

pages.en:
- 30 -

Movement of the Labourers

A) Establish a united battle front of the labouring masses,
Besides the labour unions directed by us in various places
in the country, there are the following labour unions
of different classes :-
1. The unions organized by the workers to protect their
own financial interests. This kind of union
bears the spirit of agreement between labour and
capital. The labourers' standing is for a better
livelihood and to defend the labourers from being
attacked by the capitalists. As to the political
point of view, it does not oppose the Kuomintang
and is even in concord with it. Practically
speaking it has no political struggle and is purely
a labour organ for financial interests.

2. The labour union used as a tool by the Kuomintang.
The majority of the leaders of these unions are
appointed by the Kuomintang. They mediate in
labour disputes for the benefit of the labourers
and are supported by an adequate number recruited
from the masses.

3. The unions organized by "faithful comrades" appointed
the Kuomintang and used as a tool by this Party.
These unions have no mass foundation or organization,
because they are apart from the interests of the
workers, and oppress the workers in their struggles
by means of the political power. These unions
often arouse the opposition of the labouring masses.

4. The unions of the Fascist Form under the direction of
the wealthy classes. From the political point of
view, these are closely related to the Kuomintang.
In former brushes with us, we ignored them and seized
control of the support of the masses. Therefore
they hated us very much.

The fundamental idea of our strategy to unify the
battle line is to unify the movement of the various
cliques of labouring masses, and to obtain the support
of the masses during struggles. Among the labouring
masses we should make public the intrigues of and denounce
the Reorganization Committees of Labour Unions or such
like organizations which have by no means the support
of the masses and are extremely "reactionary", for the
purpose of checking the development of influence of the
abovementioned 1st, 2nd and 4th kinds of labour unions
among the labourers. The strategy of the unification
of battle line is of two kinds, namely negotiation with
the "upper" organs (?Union committees) and union with the
"lower" masses. The union with and propaganda among
the "lower" masses are considered as the principal
work. The negotiation and parley with the "upper"
organs can be adopted only under certain conditions.
Even in the case of negotiation, it is equally important
to proceed with the work among the masses. This
This work among the masses can be carried out
independently and continually with a view to making
the "right" members of the union tend to the "left" day
by day. Under this principle, the ways of carrying
out the unification of battle line are :-
pages.zh:
- 30 -

劳工运动

A) 建立劳工群众的统一战线，
除了我们在全国各地领导的工会外，还有以下几类工会：
1. 由工人为保护自身经济利益而组织的工会。这类工会带有劳资妥协的精神。工人的立场是为了更好的生计，并保护工人免受资本家的攻击。在政治观点上，它不反对国民党，甚至与其保持一致。实际上，它没有政治斗争，纯粹是为经济利益服务的劳工机构。

2. 被国民党用作工具的工会。这些工会的大多数领导人由国民党任命。他们为工人利益调解劳资纠纷，并得到从群众中招募的足够人数的支持。

3. 由国民党任命的“忠实同志”组织并被该党用作工具的工会。这些工会没有群众基础或组织，因为它们脱离了工人的利益，并利用政治权力在斗争中压迫工人。这些工会经常引起劳工群众的反对。

4. 在富裕阶级指导下的法西斯形式工会。从政治观点来看，这些工会与国民党关系密切。在以前与我们的冲突中，我们忽视了它们，并夺取了对群众支持的控制权。因此，它们非常憎恨我们。

我们统一战线的战略基本思想是统一各派劳工群众的运动，并在斗争中获得群众的支持。在劳工群众中，我们应该公开谴责并揭发那些毫无群众支持且极其“反动”的工会改组委员会或类似组织的阴谋，目的是遏制上述第1、2和4类工会在工人中影响力的发展。统一战线的策略有两种，即与“上层”机构（？工会委员会）谈判和与“下层”群众联合。与“下层”群众的联合及对其宣传被视为主要工作。只有在特定条件下，才可采取与“上层”机构谈判和交涉的方式。即使在谈判的情况下，开展群众工作同样重要。这项群众工作可以独立且持续地进行，目的是使工会中的“右”派成员日益倾向“左”派。在此原则下，执行统一战线的方法如下：

pages.en:
- 31 -

1. It is necessary to constantly propagate, in the name of the labour union (or other labour organizations) directed by us, among the masses under the sway of the abovementioned 1st, 2nd and 4th labour unions, an outline of the principal demands which are practical and necessary to the labourers of the locality.
Furthermore, efforts must be made to instill same into the masses, especially the labourers under the union swayed by "right" elements, and to foment the labourers to move unanimously under these demands.

2. In factories where others (? parties other than the communist party) have organizations, it is necessary to endeavour to establish branches of the Party and to assign a number of "not very dark red" comrades to join their labour unions. The main work of these comrades is to make the masses tend to the "left" and to organize leftist movements by means of making sworn friends with the labourers. In the "right" labour unions, we should put into force the principle of democracy (to hold meetings often and to put into force the democratic election system) with a view to reorganizing the directing organ and ousting the extreme "right" and reactionary elements. Towards the 1st mentioned labour union, we may for the time being carry out the strategy of occupying the directing organ. The tactics towards the 2nd kind of labour unions depend upon circumstances.

3. At the commencement of the struggle directed by them, our labour union should base their efforts on the benefits of the labourers and call for their assistance (to issue manifestoes, and pamphlets, to assign representatives to console the masses and even to declare a sympathetic "tai-kung" strike or "walk-out" strike ...) in order to let the masses know that we are working in concord with them. Care should be taken to notice any weakness or vacillation on the part of their leaders. Use the defects of these leaders as propaganda among the masses.

4. When a struggle is at a period of tension or before a struggle breaks out, our union may ask the 1st and 2nd mentioned class of unions in writing to work unanimously. We can even assign representatives to negotiate with the "upper" organ or leader of the 1st mentioned kind of union for the unanimous propagating of demands (This method can be adopted towards the 2nd class of union in case of necessity). Should we secure their consent, we can unanimously carry out a struggle with them. Should they refuse to accede to our request or should they show signs of fear or giving way in the unanimous movement, it will be necessary to make known to the masses their deceit and intrigue so as to gain the sympathy of the masses towards us.
pages.zh:
- 31 -

1. 有必要以我们领导的工会（或其他劳工组织）的名义，在上述第1、2和4类工会影响下的群众中，不断宣传对当地工人实际且必要的主要需求纲领。
此外，必须努力将这些思想灌输给群众，特别是受“右”派元素影响的工会下的工人，并煽动工人在这些需求下统一行动。

2. 在其他党派（？共产党以外的党派）有组织的工厂中，有必要努力建立党支部，并指派一些“颜色不太红”的同志加入他们的工会。这些同志的主要工作是通过与工人结拜兄弟等方式，使群众倾向“左”派，并组织左翼运动。在“右”派工会中，我们应实行民主原则（经常召开会议并实行民主选举制度），以重组领导机构，驱逐极“右”和反动分子。对于前述第1类工会，我们可以暂时采取占据领导机构的策略。对第2类工会的策略则视情况而定。

3. 在他们领导的斗争开始时，我们的工会应以工人的利益为基础，呼吁他们的协助（发布宣言和小册子，指派代表慰问群众，甚至宣布声援性的“怠工”罢工或“出走”罢工……），以便让群众知道我们在与他们协同工作。应注意观察其领导人的任何弱点或动摇。利用这些领导人的缺陷在群众中进行宣传。

4. 当斗争处于紧张时期或爆发前，我们的工会可以书面要求上述第1和第2类工会统一行动。我们甚至可以指派代表与第1类工会的“上层”机构或领导人谈判，以统一宣传需求（在必要时，此方法也可用于第2类工会）。如果我们获得他们的同意，我们可以与他们一起统一进行斗争。如果他们拒绝接受我们的请求，或者在统一行动中表现出恐惧或让步的迹象，就有必要向群众揭露他们的欺骗和阴谋，从而赢得群众对我们的同情。

pages.en:
- 32 -

B) Correct the mistakes committed in the past struggles. Among the labourers, certain elements are very willing to take part in struggles but are afraid of the C.P. and do not dare to join the labour union or take part in struggles directed by the C.P. This is surely due to the political oppression of the Communist Party (as one who distributes a C.P. handbill is liable to be arrested and even executed) and the wrong form of the struggle. We must pay attention to the following points in starting labour struggles:-

1. Abandon the form of "enforcement" but use the method of "influencing by speech". We should do our best in propagating among and educating the masses in order to make them accept our opinions in struggles. It is also important that the Party should explain independently to the labourers, the Party policy and make the labourers understand the Party so that they will not fear to get into touch with us because of the white terror. Only in this way can the masses be aroused to participate in the struggle. With this aim, the Party should formulate an outline to meet the effectual demands of workers (the branch office in every factory should formulate such articles as are specially demanded by its workers), and carry out wide spread propaganda among labourers. 'Flying' meetings of labourers will be held. To distribute propaganda matter and literature of labour unions and the Party should be regarded as the ordinary work of the branches in factories. Only by this can the influence of the Party and the labour unions be expanded, thereby causing the masses to unite together under the political influence of the Party, and leaving their services at our disposal.
2. We must actually lead the lesser struggles of labourers, inasmuch as, under the reign of 'White Terror', victory in larger struggle can hardly be expected when labourers have no ability to organize-no determination to struggle. Small struggles are the means to prepare for great contests. Each branch of the Party in a factory needs to pay attention to any cause from which struggle may arise (such as on account of insanitary conditions, and oppression of workers by foremen or overseers, and failure to pay wages when due .......). To detail representatives to negotiate for transient stoppages of work as a demand for a reply, to instigate workers to intimidate overseers and to surround factories ---- these methods may be adopted for the purpose of inducing labourers to struggle. Do not think it is not a struggle if it is not carried out by means of a strike. During
pages.zh:
- 32 -

B) 纠正过去斗争中所犯的错误。在劳工中，某些分子非常愿意参加斗争，但害怕共产党（C.P.），不敢加入工会或参加由共产党领导的斗争。这无疑是由于对共产党的政治压迫（例如，散发共产党传单者可能被逮捕甚至处决）以及斗争形式的错误所致。我们在发起劳工斗争时必须注意以下几点：-

1. 放弃“强制”的形式，而采用“言语影响”的方法。我们应尽力在群众中进行宣传和教育，使他们在斗争中接受我们的观点。同样重要的是，党应向劳工独立解释党的政策，使劳工了解党，这样他们就不会因为白色恐怖而害怕与我们接触。只有这样，才能唤起群众参与斗争。为此，党应制定一个大纲，以满足工人的实际需求（每个工厂的支部应制定其工人特别要求的条款），并在劳工中进行广泛宣传。将举行劳工“飞行”集会。分发宣传材料和工会及党的文献应被视为工厂支部的日常工作。只有这样才能扩大党和工会的影响，从而使群众在党的政治影响下团结起来，听候我们的调遣。
2. 我们必须实际领导劳工的小规模斗争，因为在“白色恐怖”统治下，当劳工没有组织能力、没有斗争决心时，很难期望在大规模斗争中取得胜利。小规模斗争是为重大较量做准备的手段。每个工厂的党支部需要注意任何可能引发斗争的事由（例如由于卫生条件恶劣、工头或监工压迫工人、未能按时支付工资等……）。派遣代表就临时停工进行谈判以要求答复，煽动工人恐吓监工并包围工厂——可以采用这些方法来诱导劳工进行斗争。不要认为如果不通过罢工方式进行就不是斗争。在此期间

pages.en:
- 33 -

these contests, attention must be paid to
propaganda, the organization work of labour
unions, and the development of branches of the
Party and their influence. Concentrate mass
power in order to start great struggles. Only
by this can victory in great contests be
easily attained.

3. The activity of organizing red labour unions
in various places is usually being carried out
very slowly. Under the control of 'red' labour
unions throughout the country, the number of
organized labourers is moreover, less than
40,000. This is sufficient evidence of
weakness of influence in regard to organization
among labourers. Consequently, the formation
of red labour unions and workers societies
(brothers and sisters groups .....) as well as
their development should be the duty of every
branch. Moreover, they should pay attention
to keeping open the existence of labour unions
which we organize (but openly existing unions
must watch the existence of secret organs).
During this period when labourers are seeking
a way of existence, we should frequently use
the titles of the old labour unions (such as
Shanghai Hupeh and Hunan General Labour Union,
and the Representative Association of Canton
Labourers), and disseminate pamphlets bearing
manifestoes with a view to calling upon labourers
to rise and struggle.

4. Apart from important services in connection with
the labourers' organization, military
organizations of labour should also be
systematically carried out. It is necessary
to form 'Red Guards' or 'Self-Defence Corps'
or even to publicly organize labourers defence
bodies under the names of 'athletic corps'
or 'gymnastic society' in the Red labour unions,
in accordance with the central military
decisions.

5. In the past, activities among craftsmen have been
overlooked. This is a defect in the labour move-
ment. It is a great mistake to give up
particularly work among in those districts particularly
where industry is still in its infancy, as the
craftsmen's movement there will become the
main work in the city. In regard to this
movement, the organization of labour unions
in order to develop struggles should be the
main task. The district (hsien) committee
members, therefore, should devise complete
working plans according to their conditions in
their respective localities. (Great 132).
The self-organized bodies of labourers,
are secretly opposed to the Kuomintang, although
they not bold enough to do so openly. They either
fear us however owing to their fear of wearing
the 'red hat' (such as in Hangchow), or suspect
us due to insufficient relation with us (such as
in Shaoshing). To deal with such organizations
pages.zh:
- 33 -

在这些较量中，必须注意
宣传、工会的组织工作，
以及党支部的发展及其
影响力。集中群众力量
以发起大规模斗争。只有
这样才能轻易取得重大
较量的胜利。

3. 各地组织红色工会的活动
通常进展非常缓慢。在全国
“红色”工会的控制下，有组织的
劳工人数 moreover（此外/而且）
少于40,000人。这充分证明了
在劳工中的组织影响力薄弱。
因此，建立红色工会和工人
社团（兄弟姊妹团……）以及
其发展应是每个支部的职责。
此外，他们应注意保持我们所
组织的工会的公开存在（但
公开存在的工会必须监视
秘密机关的存在）。在劳工
寻求生存之道的这一时期，
我们应经常使用旧工会的名
义（如上海湖北湖南总工会，
以及广州劳工代表协会），并
散发载有宣言的小册子，以
号召劳工奋起斗争。

4. 除了与劳工组织有关的重要
工作外，还应系统地开展劳
工军事组织工作。有必要根
据中央军事决定，在红色工
会中组建“赤卫队”或“自卫
团”，甚至以“体育队”或“体
操社”的名义公开组织劳工
防卫团体。

5. 过去，在手工业者中的活动被
忽视了。这是劳工运动的一个
缺陷。特别是在那些工业尚处
于起步阶段的地区，放弃其中
的工作是一个巨大的错误，因
为那里的手工业者运动将成为
城市的主要工作。关于这一运
动，组织工会以发展斗争应是
主要任务。因此，县（hsien）委
员会根据各自当地的情况制定
完整的工作计划。（Great 132）。
劳工自发组织的团体，
虽然暗中反对国民党，但
不敢公开这样做。然而，他
们要么因为害怕戴上“红帽
子”而害怕我们（如在杭州），
要么因为与我们关系不足而
怀疑我们（如在绍兴）。为了
对付这类组织

pages.en:
- 34 -

it is necessary for us to plant ourselves among
the lower masses, and on the other hand, to
negotiate with these bodies or occupy their
organs. (Great 87).
Do not forget that we are of the labouring
class group. Work among labourers should be our
basis (but you should not overlook peasants). The
labour movement can only be started first in the
city. (Great 11).
Gain control over the active members in
factories. There are plenty of active members
amongst the labour masses. We must try to keep
xx in touch with them with a view to inducing
such persons to join us or the 'brothers group'
which should be under our influence. (Great 14).

The labour movement is the main work in the
city; the young labour movement is the significant
work of 'group'. With the exception of some
productive labourers in the city, most of the
workers in Chekiang are craftsmen, as industry
in that province is not well-developed. We should
immediately push our force into this class. These
craftsmen are partly labourers and partly farmers
but most of them of the latter class or closely
related to peasants. There must be some method
of getting into touch with labourers in places
where our work has already been carried out among
peasants. The number of productive labourers in
Hangchow, Ningpo, Huchow, Siaosan, Kashing and
Wenchow is about 50,000. In the foregoing places,
we should make efforts to penetrate into this class.
(Great 87).

At the commencement of the young labourers
movement, the first step of importance is to gain
control over the active elements among the workers.
Those who like to mediate in disputes in factories
can usually gain the confidence of labourers.
Consequently, efforts should be made to keep in
contact with these persons, but not to immediately
induce them to join our body. We do not hope
to win a comrade as soon as we become acquainted
with a labourer, but to become familiar with other
workers through his introduction, and by their
efforts, the labour masses will be induced to
form organization.

With regard to those committee members who are
under the control of the Kuomintang, we must resolve
to instigate the masses to oppose them. In addition,
we must not allow any reorganization to be carried
out by the Kuomintang. (Hai 22).

We should carry out our activities among the
'yellow' labour unions, and even in those factories
with many workers which are under the flag of the
Kuomintang. In order to bring the masses to
revolution, we should expose the facts with regard to
the 'yellow' labour unions, and what has been done
by the ( ) ruling class in reactionary unions.
(Hai 50).
pages.zh:
- 34 -

我们有必要深入下层群众，
另一方面，与这些团体谈判
或占据其机构。（Great 87）。
不要忘记我们是劳工阶级
群体。劳工中的工作应是我
们的基础（但不应忽视农民）。
劳工运动只能首先在城市中
发起。（Great 11）。
控制工厂中的活跃分子。
劳工群众中有许多活跃分子。
我们必须设法与 xx 保持联系，
以诱导这些人加入我们或受
我们影响的“兄弟团”。（Great 14）。

劳工运动是城市中的主要
工作；青年劳工运动是“团
体”的重要工作。除了城市中
的一些生产性劳工外，浙江
的大多数工人是手工业者，因
为该省的工业不发达。我们应
立即将力量推进到这一阶级。
这些手工业者部分是劳工，部
分是农民，但大多数属于后者
或与农民关系密切。在我们已
在农民中开展工作的地方，必
须有一些方法与劳工取得联系。
杭州、宁波、湖州、萧山、嘉
兴和温州的生产性劳工人数约
为50,000人。在上述地方，我
们应努力渗透进这一阶级。
（Great 87）。

在青年劳工运动开始时，重
要的第一步是控制工人中的活
跃分子。那些喜欢在工厂纠纷
中调解的人通常能获得劳工的
信任。因此，应努力与这些人
保持联系，但不要立即诱导他
们加入我们的组织。我们不希
望一认识一名劳工就赢得一名
同志，而是通过他的介绍熟悉
其他工人，并通过他们的努力，
诱导劳工群众形成组织。

关于那些受国民党控制的委
员，我们必须决心煽动群众反
对他们。此外，我们不允许国
民党进行任何重组。（Hai 22）。

我们应该在“黄色”工会中，
甚至在那些拥有大量工人且挂
着国民党旗帜的工厂中开展活
动。为了将群众引向革命，我
们应揭露有关“黄色”工会的事
实，以及反动工会中（ ）统治
阶级所做的事情。（Hai 50）。

pages.en:
- 35 -

The Party should abolish all methods which
have been in the past used to compel labour
masses to declare strikes, and decisively
prevail upon and lead them to perform effective
work.

With regard to the labour movement, we are
at present (1) urging the labourers to oppose those
unions which are under the sole control of 'labour
traitors', and denounce conciliatory leaders;
(2) requiring various unions to withdraw from
the Hangchow General Labour Union and to seek
their independence; (3) organizing various secret
unions and productive general (? unions);
(4) opposing the entertainment by labourers of the
"fellow-country-men's idea"; (5) developing
economic struggles; and (6) carrying out
'Red Terror'.
pages.zh:
- 35 -

党应废除过去用来强迫劳
工群众宣布罢工的所有方法，
并坚决说服和领导他们进行有
效的工作。

关于劳工运动，我们目前
(1) 敦促劳工反对那些完全受
“工贼”控制的工会，并谴责妥
协的领导层；(2) 要求各工会退
出杭州总工会并寻求独立；(3)
组织各种秘密工会和生产性总
(? 工会)；(4) 反对劳工沉迷于
“同乡观念”；(5) 发展经济斗
争；以及 (6) 实施“红色恐怖”。

pages.en:
- 36 -

Movement of Peasants

The following are schemes for the peasants'
movement :-
1. Prepare uprisings at the year end.
2. Develop struggles in farming villages.
3. Enlarge the organization of the Peasants' Cooperative
Association.
4. Carry out the movement for non-payment of debts
at the year end.
5. Declare the slogan : "Comrades sacrifice your
property and devote it to the peasants' movement".
6. Bandits activities will affect the land revolution
of peasants.
7. Suggest higher economic demands and confiscate
public property.
8. Active development of peasants cultural work.
9. Start the work of country boys groups. (Kiang 6).

The winter, the Party in various places should
carry out such activities as the seizure of political
power in rural villages, and the confiscation of rich
men's land, which are necessary to the peasants movement,
commencing with the rent reduction movement. (San 3).
Most of the cities in Chekiang suffered great
losses this year, but conditions vary in each place.
Every place may carry out the rent reduction movement,
based upon the amount of loss sustained, and refuse to
pay rent, or even demand compensation for seed losses
from estate owners (Great 93).
At a place where people's struggle may have been
commenced but at which the rent reduction movement has
not been started, it is highly important to deduct at
the time of payment of rent the sum to be duly exempted
in addition to the total back reductions from the sums
already paid. (Great 93).
At places where rent has been paid, it is still
necessary to instigate peasants to start the movement of
demanding rent reduction from their land owners. They
may state that the reduction movement has been carried
out in various cities. If any person is obliged to pay
his land owner in kind or has not been paid in full,
the movement to refuse payment is particularly applicable
under these circumstances. (East 15).
In places where a Peasants Cooperative Association
has been inaugurated, efforts should be made to join it
for the purpose of gradually bringing it under our
directing force.
If there be a students branch, adequate training
must be given to it, in order that it may play an active
part between the association and the Young Men's Group,
and posses the real power of leadership. (East 15).
With regard to the equal division of land in
places where middle class farmers and small farmers
preponderate, this cannot be put into effect by
compulsory means, as such action will result in the
benefits of the middle class and large farmers being
endangered. (Hai 43).
During the present revolutionary period, the
most important tactic of the Communist Party is to
form a united battle front of the largest possible
number of farmer masses who are suffering under the
evils of feudal influence. Under any circumstances
special attention must be paid to the work among
poor peasants' organization, and secure the leadership
pages.zh:
- 36 -

农民运动

以下是农民运动的方案：-
1. 准备年底起义。
2. 在农村发展斗争。
3. 扩大农民合作社的组织。
4. 开展年底抗债运动。
5. 提出口号：“同志们牺牲你们的
财产并奉献给农民运动”。
6. 土匪活动将影响农民的土地革
命。
7. 提出更高的经济要求并没收公
共财产。
8. 积极发展农民文化工作。
9. 启动乡村少年团的工作。（Kiang 6）。

冬季，各地的党应开展诸如
夺取农村村庄政治权力和没收富
人土地等活动，这些对于从减租
运动开始的农民运动是必要的。
（San 3）。
浙江的大多数城市今年遭受
了巨大损失，但各地情况各异。
各地可根据遭受的损失程度开展
减租运动，拒绝交租，甚至要求
地主赔偿种子损失（Great 93）。
在人们的斗争可能已经开始
但尚未启动减租运动的地方，在
支付租金时，除了从已支付的款
项中扣除总的回溯减免额外，扣
除应免除的金额至关重要。（Great 93）。
在已支付租金的地方，仍有
必要煽动农民发起向地主要求减
租的运动。他们可以声称减租运
动已在各城市开展。如果任何人
被迫以实物向地主支付或未被全
额支付，在这种情况下，拒付运
动尤其适用。（East 15）。
在已成立农民合作社的地方，
应努力加入其中，目的是逐渐将
其置于我们的指导力量之下。
如果有学生支部，必须对其
进行充分培训，使其能在协会和
青年团之间发挥积极作用，并拥
有真正的领导权。（East 15）。
关于在中农和小农占优势的
地方平均分配土地，这不能通过
强制手段实施，因为此类行动将
危及中农和大地主的利益。（Hai 43）。
在当前革命时期，共产党最
重要的策略是结成尽可能多的受
封建势力恶害之苦的农民群众的
统一战线。在任何情况下，必须
特别注意贫农组织中的工作，并
确保领导权

pages.en:
- 37 -
of either poor peasants or farm labourers in the
opinion of such bodies. (Hai 43).
Urge the farmers to withdraw from the Peasants
Cooperative Association, and form their own Peasants
Committee. If our work is really communistic, the
matter of using falsehoods is of no importance.
............
Movement of Women
The Women's movement should be energetically
carried out and be developed. Female peasants in farming
villages occupy an important position. Not only can they
participate, the same as males, in the struggle and
Uprising, but also perform such work as urging their
husbands and children to join the foregoing movement,
cooking food for the red army engaged in the fighting,
sewing red flags, and nursing farmers who are injured
in disturbances. Consequently these works which might
have been started in various places should be quickly
developed and accordingly they should be immediately
commenced. If there are no such activities at present
organize the women into the Peasants Cooperative
Association (Peasants Committee or Peasants Representative).
(Great 153)
The women's movement is now considered to be
significant work. Both in the city and country, notice
should be paid in this connection. In view of the fact
that due to labour disputes, the capitalists now employ
mostly females and juvenile workers, we should redouble
our energy in the women's movement. The farming village
peasants union may form a women's department to organize
the female masses, while the female labourers in the city
should be specially watched. (Dah Yi 3).
Past experience of struggles shows us that young
labour and peasant women are of direct use.
There is very strong tendency to induce peasant
women to join the struggle in the peasant revolutionary
movement with a view to gaining victory. Their direct
participation in the movement make them play an important
role in the peasant class and will have a great affect
on the peasants livelihood.
............
Movement of Soldiers
Acceleration of soldiers' movement. Since the
(accomplishment) of the Northern Expedition, the
Kuomintang soldiers are more easily influenced by the
propaganda of "disbandment". They attained nothing
after the completion (of the expedition) in which they
participated with great sacrifice. Not only have they
no hope of receiving wages in arrears, but are faced
with the added terror of being disbanded and consequent
unemployment. This is our opportunity to develop the
soldiers' movement. Meanwhile, the new militarists of
various parties, before they start fight among themselves,
must intensify their effort in the field against
labourers and peasants under the slogans of sweeping out
communist bandits. Consequently, our struggle work is
very important in connection with the soldiers' movement.
Special attention, however, must be paid to secret
tactics. (Great 132).
pages.zh:
- 37 -
在此类团体看来，无论是贫农还是农业雇工。（海 43）。
敦促农民退出农民合作社协会，并组建他们自己的农民委员会。如果我们的工作确实是共产主义性质的，那么使用虚假手段的问题就无关紧要。
............
妇女运动
妇女运动应大力推行并加以发展。农村中的女农民占有重要地位。她们不仅能像男性一样参与斗争和起义，还能从事诸如敦促丈夫和子女加入上述运动、为参战的红军做饭、缝制红旗以及护理在骚乱中受伤的农民等工作。因此，各地可能已经开始的这些工作应迅速开展，并应立即着手进行。如果目前尚无此类活动，应将妇女组织进农民合作社协会（农民委员会或农民代表）。（大 153）
妇女运动现在被认为是一项重要工作。在城市和农村都应注意这方面的工作。鉴于因劳资纠纷，资本家现在主要雇佣女工和童工，我们应在妇女运动中加倍努力。农村农民协会可设立妇女部以组织女性群众，而城市中的女工则应受到特别关注。（大一 3）。
过去的斗争经验向我们表明，年轻的劳工和农妇具有直接的用处。
在农民革命运动中，有一种非常强烈的趋势，即诱导农妇参加斗争以争取胜利。她们的直接参与使她们在农民阶级中发挥重要作用，并将对农民的生活产生巨大影响。
............
士兵运动
加速士兵运动。自北伐（完成）以来，国民党士兵更容易受到“遣散”宣传的影响。他们在付出巨大牺牲参与的（远征）完成后一无所获。他们不仅没有希望拿到拖欠的工资，还面临着被遣散及随之而来的失业的额外恐惧。这是我们发展士兵运动的良机。同时，各派新军阀在彼此开战之前，必须在“扫共匪”的口号下加强对劳工和农民的镇压。因此，我们的斗争工作与士兵运动密切相关。然而，必须特别注意秘密策略。（大 132）。

pages.en:
- 38 -

As a result of dissatisfaction shown in the troops
of the ruling class towards their masters, collapse and
wavering among the reactionary military organization are
in progress, but we fail to work among them. We let
them automatically collapse, with the result that they
are eventually eradicated by the ruling class, thereby
preventing them from joining in the labourers and
peasants struggle to form revolutionary strength. In
addition, we fail to extend our influence among soldiers
to quicken the collapse of military organization of the
ruling class. This is a great loss in the matter of
revolution. (Hai 38).
The formation of reactionary (? revolutionary)
armies will force the influence of the ruling class to
the point of collapse, as the army is the latter's
only tool for maintaining its reactionary political
power. Organize branches of the Party for the purpose
of using a part of the soldiers as the military force
of labourers and peasants, thereby enabling the quick
development of uprising. (Great 189).
Seek out persons acquainted with the garrison
at places where the Party exists to take charge of
soldiers' movement .........
The organization of soldiers' branches should
be in the form of small groups consisting of three
persons each. Such groups are only related to the
Party and there is no connection between party
members personally, thus enabling strict secrecy to be
maintained. In connection with the training of small
groups, only use persons suitable for that work .......
ex-service men's movement. (Hai 26).
Appointing comrades to join the army ------
Designate labour and farmer comrades or faithful
non-comrades to enlist in the reactionary army as
soldiers, and then develop our organization by
stirring up struggles. Training in secret work and
activities must be given before their dispatch.(Great 189).
neglecting With a view to stirring up struggles among wounded
soldiers, if any, such slogans as 'oppose the overlocking
of wounded soldiers by the Authorities', 'demand that the
Government grant compensation to wounded soldiers', and
'improve the treatment of wounded soldiers', should be
used. Do not set aside higher political activity -----
pay special heed to the work of detection, destruction
and instigation among soldiers, in order to develop our
influence. (Kiang 11).
In conjunction with the soldiers' movement, there
is a junior officers' movement which should be carried
out simultaneously. This is similar to the activity
among junior factory foremen in the labour movement.
With the junior officers, however, you must be
particularly careful, and pay special attention to
character, that is, base your actions upon the principle
'rather obtain nothing than choose bad element'
(Dah Yi 7).
Simultaneously, notice should also be paid to
the police and merchant volunteers during the soldiers'
movement. The sufferings amongst police in Chekiang
are more serious than those of the soldiers. For
instance, their wages are $8.00 per mensem, yet they
must work a month before they are paid. In fact,
senior officers actually deduct one months wages from
them. Take another instance, the period of service
pages.zh:
- 38 -

由于统治阶级军队中对主子的不满情绪显现，反动军事组织内部正在发生崩溃和动摇，但我们未能在其中开展工作。我们任由其自动崩溃，结果导致它们最终被统治阶级清除，从而阻止了它们加入劳工和农民的斗争以形成革命力量。此外，我们未能将影响力扩展到士兵中以加速统治阶级军事组织的崩溃。这在革命事业中是一个重大损失。（海 38）。
反动（？革命）军队的组建将迫使统治阶级的影响力走向崩溃，因为军队是后者维持其反动政治权力的唯一工具。建立党的支部，目的是利用部分士兵作为劳工和农民的军事力量，从而使起义得以迅速发展。（大 189）。
在党组织存在的地方，寻找熟悉驻军的人员来负责士兵运动.........
士兵支部的组织形式应为三人一组的小组。这些小组仅与党有关联，党员个人之间没有联系，从而能够保持严格的保密性。在培训小组方面，只使用适合该项工作的人员.......
退伍军人运动。（海 26）。
指派同志参军 ------
指定劳工和农民同志或忠诚的非同志人员作为士兵应征加入反动军队，然后通过煽动斗争来发展我们的组织。在派遣之前，必须给予秘密工作和活动的培训。（大 189）。
忽视 为了煽动受伤士兵（如有）的斗争，应使用诸如“反对当局忽视受伤士兵”、“要求政府向受伤士兵提供赔偿”以及“改善受伤士兵待遇”等口号。不要搁置更高的政治活动 ----- 特别注意在士兵中进行侦察、破坏和煽动工作，以发展我们的影响力。（江 11）。
与士兵运动相结合，还有一个下级军官运动，应同时进行。这类似于劳工运动中针对工厂初级工头的活动。然而，对于下级军官，你必须格外小心，并特别注意其品行，即基于“宁缺毋滥”的原则行事。（大一 7）。
同时，在士兵运动期间，也应注意警察和商团义勇队。浙江警察的苦难比士兵更为严重。例如，他们的月薪为 8.00 美元，但他们必须工作一个月后才能领到工资。事实上，高级军官实际上会扣除他们一个月的工资。再举一例，服役期

pages.en:
- 39 -
of mambers of the 'winter defence' police is short.
They join the force in December each year, and are
discharged again in February or March. Most of
them are poor labourers or peasants. They soon
become wanderers, suffering from cold and hungry,
after their service have been dispensed with. As
their sufferings are so serious, it is natural that
their revolutionary demand is as urgent as that of
the soldiers. (Deh Yi 7).
The merchant volunteers are mostly poor
peasants. They receive less than the soldiers and
police, either they perform duty only for rich men
and land owners without any benefit, or they are
compelled to do so by the latter. They need
revolution similar to that demanded by soldiers and
police. With only a little stirring, they will
unite together with the masses to revolt against
rich men and land owners. Based upon the foregoing
statement, the police and merchant volunteers'
movement should be looked upon as important as that
of the soldiers. (Deh Yi 7).
The police and merchant volunteers, though
their wages are poor, can maintain themselves by
extortion due to corrupt discipline. The merchant
volunteers are especially loyal to their masters,
rich men and land owners, but they have little
strength. They dare not deceive others in the
place where the masses are united together. They
easily waver and become terrified when the
revolutionary struggle is taking place. They
usually act as guides when an army launches an
attack upon the revolutionary influence. Consequently,
we should carry out activity among them in the usual
way with a view to obtaining from them news and reports
of the enemy, or inducing them to help the labourers
and peasants to instigate the enemy to revolt and sally
upon the opponents' military forces. (Hai 38).
The majority of the soldiers of the provincial
defence force are natives of Wenchow and Western
Chekiang. They contain loafer elements. They have not
received their wages for a long time. After the
mutiny occurred in Haimen, however, the ruling class
immediately tried to keep their soldiers in place
by issuing wages monthly. The amount of wages in
arrears has thus been greatly reduced. They have
freedom of movement and may gamble outside and practice
extortion in order to maintain their livelihood. They
feel no suffering as war they have not experienced.
These soldiers find it hard to discriminate and thus it
is difficult to work among them. There are, however,
numbers of companies and troops stationed in the country.
They are easily threatened and made to water by the
revolutionary influence in farming villages owing to their
poor ability. If relationship between peasant masses
and soldiers can be formed the difficulties of our work
can be eradicated. There is a soldiers movement among
the provincial defence army and naval forces in Ningpo.
As the number of police and water police in Hangchow
and Wenchow is large, you should devise wages and means
to send loyal and faithful active comrades to carry out
activities among them, and decide actual working measures.
(Great 5).
pages.zh:
- 39 -
“冬防”警察成员的任期很短。他们每年十二月加入队伍，次年二月或三月再次被遣散。他们大多是贫困的劳工或农民。服役结束后，他们很快成为流浪者，遭受饥寒交迫之苦。由于他们的苦难如此深重，他们的革命需求自然与士兵一样迫切。（德一 7）。
商团义勇队大多是贫农。他们获得的报酬少于士兵和警察，要么他们仅为富人和地主服务而没有任何利益，要么是被后者强迫这样做。他们需要类似士兵和警察所要求的革命。只需稍加煽动，他们就会与群众联合起来，反抗富人和地主。基于上述陈述，警察和商团义勇队的运动应被视为与士兵运动同等重要。（德一 7）。
警察和商团义勇队虽然工资微薄，但可以通过腐败纪律下的勒索来维持生计。商团义勇队尤其忠于他们的主人——富人和地主，但他们力量薄弱。在群众团结在一起的地方，他们不敢欺骗他人。当革命斗争发生时，他们容易动摇并感到恐惧。当军队发动攻击以打击革命影响力时，他们通常充当向导。因此，我们应该以常规方式在他们中间开展活动，旨在从他们那里获取敌人的新闻和报告，或诱导他们帮助劳工和农民煽动敌人叛变并突袭敌对军事力量。（海 38）。
省防军的大多数士兵是温州和浙西人。其中包含游手好闲的分子。他们很久没有领到工资了。然而，在海门发生兵变后，统治阶级立即试图通过按月发放工资来稳住士兵。拖欠工资的数额因此大大减少。他们有行动自由，可以在外面赌博并进行勒索以维持生计。他们没有经历过战争，因此感觉不到痛苦。这些士兵难以辨别是非，因此很难在他们中间开展工作。然而，有许多连队和部队驻扎在农村。由于能力低下，他们很容易受到农村革命影响力的威胁并被迫倒戈。如果能形成农民群众与士兵之间的关系，我们工作的困难就可以消除。宁波的省防军和海军部队中有士兵运动。由于杭州和温州的警察和水警人数众多，你应该制定薪资方案并设法派遣忠诚可靠的积极同志在他们中间开展活动，并确定实际的工作措施。（大 5）。

pages.en:
- 40 -

Movement of Bandits

The movement of bandits is by no means a major work, but it is not necessary to abandon it. Our work among bandits is similar to that among soldiers, that is, it is necessary to destroy their feudal organization, seize control of their lower masses, and introduce a proper organization. Instead of using the name of a body to establish relations with bandits, individual negotiation should be carried out with them. (Great 15).
Bandits organization :
The form of the bandits movement should be the same as that of the soldiers movement. Do not plan to depend upon their military force. The Party should detail comrades to secure personal, but not Party, relations with them when bandits wish to establish an understanding with us. (Hai 7).

...........

Relation of Movement

The important task of executing the scheme of the anti-Imperialist, anti-Kuomintang and city rehabilitation movement which was recently decided upon by the 'Divisional Central' of the Party can only be carried out through intensive struggle and the work of the labour unions. ( Great 89).
The mistake of confining the work in the centre Hsiens in Hupeh and Kiangsu, in the past, to the farmers movement should be quickly corrected. Try to keep development in the city and farming villages proportionate. (Great 132).
A city is the political centre of rich men and the capitalist class, and is also the district where their military power is strongest. Just as the labour movement, we must accelerate the work among soldiers in the city, and their development in order to destroy the reactionary military power and hasten its downfall and collapse. (Hai 38).
It may be said that the Party labour movement in Chekiang shows at present no foundation. The various districts (hsiens) should naturally assist the Party during their work, but should not relegate the young labour movement to a position of less importance, in order to assist in labour activity.
You can proceed with the measures in connection with the refusal to pay rents which you passed sometime ago, i.e. non-payment of rent for the autumn and spring quarter, but you should lead the masses to undertake this work themselves. You should never establish relation with the Kuomintang in order to prevent the masses from bad influence. In distressed areas moreover you must immediately adopt slogans such as remittance of rents and taxes, demanding relief and so on for the purpose of promoting the political knowledge of the peasants. (Great 8).
The work among soldiers is closely related to the activities in peasant villages. If there is no suitable foundation among soldiers (such as the provincial defence army and police in various hsiens), peasants struggle can be easily checked by the reactionary Party. It is easier to keep in touch with soldiers in Chekiang and their influence is especially great, as most of them are either unemployed
pages.zh:
- 40 -

匪徒运动

匪徒运动绝非主要工作，但亦无必要予以放弃。我们在匪徒中的工作与在士兵中的工作类似，即必须摧毁其封建组织，掌控其下层群众，并引入适当的组织。不应以某个团体的名义与匪徒建立关系，而应与他们进行个别谈判。（Great 15）。
匪徒组织：
匪徒运动的形式应与士兵运动相同。不要计划依赖他们的军事力量。当匪徒希望与我们达成谅解时，党应派遣同志去建立个人关系，而非党的关系。（Hai 7）。

...........

运动的关系

执行党“分区中央”最近决定的反帝、反国民党及城市复兴运动方案的重要任务，只能通过激烈的斗争和工会的工作来完成。（Great 89）。
过去将湖北和江苏中心各县的工作局限于农民运动的错误，应迅速纠正。力求保持城市与农村发展的比例协调。（Great 132）。
城市是富人和资本阶级的政治中心，也是其军事力量最强的地区。正如劳工运动一样，我们必须加速在城市中开展士兵工作及其发展，以摧毁反动军事力量，促使其垮台和崩溃。（Hai 38）。
可以说，党在浙江的劳工运动目前尚无基础。各县自然应在工作中协助党，但为了协助劳工活动，不应将年轻的劳工运动置于次要地位。
你们可以着手实施不久前通过的关于拒付租金的措施，即不支付秋季和春季季度的租金，但应引导群众自行开展这项工作。绝不应为了防范不良影响到群众中而与国民党建立关系。此外，在受灾地区，必须立即采取减免租税、要求救济等口号，以提高农民的政治觉悟。（Great 8）。
士兵工作与农村活动密切相关。如果在士兵中（如各省防军和各县警察）没有合适的基础，农民的斗争很容易被反动政党压制。在浙江与士兵保持联系较为容易，且其影响特别大，因为他们大多是该省失业

pages.en:
- 41 -

or bankrupt peasants and labourers of that province.
(Great 184).
In many places, the members still consider
that the work among labour unions is the duty of the
Party, therefore they merely carry out activities
of the "Boys' group" among workers. They do not
understand the fundamental significance of the
work. (Great 153).
Sometimes, the organization which acts as
director intentionally stands aloof from labour
union work and leaves it to be done by the Party.
It does not regard the work among labour unions
as the duty of the 'group', but considers that
among labour masses, the 'group' requires youth
vanguards or similar organization to carry out
activities. Consequently, it does not show
positive understanding of the importance of organizing
young labourers to join the union, nor the necessity
of the group undertaking labour union work independently
in the absence of the Party, with the result that it
only does a little work among young labourers after
the Party has made a start in this matter. (Great 153).

.............

Relation between Movement and Propaganda

Based upon the decision of the 6th Central Session
------ the opinion is that the movement of the mass
organization requires to be absolutely open, as secret
activity will only frighten the masses, thereby resulting
in the loss of their support. The mass organization
must be democratic, and opposes intervention by any party.
With regard to the masses in places which have no
organization, we should render them our assistance, but
do not say that the C.P. or Kuomintang will organize
them. Let the masses themselves realize the importance
of organization, and rise up to do so. At every
opportunity you should denounce the Kuomintang for
having deceived the labourers and peasants.
Let the masses understand that they can never
obtain any improvement of their living conditions
unless they overthrow the political power of the
Kuomintang militarists and their control by imperialists,
and continue your propaganda in this connection. (Great 154).
If the anti-Imperialist propaganda can stir up
the masses, then the anti-Kuomintang propaganda will be
continued. You must make public as much as possible its
reactionary facts to incite the masses. Simultaneously,
you must devise such slogans as are beneficial to them
in order that they will act accordingly ----- Besides
the general political propaganda, the various organizations
or bodies under the Party (such as labourers, peasants,
students and soldiers C.Y. crisis relieving associations
etc.) require technical propaganda and educational work.
(Great 157).
pages.zh:
- 41 -

或破产的农民和劳工。
（Great 184）。
在许多地方，党员仍然认为
工会工作是党的职责，因此他们仅在工人中
开展“少年团”的活动。他们不理解这项
工作的根本意义。（Great 153）。
有时，作为指导者的组织故意对
工会工作置身事外，将其留给党去做。
它不把工会中的工作视为“团”的职责，
而是认为在劳动群众中，“团”需要青年
先锋队或类似组织来开展活动。因此，它
对组织年轻劳工加入工会的重要性，以及
在党缺席的情况下由“团”独立承担工会
工作的必要性，缺乏积极的认识，结果只
是在党在此事上起步后，在年轻劳工中做
了一点工作。（Great 153）。

.............

运动与宣传的关系

基于第六届中央全会的决定------意见认为，
群众组织的运动必须完全公开，因为秘密活动
只会吓跑群众，从而导致失去他们的支持。
群众组织必须是民主的，并反对任何政党的干预。
对于没有组织的地方的群众，我们应该给予
协助，但不要说是共产党或国民党来组织他们。
让群众自己认识到组织的重要性，并起身去做。
在任何机会下，你都应该谴责国民党欺骗了
劳工和农民。
让群众明白，除非推翻国民党军阀的政治权力
及其受帝国主义的控制，否则他们永远无法
获得生活条件的任何改善，并继续就此进行
宣传。（Great 154）。
如果反帝宣传能激起群众，那么反国民党
宣传将继续进行。你必须尽可能公开其反动
事实以煽动群众。同时，你必须制定有利于
他们的口号，以便他们据此行动------除了
一般的政治宣传外，党属下的各种组织或团体
（如劳工、农民、学生和士兵共青团、危机救济
协会等）需要进行技术宣传和教育工作。
（Great 157）。

pages.en:
- 42 -

In the labour movement and the work among the
small capitalist class in the city you must base
your activities upon the general principle of city
work to organize labour and craftsmen's red unions.
Stir up labourers, small merchants, and students,
etc., to oppose exhorbitant taxes, and struggle for
civil rights, for the purpose of establishing the
Party base in the city and town. (Great 132).
Correct and accelerate the 'group' propaganda
among labourers, and pay heed to their daily living
question with a view to prevailing upon them as well
as inciting their anti-Imperialist and anti-Kuomintang
nature. The haranguing of labourers and the distribution
of pamphlets and newspapers among them must be considered
as your daily work. Simultaneously, you must pay
attention equally to contructive as well as destructive
propaganda. For instance, when you say what shall be
overthrown, and what shall be opposed, you must inform
the public what they should need. (Great 153).
As a means of accelerating separation among
students, branches of the 'group' should be established
in schools. Organize Young Men's bodies of various
'colours' to extend the anti-Kuomintang propagand
among students, and stir up agitation among schools,
and then follow it up with the anti-Kuomintang
activity. (Duh Xi 5).
It is natural that the movement of demanding
equal division of land must occur in places where
unemployed and poor peasants preponderate. When
this slogan receives the support of the majority
of the peasants, the Communist Party should render
them its assistance, as this is the slogan by
which the remains of feudalism may be eradicated
and the foundations of the system of private
ownership loosened. (Hai 43).
Instead of allowing ourselves to fold our
arms or to deal with the peasants by employing
intimidating means when they reconciled with the
authorities, as a result of our work being imperfect,
we should go to the masses and incite them to place so
high demands before the authorities that the latter
will be unable to comply, and will lose their (the
masses) support. Turn the legal appealing movement
into demonstration. Even if the authorities are
obliged to accept their demands in view of their
rabidness, we should also carry out propaganda
pointing out that victory was gained through their own
efforts. Furthermore, you should not overlook the
independent propaganda of the Party and the 'group'
during this struggle. (Great 93).
Make public the defects on the part of the
authorities, and organize the masses under suitable
titles. Meanwhile, you may use the Kuomintang flag
and ostensibly place yourself in the land owner class
to carry out extreme reactionary propaganda. If the
reactionary clique goes to farming villages to put
forth its propaganda, we should base upon our efforts
upon the amount of suffering and submit higher demands
before the clique and in front of the masses in order
to deal it a blow. (pay attention to public style
of dress). Apart from this, literary propaganda
pages.zh:
- 42 -

在劳工运动和城市中针对小资产阶级的
工作中，你必须基于城市工作的一般原则，
组织劳工和工匠的红色工会。煽动劳工、小
商人、学生等反对苛捐杂税，争取民权，以
便在城镇建立党的基地。（Great 132）。
纠正并加速“团”在劳工中的宣传，注
意他们的日常生活问题，以期说服他们并激
发其反帝和反国民党的性质。对劳工的演讲
以及在他们中间分发小册子和报纸必须被视为
你的日常工作。同时，你必须同等地注意建设
性宣传和破坏性宣传。例如，当你说要推翻
什么、反对什么时，你必须告知公众他们需要
什么。（Great 153）。
作为加速学生分化的一种手段，应在学校
建立“团”的分支。组织各种“色彩”的青年
团体，在学生中扩展反国民党宣传，并在学校
中激起骚动，随后跟进反国民党活动。（Duh Xi 5）。
在失业和贫苦农民占优势的地方，要求平
均分配土地的运动自然会发生。当这一口号得
到大多数农民的支持时，共产党应给予他们协
助，因为这是消除封建残余和松动私有制基础
的口号。（Hai 43）。
当我们工作不完善导致农民与当局和解时，
我们不应袖手旁观或采用恐吓手段对待农民，
而应深入群众，煽动他们向当局提出如此高的
要求，以致后者无法满足，从而失去（群众的）
支持。将合法请愿运动转变为示威。即使当局
迫于其猛烈程度不得不接受他们的要求，我们也
应进行宣传，指出胜利是通过他们自己的努力
取得的。此外，在这场斗争中，你不应忽视党
和“团”的独立宣传。（Great 93）。
公开当局的缺陷，并以适当的名义组织群
众。同时，你可以使用国民党旗帜，并表面上
将自己置于地主阶级之中，以进行极端的反动
宣传。如果反动派系去农村进行宣传，我们应
基于受苦程度，向该派系和群众面前提出更高
的要求，以打击他们。（注意公共着装风格）。
除此之外，文学宣传

pages.en:
- 43 -
should be increased as much as possible. Tear down
notices or post refutations of same. (Do not take
too long).

In connection with the newly established
government organ in charge of land taxes where the
autumn rent has been paid, it is very necessary
to employ severe measure against it. Carry out
propaganda among peasants, pointing out the reason
for its gradual establishment, and inform them that
it is simply an organ used to deceive them. It
will be better if it can be smashed by employing the
power of the masses. (Great 93).

The rent reduction movement is a transition of
the refusal to pay rent movement. The masses must be
incited to join it, instead of allowing it to be
carried out purely by comrades. Besides holding
general meetings, and demonstrations, special attention
must be paid to the work of the mass organization.
Give them a hint of the next step during the rent
reduction movement ---- refusing to pay tax. (Great 67).

Our present power is insufficient to prevent
all the labourers from registering, but we should
intensify our movement among masses (especially the
lower class people) in the matter of opposing the
appointment system of the Kuomintang. Put into
force our political slogans (such as freedom of
speech, and assembly, organization of labour unions
by workers and election of committee members by themselves),
stirring up the masses to oppose the nominee committee
members of labour unions, and oppose the unions which
act as the running dogs of the Kuomintang or capitalists,
as well as denounce all running dogs in labour unions.
(Great 1).

Craftsmen and manual workers in various places
in Chekiang are usually related to their employers
either owing to the fact that they are friends,
fellow countrymen or kinsmen and therefore they are
easily influenced by the employers. We must instigate
them to demand better material comforts from the
factory owners, and urge them to unite together.
(Kiang 11).

Put into execution the movement among the masses,
seize the various organs of reactionary labour unions,
and secretly carry out our work under the reactionary
guise. Meanwhile, you must pay attention from time
to time to the title of our General Labour Union.
Distribute secretly propaganda matter among labourers
with a view to maintaining and consolidating the
support of masses to the general labour union.
(Kiang 10).

'Groups' in various classes should develop
independent political views and propaganda of the
Party and 'group' among labourers. Apart from
such propaganda as down with ........ labourers and
peasants uprising, land revolution, and soviet
propaganda should be fully broadcasted, in order to
increase their intention and determination to seize
political power. With political influence, we
should gain their confidence and support. (Great 153).
pages.zh:
- 43 -
应尽可能增加。撕毁告示或张贴反驳同一告示
的文告。（不要花费太长时间）。

关于新成立的负责土地税收的政府机构，
在已缴纳秋季租金的情况下，对其采取严厉措
施是非常必要的。在农民中进行宣传，指出其
逐步建立的原因，并告知他们这只是一个用来
欺骗他们的机构。如果能利用群众的力量将其
粉碎，那就更好了。（Great 93）。

减租运动是拒付租金运动的过渡。必须煽
动群众参与其中，而不是让它纯粹由同志来执
行。除了举行大会和示威外，必须特别注意群
众组织的工作。在减租运动期间，向他们暗示
下一步行动----拒付税款。（Great 67）。

我们目前的权力不足以阻止所有劳工登记，
但我们应该加强在群众（尤其是下层民众）中
反对国民党指派制度的运动。实施我们的政治
口号（如言论自由、集会自由、由工人组织工
会并自行选举委员），煽动群众反对工会的指
派委员，反对充当国民党或资本家走狗的工会，
并谴责工会中的所有走狗。（Great 1）。

浙江各地的手工匠人和体力劳工通常因朋
友、同乡或亲属关系而与雇主有关联，因此他
们容易受到雇主的影响。我们必须煽动他们向
工厂主要求更好的物质待遇，并敦促他们团结
起来。（Kiang 11）。

执行群众运动，夺取反动工会的各个机构，
并在反动伪装下秘密开展我们的工作。同时，
你必须不时注意我们总工会的名称。在劳工中
秘密分发宣传材料，以维持和巩固群众对总工
会的支持。（Kiang 10）。

各阶层的“团”应在劳工中发展党和“团”
的独立政治观点和宣传。除了诸如打倒........
劳工和农民起义、土地革命和苏维埃宣传等宣
传应充分广播外，以增加他们夺取政权的意图
和决心。通过政治影响，我们应赢得他们的信
任和支持。（Great 153）。

pages.en:
- 44 -

During every combat, the mostly unlucky are
the soldiers who have sacrificed lives, and next the
wounded troops. Though they are fortunate to have
escaped from death, yet their sufferings are harder
to bear than death. If we pass the place in which
they live, we will hear their painful cries.

The Government disregards them due to the fact
that they are of no further use. Medical treatment
is rudimentary, thereby producing strong opposition
from the soldiers. This can be proved by the
disturbances created in the past by wounded soldiers
in Wuhan, Nanking, Soochow, and the recent incident
in Hangchow. As tinder is to dry straw, so they will
instantly commence fierce struggles at our instigation.
We overlooked this work in the past (as in Hangchow).
If there are wounded soldiers, we should in future
incite them to struggle with such slogans as 'Oppose
the disregard of the Authorities for wounded soldiers',
'Demand compensation from the Government' and
'Improve the treatment of wounded soldiers'.
(Duh Yi 7).

Organize the soldiers' movement committee in
cooperation with the Party. The branches in places
where soldiers are billeted should designate comrades
who are intimate with camp life to take charge of
propaganda and the introduction of ex-service men
to join the Party. (Hai 24).

As for the work among troops, we may easily
keep in touch with soldiers by enquiring about their
home affairs, and then their sufferings due to the
fact that they have no money to support their
families, as well as other miscellaneous matters
including wages in arrear, shoes and clothing.
These form our best material, which the soldiers
will feel is their own question. Secret small
organizations can also be formed among troops, but
this must be carried out in strict confidence.
Furthermore, the simple martial slogans should be
changed from time to time. We must prepare printed
matter on the eve of any disturbance to be created
by revolutionary forces among reactionary army
against its enemy, and secretly place this at dawn
in the soldiers' shoes. It will be read when they
get up but they will be at a loss to understand where it
came from. Slogans in pamphlets must be simple,
clear and readily inciting. By this method, it will
be easy to instigate them, and at least cause them
to be reluctant during battle, and keep neutral or
even instantly revolt. This will be the success
of our work. (Duh Yi 1).

According to your report, you have three soldier
comrades. You should quickly find them and plan to
stir up mutiny among junior soldiers, as well as
develop their small struggles, such as demanding
wages, prizes, and blood money. You should hurry up
and carry out propaganda among them, and put forth
the slogan 'refuse to fight labourers and peasants'.
Urge them to mutiny if possible, and call upon them
to join the army formed by labourers and peasants.
(Great 78).
pages.zh:
- 44 -

在每次战斗中，最不幸的往往是那些牺牲生命的士兵，其次是受伤的部队。虽然他们幸免于死，但其痛苦却比死亡更难忍受。如果我们经过他们居住的地方，就会听到他们痛苦的哭喊声。

政府因他们已无进一步利用价值而忽视他们。医疗待遇极其简陋，从而引起士兵们的强烈反对。这一点可由过去伤兵在武汉、南京、苏州制造的骚乱，以及最近在杭州发生的事件得到证明。正如干草遇火种，只要我们要煽动，他们就会立即发起激烈的斗争。我们过去忽视了这项工作（如在杭州）。今后若有伤兵，我们应该用“反对当局漠视伤兵”、“要求政府赔偿”和“改善伤兵待遇”等口号煽动他们进行斗争。（杜义 7）。

与党合作组织士兵运动委员会。在士兵驻扎地的支部应指派熟悉军营生活的同志负责宣传工作，并介绍退伍军人入党。（海 24）。

至于在军队中的工作，我们可以通过询问他们的家事来轻易地与士兵保持联系，进而了解他们因无钱养家而遭受的痛苦，以及其他杂项事宜，包括拖欠工资、鞋服等问题。这些构成了我们最好的材料，士兵们会觉得这是他们自己的问题。也可以在军队中建立秘密的小组织，但这必须在严格保密的情况下进行。此外，简单的军事口号应不时更换。我们必须在革命力量在反动军队中制造任何骚乱的前夜准备好印刷品，并在黎明时秘密地将其放在士兵的鞋子里。他们起床时会读到这些内容，但会困惑不知其来源。小册子中的口号必须简单、明了且易于煽动。通过这种方法，很容易煽动他们，至少使他们在战斗中产生抵触情绪，保持中立，甚至立即反叛。这将是我们工作的成功。（杜义 1）。

根据你的报告，你有三名士兵同志。你应该迅速找到他们，并策划在下级士兵中发动兵变，同时发展他们的小规模斗争，如要求发放工资、奖金和抚恤金。你应该加紧在他们中间进行宣传，并提出“拒绝攻打工农”的口号。如果可能，敦促他们兵变，并号召他们加入由工农组成的军队。（Great 78）。

pages.en:
- 45 -

The majority of the soldiers of the 1st Division
of the 1st Army and of the 26th Army returned from
battle front. They suffered terribly on the battlefield,
dressed as they were in rags and straw shoes. They
have not been paid for six or seven months. Life is
very bad. Their sufferings have reached their peak.
These soldiers are in the frame to receive revolutionary
propaganda. They are generally billeted in important
cities (Shanghai-Hangchow Line , and Chientong River
Line). We should pay attention to keeping in touch
with them, organizing them, and educating them, as
well as stirring up their struggles. There are
plenty of wounded soldiers at present in Hangchow.
We can penetrate into these troops by utilizing
wounded soldiers to establish relations with them.
(Hai 38).
pages.zh:
- 45 -

第一军第一师和第二十六军的大部分士兵从战场返回。他们在战场上遭受了极大的苦难，身穿破烂衣服和草鞋。他们已有六七个月未领到军饷。生活非常糟糕。他们的痛苦已达顶峰。这些士兵处于接受革命宣传的状态。他们通常驻扎在重要城市（沪杭线及钱塘江沿线）。我们应该注意与他们保持联系，组织他们，教育他们，并煽动他们的斗争。目前杭州有大量伤兵。我们可以利用伤兵与他们建立关系，从而渗透进这些部队。（海 38）。

pages.en:
- 46 -
Struggle

The scheme of struggle has victory for its basis. Do not neglect your own ability and shout high sounding slogans thereby causing the masses to be afraid of struggles, and to lose their confidence in us with consequent failure. Slogans of struggle should be suitable to the demands of the masses. Even in a very small case you must prepare for a second struggle after victory has been obtained but avoid extending it excessively, as failure may result. (Hai 25)

Never prevent the masses if a struggle is fermenting (as in Yu-yao), but let their fermentation develop. Meanwhile, preparations and schemes should be carried out. The route of uprising and struggle of the masses is, however, not correct. Consequently you should not follow their opinion, but try to correct their struggles, and see that this does not happen in the future. During struggles, the masses usually take a risk in carrying out their revenge due to their high spirit and without regard to their own ability. Their high spirit however, will flag if we fail to secure a better way on their behalf. Consequently, we must study our circumstances and conditions from other points of view during our advance. As soon as we are unable to advance we must try hard to expand our movement from other angles, in order to avoid the change of their view point and to prevent their spirits from drooping. He is not a leader if he is unable to direct the masses. Rash advance without due care is liable to meet with unexpected rebuffs (as in Laichi). (Great 85).

We should look upon and inspect current events from the standpoint of Marxism. You must not think, as the Right clique of the Kuomintang, that during the progress of the anti-Imperialistic movement the inequality in rank could only be removed by peaceful means after the cooperative spirit among class had been achieved. (Sang 5).

As to our present struggle, we should develop it from small daily occurrences to a big struggle. If a worker is assaulted, his wages reduced, or if he be dismissed, let us develop the incident to embrace the whole room and then to the whole factory. Under the severe oppression of the 'white terror' there is no possibility of starting a big struggle therefore if we neglect the daily small struggles and always imagine commencing a large one it would be better if we never started a single struggle.
pages.zh:
- 46 -
斗争

斗争的方案应以胜利为基础。不要忽视自身能力而高呼空洞的口号，从而导致群众害怕斗争，并因此失去对我们的信心，最终导致失败。斗争的口号应适合群众的需求。即使是非常小的案件，在取得胜利后也必须为第二次斗争做好准备，但要避免过度扩大，否则可能导致失败。（海 25）

如果斗争正在酝酿中（如在余姚），切勿阻止群众，而应让其发酵发展。同时，应进行准备和制定方案。然而，群众起义和斗争的道路并不正确。因此，你不应附和他们的意见，而应试图纠正他们的斗争，并确保将来不再发生此类情况。在斗争中，群众通常因情绪高涨而不顾自身能力，冒险进行报复。然而，如果我们不能为他们找到更好的途径，他们的高涨情绪就会消退。因此，我们在推进过程中必须从其他角度研究我们的环境和条件。一旦我们无法继续推进，就必须努力从其他角度扩大我们的运动，以避免他们观点的改变并防止他们的士气低落。如果不能指导群众，他就不是领导者。不加慎重的鲁莽推进容易遭遇意外的挫折（如在莱西）。（Great 85）。

我们应该从马克思主义的立场来看待和审视当前事件。你不能像国民党右派那样认为，在反帝运动的进程中，只有在实现阶级合作精神之后，才能通过和平手段消除等级不平等。（桑 5）。

至于我们目前的斗争，我们应该从日常小事发展为大规模斗争。如果一名工人受到袭击、工资被削减或被解雇，让我们将事件扩大到整个车间，然后扩大到整个工厂。在“白色恐怖”的严酷压迫下，不可能发动大规模斗争，因此如果我们忽视日常的小规模斗争，而总是幻想发动大规模斗争，那还不如根本不发动任何斗争。

pages.en:
- 47 -

With regard to struggle, the most important
work is for us to start as many daily struggles as possible
by the masses as possible under our influence.
We should at very first commence a military move-
ment. We should lead the masses to carry on the
struggle and we should not assign only our
comrades to carry on the work as a solitary army.
It is undoubtedly a serious mistake to have no
large masses to participate in the struggle or
to abandon them.

We should try to secure the development of
struggle and simultaneously we should continue our
struggle during the development. The principle
advocating peaceful development however, which
fears failure will never strengthen the influence
of the Group nor secure us the leadership of the
masses nor make us capable of leading them, and
on the other hand our group will never have an
opportunity of starting the automatic struggles of
the masses. In short failure to lead the masses
to develop automatic struggles owing to cowardice
will make us unworthy of the title of Bolshevik Group.

Struggle need not be extensive nor widely
developed. It is only necessary that it should
achieve its object securing the confidence of the
masses and consolidated their political under-
standing and class conception. (Great 42)

Young men's work is one of the important tasks of
the Group. Apart from joining all struggles
sponsored by labour unions and peasant cooperative
associations, you should incite independent struggles
of young labourers and peasants as much as possible
(with the assistance of labour unions and peasant
cooperative associations). (Great 16).

C.Y. wants to transfer and mobilize all our
strength in farming villages in order to participate
in or start struggles for the peasants' uprising.
(Sang 6).

While leading the youth labourers to participate
in the economic struggle, you should put forth
their demands and direct them to fight for their
own benefits according to the Party policy. The
scheme of struggle should be based upon the principle
of victory. Avoid trying greater struggles without
regarding to your own ability, thus resulting in
failure and losing the confidence placed in us
by the masses when we wish to commence a second
struggle. (Hai 22).

The daily economic struggle should be carried
out when time allows. At the beginning, it is
not necessary to be on a large scale. Slogans for
the first struggle may be a little milder and
acceptable. This will cause the masses to increase
their confidence in us and , on the other hand,
to realize their own strength. It will increase
their experience so that they will have a strong
foundation in future struggles, and will not result
in failure as in the past. We should now try hard
pages.zh:
- 47 -

关于斗争，最重要的工作是在我们的影响下，尽可能由群众发起尽可能多的日常斗争。我们首先应该发起军事运动。我们应该领导群众进行斗争，而不应只指派我们的同志作为孤军进行工作。没有广大群众参与斗争或抛弃群众，无疑是一个严重的错误。

我们应该努力争取斗争的发展，同时在发展过程中继续我们的斗争。然而，那种因害怕失败而主张和平发展的原则，永远不会加强团体的影响力，也不会确保我们对群众的领导权或使我们能够领导他们，另一方面，我们的团体将永远没有机会发动群众的自动斗争。简而言之，因怯懦而未能领导群众发展自动斗争，将使我们有愧于布尔什维克团体的称号。

斗争不必广泛或大规模发展。只要它能达到其目标，即赢得群众的信心，巩固他们的政治理解和阶级观念即可。（Great 42）

青年工作是团体的重要任务之一。除了参加工会和农民合作社发起的所有斗争外，你应该尽可能煽动青年工人和农民的独立斗争（在工会和农民合作社的协助下）。（Great 16）。

共青团希望调动和动员我们在农村的所有力量，以参与或发动农民起义的斗争。（桑 6）。

在领导青年工人参加经济斗争时，你应该根据党的政策提出他们的要求，并指导他们为自己的利益而战。斗争的方案应基于胜利的原则。避免不顾自身能力而尝试更大的斗争，从而导致失败，并在我们希望开始第二次斗争时失去群众对我们的信任。（海 22）。

日常经济斗争应在时间允许的情况下进行。开始时，不必大规模进行。第一次斗争的口号可以稍微温和且易于接受。这将使群众增加对我们的信心，另一方面，认识到他们自己的力量。这将增加他们的经验，使他们在未来的斗争中有坚实的基础，并且不会像过去那样导致失败。我们现在应该努力

pages.en:
- 48 -

to train the masses. Stir up their faculty to
struggle, and develop their ability. We should
not hope to rely upon any military- or political
influence, large uprisings or the internal
disputes of the reactionaries. (Great 11).

In the matter of organization at places where
we have good foundation and influence for the
work among the masses or where many struggles have
occurred, you should prepare military force and
do not avoid armed struggle. Once armed struggle
has been commenced, do not directly occupy any
area or city. (Great 85).

The idea of struggle is very vague. Struggle
means to carry out work on a gigantic scale.
(Great 9)

Foment great struggle from small. Do not
agitate for strikes or 'tai-kung' strikes at the
very beginning. We should not however avoid
struggle by means of strikes. (Great 14).

You convey the idea that you will be satisfied
with a bigger struggle and therefore neglect the
daily small struggle (quarreling over one copper),
but you will accomplish nothing if you simply hope
for great occasions without sufficient training in
small struggles. (Great 153).

The wrong ideas of blind obedience and peace-
ful development are still found in some organs
in various places which act as directors. Some
of them representing peasants consider that any
struggle should be commenced with
a military movement or uprising, small struggles
being not worthwhile. Instead of making preparations,
they imagine that they can carry out military
movements by means of a slogan. The others dare not
to direct struggles among the masses, they even
try to prevent the masses from starting automatic
struggles. They merely think of securing a little
development of the Group in time of peace and waiting
for political and military changes. This is the
same mistake based upon opportunism. (Great 88).

Struggle is by no means uprising. Moreover,
manslaughter and incendiarism are not struggle.
Struggle starts from small things and daily
problems of life especially in the place where there is no
foundation for work among the masses. You deny
that there is a daily struggle among farming villages.
This is wrong. For instance, the demand for
establishing free schools, or other public works,
livelihood of farm labourers, assault of
cow boy by master, or doing extra work for the
latter ---- these are all the materials of struggle.
Naturally, where there is a chance and when the
masses want to have a change in the situation by
a big struggle. We should of course
not avoid it and on the contrary we can even resort
to armed struggle.
pages.zh:
- 48 -

训练群众。激发他们的斗争本能，并发展他们的能力。我们不应指望依靠任何军事或政治影响、大规模起义或反动派的内部纠纷。（Great 11）。

在我们在群众工作中有良好基础和影响力的地方，或发生过许多斗争的地方，在组织方面，你应该准备军事力量，不要避免武装斗争。一旦开始武装斗争，不要直接占领任何地区或城市。（Great 85）。

斗争的概念非常模糊。斗争意味着大规模开展工作。（Great 9）

由小到大煽动大规模斗争。一开始不要煽动罢工或“怠工”罢工。然而，我们不应通过罢工来避免斗争。（Great 14）。

你传达了一种想法，即你对更大的斗争感到满意，因此忽视了日常的小规模斗争（为一枚铜板争吵），但如果你只是希望有大场合而没有在小规模斗争中进行足够的训练，你将一事无成。（Great 153）。
