盲目服从和和平发展的错误思想仍然存在于各地担任指导职务的一些机构中。其中一些代表农民的人认为，任何斗争都应以军事运动或起义开始，小规模斗争不值得做。他们不进行准备，而是幻想通过口号来进行军事运动。其他人则不敢指导群众斗争，甚至试图阻止群众发动自动斗争。他们只想在和平时期确保团体的一点发展，并等待政治和军事变化。这是基于机会主义的同样错误。（Great 88）。

斗争绝不是起义。此外，杀人和纵火也不是斗争。斗争从小事和日常生活问题开始，特别是在没有群众工作基础的地方。你否认农村中存在日常斗争。这是错误的。例如，要求建立免费学校或其他公共工程、农业劳工的生计、主人殴打牧童、或为后者做额外工作——这些都是斗争的材料。当然，如果有机会，且群众希望通过大规模斗争改变局势。我们当然不应避免它，相反，我们甚至可以诉诸武装斗争。

pages.en:
- 49 -

Apart from making the complete answer to above
questions, you should add your own opinions on the
future of struggle, and report forthwith to the Provincial
Committee. It will direct you to put them into
execution after your opinions have been finally passed.
You should now hurry up and prepare for struggle and
carry out your routine work. Be careful not to make
any senseless attempt in order to save yourselves from
failure. (Great 41).

With regard to struggle of peasants against middle
class farmers, small holders and large farmers, it is
not necessary to discriminate at its commencement.
But after the outbreak of the struggle, we should
however undoubtedly stand on the side of peasants.
(Great 153).

The struggle of poor peasants and proletarians of the
farming village under the leadership of the labouring
class is the motive power of land revolution. It
is also the main necessity to secure victory of
land revolution to join with middle class farmers.
(Gai 43).

Stir up the struggle which is beneficial to the
class demands of students (such as improving curriculum,
making better preparation, selecting teachers and
securing freedom of speech). (Great 60).

Instead of causing the students to focus
their attention on a dismissed girl student (girls
are behaving thus) you should direct them to turn their
viewpoint to the welfare of the whole body of students
(such as the students demands mentioned in the Ka-moh's
letter - freedom for self study, publicity of finances,
dismissal of bad teachers, betterment of curriculum,
and freedom of speech and assembly). (Great 60).

Persist in various thought struggles among students,
break the reactionary work of the various cliques of the
Kuomintang and the 3rd Party, as well as repudiate
their logical mistakes. (Great 124).

There are some day-students in the Tung Yang
School who are under our direction. You should
also lead them to join in the daily struggle. Such
slogans as demanding freedom of selecting teachers,
assembly, organization, speech and publication, are
all capable of stirring up their daily struggles.
The Party books and publications should be offered
for sale among students with a view to consolidating their
revolutionary will. (Great 4).

You must strongly determine to reorganize branches
among factories in order to carry out their works
and make them center power of the masses. Correct
their mistakes of neglecting small struggles.
Do not miss the opportunity of a quarrel over a copper
or a dispute over slight ill-treatment of workers by
foremen. A small quarrel or suspension of work by
a foreman over division of money, is struggle.
Struggle is not necessarily in the form of a large strike.
If there is a possibility, a strike will naturally
be declared. (Great 153).
pages.zh:
- 49 -

除了对上述问题作出完整答复外，你们还应加上自己对斗争前途的意见，并立即向省委报告。在你们的意见最终获得批准后，省委将指示你们予以执行。你们现在应加紧准备斗争并开展日常工作。务必小心，不要进行任何无谓的尝试，以免遭受失败。（Great 41）。

关于农民反对中农、小地主和大地主的斗争，在开始时没有必要加以区分。但在斗争爆发后，我们毫无疑问应站在农民一边。（Great 153）。

在工人阶级领导下，贫苦农民和农村无产者的斗争是土地革命的动力。与中农联合也是确保土地革命胜利的主要必要条件。（Gai 43）。

煽动有利于学生阶级要求的斗争（如改进课程、做好准备工作、选聘教师以及争取言论自由）。（Great 60）。

你们不应让学生将注意力集中在一名被开除的女学生身上（女生们正如此行事），而应引导他们将观点转向全体学生的福利（如嘉摩来信中提到的学生要求——自习自由、财务公开、撤换不良教师、改进课程以及言论和集会自由）。（Great 60）。

坚持在学生中进行各种思想斗争，打破国民党各派系及第三党的反动工作，并驳斥他们的逻辑错误。（Great 124）。

东阳学校有一些走读生受我们指导。你们也应领导他们参加日常斗争。诸如要求选聘教师自由、集会自由、组织自由、言论自由和出版自由等口号，都能激起他们的日常斗争。应向学生出售党的书籍和出版物，以巩固他们的革命意志。（Great 4）。

你们必须坚决重组工厂中的支部，以便开展工作并使其成为群众的力量中心。纠正他们忽视小斗争的错误。不要错过因一个铜板引发的争吵或工头轻微虐待工人引发的纠纷的机会。工头因分钱不均而引发的小争吵或停工，就是斗争。斗争不一定采取大规模罢工的形式。如果有可能，自然会宣布罢工。（Great 153）。

pages.en:
- 50 -

Relation between Struggle

Constant attention should be paid to the daily
life and economic interests of the labour and peasant
masses. Peasants struggles should always be organized
using any cause however trivial as an excuse.
From these minor clashes they will be led to political
struggles through economic struggles such as refusing
to pay rentals. While the small struggles are being
extended and united into a major struggle, the masses
besides benefiting by the enrichment of their struggle
experience, will become more animated in spirit and
their faith in us will be more firmly established
thereby stabilizing the foundation and strengthening
the struggle force of our Group. (Great 72).
At the same time we should also pay our attention
to relation between the struggles of labourers, and
the struggles of soldiers and the struggles of peasants.
Every comrade should exert his efforts in these
activities and participate in every struggle be it
small or large, in order to receive training,
increase his experience as well as to establish a
formidable understanding of 'class' in his mind.
(Great 72).

Extend the small struggles which are organized from
demands in the interests of labourers and peasants as
a basis and arouse the spirit of the masses of the two
aforementioned classes with a view to transforming the
economic struggles into anti-Kuomintang and anti-Imperialist
struggles. In time of carrying out struggles special
notice should be paid to the organization of the Party
and the masses, and through these struggles, the
labourers and peasants are to be induced to realize
that only by the labourers and Peasants Soviet can
they find their revolutionary emancipation. Any struggle
concerning the interests of individuals and not of a
political nature is called an economic struggle.
The line which separates an economic struggle from a
political one however, is not clearly defined. (Hai 23).

Plan of Struggle: It is not necessary to urge
the masses to work for a general political struggle
within a limited period but we should lead them to
labour at economic struggles. At this moment when
the revolutionary spirit is at its ebb we should put
forth slogans of 'determined victory' for our struggles
in order to arouse them from their cowardly and abject
spirit. In addition we should gain victories in the
small struggles in hand before we organize others and
not so extend them, in order to avoid failure.
Appeals and petitions should not be given too prominent a
position in the struggles—if they are successful,
the masses gain faith in the Kuomintang. Demonstrations
may be used whenever it is deemed necessary. (Hai 5).
pages.zh:
- 50 -

斗争之间的关系

应时刻关注劳工和农民群众的日常生活及经济利益。农民斗争应始终利用任何借口（无论多么琐碎）来组织。通过这些小的冲突，他们将经由拒绝交租等经济斗争被引向政治斗争。当小斗争扩展并联合成大斗争时，群众除了从丰富的斗争经验中受益外，精神将更加振奋，对我们的信念也将更加坚定，从而稳定基础并加强我们团体的斗争力量。（Great 72）。
同时，我们也应关注工人斗争、士兵斗争和农民斗争之间的关系。每位同志都应在这些活动中尽力，并参加每一次斗争，无论大小，以便接受训练，增加经验，并在头脑中建立牢固的“阶级”观念。（Great 72）。

以基于劳工和农民利益要求而组织起来的小斗争为基础，将其扩展，并激发上述两个阶级群众的精神，旨在将经济斗争转化为反国民党和反帝国主义斗争。在进行斗争时，应特别注意党和群众的组织，并通过这些斗争，诱导劳工和农民认识到，只有工农苏维埃才能使他们找到革命的解放。任何涉及个人利益而非政治性质的斗争称为经济斗争。然而，区分经济斗争与政治斗争的界限并不明确。（Hai 23）。

斗争计划：没有必要敦促群众在有限期限内为一般性政治斗争而努力，但我们应引导他们致力于经济斗争。在目前革命精神处于低潮的时刻，我们应提出“坚决胜利”的斗争口号，以唤醒他们摆脱怯懦和卑躬屈膝的精神。此外，我们在组织其他斗争之前，应先在手头的小斗争中取得胜利，且不要过度扩展，以避免失败。在斗争中，呼吁和请愿不应占据过于突出的地位——如果成功，群众会对国民党产生信任。示威游行可在认为必要时使用。（Hai 5）。

pages.en:
- 51 -

Struggles should be organized in various localities,
in cities as well as in towns. The developments must
cover all sides equally and not centre in one particular
village or city. (Great 85).

Oppressions practiced in villages are comparatively
smaller in scope than those in cities. It is not
difficult to incite the peasants to attack cities wherein
live landlords and people of the ruling class, but it
is dangerous, and to do so will run the risk of failure
as the work in the city is still not strongly established
and that in the village not equally developed. We
should not therefore undertake such a trial at present.
(Great 85).

To organize and associate labourers' struggles
with those of peasants in the period of the 'Autumn
Harvest Struggle'. Labourers should lead the farm
villages in struggles and should not look upon the
'Autumn Harvest Struggle' as a mere peasant struggle
otherwise this struggle will lose its true meaning,
from the political point of view. (Hai 15).

In connection with the 'Autumn Harvest Struggle'
not only the peasants should be led in struggles but
the labourers in the city as well. They should, in order
to avoid being isolated and thereby causing failure,
associate with each other. (Hai 17).

Soldiers in villages are often in contact with
peasants, activities should also be carried out amongst
them in order to avoid any attack on the peasants
struggles in future.

The failure of many struggles in various localities
are accounted for by isolation in activity. Isolated
struggles are easily suppressed one by one by opponents,
Special notice therefore should be paid to this.
(Great 152).

Relation between Struggle and organization

In the course of the development of our group we
should carry out struggles. In the midst of these
struggles we should exert all our efforts to recommend
to our body the most active elements and the ringleaders
of the masses otherwise we will lose our revolutionary
spirit, never be able to establish our group within
the masses, nor will we be able to carry out any
activity amongst the masses or hope for the
materialization of our policy. (Great 81).

The organization in a long period of peace (that
is to say when no struggle has occurred) whereby
its comrades receive no training, is just like a building
on sand and will be easily destroyed when wind and rain
come. It is far from being bolshevized. (Great 45).
pages.zh:
- 51 -

斗争应在各地组织，包括城市和城镇。发展必须全面覆盖，不得集中于某一个特定的村庄或城市。（Great 85）。

乡村中实施的压迫范围相对小于城市。煽动农民攻击居住着地主和统治阶级人士的城市并不难，但这很危险，这样做会有失败的风险，因为城市工作尚未牢固建立，乡村工作也未均衡发展。因此，我们目前不应进行此类尝试。（Great 85）。

在“秋收斗争”期间，组织并将工人斗争与农民斗争联系起来。工人应领导农村进行斗争，不应将“秋收斗争”仅仅视为农民斗争，否则从政治角度来看，这场斗争将失去其真正意义。（Hai 15）。

关于“秋收斗争”，不仅应领导农民进行斗争，还应领导城市工人进行斗争。为了避免孤立从而导致失败，他们应相互联合。（Hai 17）。

乡村士兵经常与农民接触，也应在他们中间开展活动，以避免将来对农民斗争的任何攻击。

各地许多斗争的失败归因于活动的孤立。孤立的斗争容易被对手逐一镇压。因此应特别注意这一点。（Great 152）。

斗争与组织的关系

在我们团体的发展过程中，我们应开展斗争。在这些斗争中，我们应竭尽全力向我们团体推荐最积极的分子和群众领袖，否则我们将失去革命精神，永远无法在群众中建立我们的团体，也无法在群众中开展任何活动或希望实现我们的政策。（Great 81）。

在长期和平时期（即没有发生斗争时）的组织，其同志未接受训练，就像建在沙地上的建筑，风雨一来便易被摧毁。这远非布尔什维克化。（Great 45）。

pages.en:
- 52 -

The victory in a struggle depends upon the strength
of unification of the masses. The by-gone struggles
which were conducted with unorganized people gave us
experience and proved that such struggles were useless.
We should strive for the organization work prior to
or during a struggle. (Great 85).

Special attention should be paid to the masses and
also that weapons are in order prior to the start of
a struggle although weapons are always standing by for
use. (Great 85).

Accurate statistics dealing with the number and
ability of members must be made. The organization of
the party will be developed during struggles, absorbing
and promoting brave and talented comrades. These
comrades will be assigned to reform and strengthen
administrative organs. (Duh Yi 3).

When the masses who have insufficient experience
in struggles, become disheartened with their own
efforts and grow tired of the daily struggles, we
should induce them to realize the meaning of 'class'
and their own strength by victory in small struggles
and help them to start off on the right track.
(Great 64).

Organize and extend such bodies as the anti-Japanese
League, Diplomatic Affairs Supervisory Committee, and
National Salvation Ten Men's Groups, utilizing them
as implements for open activities and concurrently for
carrying out struggles for the freedom of speech,
assembly and publication. (Great 132).

The Chief aim of our carrying out constant struggles
is to arouse sympathy amongst the masses. Besides
influencing the masses however, we should develope
the organization of the Group and the masses themselves.
Recently, in many struggles, instead of centralizing
your work in penetrating into the masses you devoted
all your attention to military activities. Whether
or not a struggle resulted in victory or failure
thereby, both the Party and the Group were unable
to carry on further struggles and the organization
of the Group even ran the risk of being eliminated.
This is not only a humiliation to our work but also
a loss. (Great 74).

The Group should absorb active elements with a view
to developing its organization, and foment struggles
in the course of its development. (Great 58).

When no struggle occurs the Group may continue
its development, but the peaceful state will cause the
organization to disintegrate and the comrades depressed
in spirit. We should therefore constantly fight against
any thought favouring peace with a view to preventing
the collapse of the organization. (Great 52).
pages.zh:
- 52 -

斗争的胜利取决于群众团结的力量。过去由无组织人员进行的斗争给了我们经验，证明此类斗争是无用的。我们应在斗争之前或期间努力进行组织工作。（Great 85）。

在斗争开始前，应特别注意群众情况，并确保武器就绪，尽管武器总是处于备用状态。（Great 85）。

必须制作有关成员数量和能力的准确统计资料。党的组织将在斗争中得到发展，吸收并提拔勇敢且有才干的同志。这些同志将被指派去改革和加强行政机构。（Duh Yi 3）。

当缺乏斗争经验的群众对自己的努力感到灰心并对日常斗争感到厌倦时，我们应通过小斗争的胜利诱导他们认识“阶级”的意义及其自身力量，并帮助他们走上正轨。（Great 64）。

组织并扩展抗日联盟、外交事务监督委员会和救国十人团等团体，利用它们作为公开活动的工具，并同时开展争取言论、集会和出版自由的斗争。（Great 132）。

我们开展持续斗争的主要目的是唤起群众的同情。然而，除了影响群众外，我们还应发展团体和群众自身的组织。最近，在许多斗争中，你们没有将工作重心放在深入群众上，而是将所有注意力都集中在军事活动上。无论斗争结果是胜是败，党和团体都无法继续进行进一步的斗争，团体的组织甚至面临被消灭的风险。这不仅是我们工作的耻辱，也是一种损失。（Great 74）。

团体应吸收积极分子以发展其组织，并在发展过程中煽动斗争。（Great 58）。

当没有斗争发生时，团体可以继续发展，但和平状态会导致组织瓦解和同志精神消沉。因此，我们应不断反对任何倾向于和平的思想，以防止组织崩溃。（Great 52）。

pages.en:
- 53 -

Should the establishment and/or the strengthening
measures of the organization of the masses be overlooked
during a struggle, the masses will be but a disorganized
rabble. If the struggle becomes a failure dissension
among the masses will be the natural result; if victorious
the interests gained will be lost should the masses
be loosely organized masses. (Great 153).

Extend small struggles in connection with the
daily life of the labouring masses and absorb
labourers with a view to arousing the depressed
revolutionary spirit of the masses. (Hai 50).

In the evolution from economic struggles to
political anti-Imperialist and anti-Kuomintang
struggles and from individual labour struggles to
a united economic or political struggle of peasants,
soldiers, people engaged in the salt business, and
shop assistants, the chief work is to extend our
organization. (Great 44).

Comrades who are members of students' unions
should organize sections of the Group to discuss and
direct these activities to be undertaken by the unions
and select enthusiastic elements to join the Group.
It is not necessary to adopt the policy of 'comrades
struggle' but it is of importance to observe clearly
the evolution of circumstances, seizing opportunities
as they emerge therefrom to start struggles, which
we can turn into a partial or whole victory. (Great 60).

The Juvenile and young workers, apprentices and
shops assistants in Chekiang Province are all in an
intolerable condition, we should organize 'grey'
organizations to lead them to foment political as well
as economic struggles. (Kiang 11).

The 'Brother Groups' should besides assisting
each other in military work, mutually help in economic
struggles of the masses. During these struggles
they should quickly unite together and be transformed
into labour unions. (Great).

You, the several intellectual elements of the City
who have no experience in work, should try to understand
the livelihood of the labourers and then put forth
demands dealing with the interests of the labourers,
and shop assistants with a view to starting struggles.
In the course of the struggles, various labour unions
must be organized and the basis for future city activities
is to be established to serve as a leading organ in
the transition to Proletarian Revolution. (Duh Yi 4).

You should put forth demands dealing with the
interests of the peasants, small holders and farmers
to start struggles with a view to enlarging the
associations of the Peasants. Under the guidance
of the Party, clashes are certain to arise between the
peasants and their landlords yet disputes may also
arise between small holders or farmers and the peasants
(hired men). In the latter case we should however,
stand on the side of the peasants, organize peasants
unions and establish proletarian organizations in the
farm villages. (Duh Yi 4.)
pages.zh:
- 53 -

如果在斗争期间忽视了群众组织的建立和/或加强措施，群众将只是一群乌合之众。如果斗争失败，群众内部出现分歧将是自然结果；如果胜利，但群众组织松散，所获得的利益也将丧失。（Great 153）。

开展与劳动群众日常生活相关的小型斗争，并吸收劳动者，以激发群众低落的革命精神。（Hai 50）。

在从经济斗争向反帝和反国民党政治斗争演变，以及从个别劳工斗争向农民、士兵、盐业从业者和店员的联合经济或政治斗争演变的过程中，主要工作是扩展我们的组织。（Great 44）。

身为学生会成员的同志应组织小组分部，讨论并指导由学生会开展的这些活动，并挑选积极分子加入本组。不必采取“同志斗争”的政策，但重要的是要清楚地观察局势的演变，从中抓住机会发起斗争，我们可以将其转化为局部或全面的胜利。（Great 60）。

浙江省的少年和青年工人、学徒及店员都处于难以忍受的境地，我们应该组织“灰色”组织，领导他们煽动政治以及经济斗争。（Kiang 11）。

“兄弟团”除了在军事工作上相互协助外，还应在群众的经济斗争中相互帮助。在这些斗争中，他们应迅速联合起来，并转变为工会。（Great）。

你们这几位没有工作经验的城市知识分子分子，应尝试了解工人的生活状况，然后提出涉及工人和店员利益的诉求，以发起斗争。在斗争过程中，必须组织各种工会，并为未来的城市活动奠定基础，使其成为向无产阶级革命过渡的领导机构。（Duh Yi 4）。

你们应提出涉及农民、小土地所有者和农户利益的诉求，以发起斗争，旨在扩大农民协会。在党的指导下，农民与其地主之间必然会发生冲突，但小土地所有者或农户与农民（雇工）之间也可能发生纠纷。在后一种情况下，然而，我们应站在农民一边，组织农民协会，并在农村建立无产阶级组织。（Duh Yi 4。）

pages.en:
-54-

Special Attention should be paid to the degree of
penetration of struggles into the farm villages and the
training and development of craftsmen in farm villages,
farm labourers and poor peasants. Able comrades who
are sent from the city to work in farm villages should
induce the brave young peasants to join the Group.
It is not necessary to absorb all our sympathizers
into our group but it is of importance to send them
to the Peasants Unions, Peasants Representative
Associations, and Youth Vanguards Corps to make them
efficient elements in our administration. (Great 135).

Commence military organization and training of the
labour and peasant masses and concurrently carry on
our daily struggles. Should all efforts be spent
on military matters we will be following the 'Military
Route' but should we neglect this and centralize
our attention on the daily struggles we will never
attain a higher development. So in the daily
struggles we should arouse the labourers and peasants
to realize the necessity of military organization
and training and militarize them into strong Red
Armies. (Duh Yi 3).

Labour Unions in the villages may be put under
the direction of those in cities but should have
intimate connection with the Peasants Unions in their
respective localities. Struggles of labourers
in farm villages should also be constantly organized.
(Great 153).

The Rent Reduction Association of the Central
District and the Peasant Representative Association
of the Southern Village should immediately absorb
brave and young peasants and poor peasants with a
view to extending the mass struggles. (Great 29).

Relation between Struggle and Movement

In every struggle attention should be paid to the
slogans used. Should we lead labour and peasant masses
in economic struggles without using any political propaganda
the labourers and peasants will become economists.
On the contrary should we lead them in political struggles
(Anti-Imperialist and anti-Kuomintang) without any
economic demands they will not persevere in the
struggles. So the most important thing in the struggles
is to let them know the revolutionary route of the
labour and peasant Soviet. (Duh Yi 4).

Propaganda Work: The labourers, peasants, and
soldiers should be informed of the news of uprisings
in various places with a view to setting them on the
way of struggle. (Tung 3).

Keep in contact with and penetrate into the masses.
Try to understand the daily life of the people and put
forth slogans containing demands in their interests
(such as refusal to pay rents and taxes, demands for
freedom of speech, assembly and publication) in order
to start daily struggles.
pages.zh:
-54-

应特别注意斗争深入农村的程度，以及农村工匠、农业劳工和贫农的训练与发展。从城市派往农村工作的得力同志，应诱导勇敢的年轻农民加入本组。不必将所有同情者都吸收到我们的小组中，但重要的是将他们派往农民协会、农民代表协会和青年先锋队，使他们成为我们管理中的有效分子。（Great 135）。

开始对工农群众进行军事组织和训练，同时开展我们的日常斗争。如果所有精力都花在军事事务上，我们将走上“军事路线”；但如果忽视这一点，将注意力集中在日常斗争上，我们将永远无法获得更高层次的发展。因此，在日常斗争中，我们应唤醒工农认识到军事组织和训练的必要性，并将他们军事化为强大的红军。（Duh Yi 3）。

乡村工会可受城市工会的指导，但应与当地的农民协会保持密切联系。还应不断组织农村劳工的斗争。（Great 153）。

中区减租协会和南村农民代表协会应立即吸收勇敢的青年农民和贫农，以扩展群众斗争。（Great 29）。

斗争与运动的关系

在每次斗争中，应注意所使用的口号。如果我们领导工农群众进行经济斗争而不使用任何政治宣传，工人和农民将成为经济主义者。相反，如果我们领导他们进行政治斗争（反帝和反国民党）而没有任何经济诉求，他们将无法坚持斗争。因此，斗争中最重要的是让他们知道工农苏维埃的革命路线。（Duh Yi 4）。

宣传工作：应告知工人、农民和士兵各地起义的消息，以引导他们走上斗争之路。（Tung 3）。

保持与群众的联系并深入群众。尝试了解人民的日常生活，并提出包含符合其利益诉求的口号（如拒付租金和税款，要求言论、集会和出版自由），以发起日常斗争。

pages.en:
-55-

Peasants are in an intolerable condition but they
will not realize or even dream about the power they
can wield. It is not to be believed that they will
follow us when we put forth a slogan revealing tortures
they undergo, as they have no organization nor have
they been influenced by our propaganda. So prior to
starting a struggle, we should ascertain whether the
time is ripe or not that is to say whether we have
carried out sufficient intimidation work among the
masses or not. (Great 85).

The outbreak of a struggle should be the voluntary
action of the masses. To attain this, special attention
should be paid to propaganda work amongst the masses.
To compel labourers to declare strikes by force of
arms and threaten peasants to carry out massacres and arson
with the 'Guerilla Warfare Groups' in the past was not
the proper way to stir up struggles of the masses.
(Great 85).

In the past you only put forth common slogans for
land revolution but not the important ones, so the aim
of the struggle was not known by the masses. Most of
you did not exert your efforts in organization and train-
ing work nor in attempts to instill the doctrine into
the masses during the last struggle, so that you appeared
to the masses only as heroes of the Communist Party.
(Duh Yi 3).

The Propaganda work should besides penetrating
the masses at the same time be extended
especially in a struggle. (Hai 15).

You should not put aside the mass struggle after
having posted posters but should arouse the masses to
participate in the struggle under the shouting of our
slogans. (Hai 15).

You should make sure that not only do you carry
out anti-Japanese activities but also anti-British
and anti-American activities. In your propaganda
matter you should point out the fact that the Kuomintang
deceives the people (it apparently advocates the boycott
of Japanese goods but actually surrenders to British
and American Imperialism), and put forth anti-Kuomintang
slogans. You should carry out anti-Imperialism and
anti-Kuomintang propaganda and that which is appropriate
to the daily struggles (the three kinds of propaganda
should be connected with each other). (Great 5).

Guide various classes especially the labourers
and peasants to carry out the vital activities
mentioned in the Outline of Principal Activities and
Outline of Principal Propaganda in their respective
localities. (Kiang 11).

Extend the non-payment of rentals, anti-Kuomintang
and land revolution propaganda to stir up the struggle
for non payment of rentals. (Demands and arrangements
for rent reduction and rent remission will be clearly
announced by notice). (Great 65).
pages.zh:
-55-

农民处于难以忍受的境地，但他们不会意识到，甚至梦想不到他们所能 wield（行使）的力量。不能相信，当我们提出揭示他们所受折磨的口号时，他们会跟随我们，因为他们没有组织，也没有受到我们宣传的影响。因此，在开始斗争之前，我们应查明时机是否成熟，也就是说，我们是否在群众中进行了足够的恐吓工作。（Great 85）。

斗争的爆发应是群众的自愿行动。为此，应特别注意在群众中的宣传工作。过去用武力强迫工人宣布罢工，并用“游击战小组”威胁农民进行屠杀和纵火，并不是激起群众斗争的正确方式。（Great 85）。

过去你们只提出了土地革命的普通口号，而没有提出重要的口号，因此群众不知道斗争的目标。在上次斗争中，你们大多数人没有在组织和训练工作上努力，也没有试图向群众灌输主义，以至于在群众眼中，你们只是共产党的英雄。（Duh Yi 3）。

宣传工作除了深入群众外，同时还应特别在斗争期间加以扩展。（Hai 15）。

你们不应在张贴海报后就搁置群众斗争，而应在高呼我们口号的同时，唤起群众参与斗争。（Hai 15）。

你们应确保不仅开展反日活动，还要开展反英和反美活动。在宣传事项中，你们应指出国民党欺骗人民的事实（它表面上提倡抵制日货，但实际上向英美帝国主义投降），并提出反国民党的口号。你们应开展反帝和反国民党宣传，以及适合日常斗争的宣传（这三种宣传应相互联系）。（Great 5）。

引导各阶层，特别是工人和农民，在各自地区开展《主要活动大纲》和《主要宣传大纲》中提到的重要活动。（Kiang 11）。

扩展拒付租金、反国民党和土地革命的宣传，以激起拒付租金的斗争。（减租和免租的要求及安排将通过通告明确宣布）。（Great 65）。

pages.en:
-56-

At places where rents have been paid slogans for
the return of the rent may be put forth while struggles
may be organized elsewhere for other reasons (such
as demanding that the landlords contribute money
to charitable works and improve treatment). During
the period of the struggle for rent reduction some
of the peasants will fail to pay their rent. (Great 78)

At present it is not known whether the rent
for the Autumn quarter at Wong-gnai (黃泥) has all been
paid or not. Should the answer be negative you should
carry out rent reduction propaganda pointing out the
fact that the Kuomintang deceives people with its
2 5 (?) reduction, and putting forth slogans advocating
that the amount of rent remission should be decided
by the peasants themselves (yet concurrently attention
should be given to anti-Kuomintang, anti-Bureau of
Farming Affairs, refusing rent payment, establishment
of Soviet Administration and debts cancellation propaganda).
The propaganda should also be connected with the year
end struggle. (Great 42).

The lunar year end is very near and you should
strive to stir up the 'year end struggle'. In your
work the chief thing is to progress from your propaganda
of rent reduction, non payment of rent to propaganda of
non payment of debts as well as taxes. (Great 43).

1. Try to obtain a comprehensive knowledge of the
daily struggles and start daily struggles, search out
the requirements of the labour masses in their daily
life and lead them to demand and obtain their
requirements from the capitalists.

2. We should not hope for the extension of a
struggle but its victory, so there should be no demands
in slogans which are impossible for us to attain.

3. Connection between struggle slogans and political
slogans:
a) adequate slogans for activities to be undertaken
be put forth in the struggle.
b) appended to these slogans adequate political
slogans be put forth.

4. Should the Kuomintang come to arbitrate in the
struggle we should
a) propagate that the judgement will not benefit
the labour masses.
b) propagate that the judgement will deceive the
labour masses.
c) propagate that the judgement will benefit the
capitalists.
d) should it be imperative to accept the judgement
explain to the masses that the judgement is
unsatisfactory with the intention of making
them discontented thus forming the nucleus
for a second struggle and also tell them that
we will continue the fight later.
(Hai 7).
pages.zh:
-56-

在已支付租金的地方，可以提出退还租金的口号，而在其他地方则可能因其他原因组织斗争（如要求地主捐款用于慈善事业并改善待遇）。在减租斗争期间，部分农民将不支付租金。（Great 78）

目前尚不知黄泥（Wong-gnai）秋季季度的租金是否已全部支付。如果答案是否定的，你们应开展减租宣传，指出国民党以25%（?）的减租欺骗人民，并提出主张免租金额应由农民自己决定的口号（但同时应注意反国民党、反农事局、拒付租金、建立苏维埃行政机构和取消债务的宣传）。宣传还应与年终斗争联系起来。（Great 42）。

农历年底临近，你们应努力激起“年终斗争”。在工作中，主要任务是从减租、拒付租金的宣传进展到拒付债务以及税款的宣传。（Great 43）。

1. 尝试全面了解日常斗争并发起日常斗争，寻找劳动群众在日常生活中的需求，并领导他们向资本家要求并获得这些需求。

2. 我们不应希望斗争的扩展，而应希望其胜利，因此口号中不应包含我们无法实现的诉求。

3. 斗争口号与政治口号的联系：
a) 在斗争中提出适合即将开展活动的充分口号。
b) 在这些口号之后，提出充分的政治口号。

4. 如果国民党介入仲裁斗争，我们应：
a) 宣传该裁决不会对劳动群众有利。
b) 宣传该裁决将欺骗劳动群众。
c) 宣传该裁决将使资本家受益。
d) 如果必须接受裁决，应向群众解释该裁决令人不满，旨在使他们感到不满，从而形成第二次斗争的核心，并告诉他们我们将稍后继续战斗。
(Hai 7)。

pages.en:
-57-

not
You should/hope for a general strike in a certain
district but should undertake the underground and
labo/rious activities in the daily mass struggles.
By every possible measures try to come into contact
with the labourers and discover their sufferings
which can be made reasons for demands. Develope
the demands of a facto y into the demands of the
whole body of young labourers of a certain district.

Comrades should make propaganda out of ordinary
demands and seized any chance which is possible to
extend them into economic and political struggles
(such as the Tsinan Incident, workers of a certain
factory being insulted or assaulted, etc.) (Great 184).

Amidst the daily struggles we should have slogans
bearing on the demands of youths - this was often
overlooked in many by-gone struggles. We should put
forth demands in connection with the interests of the
youths, summon the young masses to participate in
the struggles thus helping the party to attain its
aim.(Great 85).

Put forth special demands of the young masses
(the most necessary ones relating to their own interests)
to start the daily struggles. (Great 68).

Draft demands for the young labourers and peasants
to be used as slogans such as 'no assault or reprisal
to be imposed on young labourers, 'increase the wages'
of peasants'and'education of labourers and peasants',
to stir up the individual struggle of the young masses
with a view to attaining the chief object of the Group.
(Great 86).

From the present situation of the whole country we
hope to organize struggles on all sides rather than
to occupy several hsiens, and to obtain small victories
with a view to arousing the struggle spirit rather
than to put forth too ambitious demands which by
the circumstances are incapable of attainment. We
acknowledge that a rent reduction movement should be
carried out in various places with the exception of
a few hsiens according to the following measures:-
a) enlarge the daily struggles so that the rent
reduction movement becomes the non-payment of
rent movement.
b) With the rent reduction movement as the starting
point, struggles should be organized in various
hsiens with the exception of Lan Shi (兰溪), Zai
Chong (诸), Wu-nyi (武义), Wen-ling (温岭),
Zush-an (诸安) and Yu-yao (余姚). The measures
for activity in these places will be decided upon
after a thorough investigation has been made into
their present conditions owing to the fact that
many strong agitations carried out in these localities
have recently been more or less suppressed.
pages.zh:
-57-

不
你们不应指望在某一地区发生总罢工，而应在日常的群众斗争中开展地下和艰苦的工作。采取一切可能的措施与工人接触，发现他们的苦难，并将其作为提出要求的理由。将一家工厂的要求发展为某一地区全体青年工人的要求。

同志们应利用普通要求进行宣传，并抓住任何可能的机会将其扩展为经济和政治斗争（如济南事件、某工厂工人受辱或遭殴打等）（Great 184）。

在日常斗争中，我们应提出与青年要求相关的口号——这在许多过去的斗争中常被忽视。我们应提出与青年利益相关的要求，号召青年群众参与斗争，从而帮助党实现其目标。（Great 85）。

提出青年群众的特殊要求（与其自身利益最密切相关的要求），以发动日常斗争。（Great 68）。

起草青年工人和农民的要求作为口号，如“不得对青年工人实施殴打或报复”、“增加农民工资”以及“工农教育”，以激起青年群众的个别斗争，旨在实现小组的主要目标。（Great 86）。

从全国目前的形势来看，我们希望组织各方面的斗争，而不是占领几个县，并取得小胜利，以激发斗争精神，而不是提出因环境所限无法实现的过于雄心勃勃的要求。我们承认，除少数县外，各地应按照以下措施开展减租运动：-
a) 扩大日常斗争，使减租运动变为抗租运动。
b) 以减租运动为起点，除兰溪、诸重（音译）、武义、温岭、诸安（音译）和余姚外，应在各县组织斗争。鉴于这些地区近期开展的许多强烈 agitation（煽动/鼓动）已受到不同程度的镇压，将在彻底调查其现状后决定在这些地方的活动措施。

pages.en:
-58-

c) Not to work for any rent reduction movement under
the direction of the Kuomintang.
d) When the rent reduction movement is being carried
out arrangements should also be made for the
non-payment of rent movement.
e) The rent reduction movement after having been started
should be developed into the 'Non payment of Rent
Movement' within a short period.
f) Should there be adequate results attained by the rent
reduction movement thus making it impossible to
develope it into the non payment of rent movement,
our way should be to turn and intensify our activities
among the masses in daily struggles
g) Proper preparations should be made prior to the out-
break of a non payment of rent movement.
h) The occupation of farm villages will be the natural
and most immediate result of a non-payment of rent
movement.
i) The non-payment of rent movement should be extended
and should penetrate into the masses. In its
course of development the occupation of cities
must be avoided.
j) To exert all efforts to connect the work of land
revolution with other tasks. (Great 88).

Relation between Struggle and movement

We hope that the Party will lead the masses
to participate in political struggles, extend
the 'anti-Nanking' and 'anti-Wu-han' propaganda among
the labourers and the peasants, stir up agitation in
cities opposing exhorbitant taxes, and capitalists,
and in farm villages demanding the overthrow of the
capitalist class. The party should also deceive
the higher officials of our opponents into opposing
one another and send comrades to organize systematic
activities inside the organization and organs of
the 'Right' clique. (Kiang 10).

Amidst the anti-Imperialist movement the labour
struggles vigorously spring up. In Shanghai there has
been 40 economic struggle since the spirit of the
labourers was aroused by the demonstrations of May 30,
June 3rd etc.. The minority of them were wholly
victorous while the majority were partially successful.
At present several strikes have been declared in the
Japanese mills in the Western District and all possess
the possibility of being enlarged. The labour struggles
will directly affect the anti-Imperialist struggle,
the slogan "Down with Japanese Imperialism" is very
often used while "Down with the labour Committee"
and "Down with the Kuomintang" was also shouted
when the labourers besieged the Kuomintang Headquarters
protesting against the latter's support to the capitalists.
Recently the B.A.T. Factory Workers' Union, the Postal
Workers' Union, the Printing Workers Union and four other
large unions have shown gradual inclination to the left
and paid no more heed to the labour committee and as
a consequence the influence of Song Tsong (?Shanghai
General Labour Federation) and C.P. grows daily.
pages.zh:
-58-

c) 不在国民党的指导下进行任何减租运动。
d) 在进行减租运动时，也应安排抗租运动。
e) 减租运动开始后，应在短时间内发展为“抗租运动”。
f) 如果减租运动取得充分成果，导致无法将其发展为抗租运动，我们的做法应是转而加强我们在日常斗争中的群众工作。
g) 在抗租运动爆发前应做好适当准备。
h) 占领农村将是抗租运动自然且最直接的结果。
i) 抗租运动应予以扩展并深入群众。在其发展过程中，必须避免占领城市。
j) 竭尽全力将土地革命的工作与其他任务联系起来。（Great 88）。

斗争与运动的关系

我们希望党能领导群众参与政治斗争，在工人和农民中扩大“反南京”和“反武汉”的宣传，在城市中激起反对苛捐杂税和资本家的鼓动，在农村中要求推翻资产阶级。党还应诱使对方的高级官员互相反对，并派遣同志在“右”派团体的组织和机构内部组织系统性的活动。（Kiang 10）。

在反帝运动中，劳工斗争蓬勃兴起。自五卅、六月三日等示威活动激发了工人的精神以来，上海已发生了40起经济斗争。其中少数完全胜利，多数部分成功。目前，西区日资纱厂已宣布数次罢工，且均有可能扩大。劳工斗争将直接影响反帝斗争，“打倒日本帝国主义”的口号经常被使用，而当工人包围国民党总部抗议其支持资本家时，也高呼“打倒劳工委员会”和“打倒国民党”。最近，英美烟草公司工厂工会、邮政工会、印刷工会和其他四个大型工会逐渐表现出左倾倾向，不再理会劳工委员会，因此宋宗（?上海总工会）和共产党的影响力日益增长。

pages.en:
-59-

There is a new prospect in the development of the
Shanghai labour struggles. These struggles as they are
the consequences of the high handed oppressions practiced
by the capitalists over a long period of time will last
a long time. Besides in Shanghai, the economic
struggles (about one third of which are strikes) in
Canton (An Yuen miners), Tientsin (Cotton mills)
Tsinan (unemployed workers of Kwang Dah) Tsu Poh
(Miners) etc. have been successively organized under
our guidance. (Great 160).

The anti-Imperialist movement should be considered
as a kind of daily work which should influence the masses.
Measures should be devised in order to connect the
daily struggle with the anti-Imperialist movement.
(Great 58).

The merchants and trades should be led to anti-
imperialist and anti-Kuomintang struggles through the
agitation opposing exhorbitant taxes. The students
at the same time should be incited to create disorder
in their respective schools as a bridge to the anti-
imperialist and anti-Kuomintang struggles. (Great 152).

The Party should develope its section among the
students leading them to participate in the daily
struggles. Such demands as anti-Imperialist,
anti-Kuomintang, freedom of choosing teachers, speech,
assembly and publication can all be used as pretexts to
start struggles, while the view of the Party in connection
with these struggles may be expressed through the speeches
of the students as well as the students associations
by issuing manifestoes or circular letters. Publications
and books of the Party should by all possible means
be introduced to students with a view to stabilizing their
revolutionary spirit. (Duh Yi 3).

The influence already established in the peasants
in important districts should be well preserved as potential
energy for starting land revolution and the non payment
of rent movement at the Autumn Harvest. (Kiang 10).

We should prepare for a class struggle at the begin-
ning of the peasant movement regardless of the attitude
of the rich farmers. The latter will either remain
unmoved or neutral in the course of the movement but
will very rapidly turn reactionary at the last moment.
(Hai 43).

The non payment of rent movement and the non payment
of tax movement : In cities we should lead people
in various walks of life to oppose the exhorbitant
taxes and in farm villages guide the small farmers
to refuse to pay rent. Hangchow will be the centre
of the movement for non payment of taxes. (Kiang 1).
pages.zh:
-59-

上海劳工斗争的发展出现了新的前景。这些斗争是资本家长期以来实行高压压迫的后果，将持续很长时间。此外，在上海之外，广州（安源矿工）、天津（棉纺厂）、济南（广大失业工人）、淄博（矿工）等地的经济斗争（其中约三分之一是罢工）也在我们的指导下相继组织起来。（Great 160）。

反帝运动应被视为一种影响群众的日常工作。应制定措施，将日常斗争与反帝运动联系起来。（Great 58）。

应通过反对苛捐杂税的鼓动，引导商人和行业从业者参与反帝和反国民党斗争。同时，应煽动学生在各自学校制造混乱，作为通向反帝和反国民党斗争的桥梁。（Great 152）。

党应在学生中发展其分部，领导他们参与日常斗争。反帝、反国民党、自由选择教师、言论、集会和出版自由等要求均可作为发动斗争的借口，而党关于这些斗争的观点可以通过学生的演讲以及学生协会发布宣言或通函来表达。应尽一切可能向学生介绍党的出版物和书籍，以稳定他们的革命精神。（Duh Yi 3）。

在重要地区已在农民中建立的影响力应妥善保存，作为秋季收获时发动土地革命和抗租运动的潜在力量。（Kiang 10）。

无论富农态度如何，我们都应在农民运动开始时准备阶级斗争。后者在运动过程中要么保持不动，要么保持中立，但在最后时刻会迅速转向反动。（Hai 43）。

抗租运动和抗税运动：在城市中，我们应引导各界人士反对苛捐杂税，在农村中引导小农拒绝交租。杭州将成为抗税运动的中心。（Kiang 1）。

pages.en:
-60-

The rent reduction movement should be quickly
transformed into the non payment of rent movement
if the circumstances permit, or when there is no result
from the former movement but the spirit of the
masses has been greatly aroused. (Great 67).

By pointing out the disputes which may arise
in consequence of the Bureau of Farm Affairs
summoning persons (peasants) as a pretext,
the peasants should be instigated to destroy the
premises of the Bureau. (Great 39)

Put forth demands which the Bureau of Farm
Affairs will be unable to comply with thereby
causing it to lose the confidence of the peasants.
Our work is to fight forward incessantly. Victory
and failure of struggles are but records in the course
of the revolution. (Great 39).

Wherever the peasants can be incited or
the feeling of the masses is running high they should
be led to smash it (? Bureau of Farm Affairs) and the
struggle should be immediately extended. (Great 67)

Labour movement - Strive for economic struggles of
workers, craftsmen and shop assistants for they will
develope into political struggles. (Tung 3).

Attend to the work of the female labourers and
lead them to participate in the revolutionary struggles.
(Great 124).

Soldiers movement - the aim of the movement is to
organize struggles among soldiers. To attain this aim
we should stir up agitation relating to the daily life
of the soldiers, intimidate them to oppose their command-
ing officers, mutiny and desert with their arms to the
peasants. The mutineers will become the armed force
of the peasants participating in the land revolution,
while those soldiers in the army who have been influenced
by us will respond to our influence when the labour
and peasant masses clash with the troops. (Great 189)

The committee of the liaison will send comrades to
intimidate soldiers to mutiny or to desert with their
arms in order to make the struggles of soldiers
responsive to those of the labourers and peasants.
(Great 44).

Between
Relation among struggle, propaganda
and organization

The masses must be strictly organized
(as strike committees, representative groups, picketing
groups etc.) in all struggles with a view to preventing
any dissipation of the strength of the participants
in action. In every struggle we should carry out a general
propaganda to secure the sympathy of the community.
(Ben:Yi 4.)
pages.zh:
-60-

如果情况允许，或者当减租运动没有结果但群众精神已被极大激发时，减租运动应迅速转变为抗租运动。（Great 67）。

通过指出田赋局传唤人员（农民）可能引发的纠纷作为借口，煽动农民摧毁田赋局的办公场所。（Great 39）

提出田赋局无法满足的要求，从而使其失去农民的信任。我们的工作是不停地向前战斗。斗争的胜负不过是革命过程中的记录。（Great 39）。

凡是可以煽动农民或群众情绪高涨的地方，都应引导他们砸毁它（?田赋局），并立即扩大斗争。（Great 67）

劳工运动 - 争取工人、工匠和店员的經濟斗争，因为它们将发展为政治斗争。（Tung 3）。

关注女工的工作，并领导她们参与革命斗争。（Great 124）。

士兵运动 - 该运动的目标是在士兵中组织斗争。为了实现这一目标，我们应煽动与士兵日常生活相关的鼓动，恐吓他们反对指挥官，哗变并携带武器投奔农民。哗变者将成为参与土地革命的农民武装力量，而军队中受我们影响的士兵将在劳苦大众和农民群众与部队发生冲突时响应我们的影响。（Great 189）

联络委员会将派遣同志恐吓士兵哗变或携带武器开小差，以使士兵的斗争响应工人和农民的斗争。（Great 44）。

之间
斗争、宣传和组织之间的关系

在所有斗争中，必须严格组织群众（如罢工委员会、代表小组、纠察队等），以防止参与者力量的分散。在每一次斗争中，我们应进行普遍宣传，以争取社会的同情。（Ben:Yi 4.）

pages.en:
-61-

Propaganda material and ways of propagating:
Point out the suffering; the masses undergo and
lead them to start daily struggles. During the
struggles extend and tighten up the organization
of the masses, pick out brave young elements to participate
in the directing organs and get rid of all those cowardly
ones. (Great 86).

When we undertake propaganda, we should concurrently
pay attention to organization also. We should absorb
into our group talented elements on one hand and
form organizations under any title and any number of
persons whether 3 or 5. It is not necessary to have a
controlling organ over them. These organizations
will be transformed into labour unions to direct
activities at the outbreak of a struggle. (Great 87).

The foregoing measures are not necessarily the
steps we shall follow (i.e. first do propaganda work,
secondly organization and then struggle). Propaganda
must be carried out to intensify the agitation prior
to the outbreak of a struggle and should be extended
during a struggle. It is natural that we should
do organization work before the outbreak of a struggle
yet it is equally of importance for us to extend the
organization in the course of the struggle (by recommend-
ing to the Group able elements). Propaganda, organization
and struggle are equal in importance.

In the labour movement we should stir up struggles
but should not do so blindly. Failure will result
if we call for a strike immediately after hearing that
the workers are being oppressed. We should use every
means to carry our propaganda work inciting workers to
stir up unrest, calling for the union of the labour
masses (join labour unions and Brothers Groups) prior
to the declaration of a strike. The term, labour
struggle, is not limited to strikes only, to quarrel
with the foremen in a factory or the proprietor of
a shop is also a labour struggle although of a smaller
scope. We must realize that the smaller struggles
will culminate in a general struggle. (Great 87).

The slogan that the rentals be withheld for the time
being may be used to start the rent reduction movement
and the non payment of rent movement. As the 'early'
rentals have already been paid, your attention should
be centralized on the 'late' rentals, struggles for the
reduction and non payment of which are to be arranged
in addition to the daily struggles. The latter struggles
will assist you to start the former ones. (Great 49).
pages.zh:
-61-

宣传材料及宣传方式：
指出民众所遭受的苦难，并引导他们开展日常斗争。在斗争过程中扩展和巩固群众组织，选拔勇敢的年轻分子参与领导机构，并清除所有怯懦分子。（Great 86）。

在进行宣传时，我们应同时注意组织工作。一方面应将人才吸收到我们的团体中，另一方面无论人数是三人还是五人，都应以任何名义组建组织。没有必要设立控制这些组织的上级机关。这些组织将在斗争爆发时转变为工会以指导活动。（Great 87）。

上述措施并非我们必须遵循的步骤（即先做宣传工作，其次组织，然后斗争）。在斗争爆发前，必须进行宣传以加强鼓动，并在斗争期间扩大宣传。在斗争爆发前进行组织工作自然是应该的，但在斗争过程中扩展组织（通过向团体推荐能干分子）同样重要。宣传、组织和斗争同等重要。

在工人运动中，我们应该激起斗争，但不应盲目行事。如果一听到工人受压迫就立即号召罢工，将会导致失败。在宣布罢工之前，我们应该利用一切手段开展宣传工作，煽动工人制造不安，号召劳工大众联合起来（加入工会和兄弟会）。“劳工斗争”一词并不仅限于罢工，与工厂工头或店主争吵也是劳工斗争，尽管规模较小。我们必须认识到，较小的斗争将汇集成总斗争。（Great 87）。

“暂时拒付租金”的口号可用于发起减租运动和抗租运动。由于“早”租已经支付，你们的注意力应集中在“晚”租上，除了日常斗争外，还应安排关于减租和拒付晚租的斗争。后者的斗争将有助于你们发起前者的斗争。（Great 49）。

pages.en:
-62-

In the rent reduction movement,
1) Put forth slogans demanding reduction when payment
is made in kind, of so many piculs and catties of
rice not the reduction percentage of the payment as
done by the Kuomintang.
2) The rate of reduction proposed by us should be higher
that that suggested by the Kuomintang.
3) Propaganda on non payment of rentals and land
revolution must be put forth as a preliminary step
to these two struggles.
4) Should the spirit of the masses be aroused to such
a degree that we are able to transform it into non
payment of rentals movement, action for the
transformation should be immediately taken.
5) Should no result be obtained but the spirit of
the masses is at fever heat, action should be
taken to transform it into non payment of rentals
movement.
6) Should no result be obtained and the spirit of
the masses is depressed, or should there be partial
victory and the masses show unwillingness to proceed
further, we should exert our efforts to carry out
fundamental work among them and start daily struggles
with a view to preserving our strength. (Great 58).

Wounded soldier movement - Next to the soldiers who
were killed, the wounded are the most unfortunate
at the end of a war. They possess a hot temper as is
proved in many agitations carried out by them in Wuhan,
Nanking, Soochow and recently in Hangchow as a consequence
of their being carelessly treated, medically and otherwise.
So if they are only slightly intimidated just as
tinder is to dry firewood a struggle will surely result.
We have overlooked the wounded soldiers movement in
Hangchow. Hereafter we should put forth slogans opposing
the careless treatment of wounded soldiers by the
authorities and demanding compensation and better
treatment for them, wherever they are accommodated with
a view to stirring up struggles. (Great 189).
pages.zh:
-62-

在减租运动中，
1) 提出实物缴纳时要求减少若干担和斤大米的口号，而不是像国民党那样按付款百分比减租。
2) 我们提出的减租率应高于国民党的建议。
3) 必须将抗租和土地革命的宣传作为这两项斗争的初步步骤提出。
4) 如果群众情绪被激发到足以将其转化为抗租运动的程度，应立即采取行动进行转化。
5) 如果未取得结果但群众情绪高涨，应采取行动将其转化为抗租运动。
6) 如果未取得结果且群众情绪低落，或者取得部分胜利但群众不愿继续前进，我们应努力在他们中间开展基础工作，并发动日常斗争，以保存我们的力量。（Great 58）。

伤兵运动——在战争结束时，除了阵亡士兵外，伤员是最不幸的。由于他们在医疗和其他方面受到粗心对待，他们在武汉、南京、苏州以及最近在杭州进行的多次骚动证明了他们脾气火爆。因此，如果他们只受到轻微的恐吓，就像火绒遇到干柴一样，斗争必然会发生。我们在杭州忽视了伤兵运动。今后，无论伤员安置在哪里，我们都应提出反对当局粗心对待伤员、要求赔偿和改善待遇的口号，以激起斗争。（Great 189）。

pages.en:
-63-

between
Relation among struggle, movement and organization

When the Autumn Harvest arrives, we should seize the opportunity to establish our work among and instill the land revolution propaganda into the masses causing them to realize their own strength. The Bureau of Farm Affairs will be our opponent of the struggle of the time and should be smashed if possible. Rent Reduction propaganda should be intensified and our organization should be extended to other villages. With a view to hastening the collapse of the ruling class and to making more sure the victory of our revolution, special attention should be paid to the soldiers movement and the military organization of the labour and peasant masses. Military work is extremely important in the new policy of the Party of land revolution, armed uprising of labour and peasant masses, and establishment of Soviet Administration. (Hai 38).

That the labour and peasant struggles will become military struggles is certain. It is absolutary necessary to carry out the soldiers movement and military work as we are proceeding in our arrangements for uprising. Military work of minor importance in the districts in Chekiang Province where labour and peasant movement are now going on has been performed and the soldiers movement in Hangchow has also been started. The route we will follow hereafter is to intensify the soldiers movement in the reactionary armies, to organize soldier masses to beat down the Pao Wei Tuan or Ming Tuan, the armed force of the landlords and gentry of various places, to form a systematically organized Labourers and Peasants Revolutionary Army and to enforce military training on all comrades. (Yang 18).

The chief aim of the soldier movement at present is to break the organization of the armed force of the opponent not by uprisings, but by leading soldiers to carry out daily struggles such as demanding increases in wages, payment of wages in arrears and better treatment. From these struggles soldiers are to be incited to distrust their commanding officers, or even kill the latter, and to be induced to realize that to fight against the labourers and ██████ peasants is just like fighting against themselves, and that their way of emancipation is to unite with the labourers and peasants. Disguise yourselves as washmen and hawkers and with the assistance of ex-soldiers secure contact with the soldiers as the preliminary step in the movement. (Duh Yi/S).
pages.zh:
-63-

斗争、运动和组织之间的关系

当秋收到来时，我们应抓住机会在群众中建立我们的工作，并向他们灌输土地革命宣传，使他们认识到自己的力量。农政局将是当时斗争的对手，如果可能，应予以粉碎。应加强减租宣传，并将我们的组织扩展到其他村庄。为了加速统治阶级的崩溃并确保我们革命的胜利，应特别注意士兵运动以及工农群众的军事组织。在党的土地革命、工农武装起义和建立苏维埃政权的新政策中，军事工作极其重要。（Hai 38）。

工农斗争必将转变为军事斗争，这是肯定的。在我们着手安排起义的过程中，开展士兵运动和军事工作是绝对必要的。在目前工农运动正在进行的浙江省各地区，次要的军事工作已经开展，杭州的士兵运动也已启动。我们今后的路线是加强反动军队中的士兵运动，组织士兵群众打击各地的保卫团或民团（地主绅士的武装力量），组建系统组织的工农革命军，并对所有同志实施军事训练。（Yang 18）。

目前士兵运动的主要目标不是通过起义，而是通过领导士兵进行日常斗争（如要求增加工资、支付欠薪和改善待遇）来打破对手武装力量的组织。通过这些斗争，要煽动士兵不信任他们的指挥官，甚至杀死后者，并诱导他们认识到，与劳工和 ██████ 农民作战就像与自己作战一样，他们的解放之路是与工农联合。伪装成洗衣工和小贩，并在退伍军人的协助下与士兵取得联系，作为运动的初步步骤。（Duh Yi/S）。

pages.en:
-648

between
Relation among struggle, movement, organization
and propaganda

To struggle, you should not only summon the masses
to follow you from outside but should concurrently
perform internal intimidation work in the masses.
Before the outbreak of many a struggle in the past you
only thought of preparing your armed force but
neglected the masses so after the struggles had
materialized, you found that your fighting force
was composed of only our own comrades. (Great 85).

Take care that no struggle is thought to be
the last one, there will be more struggles to come
after the one now in hand. Energy and spirit to continue
the many more struggles to come should be well preserved.
In order to attain this aim the following activities
must be performed :
1. Extend the fundamental organization of the masses
in the struggles.
2. Extend the organization of the 'Group'.
3. Propaganda inciting the masses to continue to struggle.
4. Avoid serious loss in struggles.
5. Secret demands (?) of the Group.

Struggles should not be considered by us as
successful unless we have performed the aforementioned
five kinds of activities in the struggles.

Carry out general propaganda for Non-payment
of rentals and land revolution, and secretly or
publicly militarize the peasants to accomplish the
preliminary step in the struggle for the political
administration of farm villages. (Kiang 11).

Extend and consolidate the organization of the
students unions. They will be the Headquarters of the
struggles. Oppose bad teachers, demand that the
finances of schools be made public, and courses in the
curriculum be changed, and oppose rotten education, and
slavish education, should be used as slogans in
propaganda with a view to securing the sympathy of
students of other schools and the community. (Great 60).

The Group should not centralize all its efforts
in the peasant movement as was formerly done but should
establish a fundation for labour movement in the cities
utilizing various sorts of organizations (as the Brothers
Groups or Sisters Groups) to unite the masses. Slogans
bearing upon the demands relating to the interests of
labourers should be put forth to start daily struggles.
Small business men should be led to oppose exhorbitant
taxes, students be guided to fight for their benefits,
and soldiers be instigated to demand wages in arrears
and better treatment and to participate in the labour
and peasant struggle thereby causing the collapse of
the reactionary armies. (Great 64).

Commence the soldiers movement according to the
notice from the Provincial Committee. Secure constant
contact with the soldiers, carry out propaganda and
establish sections of our Group among them. The
Universities should join in the movement organizing
soldiers movement Committees to plan schemes of
activities to be undertaken. (Great 52).
pages.zh:
-648

斗争、运动、组织和宣传之间的关系

要进行斗争，你不仅要从外部号召群众跟随你，还应在群众内部进行威慑工作。在过去许多斗争爆发之前，你只想着准备武装力量而忽视了群众，因此当斗争实现时，你发现你的战斗力量仅由我们自己的同志组成。（Great 85）。

注意不要认为任何一次斗争是最后一次，当前的斗争之后还会有更多的斗争。应妥善保留继续应对未来更多斗争的精力和精神。为了达到这一目的，必须进行以下活动：
1. 在斗争中扩展群众的基础组织。
2. 扩展“团体”的组织。
3. 进行宣传，激励群众继续斗争。
4. 避免在斗争中遭受严重损失。
5. 团体的秘密要求（？）

除非我们在斗争中完成了上述五种活动，否则我们不应认为斗争是成功的。

开展关于抗租和土地革命的一般性宣传，并秘密或公开地将农民军事化，以完成争取农村政治管理权斗争的初步步骤。（Kiang 11）。

扩展并巩固学生会的组织。它们将成为斗争的总部。反对不良教师，要求学校财务公开，更改课程，反对腐朽教育和奴化教育，应将这些作为宣传口号，以争取其他学校学生和社区的同情。（Great 60）。

团体不应像以前那样将所有精力集中在农民运动上，而应利用各种组织（如兄弟会或姐妹会）团结群众，在城市中为工人运动奠定基础。应提出涉及工人利益要求的口号，以发动日常斗争。应引导小商人反对苛捐杂税，引导学生争取自身利益，煽动士兵要求支付欠薪和改善待遇，并参与工农斗争，从而导致反动军队的崩溃。（Great 64）。

根据省委的通知开始士兵运动。与士兵保持经常联系，开展宣传，并在他们中间建立我们团体的分部。各大学应参与运动，组织士兵运动委员会，策划拟开展的活动方案。（Great 52）。

pages.en:
- 65 -

Uprising

Uprising is not child's play. It is not a
thing that can be accomplished when we want it. If
we want to stage an uprising, we hope it will be
successful, and if we wish it to be successful, we
must attain the following conditions : Firstly we
must have a large organization, which must be organized
at any time - farmers join the peasants committee and
labourers the union. The larger the organization
grows, the more influential we will become. Secondly
we must have vigorous branches of our Party or Group.
In order to enable the Party to direct the people to
obey our command, it is necessary to make our branches
powerful and capable of holding meetings. For every
one of our colleagues to be able to proceed with
work without depending upon his leaders is of utmost
importance. Thirdly, we must have the public tendency
to rise up, so prior to an uprising, it is necessary
to rouse the determination of the public in order to
make them realize the necessity of uprisings and
nothing else. Fourthly, we must have struggles by
the public. Thus before the Canton Uprising, the
seamen's union declared a strike and farmers refused
to pay autumn rents. To start an uprising is just
the same as firing a cracker, the fuse must be lit
first and then the cracker will explode. Fifthly,
we must arm the public. Therefore labour corps,
peasants revolutionary armies and youth vanguards must
be formed. To fight and shoot must be practiced in
normal times. During an uprising everyone by means
of his own gun disarms his opponent. In this way,
weapons may be obtained. Sixthly, the uprising must
be started when the reactionaries are in a state of
abstraction. For example: if we start an uprising
when the Kuomintang members are fighting among them-
selves or there is a shortage of rice or food in
the market, the Kuomintang will be in a great fright
and will not know how to offer resistance. Now what
form shall be adopted for an uprising? If we have
attained all the above mentioned, how shall we start
our uprising? We can mention the following two ways:
(1) The direct partial occupation of land and (2) The
extension of guerrilla warfare resulting in partial
occupation. (Great 132)

To carry out the uprising policy, it is necessary
to pay attention to the following : (1) The struggle
and uprising of labourers, peasants and soldiers in
various places will be entirely under the leadership
of the proletariat. (2) The developments will depend
upon the power of the organization of the public. (3)
An estimate of the strength of the reactionaries and
ourselves should be made and we must remove as far as
possible disorganization elements in order to prevent
our opponents from attacking them, thereby breaking our
line. (Great 132)

We must comply with the following terms in attacking
and occupying a hsien :-
(1) Struggles among farming villages in this hsien have
been developed, there are at least several district
struggles and the masses have foundation and suitable
armed influence in the occupied area. (2) The good basis
of city work in the hsien will not only strengthen the
power of masses to struggle, but also make the bourgeoisie
pages.zh:
- 65 -

起义

起义并非儿戏。这不是我们可以随心所欲就能完成的事情。如果我们想要发动起义，我们希望它能成功；而如果我们希望它成功，就必须具备以下条件：首先，我们必须拥有庞大的组织，该组织必须随时处于组织状态——农民加入农会，工人加入工会。组织越壮大，我们的影响力就越大。其次，我们必须拥有强有力的党或团体支部。为了使党能够指挥民众服从我们的命令，必须使我们的支部强大并具备召开会议的能力。让我们每一位同志都能在不依赖领导的情况下开展工作，这是至关重要的。第三，我们必须拥有公众的起义倾向，因此在起义之前，必须激发公众的决心，使他们认识到起义的必要性，别无其他。第四，我们必须有公众的斗争。因此，在广州起义之前，海员工会宣布罢工，农民拒绝缴纳秋租。发动起义就像放鞭炮一样，必须先点燃引信，鞭炮才会爆炸。第五，我们必须武装公众。因此，必须组建劳工队、农民革命军和青年先锋队。平时必须练习战斗和射击。在起义期间，每个人都要用自己的枪支解除对手的武装。通过这种方式，可以获得武器。第六，必须在反动派处于涣散状态时发动起义。例如：如果我们在国民党成员内部互相争斗，或者市场上出现米荒或食物短缺时发动起义，国民党将陷入极大的恐慌，不知如何抵抗。那么，起义应采取何种形式呢？如果我们具备了上述所有条件，该如何发动起义呢？我们可以提及以下两种方式：(1) 直接局部占领土地，以及 (2) 扩展游击战从而导致局部占领。（Great 132）

为了执行起义政策，必须注意以下几点：(1) 各地工人、农民和士兵的斗争与起义将完全在无产阶级领导下进行。(2) 事态的发展将取决于公众组织的力量。(3) 应对反动派和我方的力量进行评估，并必须尽可能清除无组织分子，以防止对手攻击他们，从而破坏我们的阵线。（Great 132）

在攻击和占领一个县时，我们必须遵守以下条款：
(1) 该县内的村庄斗争已经发展起来，至少有几个区的斗争，且群众在被占领地区拥有基础和适当的武装影响力。(2) 该县城市工作的良好基础，不仅会增强群众斗争的力量，还会使资产阶级

pages.en:
- 66 -

class hate the ruling class so that the latter will be
in a state of disintegration and incapable of maintaining
power. (3) When a city is to be the centre of the area
occupied, it should be left untouched and the struggle
should begin in the neighbouring villages. When there is
a sufficiently strong foundation in the peasant movement
in these villages, the City will then be occupied, thus
completing the uprising of this city. This applies to
the provincial city which will only be attacked when the
revolution in the whole province is nearing completion.
No vain attempt should be made before the time is ripe.
(Great 132).

Even after correction by the Central from its
tendency to veer towards the peaceful measures of
development, the Chekiang Group has from the Shanghai
Uprising to the Laichi struggle been proceeding along
a wrong course. This is the result of blind obedience.
In addition the old peaceful measures are still adopted
in other districts (such as Chekiang North). Therefore
we are trapped between these two extreme mistakes. On
the one hand we are attacked and destroyed before we can
establish a foundation and on the other we have no means
to further our movement and lead the public. These mistakes will not only prove dangerous obstacles to our
movement but also develop into a crisis for our revolution. Consequently the Provincial Committee considers
it absolutely necessary that these mistakes be corrected
and not allowed to remain in existence any longer,
Otherwise our work will never run along the proper course.
(Great 53).

The Provincial Committee has carefully considered
the situation as well as the strength of Chekiang South
from all points of view. It is not yet time for an
Uprising and consequently no Hsien may commence the
work of Uprising before permission has been obtained
from the Provincial Committee. During struggle
measures including arson and murder should be avoided
except in cases of emergency when, at least, wholesale
murder and arson will never be tolerated. (Great 53)

According to theory, Blind-Movement-Principle is
when a few individuals with no regard for the public
start the movement themselves. This is of course also
due to their under-estimating the power of the reactionaries and it is also because they have neglected the
necessity of preparing themselves for the necessary
conditions of 'Uprising'. In short, this principle
means that a few revolutionary comrades rely upon their
armed strength and undertake adventurous military
struggles. They will undoubtedly compel the people
to arm themselves and start the uprising with the result
that the movement will be transformed into independent
acts of terror. This will achieve nothing but the
degradation of position of the Party in the masses, waste
time and strength and lose us communistic vanguards.
(Great 154)

The terribly distressed state of the peasant mass
very easily leads to uprising of their own accord.
With regard to uprisings of this kind, the Party should
accelerate their movement in acquainting the manual
workers and shop assistants in a city of the important
significance of these uprisings and on the other hand
lead these uprisings on until Soviet is established
and extended.

阶级憎恨统治阶级，从而使后者处于瓦解状态，无法维持权力。(3) 当一座城市被定为被占领区域的中心时，应暂时不动它，斗争应从邻近村庄开始。当这些村庄的农民运动拥有足够强大的基础时，再占领该城市，从而完成该城市的起义。这适用于省会城市，只有在全省革命接近完成时才对其进行攻击。在时机成熟之前，不应进行徒劳的尝试。（Great 132）。

即使中央纠正了其倾向于和平发展措施的偏向，浙江小组从上海起义到莱次（Laichi，音译）斗争期间，一直沿着错误的路线前进。这是盲从的结果。此外，其他地区（如浙北）仍采用旧的和平措施。因此，我们被困在这两种极端错误之间。一方面，我们在建立基础之前就遭到攻击和摧毁；另一方面，我们没有手段来推进我们的运动并领导公众。这些错误不仅会成为我们运动的危险障碍，还会发展成我们革命的危机。因此，省委认为绝对有必要纠正这些错误，不再允许其存在，否则我们的工作将永远无法走上正轨。（Great 53）。

省委从各个角度仔细考虑了局势以及浙南的力量。目前还不是起义的时机，因此在获得省委许可之前，任何县都不得开始起义工作。在斗争期间，除非在紧急情况下，否则应避免包括纵火和谋杀在内的措施，而在任何情况下，大规模谋杀和纵火都是绝不容忍的。（Great 53）

根据理论，“盲动主义原则”是指少数人不顾公众，自行发动运动。这当然也是由于他们低估了反动派的力量，也是因为他们忽视了为“起义”的必要条件做好准备的必要性。简而言之，这一原则意味着少数革命同志依靠其武装力量，进行冒险的军事斗争。他们无疑会强迫民众武装起来并发动起义，结果导致运动转变为独立的恐怖行动。这除了降低党在群众中的地位、浪费时间和力量以及使我们失去共产主义先锋队员外，不会有任何成就。（Great 154）

农民群众极度困苦的状态很容易导致他们自发起义。对于这类起义，党应加快运动步伐，让城市中的手工工人和店员了解这些起义的重要意义，另一方面要领导这些起义，直到苏维埃建立并扩展。

- 67 -

As more than 80 or 90% of the population of China
are peasants, the movement of the Party at present
consequently tends to follow the peasant idea. As
soon as an uprising is started the peasants regard
the city as their only enemy owing to the fact that
the cruel taxation and oppression originates from
there, and therefore instead of cooperating with the
labourers to deal with the reactionary, attack the
inhabitants of the city without exception. Arson
and manslaughter occurs time after time to such an
extent that the small capitalists oppose us and the
labourers feeling that they do not benefit by the
uprising look upon the Soviet as a Peasant's Government
only. (Great 171)

----------
Red Terror

In enforcing the Red Terror, the following two
points should receive attention : (1) The Red Terror
is directed towards the reactionary and not to the
public; (2) The Red Terror is not to be carried out
by a few individuals but by the people. In other
words, when a corrupt member of the gentry or a loafer
is to be killed, this should be done only when the
people have risen up and agreed that this particular
person who is obstructing the movement must be removed.
The Red Terror carried out individually will only
drive public to lose confidence in the Party and
will serve a severe blow to our cause. (Great 35)

Even during the Red Terror by the public, acts of
arson and manslaughter should be corrected because they
are of no use, being committed by the peasants in their
temporary state of passion and high feeling. (Great 85)

You are quite right in resisting the White Terror
by means of Red Terror, but you should not carry it out
on a large military scale. (Great 73).

When you do not fully understand the feelings of
the public and yet have enforced the Red Terror, the
revolutionary feeling of the public will be greatly
excited. Due to lack of proper preparations, the
public will turn to rash movements which you will have
difficulty in controlling. (Great 78)

You have no determination for the struggle, you
do not know the way to struggle and you are not prepared
to carry out a movement to resist the payment of rent
as soon as the Red Terror is enforced, you have not led
the public to participate in the struggle and yet you
allow the excited masses to carry out their own free
movement and even do as you please yourselves. This will
undoubtedly bring forth no good results and you will
make the Group appear to be a tail of the masses.
(Great 78)

You are already wrong in neglecting to prepare
propaganda and inciting work on a gigantic scale; and
having allowed matters to go on as they are yet you
fail to use the proper slogans and permit the adoption
of the principle of arson and manslaughter. Therefore
the Red Terror will be transformed into armed struggle

由于中国80%至90%以上的人口是农民，党的运动目前 consequently（因此）倾向于追随农民思想。一旦起义开始，农民由于残酷的税收和压迫源自城市，便将城市视为唯一的敌人，因此他们不与工人合作对付反动派，而是无差别地攻击城市居民。纵火和杀人事件屡见不鲜，以至于小资本家反对我们，而工人觉得他们并未从起义中受益，便将苏维埃仅仅视为“农民政府”。（Great 171）

----------
红色恐怖

在执行红色恐怖时，应注意以下两点：(1) 红色恐怖针对的是反动派，而不是公众；(2) 红色恐怖不应由少数个人执行，而应由民众执行。换句话说，当要处决一名腐败的士绅或流氓时，只有在民众奋起并同意必须清除这个阻碍运动的特定人物时，才能这样做。个人实施的红色恐怖只会驱使公众失去对党的信心，并对我们的事业造成严重打击。（Great 35）

即使在民众实施红色恐怖期间，纵火和杀人行为也应予以纠正，因为这些行为是农民在暂时的情绪激动和高昂情感状态下做出的，毫无用处。（Great 85）

你们用红色恐怖来抵抗白色恐怖是完全正确的，但不应以大规模军事行动的方式来进行。（Great 73）。

当你们没有充分了解公众情绪却强行实施红色恐怖时，公众的革命情绪会被极大地激发。由于缺乏适当的准备，公众将转向鲁莽的行动，这将使你们难以控制。（Great 78）

你们没有斗争的决心，不知道斗争的方法，也没有准备在实施红色恐怖后立即开展抵制缴租的运动，你们没有领导公众参与斗争，反而让激动的群众进行自发的自由行动，甚至任由你们自己随心所欲。这无疑不会带来好的结果，并使团体显得像是群众的尾巴。（Great 78）

你们忽视进行大规模宣传和鼓动工作已经是错误的；在任由事态发展的同时，你们未能使用适当的口号，并允许采用纵火和杀人的原则。因此，红色恐怖将转变为武装斗争

and will certainly become out of control, and the absence
of proper slogans will lead the public to think that
these are the acts of bandits. (Great 79)

The Party of course should lead the struggle of
the peasants in exterminating landowners and corrupt
gentry and diminishing the influence of reactionaries
but a careful scheme must be laid out before taking the
lead in Incendiarism and Homicide and these have no
direct relation with the proper work and no real
benefit to the revolution. (Great 159)

Certain elements in villages, however, are of the
opinion that in starting a struggle the reactionary
Gentry must be put to death first. This, of course,
should not be prohibited in case of emergency, but we
should convince them that the method of "Red Terror
Assassination" should not be used as the fuse to start
the struggle. "Remember, we can obtain their sympathy
and full support only when we have convinced them of
the correctness of the measures we have suggested -
and only then can we lead the movement." This means
that before starting the movement we have to carry on
propaganda on an extensive scale and lead them to
struggle according to the policy and slogans of the
Land Revolution of the Party. (Great 158 - 13C)

The most reactionary and oppressive landlords
and gentry who are most hated by the peasants should
of course be killed by the public. But the wholesale
murder of gentry and lords thus creating a reign of
terror is not to be allowed and must be prevented.
(Hai 17)

According to your report, the Red Terror policy
adopted to resist the White Terror has resulted in the
armed struggle and the attack on the City. Now you
realize that as a result of the failure of this
movement, you have not only failed to materialize
the scheme to resist the payment of the rent but also
the scheme to reduce the rent. The revolutionary
feeling of the public has been suppressed and our
political influence on the masses eliminated. (Gr. 78)

并且肯定会失控，缺乏适当的口号会导致公众认为这些是匪徒的行为。（Great 79）

党当然应该领导农民消灭地主和腐败士绅、削弱反动派影响的斗争，但在带头进行纵火和杀人之前必须制定周密的计划，而这些行为与正当工作没有直接关系，对革命也没有真正的益处。（Great 159）

然而，农村中的某些元素认为，在开始斗争时必须先处死反动士绅。当然，在紧急情况下不应禁止这种做法，但我们应该说服他们，不应将“红色恐怖暗杀”作为发动斗争的引信。“记住，只有当我们让他们相信我们所建议的措施是正确的时，我们才能获得他们的同情和全力支持——也只有这样，我们才能领导运动。”这意味着在开始运动之前，我们必须进行广泛的宣传，并根据党的土地革命政策和口号领导他们进行斗争。（Great 158 - 13C）

那些最受农民痛恨的最反动、最压迫的地主和士绅，当然应由民众处决。但是，不允许也不得预防通过大规模屠杀士绅和领主来制造恐怖统治。（Hai 17）

根据你们的报告，为抵抗白色恐怖而采取的红色恐怖政策已导致武装斗争和对城市的攻击。现在你们意识到，由于这次运动的失败，你们不仅未能实现抵制缴租的计划，也未能实现减租的计划。公众的革命情绪受到压制，我们在群众中的政治影响也被消除。（Gr. 78）

Guerilla Warfare

What is guerilla warfare ? It is like this:
At a place where our power is not strong enough and
the peasant army is not well armed and yet the
struggle of the public has reached its zenith and
at the same time the reactionary party is still
able to defeat us with an army, we cannot therefore
occupy this area and are obliged to mobilize our
followers in various villages who will be advised
not to fight face to face with the reactionary
soldiers but to evade them and start riots and
uprising in other villages. They should be advised
to shift their activities from the original place
to other places on the arrival of the reactionary
soldiers. On the other hand sudden attacks are
to be made on these soldiers en route, disarm some
of them, seize their rice and extend our influence
from one place to another with a view to establishing
Soviet. But in guerilla warfare we should pay
attention to the following :

1. The Peasant army should be closely related to the
public.

2. On arrival at a village, the peasant army should
at once absorb the peasants of that village into
the army and start the uprising by killing the
land owners, corrupt gentry and loafers. But
they should not behave as bandits and loot in the
village. (Great 138).

The armed strength of the guerilla warfare
is secured through the regular attention of the
public. It is not to be an organization formed
by us by employing some persons as soldiers and
training them. The use of the guerilla warfare
is (1) To resist the armed force of the reactionary
party or to attack them as well as to support the
progress of the struggle of the people; (2) to
assist certain villages, where the work has not yet
been started but the neighbouring cities have been
so developed for the struggle that these places may
be occupied at any time, in starting the struggle;
(3) to start the uprising or assist the people to
rise up when the time is ripe but when the uprising
has not yet been started owing to certain oppression
or suppression. The guerilla warfare should always
be with the public unless during a critical period
when it is necessary to take shelter somewhere in
order to preserve the strength. (Great 85).

Guerilla warfare is one of the forms of the
struggle or new tactics in warfare. Although it
is closely related to struggle and the mass,
its main object is to extend the movement of the
masses and establish a more extensive revolutionary
area.

When a delay in starting the peasants' uprising
even for the purpose of making fuller preparations is
not permitted or little greater success can be achieved
from a material point of view, the Party should therefore
adopt the guerilla warfare (That is, cities or large

游击战

什么是游击战？情况如下：
在我方力量不够强大、农民军队武装不良，但群众斗争已达到高潮，同时反动派仍能凭借军队击败我们的地方，我们无法占领该区域，因此必须动员各村的追随者，并告诫他们不要与反动士兵正面交战，而是避开他们，在其他村庄发动骚乱和起义。应建议他们在反动士兵到达时，将活动从原地转移到其他地方。另一方面，要在途中对这些士兵发动突然袭击，解除部分士兵的武装，缴获他们的粮食，并将我们的影响力从一个地方扩展到另一个地方，以期建立苏维埃。但在游击战中，我们应注意以下几点：

1. 农民军队应与公众保持密切联系。

2. 到达村庄后，农民军队应立即吸收该村的农民加入军队，并通过杀害地主、腐败士绅和游手好闲者来发动起义。但他们不应像土匪那样在村庄里进行掠夺。（Great 138）。

游击战的武装力量是通过公众的持续关注而获得的。它不是由我们雇佣一些人作为士兵并加以训练而组成的组织。使用游击战的目的是：(1) 抵抗反动派的武装力量或攻击他们，以及支持人民斗争的进展；(2) 协助某些尚未开始工作但邻近城市斗争已发展到随时可能占领这些地方的村庄，以启动斗争；(3) 当时机成熟但因某种压迫或镇压而尚未发动起义时，发动起义或协助人民起义。除非在需要到某处避难以保存实力的关键时期，否则游击战应始终与公众在一起。（Great 85）。

游击战是斗争的一种形式或战争中的新战术。虽然它与斗争和群众密切相关，但其主要目标是扩大群众运动并建立更广泛的革命区域。

当即使为了做更充分的准备也不允许延迟发动农民起义，或者从物质角度来看可以取得稍大的成功时，党因此应采取游击战（即，不占领城市或大

pages.en:
- 78 -

town are not to be occupied, nor any army be organized.
With a small number of men, incessant attacks are to
be made on the troops of the Government or the armed
force of the landlords) (Great 196).

At a place where the conflict between the
peasants and the upper classes is in a very
serious state, a small dispute in the daily
life should be developed into an armed encounter.
Consequently the guerilla warfare has become one
of the most important methods of struggle at these
places. Communists should therefore be more
determined to lead these struggles so as to make
them better organized. (Hai 51).

The resolutions passed at the 9th Meeting
of the Executive Committee of the Communist
Internationale points out that the peasants'
automatic guerilla warfare of one or a few hsien
in various provinces or districts can
become the starting point of the victory of the
people's uprising of the whole country under the
following condition. It is not absolutely
necessary to transform the guerilla warfare into
a local uprising. It can only be transformed when
a large number of peasant masses are mobilized
and when they are demanding the establishment of
their own political power of their own while the
reactionary influence is quickly waning.
Consequently when the guerilla warfare has been
extended to a larger area and due to the
participation of a big mass shown signs of
developing into a local uprising of a district
or Hsien, the Party should pay particular attention
to the strength, preparations, organizations,
plans and strategy in order to lead the labourers
and masses of the places and cooperate with them to
further the uprising. Efforts should be concentrated
to fulfil all slogans of struggle, exterminate all
reactionary influence with a view to materializing
the policy of the Soviet Political Power and above
all extending the limits of the uprising to the
adjoining cities or areas. (Hai 43 Great 159).

The main duties of guerilla warfare are to
(1) materialise the slogans of the peasants'
struggle (confiscate the land of the land
owners and divide it among the peasants;
massacre the landlords and corrupt gentry,
organize peasants' representative meetings
and Peasants' Soviet Political Power) and
extend the peasants' activities to the
revolutionary battle line.

(2) absorb the surviving courageous youths and
proletarians as well as semi-proletarians
into the guerilla warfare of the Red Army
with a view to enlarging it into a Labourers'
and Peasants' Revolutionary Red Army.

(3) Weaken the influence of the reactionaries by
disarming the volunteers and policemen etc.
