城镇，也不组建任何军队。用少数人不断攻击政府部队或地主的武装力量）（Great 196）。

在农民与上层阶级之间的冲突处于非常严重状态的地方，日常生活中的小争端应发展为武装冲突。因此，游击战已成为这些地方最重要的斗争方法之一。共产党人因此应更坚定地领导这些斗争，使其更有组织性。（Hai 51）。

共产国际执行委员会第九次会议通过的决议指出，在以下条件下，各省或地区一个或几个县农民的自发游击战可以成为全国人民起义胜利的起点。将游击战转变为地方起义并非绝对必要。只有当大量农民群众被动员起来，并且他们要求建立自己的政治权力，而反动影响迅速减弱时，才能进行这种转变。因此，当游击战扩展到更大区域，并由于大量群众的参与而显示出发展成为某个地区或县的局部起义的迹象时，党应特别注意力量、准备、组织、计划和战略，以便领导当地的劳工和群众并与他们合作，进一步推进起义。应集中力量实现所有斗争口号，消灭所有反动影响，以实现苏维埃政权的政策，最重要的是将起义的范围扩展到邻近的城市或地区。（Hai 43 Great 159）。

游击战的主要职责是：
(1) 实现农民斗争的口号（没收地主的土地并在农民中分配；屠杀地主和腐败士绅，组织农民代表会议和农民苏维埃政权），并将农民的活动扩展到革命战线。

(2) 吸收幸存的勇敢青年、无产阶级以及半无产阶级加入红军的游击战，以期将其扩大为工农革命红军。

(3) 通过解除志愿团和警察等的武装，削弱反动派的影响。

pages.en:
- 71 -

The guerilla warfare therefore should be started
from the demands of the masses and conducted under the
leadership and organization of the masses. It should
be carried out in conjunction with propaganda and
inciting work. (Great 159).

With relations to the question of guerilla
warfare, the Central Notification in one part
points out "The guerilla warfare is started from
the mass struggle and must be used to aid the mass
struggle". At various places, however, the guerilla
warfare is still regarded as the Red Terror Method
of Incendiarism and Homicide which is independent
of the masses. Isolation from the masses will surely
give the reactionary influence a chance to launch an
attack, thereby discourging the masses in the struggle.
This mistake must be corrected. (Great 132).

Guerilla warfare is to be used to resist the
armed force of reactionaries in a mass struggle
(volunteers troops or policemen) or to attack the
reactionaries (disarming the landlords or gentry).
It is to use a small number of armed men to support
the mass struggle in order to make further progress.
Consequently it should not be separated from the
mass struggle and particular attention must be made
to create armed organization among the masses.
(Great 132).

Guerilla warfare also embodies the meaning of
starting the mass struggle. Therefore, under the
following circumstances we can and should send
guerilla groups to assist the peasants in the struggle:
(1) When in an occupied area (which requires external
extension) there are Red Army or Red Vanguards which
exist publicly, we should send Red Army Vanguards
to the neighbouring villages to incite the public
to struggle.

(2) At places where we have our labourers, peasants
and student armies, (such as Kian where there are
rifles), small groups should be sent to villages
to incite the public to start the struggle.

(3) At places where the peasants have already risen
up or have very high feelings for struggle but
occupation has not yet been carried out owing
to the suppression by certain reactionary
influence (volunteers and garrison) we can send
guerilla groups to assist in starting the uprising
and reinforcing the armed force of the guerilla
warfare.

The Party should also pay attention to the
armed strength of the peasants. Formerly we had
the peasants armed, we assembled them together
and formed a labourers and peasants revolutionary
army similar to the ordinary troops (once recruited
their families required money). As soon as we were
short of money, these armies were transformed into
bandit-like troops. This requires improvement.
(Great 132. 158).
pages.zh:
- 71 -

因此，游击战应从群众的需求出发，并在群众的领导和组织下进行。它应与宣传和鼓动工作结合进行。（Great 159）。

关于游击战问题，《中央通告》的一部分指出：“游击战始于群众斗争，必须用于援助群众斗争”。然而，在各处，游击战仍被视为一种独立于群众之外的纵火和杀人的红色恐怖手段。脱离群众肯定会给反动影响提供发动攻击的机会，从而打击群众在斗争中的积极性。必须纠正这一错误。（Great 132）。

游击战用于在群众斗争中抵抗反动派的武装力量（志愿团或警察）或攻击反动派（解除地主或士绅的武装）。它是用少数武装人员支持群众斗争，以取得进一步进展。因此，它不应脱离群众斗争，必须特别注意在群众中建立武装组织。（Great 132）。

游击战也蕴含着发动群众斗争的意义。因此，在以下情况下，我们可以且应该派遣游击小组协助农民进行斗争：
(1) 在需要向外扩展的被占领区域内，存在公开活动的红军或红色先锋队，我们应派遣红军先锋队到邻近村庄，鼓动公众进行斗争。

(2) 在我们拥有工人、农民和学生军队的地方（如吉安，那里有步枪），应派遣小组到村庄，鼓动公众开始斗争。

(3) 在农民已经起义或对斗争情绪非常高涨，但由于某些反动势力（志愿团和驻军）的镇压而尚未实施占领的地方，我们可以派遣游击小组协助发动起义并加强游击战的武装力量。

党还应注意农民的武装力量。以前我们武装农民，将他们聚集在一起，组成类似普通部队的工农革命军（一旦招募，其家庭就需要钱）。一旦我们缺钱，这些军队就变成了像土匪一样的部队。这需要改进。（Great 132. 158）。

pages.en:
- 72 -

The past guerilla warfare in various places
brought about many defects which were detrimental
to the development of the struggle or which even
destroyed it. Therefore we should try to amend these
wrongs in the following ways. Firstly, to prevent the
masses from being affected by the propaganda of
landowners and gentry leading them to look upon the
guerilla warfare as the acts of bandits. Consequently
guerilla warfare must be started at the request of the
masses and be under their leadership and organization.
It should be carried out in conjunction with propaganda
and inciting work. Secondly, the tendency to destroy
cities, and the aimless incendiarism and massacre, which
undoubtedly endanger the developments of the influence
of the Party among labourers and the masses, should be
eliminated. The Party should therefore endeavour to
do away with the tendency but should lead the struggles
of peasants in killing landowners and gentries and
weakening the influence of the reactionaries. The
aimless incendiarism and slaughter which has no
relation to the main work and no real benefits for
the revolution should be strongly opposed. Thirdly,
the present guerilla warfare is badly organized.
Therefore, well planned, organized and centralized
directions should be given (Peasants Cooperative
Association) (Hai 51).

When the masses' struggle-feelings are very
excited, several tens of persons may disarm the Peace
Reservation Corps and burn their houses as well
as massacre rowdies and evil gentry and confiscate
their properties, which should be distributed among
poor peasants. A meeting of a large number of
peasants and masses should then be immediately
convened to promulgate the general regulations of
land revolution and establish the Soviet. The land
deeds should be burnt publicly and the wrongs of
these rowdies denounced. Propaganda in favour of
the extension of Soviet land revolution should better
be carried out by the peasants committee if the
committee is well organized and has the trust of
farming masses.

Peasants struggles should not be carried out
by peaceful measures. We should make preparations
for an armed struggle of which guerilla warfare
is of the utmost importance. Guerilla warfare must
originate from the masses and should on no account
be seperated from the public, thus making it as an
independent military movement.

In the course of guerilla warfare and struggles,
the 'Group' should organize propaganda parties (of 3 or
5 persons each and not more than 6 persons) which should
carry out propaganda work as usual at places where the
mass movement has occurred in order that the inhabitants
there will not regard us as common troops or bandits.

There are not many provincial defence troops
at your place, and therefore you may start small armed
disturbances in villages where the force of the
defence army is small (N.B. the object of these
disturbances is to save us from being besieged) in
order to isolate the power of the troops and so that
even if we be surrounded, we may break through the
siege by our force. One of the following two ways
ways may be adopted according to circumstances.
pages.zh:
- 72 -

过去各地的游击战带来了许多缺陷，这些缺陷不利于斗争的发展，甚至破坏了斗争。因此，我们应该尝试通过以下方式纠正这些错误。首先，防止群众受到地主和士绅宣传的影响，导致他们将游击战视为土匪行为。因此，游击战必须应群众的要求发起，并在他们的领导和组织下进行。它应与宣传和鼓动工作结合进行。其次，应消除破坏城市以及无目的的纵火和屠杀的倾向，这无疑会危及党在劳工和群众中影响力的发展。因此，党应努力消除这种倾向，但应领导农民杀死地主和士绅并削弱反动派影响的斗争。强烈反对与主要工作无关且对革命没有真正利益的无目的纵火和杀戮。第三，目前的游击战组织不善。因此，应给予计划周密、有组织且集中的指导（农民合作社协会）（Hai 51）。

当群众的斗争情绪非常激动时，几十个人可以解除和平保卫团（Peace Reservation Corps）的武装，烧毁他们的房屋，屠杀流氓和恶霸士绅，并没收他们的财产，这些财产应分配给贫农。随后应立即召开大量农民和群众的会议，颁布土地革命的一般条例并建立苏维埃。应公开焚烧地契，并谴责这些流氓的罪行。如果农民委员会组织良好并得到农耕群众的信任，有利于扩展苏维埃土地革命的宣传最好由农民委员会进行。

农民斗争不应通过和平手段进行。我们应为武装斗争做准备，其中游击战至关重要。游击战必须源于群众，决不能脱离公众，使其成为一种独立的军事运动。

在游击战和斗争过程中，“小组”应组织宣传队（每队3至5人，不超过6人），在发生群众运动的地方照常开展宣传工作，以便当地居民不将我们视为普通部队或土匪。

你所在地的省防军不多，因此你可以在防御军力量薄弱的村庄发动小型武装骚乱（注：这些骚乱的目的是使我们免于被包围），以孤立部队的力量，这样即使我们被包围，也可以凭借我们的力量突破包围。可根据情况采取以下两种方式之一。

pages.en:
- 73 -

(1) To scatter and go among the peasants in various
villages.

(2) To proceed to neighbouring villages or hsiens
where the military force is weak in order to
preserve our strength. If the troops (which
surround us) are incapable of destroying
us, we may remain inside, but accelerate the
progress of our work and establish relations
with work in neighbouring places.

The resolution points out that guerilla warfare
as well as uprising should be immediately started
in Chekiang South. Regarding this the Party should
therefore intensify the work in this district and
strengthen the relations among the Provincial
Committee and the ranks of the Party. (Great 191).
pages.zh:
- 73 -

(1) 分散并进入各个村庄的农民中。

(2) 前往军事力量薄弱的邻近村庄或县，以保存我们的实力。如果包围我们的部队无法消灭我们，我们可以留在内部，但加快工作进度，并与邻近地区的工作建立联系。

决议指出，浙南应立即开始游击战和起义。对此，党应加强该地区的工作，并加强省委与党内各级之间的关系。（Great 191）。

pages.en:
- 74 -

Partial Occupation

What is meant by direct partial occupation of land? It is this: In a province or at a certain place where our power is strong enough and the peasants army is well armed and the reactionary party is powerless to attack us, we then occupy this place and establish our government. If the reactionary party despatches troops to the place, we fight with them. For example: Hai Loh Poong, Kwang, was occupied in this way. (Great 138)

Partial occupation and occupation of cities or towns is not child's play. To occupy a city or a town you must pay attention to the following :
(for conditions of occupying a village see notice for Chicu Teu (autumn struggle ?) :-
a) Farming village struggles in this hsien have been developed and there is a possibility of establishing certain foundations of the masses in several villages or certain villages have been occupied and defended with appropriate armed force.
(b) Inside the city of the hsien, the city work has some foundations; labourers have good organization and armed forces; suitable work has been carried out in the reactionary troops and the bourgeoisie classes have been influenced by us.
(c) When the ruling class is very weak in power or is in a state of disintegration and incapable of maintaining its present state.
(d) There must be at least in the neighbouring hsians or several of them the possibility of occupying the area where the masses have established good foundation. In addition a careful military plan must be prepared. In short the mass movement is to be responsible for the occupation of a city while the military force is only to assist. You must not attempt the movement until you feel sure of your success nor when the mass is not in a position to receive our direction in full. We have some carefully considered matters and think that at present no cities should be occupied in Chekiang pending further developments in the work. Detailed conditions should be reported to the Provincial Committee and no movement should be started before permission is obtained from the Committee.

In an occupied area standing red armies and volunteer armies (?) are required. Red garrisons should be formed over a wide area.

Relation between Uprising and Struggle

The mass struggle needs not necessarily be in the form of military movement, although the final object of the Party and Group is to seize the political power and materialize the society of the Communist Party. It does not mean, however, that the political power must be seized as soon as the struggle has been started. The responsible comrades at various places have neglected to carefully study the significance of 'struggle' and consequently when a struggle is started, they have not secured sufficient numbers of the masses to do the work with the result that "all struggles are uprisings and none of the uprisings are successful". (Great 85).
pages.zh:
- 74 -

局部占领

何谓对土地的直接局部占领？即：在一个省份或某个地方，当我们的力量足够强大，农民军队武装精良，而反动派无力攻击我们时，我们就占领该地并建立我们的政府。如果反动派向该地派遣军队，我们就与其作战。例如：广东的海陆丰就是这样被占领的。（Great 138）

局部占领以及占领城市或城镇并非儿戏。要占领一个城市或城镇，必须注意以下事项：
（关于占领村庄的条件，见秋斗通知 :-
(a) 本县的农村斗争已得到发展，有可能在几个村庄或某些村庄建立一定的群众基础，或者某些村庄已被占领并由适当的武装力量进行防守。
(b) 在县城内部，城市工作有一定基础；工人有良好的组织和武装力量；在反动军队中开展了适当的工作，资产阶级阶层受到了我们的影响。
(c) 统治阶级权力非常薄弱，或处于瓦解状态，无法维持其现状。
(d) 至少在邻近的一个或几个县，必须具备在群众已建立良好基础的地区进行占领的可能性。此外，必须制定周密的军事计划。简言之，群众运动负责占领城市，而军事力量仅起辅助作用。在确信能够成功之前，或在群众无法完全接受我们指导的情况下，不得尝试发动运动。我们经过慎重考虑，认为目前浙江不应占领任何城市，待工作有进一步发展后再作打算。详细情况应向省委报告，在未获得委员会许可之前，不得发动任何运动。

在被占领地区，需要常备红军和志愿军（?）。应在广大区域组建红色驻防部队。

起义与斗争的关系

群众斗争不一定非要采取军事行动的形式，尽管党和团体的最终目标是夺取政权并实现共产党的社会理想。然而，这并不意味着一旦开始斗争就必须立即夺取政权。各地的负责同志忽视了对“斗争”意义的仔细研究，因此，当斗争开始时，他们未能争取到足够数量的群众来开展工作，导致“所有斗争都变成起义，而没有一次起义取得成功”。（Great 85）。

pages.en:
- 75 -

Struggle need not necessarily be uprising. An
uprising is the continuation of a struggle and is the
development of the struggle to such a strong degree
that the political power is seized and the Soviet
established. Without daily training in struggle,
you cannot expect to start an uprising nor can you
start a sudden uprising without having maintained
and developed the daily struggle. As a matter of
fact the dicta "all struggles are uprisings", "one
uprising will be successful", "To be afraid to conduct
struggles" and "To be unwilling to conduct struggles"
are all the evil results of the blind-obedience-doctrine
and opportunism. (Great 65)

Having no clear idea of the difference between
struggle and uprising (no matter whether it is small
or large) you always consider struggle as uprising
with the result that you are afraid to conduct struggle
and the struggle therefore disappears altogether.
(Great 65).

The necessary conditions for a city uprising are :
(1) The excited revolutionary feelings of the labourers
and the development of their daily economic struggle.
(2) The disintegrating state of the ruling class.
(3) The hatred and bitterness against the citizens
(bourgeoisie) and where the downfall of the ruling class
has the public approvation.
(4) The preparation of the revolutionary strength of
the labouring class.

In fact the Party should never neglect the direction
of the economic and political struggle of labourers in
various hsiers, but redouble their efforts in this
movement. Taking advantage of every trifling dispute,
you should lead the labourers to start the struggle and
convince them of the importance of seizing the political
power by uprising and with the cooperation of the
peasants overthrowing the ruling class. These are
material preparations for a city uprising. The close
establishment of a relation between the labour uprising and
the peasant uprising rests heavily on the shoulders of the
Party. These single uprisings can never achieve any
success. (Great 196)

It is a great mistake to overlook the strength
of the labourers and peasants. The duty of the Party
is to lead and direct the daily struggle of the labourers
and teach them armed uprising. The city labour
uprising is the victory for the revolution. (Great 196)

Due to neglect of duty by the Hsien and town
Committees, the Peasants uprising and struggle became
independent. You must try to connect them although
they should carry on their work independently, so as
to facilitate the work of extension and making it more
difficult for our opponents to attack us.

It is pure blind-obedience to establish an
independent 'uprising committee' with branches at
various villages, because it means that without starting
the mass struggle you are thinking of obtaining victory
by means of military preparations. What a serious
mistake this is. You should at once correct it, other-
wise the 'Yung Kong Group' will result in tragic failure.
(Great 64)
pages.zh:
- 75 -

斗争不一定是起义。起义是斗争的延续，是斗争发展到如此强烈的程度，以至于夺取了政权并建立了苏维埃。如果没有日常的斗争训练，你就不能指望发动起义；如果没有维持和发展日常斗争，你也不能发动突然的起义。事实上，“所有斗争都是起义”、“一次起义就会成功”、“害怕开展斗争”和“不愿开展斗争”等论调，都是盲从主义和机会主义的恶果。（Great 65）

由于对斗争和起义（无论大小）之间的区别没有清晰的概念，你总是将斗争视为起义，结果导致你害怕开展斗争，从而使斗争完全消失。（Great 65）。

城市起义的必要条件是：
(1) 工人的革命情绪高涨及其日常经济斗争的发展。
(2) 统治阶级处于瓦解状态。
(3) 对市民（资产阶级）的仇恨和愤慨，且统治阶级的垮台得到公众的认可。
(4) 劳动阶级革命力量的准备。

事实上，党绝不应忽视对各县政府中工人经济和政治斗争的指导，而应加倍努力推动这一运动。利用每一个微小的争端，引导工人开始斗争，使他们相信通过起义夺取政权以及与农民合作推翻统治阶级的重要性。这些是城市起义的物质准备。密切建立工人起义与农民起义之间的关系，重任在于党。这些单独的起义永远不可能取得任何成功。（Great 196）

忽视工人和农民的力量是一个巨大的错误。党的职责是领导和指导工人的日常斗争，并教导他们进行武装起义。城市工人起义是革命的胜利。（Great 196）

由于县和镇委员会疏忽职守，农民起义和斗争变得各自为政。虽然它们应独立开展工作，但你必须努力将它们联系起来，以便于扩展工作，并使对手更难攻击我们。

建立独立的“起义委员会”并在各个村庄设立分支机构，纯属盲从，因为这意味着在不发动群众斗争的情况下，企图通过军事准备取得胜利。这是一个多么严重的错误。你应该立即纠正它，否则“永工集团”（Yung Kong Group，音译）将导致悲剧性的失败。（Great 64）

pages.en:
- 76 -

Instead of considering the extension of the
activities to a larger area and developing the
struggle to uprising with a view to establishing
the Soviet foundation and executing the policy of
the Soviet, you instantly attack a city as soon as the
struggle is commenced and massacre the people, set
fire to property, and rob and loot. In short you
confine your activities to one place with the
result that the people are led to think that the
land revolution is no better than bandit activities
and does not work for the benefit of the peasants.
Consequently you can not maintain what success you have
attained. Your line may be easily broken through
by the enemy. (Great 153).

The uprising is to be developed from the daily
small struggle. Therefore comrades at various places
should seize every trifling matter and whenever there is
a chance for struggle start is without delay. In
addition to the rent and rice question which will easily
form an important struggle, you should seize every in-
cident of oppression or insulting of peasants by the
rowdies, policemen, troops such as disputes over one
cooper, etc, to start the struggle. No matter whether
there are only a few persons present at the beginning,
even one or two, just start the struggle, once, twice,
etc. and eventually the number of men will be greatly
increased, when the struggle can take form of
uprising. So at the beginning you need not commit
homicide or incendiarism; you just hold a
demonstration, quarrel with the oppressors and when
the number of man increases, then massacre rowdies,
disarm the troops, organize and enlarge the revolutionary
army, red garrison and youth vanguards. Propaganda on
land revolution and Soviet political power should then
be conducted thus inciting the revolutionary and
political feeling to a climax. In the end a village
or a town can be occupied and a Soviet political power
can be established.

You have neglected to start the daily struggle;
you have concentrated your attention on the preparations
for the big struggle or uprising. But you should
know that the daily struggle will stir up the
revolutionary spirit and enlighten the political
knowledge as well as strengthen the foundation of the
organization. Without these preliminaries, the
large struggle or uprising will not succeed in inciting
the public feeling. (Great 153)

If the peasant struggle struggle and the city
struggle are not related and do not cooperate together,
the peasant struggle can not develop independently
with the result that the success is almost certain to
disappear, (Great 153)

We should energetically lead the labour class and
their friends - poor people and the citizens - to beat
down the capitalists. During the struggle we should
put forwards various demands for the youth labourers.
It should be remembered that our directing power can
only be secured during the struggle and our closest
object is land revolution and city uprising, the
foundation of which must be laid in the struggle.
(Tung 3)

In future you should seize all opportunities to
use the slogan of "resist landtax, rent, demand increase
pages.zh:
- 76 -

你没有考虑将活动扩展到更大的区域，并将斗争发展为起义，以建立苏维埃基础并执行苏维埃政策，而是在斗争一开始就立即攻击城市，屠杀人民，焚烧财产，抢劫掠夺。简言之，你将活动局限在一个地方，导致人们认为土地革命并不比土匪活动好多少，也不为农民谋福利。因此，你无法维持已取得的成果。你的防线很容易被敌人突破。（Great 153）。

起义应从日常的小规模斗争中发展而来。因此，各地的同志应抓住每一件琐事，只要有机会开展斗争，就立即开始。除了容易形成重要斗争的租米问题外，你还应抓住流氓、警察、军队压迫或侮辱农民的每一个事件，如关于一个铜板的纠纷等，来发起斗争。不管开始时只有几个人在场，甚至只有一两个人，也要开始斗争，一次、两次等，最终人数会大大增加，此时斗争可以采取起义的形式。所以在开始时，你不必犯下杀人或纵火罪；你只需举行示威，与压迫者争吵，当人数增加时，再屠杀流氓，解除军队武装，组织并扩大革命军队、红色驻防部队和青年先锋队。随后应开展关于土地革命和苏维埃政权的宣传，从而将革命和政治情绪推向高潮。最后，可以占领一个村庄或城镇，并建立苏维埃政权。

你忽视了开始日常斗争；你将注意力集中在大规模斗争或起义的准备上。但你应该知道，日常斗争会激发革命精神，启发政治知识，并加强组织基础。没有这些预备工作，大规模斗争或起义将无法成功激发公众情绪。（Great 153）

如果农民斗争和城市斗争没有联系且不相互合作，农民斗争就无法独立发展，结果几乎注定会失败，（Great 153）

我们应该积极领导工人阶级及其朋友——穷人和市民——去打击资本家。在斗争中，我们应该为青年工人提出各种要求。应当记住，我们的指导权力只能在斗争中获得，而我们最迫切的目标是土地革命和城市起义，其基础必须在斗争中奠定。（Tung 3）

今后，你们应抓住一切机会，利用“抗粮、抗租、要求增加

pages.en:
- 77 -

in wages" etc. to incite the feeling of the public
with a view to starting the daily struggle which will
be developed into an uprising. Before the outbreak,
extensive propaganda should be conducted among the
public so as to make it the desire of the public to
light the fuse. You should never start the movement
when the public are still ignorant of the meaning and
object. (Great 45)

Our comrades have abandoned the city work and
devoted their time to accelerating the commencement of the
uprising, while the peasants owing to oppression over
a long period will not believe in the fact that the
daily struggle will bring forth success with the result
that they are willing to undertake the work of uprising
once and for all. Consequently our comrades have no
time to correct this wrong idea. (Particularly the
Special Committee of West Chekiang) [Great 35).

The public is not a united body therefore every member
keeps his suffering to himself and having no experience
of struggle does not realize his own strength.
Consequently it is our duty to make him understand that
the only way to redress his sufferings is to unite with
others and stand on the same line to fight against
the ruling class and the capitalists. On the other
hand the Party and Group should have extensive
organization and strong determination to lead the public
through the struggle so as to make them understand that
our organization is fighting for the benefit of the
labourers and peasants. Our foundation will thereby
be consolidated and the public will therefore
willingly follow our leadership. (Great 85)

Peasants struggle and uprising will be unsuccessful
if no assistance is obtained from the labourers in
cities and villages. You should therefore commence
immediately the work among youth manual workers and
organize their unions. (Great 153)

At present there is no foundation of city work
in the whole province of Chekiang but only preparations
of military force in villages and therefore we have
no hope of city uprisings. You should not use
guerilla groups and heroic red terror such as assassi-
nation corps to rouse the public to attack cities as
these are too independent. (Great 85)

The duty of absorbing the masses is necessary
for armed uprising -- because to fulfil this duty
is the preliminary step of the new revolution. It
also means that the propaganda slogans of struggles
are changed into slogans of practical movement.

The Group should besides appointing a portion of
its brave labour comrades to participate in the military
training and secret organizations conducted by the
Party, make strong efforts to select radical elements
among youth labourers. (Sang 6)

Struggles should not be developed into uprising.
The highest object is to materialise the partial
occupation of villages. (Hai 5)
pages.zh:
- 77 -

工资”等口号来激发公众情绪，旨在发动将发展为起义的日常斗争。在爆发之前，应在公众中进行广泛的宣传，使其成为公众点燃导火索的愿望。当公众尚不了解其意义和目标时，切勿发动运动。（Great 45）

我们的同志放弃了城市工作，致力于加速起义的开始，而农民由于长期受压迫，不相信日常斗争会带来成功，结果他们愿意一劳永逸地进行起义工作。因此，我们的同志没有时间纠正这种错误观念。（特别是浙西特委）[Great 35)。

公众不是一个统一的团体，因此每个成员都独自忍受苦难，由于缺乏斗争经验，没有认识到自己的力量。因此，我们有责任让他们明白，弥补苦难的唯一途径是与他人团结起来，站在同一阵线上对抗统治阶级和资本家。另一方面，党和团体应有广泛的组织和坚定的决心，通过斗争领导公众，使他们明白我们的组织是为工人和农民的利益而战。我们的基础由此得以巩固，公众也将自愿跟随我们的领导。（Great 85）

如果得不到城市和乡村工人的援助，农民斗争和起义将不会成功。因此，你应该立即开始在青年体力劳动者中开展工作，并组织他们的工会。（Great 153）

目前，整个浙江省没有城市工作的基础，只有在村庄中的军事力量准备，因此我们对城市起义不抱希望。你不应该使用游击队组和英雄式的红色恐怖（如暗杀队）来煽动公众攻击城市，因为这些行动过于独立。（Great 85）

吸收群众的任务对于武装起义是必要的——因为履行这一任务是新革命的初步步骤。这也意味着斗争的宣传口号转变为实际行动的口号。

团体除了指派一部分勇敢的工人同志参加党进行的军事训练和秘密组织外，还应大力在青年工人中挑选激进分子。（Sang 6）

斗争不应发展为起义。最高目标是实现村庄的局部占领。（Hai 5）

pages.en:
- 78 -

During the course of struggle, you should extend
as much as possible the work of red terror and pro-
paganda such as distributing handbills, killing land-
owners, rowdies and gentries, burning their houses and
confiscating their properties and then mass meetings
should be convened. You should form farm labourers
revolutionary corps and red garrisons and select some
strong peasants to participate in the movement so as to
conduct guerilla warfare and armed uprising. (Gr. 185)

Because it is difficult to conduct guerrila warfare
inside cities, you should not do so until uprising and
street skirmishes in the cities have commenced. (Great 196)

Struggle is important for guerrila warfare, and
military preparations in various villages and seizure of
enemy's weapons are important for struggle, so that
guerrila warfare cannot be declared without the public
support thus making it as indepent military movement.
Because guerrila warfare is different from armed
uprising or attacking of cities, you should not despise
the latter nor ignore mass work, and at the same time
you should not devote all your attention to the former.
(Great 93)

During the struggle (on the night of June 19) in
killing rowdies and gentries you have neglected the
following points. You did not make sufficient pre-
parations and carry out propaganda beforehand. Owing
to the fact that none of the masses participated in the
struggle but only several tens of our comrades, on the
following day the gentries and rowdies had all fled.
During that struggle though the reactionary force in
the city was feeble yet you did not extend the movement
by propaganda and excitement but nullified the struggle.
(Great 73)

Our comrades are all pleased to hear about and
conduct uprising, partial occupation and guerrila war-
fare. For this reason you disregard your daily work
and pay attention only to preparation of military
movement. Military preparation is, however, obtained
from daily work and is only a portion of the whole
preparation for uprising. Proletarians revolutions
and military movement depends entirely upon the masses.
Military opportunism is blind-obedience-doctrine, which
mistakes the Bolshevik Group should not commit You
have misunderstood the significance and action of the
struggle and forgotten to do your work which is the
basis of our Group. (Great 85).

Instead of attacking and occupying cities as soon
as you have led the masses to conduct the movement of
resisting rent payments, you should accelerate the
progress of our work in order to threaten and prevent
the landlords and ruling class from proceeding to the
villages to collect rent. In fact we will have occupied
these villages. Then you extend the organization of the
masses and develop the revolutionary influence and when
sufficient foundation is established you may start guerrila
warfare and occupy publicly --- remember that you should
not establish the Soviet before good mass foundation
pages.zh:
- 78 -

在斗争过程中，你们应尽可能扩大红色恐怖及宣传工作，例如散发传单、杀害地主、流氓及士绅，焚烧其房屋并没收其财产，随后召开群众大会。你们应组建雇农革命团及红色卫戍部队，并挑选一些强壮的农民参与运动，以便开展游击战和武装起义。(Gr. 185)

由于在城市内部难以开展游击战，因此在城市内的起义及街头冲突开始之前，你们不应采取此类行动。(Great 196)

斗争对于游击战至关重要，而各村的军事准备及缴获敌人武器对于斗争亦至关重要，因此，若无公众支持，便不能宣布开展游击战，从而使其成为一种独立的军事行动。由于游击战不同于武装起义或攻打城市，你们既不应轻视后者，也不应忽视群众工作，同时也不应将全部注意力集中于前者。(Great 93)

在（6月19日晚）杀害流氓及士绅的斗争中，你们忽略了以下几点。你们未做充分准备，也未事先进行宣传。由于没有群众参与斗争，仅有我们几十名同志参加，导致次日士绅和流氓全部逃散。在那次斗争中，尽管城内的反动势力薄弱，但你们并未通过宣传和鼓动来扩大运动，反而使斗争归于无效。(Great 73)

我们的同志都乐于听闻并从事起义、局部占领及游击战。正因如此，你们忽视了日常工作，只关注军事行动的准备工作。然而，军事准备源于日常工作，且仅是起义整体准备的一部分。无产阶级革命及军事行动完全依赖于群众。军事机会主义是一种盲从教条，布尔什维克小组不应犯此类错误。你们误解了斗争的意义和行动，忘记了去做作为我们小组基础的工作。(Great 85)。

在领导群众开展抗租运动后，你们不应立即攻打并占领城市，而应加快我们的工作进度，以威胁并阻止地主及统治阶级进入乡村收租。实际上，我们将已占领这些村庄。随后，你们应扩大群众组织，发展革命影响力，待基础稳固后，方可开始游击战并公开占领——切记，在未获得良好的群众基础之前，不应建立苏维埃
